xc_files.name: main.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; TETRIS for ChipOS. Alias this computer "app-tetris".
include "chipos-appkit.xc"
storage var $best : number
array $board : number            ; 10 x 20, 0 empty, 1-7 colour
array $px : number               ; current piece block offsets (4)
array $py : number
array $spx : number             ; saved copy during the preview draw
array $spy : number
var $pc = 1                      ; current piece colour/type 1-7
var $nx = 4                      ; piece position
var $ny = 0
var $next = 2
var $score = 0
var $lines = 0
var $level = 1
var $over = 0
var $paused = 0
var $fall_next = 0
var $seed = 7

function @rnd7() : number
	$seed = mod($seed * 1103515245 + 12345 + floor(time * 1000), 2147483648)
	return floor(mod($seed / 65536, 7)) + 1

; Load the shape of type t into px/py (offsets around a pivot).
function @shape($t : number)
	$px.clear()
	$py.clear()
	if $t == 1
		$px.append(-1, 0, 1, 2)
		$py.append(0, 0, 0, 0)
	elseif $t == 2
		$px.append(0, 1, 0, 1)
		$py.append(0, 0, 1, 1)
	elseif $t == 3
		$px.append(-1, 0, 1, 0)
		$py.append(0, 0, 0, 1)
	elseif $t == 4
		$px.append(0, 1, -1, 0)
		$py.append(0, 0, 1, 1)
	elseif $t == 5
		$px.append(-1, 0, 0, 1)
		$py.append(0, 0, 1, 1)
	elseif $t == 6
		$px.append(-1, -1, 0, 1)
		$py.append(0, 1, 1, 1)
	else
		$px.append(1, -1, 0, 1)
		$py.append(0, 1, 1, 1)

function @cell($x : number, $y : number) : number
	if ($x < 0) or ($x > 9) or ($y > 19)
		return 9
	if $y < 0
		return 0
	return $board.($y * 10 + $x)

function @fits($ox : number, $oy : number) : number
	repeat 4 ($i)
		if @cell($ox + $px.$i, $oy + $py.$i) != 0
			return 0
	return 1

function @spawn()
	$pc = $next
	$next = @rnd7()
	@shape($pc)
	$nx = 4
	$ny = 0
	if !@fits($nx, $ny)
		$over = 1
		if $score > $best
			$best = $score
		@kit_beep(220, 0.6)

function @newgame()
	$board.clear()
	repeat 200 ($i)
		$board.append(0)
	$score = 0
	$lines = 0
	$level = 1
	$over = 0
	$paused = 0
	$next = @rnd7()
	@spawn()

function @rotate()
	if $pc == 2
		return
	array $ox2 : number
	array $oy2 : number
	$ox2.clear()
	$oy2.clear()
	repeat 4 ($i)
		$ox2.append($px.$i)
		$oy2.append($py.$i)
		var $tx = $px.$i
		$px.$i = -$py.$i
		$py.$i = $tx
	; simple wall kicks
	if @fits($nx, $ny)
		return
	if @fits($nx - 1, $ny)
		$nx -= 1
		return
	if @fits($nx + 1, $ny)
		$nx += 1
		return
	repeat 4 ($j)
		$px.$j = $ox2.$j
		$py.$j = $oy2.$j

function @lock()
	repeat 4 ($i)
		var $bx = $nx + $px.$i
		var $by = $ny + $py.$i
		if $by >= 0
			$board.($by * 10 + $bx) = $pc
	; clear full rows
	var $cleared = 0
	var $y = 19
	repeat 20 ($k)
		var $full = 1
		repeat 10 ($x)
			if $board.($y * 10 + $x) == 0
				$full = 0
		if $full
			$cleared += 1
			var $yy = $y
			repeat 20 ($m)
				if $yy > 0
					repeat 10 ($x2)
						$board.($yy * 10 + $x2) = $board.(($yy - 1) * 10 + $x2)
					$yy -= 1
			repeat 10 ($x3)
				$board.$x3 = 0
		else
			$y -= 1
	if $cleared > 0
		var $pts = 100
		if $cleared == 2
			$pts = 300
		elseif $cleared == 3
			$pts = 500
		elseif $cleared >= 4
			$pts = 800
		$score += $pts * $level
		$lines += $cleared
		$level = floor($lines / 10) + 1
		@kit_beep(660 + $cleared * 110, 0.12)
	@spawn()

function @step_down()
	if @fits($nx, $ny + 1)
		$ny += 1
	else
		@lock()

init
	; three coloured pieces: purple T, orange L, green S
	@kit_icon("R,-35,-21,-23,-9,#b15cff;R,-21,-21,-9,-9,#b15cff;R,-7,-21,5,-9,#b15cff;R,-21,-7,-9,5,#b15cff;R,7,-35,19,-23,#ff9a2e;R,7,-21,19,-9,#ff9a2e;R,7,-7,19,5,#ff9a2e;R,21,-7,33,5,#ff9a2e;R,-7,7,5,19,#3ddc6a;R,7,7,19,19,#3ddc6a;R,-21,21,-9,33,#3ddc6a;R,-7,21,5,33,#3ddc6a")
	@kit_app("TETRIS", "#1d2433", "T")
	$seed = mod(floor(time * 7919), 99991) + 17
	@newgame()
	$paused = 1

update
	@kit_poll()
	var $t = $kit_tap
	if $t == "new"
		@newgame()
	elseif $t == "pause"
		$paused = !$paused
	elseif (!$over) and (!$paused)
		if $t == "l"
			if @fits($nx - 1, $ny)
				$nx -= 1
		elseif $t == "r"
			if @fits($nx + 1, $ny)
				$nx += 1
		elseif $t == "rot"
			@rotate()
		elseif $t == "d"
			@step_down()
			$score += 1
		elseif $t == "drop"
			repeat 20 ($q)
				if @fits($nx, $ny + 1)
					$ny += 1
					$score += 2
			@lock()
	if $t != ""
		@kit_invalidate()
	; gravity (pauses while the app is closed)
	if (!$over) and (!$paused) and $kit_open and (time >= $fall_next)
		$fall_next = time + max(0.8 - ($level - 1) * 0.07, 0.12)
		@step_down()
		@kit_invalidate()
	if @kit_should_draw()
		@kit_begin()
		; board with the falling piece
		var $cells = ""
		repeat 200 ($i)
			var $v = $board.$i
			var $cx = mod($i, 10)
			var $cy = floor($i / 10)
			if !$over
				repeat 4 ($b)
					if ($cx == $nx + $px.$b) and ($cy == $ny + $py.$b)
						$v = $pc
			$cells = $cells & text("{}", $v)
		@kit_grid(4, 2, 46, 96, 10, 20, $cells)
		; side panel
		@kit_text(56, 3, 2.2, "accent", "TETRIS")
		var $st = text("SCORE {}", $score)
		var $lt = text("LINES {}   LEVEL {}", $lines, $level)
		var $bt = text("BEST {}", max($best, $score))
		@kit_text(56, 15, 1.4, "text", $st)
		@kit_text(56, 21, 1.1, "dim", $lt)
		@kit_text(56, 26, 1.1, "dim", $bt)
		; next piece preview (4 x 2)
		@kit_text(56, 32, 1, "dim", "NEXT")
		; keep the falling piece's rotated blocks while the preview borrows px/py
		$spx.clear()
		$spy.clear()
		repeat 4 ($sv)
			$spx.append($px.$sv)
			$spy.append($py.$sv)
		@shape($next)
		var $pv = ""
		repeat 8 ($k)
			var $kx = mod($k, 4) - 1
			var $ky = floor($k / 4)
			var $pvv = 0
			repeat 4 ($b2)
				if ($kx == $px.$b2) and ($ky == $py.$b2)
					$pvv = $next
			$pv = $pv & text("{}", $pvv)
		repeat 4 ($rs)
			$px.$rs = $spx.$rs
			$py.$rs = $spy.$rs
		@kit_grid(56, 36, 20, 10, 4, 2, $pv)
		if $over
			@kit_text(56, 49, 1.6, "bad", "GAME OVER")
		elseif $paused
			@kit_text(56, 49, 1.6, "warn", "PAUSED")
		; controls
		@kit_button("rot", 66, 56, 18, 11, "ROTATE")
		@kit_button("l", 56, 68, 13, 11, "<")
		@kit_button("d", 70, 68, 13, 11, "v")
		@kit_button("r", 84, 68, 13, 11, ">")
		@kit_button("drop", 56, 80, 41, 8, "DROP")
		var $pl = "PAUSE"
		if $paused
			$pl = "PLAY"
		@kit_button("pause", 56, 90, 20, 8, $pl)
		@kit_button("new", 77, 90, 20, 8, "NEW")
		@kit_end()

xc_files.name: chipos-appkit.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; =====================================================================
; ChipOS App Kit v3  -  include this in an app computer's program.
;  Give THIS computer any alias, and alias the ChipOS computer "chipos"
;  (both on the same router network). ChipOS finds the app by itself.
;
;  In your program:
;    include "chipos-appkit.xc"
;    init:    @kit_app("NAME", "#rrggbb", "G")    ; name, icon colour, glyph
;    update:  @kit_poll()                         ; read events first
;             if $kit_tap == "my-button" ...      ; a button was tapped
;             if @kit_should_draw()               ; only while open & changed
;                 @kit_begin()
;                 @kit_text_c(50, 20, 2, "accent", "HELLO")
;                 @kit_button("my-button", 30, 60, 40, 15, "TAP ME")
;                 @kit_end()
;  Positions and sizes are % of the app area (0-100). Text size multiplies
;  ChipOS's own text size. Colours: text, dim, accent, ok, warn, bad, or
;  #rrggbb. Do not use the characters | and ~ in your text.
;  Values from ChipOS: $kit_open, $kit_clock ("14:05"), $kit_day,
;  $kit_units (0 metric / 1 imperial), $kit_mins (minutes since day 1
;  00:00, received at $kit_mins_t on this computer's clock).
;  Text input:  @kit_input("id", "Prompt", "starting text") pops up ChipOS's
;  keyboard; when the user presses DONE, $kit_input_id / $kit_input_text are
;  set for one tick (CANCEL sets $kit_input_id and $kit_input_cancel = 1).
;  Sound: @kit_beep(880, 0.3) plays on ChipOS's buzzers (frequency Hz, s).
;  Paragraph: @kit_para(x, y, w, size, colour, text) wraps text to width w.
;  Grid: @kit_grid(x, y, w, h, cols, rows, "0012...") draws coloured cells
;  (0 empty, 1 cyan 2 yellow 3 purple 4 green 5 red 6 blue 7 orange 8 grey 9 white).
;  Animations: call @kit_invalidate() to redraw (e.g. a running stopwatch).
;  Home-screen widgets (up to 4): in init, BEFORE @kit_app:
;    @kit_widget("NAME", 2, 1)            ; name, width, height in cells
;  then in update:
;    if @kit_widget_due()                 ; about once a second / after a tap
;        @kit_begin()  ...draw with the same calls...  @kit_wend(0)
;  (@kit_wend(n) for widget n). Widgets are drawn even when the app is
;  closed. A widget button whose id starts with "open:" opens the app and
;  passes the rest of the id as $kit_tap (e.g. "open:note_3").
;  ChipOS shows the app only while this program runs (heartbeat).
;  Icon (optional, before @kit_app): @kit_icon("R,-20,-20,20,20,#ffcc00;C,0,0,10")
;  draws your own icon on the tile instead of the glyph. Units: the tile is
;  -50..50 each way, y down. Shapes, separated by ; (colour optional, white):
;    R,x1,y1,x2,y2,#rrggbb  filled box     B,x1,y1,x2,y2,#rrggbb  box outline
;    L,x1,y1,x2,y2,#rrggbb  thick line     C,x,y,r,#rrggbb        filled circle
;    O,x,y,r,#rrggbb        ring
;  Whole numbers only; up to 24 shapes. Without an icon ChipOS shows the glyph.
;  Clear data: when the user picks CLEAR DATA, $kit_clear is 1 for one tick;
;  reset your storage variables then.
; =====================================================================
const $kit_host = "chipos"
var $kit_name = ""
var $kit_manifest = ""
var $kit_open = 0
var $kit_tap = ""
var $kit_clock = ""
var $kit_day = 0
var $kit_units = 0
var $kit_mins = 0                       ; ChipOS clock, minutes since day 1 00:00
var $kit_mins_t = 0                     ; this computer's time when it arrived
var $kit_seq = -1
var $kit_rx = ""
var $kit_frame = ""
var $kit_sent = ""
var $kit_dirty = 1
var $kit_redraw_next = 0
var $kit_input_id = ""
var $kit_input_text = ""
var $kit_input_cancel = 0
var $kit_clear = 0                      ; 1 for one tick: ChipOS asked to wipe this app's data
var $kit_off = 0                        ; uninstalled: silent until this program restarts
var $kit_rq = 0
var $kit_bq = 0
var $kit_color = ""
var $kit_glyph = ""
var $kit_icon_s = ""
var $kit_wdefs = ""
var $kit_hb = 0
var $kit_hb_next = 0
var $kit_wnext = 0
var $kit_wdirty = 1
array $kit_wsent : text

function @kit_mk()
	$kit_manifest = ".kit{3}.name{" & $kit_name & "}.color{" & $kit_color & "}.glyph{" & $kit_glyph & "}.hb{" & text("{}", $kit_hb) & "}"
	if $kit_wdefs != ""
		$kit_manifest = $kit_manifest & ".widgets{" & $kit_wdefs & "}"
	if $kit_icon_s != ""
		$kit_manifest = $kit_manifest & ".icon{" & $kit_icon_s & "}"

; Your own icon (call before @kit_app). See the shapes above.
function @kit_icon($spec : text)
	$kit_icon_s = $spec

; Declare a home-screen widget (call before @kit_app).
function @kit_widget($name : text, $w : number, $h : number)
	if $kit_wdefs != ""
		$kit_wdefs = $kit_wdefs & "|"
	$kit_wdefs = $kit_wdefs & $name & text("~{}~{}", $w, $h)
	$kit_wsent.append("")

function @kit_app($name : text, $color : text, $glyph : text)
	$kit_name = $name
	$kit_color = $color
	$kit_glyph = $glyph
	@kit_mk()
	output_text($kit_host, 0, $kit_manifest)
	output_text($kit_host, 1, "")
	output_text($kit_host, 2, "")
	output_text($kit_host, 3, "")

; Call first thing in update. Sets $kit_tap for one tick when a button is tapped.
function @kit_poll()
	$kit_tap = ""
	$kit_clear = 0
	$kit_input_id = ""
	$kit_input_text = ""
	$kit_input_cancel = 0
	if $kit_off
		return
	; Heartbeat: re-publish the manifest every 2 s, so ChipOS knows we run.
	if time >= $kit_hb_next
		$kit_hb_next = time + 2
		$kit_hb += 1
		@kit_mk()
		output_text($kit_host, 0, $kit_manifest)
	if time >= $kit_redraw_next
		$kit_redraw_next = time + 5
		$kit_dirty = 1
	var $ev = $kit_rx
	if $ev == ""
		return
	var $sq = $ev.seq:number
	if $sq == $kit_seq
		return
	$kit_seq = $sq
	$kit_clock = $ev.clock
	$kit_day = $ev.day:number
	$kit_units = $ev.units:number
	$kit_mins = $ev.mins:number
	$kit_mins_t = time
	var $e = $ev.ev
	if $e == "open"
		$kit_open = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1
		$kit_tap = $ev.id
	elseif $e == "close"
		$kit_open = 0
	elseif $e == "tap"
		$kit_open = 1
		$kit_tap = $ev.id
		$kit_dirty = 1
	elseif $e == "uninstall"
		; unload: blank every output; ChipOS ignores us until we restart
		$kit_off = 1
		$kit_open = 0
		repeat 8 ($oc)
			output_text($kit_host, $oc, "")
	elseif $e == "clear"
		$kit_clear = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1
		$kit_wdirty = 1
	elseif $e == "wtap"
		$kit_tap = $ev.id
		$kit_wdirty = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1
	elseif $e == "tick"
		$kit_open = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1
	elseif $e == "input"
		$kit_input_id = $ev.id
		$kit_input_text = $ev.text
		$kit_dirty = 1
	elseif $e == "input_cancel"
		$kit_input_id = $ev.id
		$kit_input_cancel = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1

function @kit_invalidate()
	$kit_dirty = 1

; Ask ChipOS for text from the keyboard.
function @kit_input($id : text, $prompt : text, $init : text)
	if $kit_off
		return
	$kit_rq += 1
	var $rq_t = text("{}", $kit_rq)
	output_text($kit_host, 2, ".rq{" & $rq_t & "}.id{" & $id & "}.prompt{" & $prompt & "}.init{" & $init & "}")

; Beep on ChipOS's buzzers.
function @kit_beep($f : number, $d : number)
	if $kit_off
		return
	$kit_bq += 1
	var $bq_t = text("{}", $kit_bq)
	var $bf_t = text("{}", $f)
	var $bd_t = text("{}", $d)
	output_text($kit_host, 3, ".rq{" & $bq_t & "}.f{" & $bf_t & "}.d{" & $bd_t & "}")

; Redraw while open, at most once a second unless something happened.
function @kit_should_draw() : number
	return $kit_open and $kit_dirty and (!$kit_off)

function @kit_begin()
	$kit_frame = ""

function @kit_add($el : text)
	if $kit_frame != ""
		$kit_frame = $kit_frame & "|"
	$kit_frame = $kit_frame & $el

function @kit_text($x : number, $y : number, $size : number, $color : text, $t : text)
	@kit_add(text("T~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $size, $color) & $t)

function @kit_text_c($x : number, $y : number, $size : number, $color : text, $t : text)
	@kit_add(text("C~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $size, $color) & $t)

function @kit_button($id : text, $x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $label : text)
	@kit_add(text("B~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $w, $h) & $id & "~" & $label)

function @kit_box($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $color : text)
	@kit_add(text("R~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $w, $h) & $color)

function @kit_bar($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $pct : number, $color : text)
	@kit_add(text("G~{}~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $w, $h, $pct) & $color)

function @kit_para($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $size : number, $color : text, $t : text)
	@kit_add(text("P~{}~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $w, $size, $color) & $t)

function @kit_grid($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $cols : number, $rows : number, $cells : text)
	@kit_add(text("M~{}~{}~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $w, $h, $cols, $rows) & $cells)

function @kit_end()
	$kit_dirty = 0
	if $kit_off
		return
	if $kit_frame != $kit_sent
		$kit_sent = $kit_frame
		output_text($kit_host, 1, $kit_frame)

; Widgets: time to redraw? (about once a second, or right after a tap)
function @kit_widget_due() : number
	if $kit_off
		return 0
	if $kit_wdirty or (time >= $kit_wnext)
		$kit_wdirty = 0
		$kit_wnext = time + 1
		return 1
	return 0

function @kit_wend($n : number)
	if $kit_off
		return
	if ($n >= 0) and ($n < $kit_wsent.size)
		if $kit_frame != $kit_wsent.$n
			$kit_wsent.$n = $kit_frame
			output_text($kit_host, 4 + $n, $kit_frame)

; Events from ChipOS arrive on whatever port the router is on.
input.0 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.1 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.2 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.3 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.4 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.5 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.6 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.7 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.8 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.9 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.10 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.11 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.12 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.13 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.14 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0
input.15 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0

xc_files.name: flight.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - FLY (aircraft) and BOAT.
; Control surfaces: Ailerons (input -1..1), Data Junctions that fan one value
; out to several ailerons, and Small Pivots / Hinges used as flaps or rudders.
; ChipOS guesses from aliases (left / right wing, aileron, flap, rudder,
; elevator...) but the user confirms each role and which way it moved.
; Engines: Propellers (in 0 speed -1..1, 1 pitch -1..1; out 0 rot/s, 1 N),
; Turbojets (in 0 starter, 1 igniters, 2 throttle 0-1; out 3 running).
; Rocket thrusters (Mini / Small / Big: in 0 ignition, 1-2 gimbal X / Z;
; out 0 thrust N, 1 burned kg/s) have no throttle: their turbopumps
; (in 0 speed -1..1) are the throttle, and ignition follows the command.
; Pilot seat: 1 fwd/back, 2 left/right, 4 pitch, 5 roll, 6 yaw, 7 main thrust,
; 8-17 AUX 1-9, 0.
storage var $fy_ver : number
storage array $cs_a : text              ; control surfaces (alias)
storage array $cs_role : number         ; 0 none 1 left aileron 2 right aileron 3 elevator 4 rudder 5 flaps
storage array $cs_sign : number         ; +1: a positive command moved the back edge DOWN (rudder: RIGHT); 0 untested
storage array $pp_a : text              ; engines (alias)
storage array $pp_use : number          ; 1 main thrust, 0 not used, 2 manoeuvring (left alone), 3 lift (up/down keys)
storage array $pp_sign : number         ; +1 / -1 pushes forward
storage array $pp_prof : number         ; thrust profile: 0 linear 1 smooth 2 punchy 3 idle floor
storage array $pp_max : number          ; most it may give (%)
storage array $pp_gim : number          ; rockets: gimbal steering 0 off, 1 on, -1 on (reversed)
storage var $fy_on : number             ; ChipOS flies (surfaces + engines)
storage var $bt_on : number             ; ChipOS steers the boat
storage var $fy_inv : number            ; invert pitch
storage var $fy_flapkey : number        ; AUX key for flaps (0 none, 1-10)
storage var $fy_rate : number           ; control authority 0.2-1
storage var $pp_tested : number         ; the propellers were tested
var $fy_scan_t = 0
var $fy_nail = 0
var $fy_njet = 0
var $fy_nprop = 0
var $fy_nrock = 0
var $eng_redraw = 0
var $fy_types = ""                     ; device type by alias (connected now)
array $pp_seen : number                 ; most thrust seen (for the gauges)
var $fy_present = 0
var $bt_present = 0
var $fy_flap = 0                        ; flap setting 0 / 0.5 / 1
var $fy_flap_prev = 0
var $fy_thr = 0
var $fy_seated = 0
var $fy_was = 0
var $fy_showall = 0
array $fy_cand : text                   ; surface candidates now
array $fy_ctype : text
; tests
var $fy_tk = -1                         ; surface being tested
var $fy_tt = 0
var $fy_tph = 0                         ; 0 idle 1 moving 2 asking
var $pt_on = 0                          ; propeller auto test: 1 running 2 done
var $pt_k = 0
var $pt_ph = 0
var $pt_t = 0
var $pt_h0 = 0
var $pt_f = 0
var $pt_r = 0
var $pt_n = 0
var $pt_th = 0
array $pt_fwd : number
array $pt_side : number
array $pt_yaw : number
array $pt_thr : number
var $pt_note = ""
var $pt_manual = -1                     ; propeller being tested by hand

function @fy_load()
	if $fy_ver != 1
		$cs_a.clear()
		$cs_role.clear()
		$cs_sign.clear()
		$pp_a.clear()
		$pp_use.clear()
		$pp_sign.clear()
		$pp_prof.clear()
		$pp_max.clear()
		$pp_gim.clear()
		$fy_on = 0
		$bt_on = 0
		$fy_inv = 0
		$fy_flapkey = 1
		$fy_rate = 1
		$fy_ver = 1

; ---- finding things ----
function @cs_find($a : text) : number
	var $n = $cs_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $cs_a.$i == $a
			return $i
	return -1

function @pp_find($a : text) : number
	var $n = $pp_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $pp_a.$i == $a
			return $i
	return -1

; Role guess from an alias (0 = can't tell).
function @cs_guess($a : text) : number
	var $l = lower($a)
	if contains($l, "rud")
		return 4
	if contains($l, "elev") or contains($l, "stab") or contains($l, "tail")
		return 3
	if contains($l, "flap")
		return 5
	if contains($l, "ail") or contains($l, "wing")
		if contains($l, "left") or contains($l, "port") or contains($l, "-l") or contains($l, "_l")
			return 1
		if contains($l, "right") or contains($l, "star") or contains($l, "-r") or contains($l, "_r")
			return 2
	return 0

; Does an alias sound like a control surface?
function @cs_word($a : text) : number
	var $l = lower($a)
	return contains($l, "ail") or contains($l, "wing") or contains($l, "flap") or contains($l, "rud") or contains($l, "elev") or contains($l, "control") or contains($l, "surf") or contains($l, "stab") or contains($l, "tail")

function @pp_is_engine($t : text) : number
	return ($t == "Propeller") or ($t == "Turbojet") or contains($t, "Thruster") or ($t == "SmallTurboPump") or ($t == "BigTurboPump")

function @pp_pad()
	while $pp_prof.size < $pp_a.size
		$pp_prof.append(0)
	while $pp_max.size < $pp_a.size
		$pp_max.append(100)
	while $pp_gim.size < $pp_a.size
		$pp_gim.append(0)
	while $pp_seen.size < $pp_a.size
		$pp_seen.append(1)

function @pp_prof_name($p : number) : text
	if $p == 1
		return "SMOOTH"
	if $p == 2
		return "PUNCHY"
	if $p == 3
		return "IDLE 20%"
	return "LINEAR"

; Command 0..1 through an engine's profile and limit.
function @pp_shape($i : number, $c : number) : number
	var $v = clamp($c, 0, 1)
	var $p = $pp_prof.$i
	if $p == 1
		$v = $v * $v
	elseif $p == 2
		$v = sqrt($v)
	elseif ($p == 3) and ($v > 0.001)
		$v = 0.2 + 0.8 * $v
	return $v * $pp_max.$i / 100

function @fy_scan()
	if time < $fy_scan_t
		return
	$fy_scan_t = time + 3
	$fy_nail = 0
	$fy_njet = 0
	$fy_nprop = 0
	$fy_cand.clear()
	$fy_ctype.clear()
	var $nw = 0
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if $db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1
			var $t = $db_type.$j
			var $a = $db_alias.$j
			if $t == "Aileron"
				$fy_nail += 1
			elseif $t == "Turbojet"
				$fy_njet += 1
			elseif $t == "Propeller"
				$fy_nprop += 1
			elseif contains($t, "Thruster")
				$fy_nrock += 1
			elseif contains($t, "Wheel")
				$nw += 1
			if $a != ""
				var $is = 0
				if $t == "Aileron"
					$is = 1
				elseif ($t == "DataJunction") or ($t == "SmallPivot") or ($t == "SmallHinge")
					if @sol_uses($a) or ($a == $ws_vane) or @wt_uses($a)
						$is = 0
					elseif $fy_showall or @cs_word($a) or (@cs_find($a) >= 0)
						$is = 1
				if $is
					$fy_cand.append($a)
					$fy_ctype.append($t)
					if @cs_find($a) < 0
						$cs_a.append($a)
						$cs_role.append(@cs_guess($a))
						$cs_sign.append(0)
				if @pp_is_engine($t) and (@pp_find($a) < 0)
					$pp_a.append($a)
					$pp_use.append(1)
					$pp_sign.append(1)
					var $pf = 0
					if $t == "Turbojet"
						$pf = 3
					$pp_prof.append($pf)
					$pp_max.append(100)
					$pp_gim.append(0)
					$pp_tested = 0
	@pp_pad()
	; device types by alias (only what's connected now)
	$fy_types = ""
	repeat $n ($j3)
		if ($db_alias.$j3 != "") and ($db_seen.$j3 >= $scan_gen - 1)
			if ($db_cat.$j3 == 11) or ($db_cat.$j3 == 6) or ($db_cat.$j3 == 10) or ($db_type.$j3 == "SmallTurboPump") or ($db_type.$j3 == "BigTurboPump")
				var $ka = $db_alias.$j3
				$fy_types.$ka = $db_type.$j3
	$fy_present = ($cfg_arch == 2) or ($cfg_arch == 4) or ($fy_nail > 0) or ($fy_njet > 0) or ($fy_nrock > 0)
	$bt_present = ($cfg_arch == 3) or (($fy_nprop > 0) and ($fy_nail == 0) and ($fy_njet == 0) and ($nw == 0))

; Type of an aliased device ("" = not here now); cached by the scan.
function @fy_type_of($a : text) : text
	return $fy_types.$a

; A surface's full-scale command: ailerons and junctions -1..1; pivots and
; hinges move a lot per unit, so they get a small range (about 25 degrees).
function @cs_scale($a : text) : number
	var $t = @fy_type_of($a)
	if $t == "SmallPivot"
		return 0.07
	if $t == "SmallHinge"
		return 0.28
	return 1

function @cs_role_name($r : number) : text
	if $r == 1
		return "LEFT AILERON"
	if $r == 2
		return "RIGHT AILERON"
	if $r == 3
		return "ELEVATOR"
	if $r == 4
		return "RUDDER"
	if $r == 5
		return "FLAPS"
	return "NOT USED"

; ---- surface test: move it, then ask which way ----
function @cs_test_start($i : number)
	$fy_tk = $i
	$fy_tph = 1
	$fy_tt = time + 2.5
	@out_n($cs_a.$i, 0, 0.6 * @cs_scale($cs_a.$i))

function @cs_test_tick()
	if ($fy_tph == 1) and (time >= $fy_tt)
		@out_n($cs_a.$fy_tk, 0, 0)
		$fy_tph = 2
		$ui_dirty = 1

; ---- propeller test (with a nav: which way it pushes, or if it's for manoeuvring) ----
function @pt_start()
	$pt_on = 1
	$pt_k = -1
	$pt_ph = 2
	$pt_t = time
	$pt_fwd.clear()
	$pt_side.clear()
	$pt_yaw.clear()
	$pt_thr.clear()
	var $n = $pp_a.size
	repeat $n ($q)
		$pt_fwd.append(0)
		$pt_side.append(0)
		$pt_yaw.append(0)
		$pt_thr.append(0)
	$pt_note = "STARTING"

function @pt_finish()
	var $n = $pp_a.size
	var $mx = 0
	repeat $n ($k)
		$mx = max($mx, abs($pt_thr.$k))
	var $nd = 0
	repeat $n ($k2)
		if @fy_type_of($pp_a.$k2) == "Propeller"
			var $f = $pt_fwd.$k2
			var $s = $pt_side.$k2
			var $main = (abs($f) > 0.05) and (abs($f) > abs($s) * 2)
			if $att_nav == ""
				; no nav: the strongest propellers drive (direction set by hand)
				$main = 1
			; much weaker than the biggest: a manoeuvring propeller
			if ($mx > 0) and (abs($pt_thr.$k2) < $mx * 0.3)
				$main = 0
			if $main
				$pp_use.$k2 = 1
				if $att_nav != ""
					$pp_sign.$k2 = 1
					if $f < 0
						$pp_sign.$k2 = -1
				$nd += 1
			else
				$pp_use.$k2 = 2
	$pt_note = text("{} DRIVE PROPELLER(S); THE OTHERS ARE LEFT FOR MANOEUVRING.", $nd)
	if $nd == 0
		$pt_note = "NONE PUSHED FORWARD - CHECK POWER / THE NAV, OR SET THEM BY HAND"
	if $att_nav == ""
		$pt_note = $pt_note & " NO NAV: CHECK EACH ONE'S FWD / REV BELOW."
	$pp_tested = 1
	$pt_on = 2

function @pt_tick()
	@att_find_nav()
	var $n = $pp_a.size
	if time < $pt_t
		if $pt_ph == 1
			$pt_f += @in_n($att_nav, 11)
			$pt_r += @in_n($att_nav, 12)
			$pt_th = max($pt_th, abs(@in_n($pp_a.$pt_k, 1)))
			$pt_n += 1
		return
	if $pt_ph == 2
		$pt_k += 1
		repeat $n ($q)
			if $pt_k < $n
				if @fy_type_of($pp_a.$pt_k) != "Propeller"
					$pt_k += 1
		if $pt_k >= $n
			@pt_finish()
			$ui_dirty = 1
			return
		$pt_ph = 0
		$pt_t = time + 3
		$pt_note = text("PROPELLER {} OF {}: ", $pt_k + 1, $n) & $pp_a.$pt_k
		$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	if $pt_ph == 0
		$pt_h0 = @in_n($att_nav, 6)
		$pt_f = 0
		$pt_r = 0
		$pt_n = 0
		$pt_th = 0
		@out_n($pp_a.$pt_k, 1, 1)
		@out_n($pp_a.$pt_k, 0, 0.5)
		$pt_ph = 1
		$pt_t = time + 4
		return
	if $pt_ph == 1
		@out_n($pp_a.$pt_k, 0, 0)
		$pt_fwd.$pt_k = $pt_f / max($pt_n, 1)
		$pt_side.$pt_k = $pt_r / max($pt_n, 1)
		$pt_yaw.$pt_k = @posmod(@in_n($att_nav, 6) - $pt_h0 + 180, 360) - 180
		$pt_thr.$pt_k = $pt_th
		$pt_ph = 2
		$pt_t = time + 4

; ---- flying / sailing ----
function @fy_seat_in($c : number) : number
	if $dv_seat_now == ""
		return 0
	return clamp(@in_n($dv_seat_now, $c), -1, 1)

; Back-edge-down command for every surface of a role.
function @cs_drive($role : number, $v : number)
	var $n = $cs_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if ($cs_role.$i == $role) and (@fy_type_of($cs_a.$i) != "")
			var $sg = $cs_sign.$i
			if $sg == 0
				$sg = 1
			@out_n($cs_a.$i, 0, clamp($v, -1, 1) * $sg * @cs_scale($cs_a.$i))

; Main engines follow $thr (boats: -1..1), lift engines $lift; rockets
; can steer with their gimbals ($pit, $yaw).
function @pp_drive($thr : number, $lift : number, $pit : number, $yaw : number)
	@pp_pad()
	var $n = $pp_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $a = $pp_a.$i
		var $u = $pp_use.$i
		if (($u == 1) or ($u == 3)) and (@fy_type_of($a) != "")
			var $t = @fy_type_of($a)
			var $c = $thr
			if $u == 3
				$c = $lift
			var $neg = $c < 0
			var $v = @pp_shape($i, abs($c))
			if $neg
				$v = -$v
			if $t == "Propeller"
				@out_n($a, 1, 1)
				@out_n($a, 0, $v * $pp_sign.$i)
			elseif $t == "Turbojet"
				var $run = @in_n($a, 3) != 0
				var $want = $v > 0.02
				@out_n($a, 0, $want and !$run)
				@out_n($a, 1, $want or $run)
				@out_n($a, 2, max($v, 0))
			elseif contains($t, "Thruster")
				@out_n($a, 0, $v > 0.01)
				if $t != "MiniThruster"
					var $g = $pp_gim.$i
					@out_n($a, 1, clamp($yaw * $g, -1, 1))
					@out_n($a, 2, clamp($pit * $g, -1, 1))
			else
				; turbopump feeding the rockets: its speed is the throttle
				@out_n($a, 0, max($v, 0))

function @fy_tick()
	@fy_scan()
	if $fy_tph > 0
		@cs_test_tick()
		return
	if $pt_on == 1
		@pt_tick()
		return
	var $on = ($fy_on and $fy_present) or ($bt_on and $bt_present)
	if !$on
		if $fy_was
			; hand everything back: neutral surfaces, engines idle
			@cs_drive(1, 0)
			@cs_drive(2, 0)
			@cs_drive(3, 0)
			@cs_drive(4, 0)
			@cs_drive(5, 0)
			@pp_drive(0, 0, 0, 0)
			$fy_was = 0
		return
	$fy_was = 1
	; live gauges: redraw once a second while engines are in use
	if time >= $eng_redraw
		$eng_redraw = time + 1
		$ui_dirty = 1
		$panels_dirty = 1
	$fy_seated = 0
	if $dv_seat_now != ""
		$fy_seated = @in_n($dv_seat_now, 0) != 0
	if !$fy_seated
		@cs_drive(1, 0)
		@cs_drive(2, 0)
		@cs_drive(3, 0)
		@cs_drive(4, 0)
		@pp_drive(0, 0, 0, 0)
		$fy_thr = 0
		return
	if $bt_on and $bt_present and !($fy_on and $fy_present)
		; boat: W/S (or the main thrust lever) and A/D (or yaw)
		var $thr = @fy_seat_in(7)
		if abs($thr) < 0.01
			$thr = @fy_seat_in(1)
		var $st = @fy_seat_in(2)
		if abs($st) < 0.01
			$st = @fy_seat_in(6)
		$fy_thr = $thr
		@cs_drive(4, $st * $fy_rate)
		@pp_drive($thr, 0, 0, 0)
		return
	var $pitch = @fy_seat_in(4)
	if $fy_inv
		$pitch = -$pitch
	var $roll = @fy_seat_in(5)
	var $yaw = @fy_seat_in(6)
	var $thr2 = max(0, @fy_seat_in(7))
	$fy_thr = $thr2
	; roll right: left aileron down, right aileron up; pull back: elevator up
	@cs_drive(1, $roll * $fy_rate)
	@cs_drive(2, -$roll * $fy_rate)
	@cs_drive(3, -$pitch * $fy_rate)
	@cs_drive(4, $yaw * $fy_rate)
	; flaps: each press of the flap key steps 0 -> half -> full -> 0
	if $fy_flapkey > 0
		var $k = @in_n($dv_seat_now, 7 + $fy_flapkey) != 0
		if $k and !$fy_flap_prev
			$fy_flap = $fy_flap + 0.5
			if $fy_flap > 1
				$fy_flap = 0
			@ui_toast(text("FLAPS {0}%", $fy_flap * 100))
		$fy_flap_prev = $k
	@cs_drive(5, $fy_flap)
	@pp_drive($thr2, max(0, @fy_seat_in(3)), $pitch, $yaw)

; ---- ENGINES widget: every engine's live numbers with a bar ----
function @fmt_force($n : number) : text
	if $cfg_units
		return text("{0.0} klbf", $n * 0.000224809)
	return text("{0.0} kN", $n / 1000)

function @fmt_flow($k : number) : text
	if $cfg_units
		return text("{0.00} lb/s", $k * 2.20462)
	return text("{0.00} kg/s", $k)

var $eng_frac = 0
; One engine as text; $eng_frac = how hard it works (0-1).
function @eng_line($i : number) : text
	@pp_pad()
	var $a = $pp_a.$i
	var $t = @fy_type_of($a)
	$eng_frac = 0
	if $t == "Propeller"
		var $th = abs(@in_n($a, 1))
		$pp_seen.$i = max($pp_seen.$i, $th)
		$eng_frac = $th / $pp_seen.$i
		return $a & text("  {0} rpm  ", abs(@in_n($a, 0)) * 60) & @fmt_force($th)
	if $t == "Turbojet"
		var $n1 = @in_n($a, 0)
		$eng_frac = clamp($n1 / 100, 0, 1)
		var $st = @in_t($a, 6)
		if (@in_n($a, 3) == 0) and ($st != "")
			return $a & "  " & upper($st)
		return $a & text("  N1 {0}%  EGT ", $n1) & @ws_temp_s(@in_n($a, 2))
	if contains($t, "Thruster")
		var $tr = @in_n($a, 0)
		$pp_seen.$i = max($pp_seen.$i, $tr)
		$eng_frac = $tr / $pp_seen.$i
		return $a & "  " & @fmt_force($tr) & "  " & @fmt_flow(@in_n($a, 1))
	return ""

function @eng_widget($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number)
	@ui_box($x, $y, $w, $h, $th_panel, $th_line)
	@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $chh * 0.3, $th_dim, "ENGINES", $w - $cw)
	var $ly = $y + $chh * 1.6
	var $n = $pp_a.size
	var $shown = 0
	repeat $n ($i)
		if @db_has_alias($pp_a.$i)
			var $l = @eng_line($i)
			if ($l != "") and ($ly + $chh * 1.8 <= $y + $h)
				@ui_text($x + $cw * 0.6, $ly, $th_text, @ui_fit($l, floor(($w - $cw * 1.2) / $cw)))
				var $by = $ly + $chh * 1.2
				var $bw = $w - $cw * 1.2
				@ui_box($x + $cw * 0.6, $by, $bw, $chh * 0.5, $th_bg, $th_line)
				var $col = $th_accent
				if ($eng_frac > 0.95) and (@fy_type_of($pp_a.$i) == "Turbojet")
					$col = $th_warn
				if $eng_frac > 0.01
					@ui_box($x + $cw * 0.6, $by, max(2, $bw * clamp($eng_frac, 0, 1)), $chh * 0.5, $col, $col)
				$ly += $chh * 2.2
				$shown += 1
	if $shown == 0
		@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $h / 2 - $chh / 2, $th_dim, "NO ENGINES", $w - $cw)

xc_files.name: arch.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - "WHAT AM I?": guess the build's archetype from its devices.
; 0 BASE, 1 VEHICLE, 2 AIRCRAFT, 3 BOAT, 4 SPACECRAFT
storage var $cfg_arch_ver : number
storage var $cfg_arch : number
storage var $cfg_sub : number
var $ar_guess = 0
var $ar_sub_guess = 0
var $ar_reason = ""
var $ar_sel = 0
var $ar_sub_sel = 0
var $ar_len = 0
var $ar_wid = 0
var $ar_mass = 0
array $home_order : number

function @arch_load()
	if $cfg_arch_ver != 1
		$cfg_arch = -1
		$cfg_sub = 0
		$cfg_arch_ver = 1

function @arch_name($a : number) : text
	if $a == 1
		return "VEHICLE"
	if $a == 2
		return "AIRCRAFT"
	if $a == 3
		return "BOAT"
	if $a == 4
		return "SPACECRAFT"
	return "BASE"

function @arch_desc($a : number) : text
	if $a == 1
		return "rover, car, truck, train"
	if $a == 2
		return "plane, helicopter, quadcopter"
	if $a == 3
		return "boats and ships"
	if $a == 4
		return "rocket, lander, station"
	return "ground structure"

function @sub_count($a : number) : number
	if $a == 0
		return 4
	return 3

function @sub_name($a : number, $s : number) : text
	if $a == 0
		if $s == 0
			return "COMMS CENTER"
		if $s == 1
			return "INVENTORY / FACTORY"
		if $s == 2
			return "POWER STATION"
		return "OUTPOST"
	if $a == 1
		if $s == 0
			return "ROVER"
		if $s == 1
			return "CAR / TRUCK"
		return "TRAIN"
	if $a == 2
		if $s == 0
			return "PLANE"
		if $s == 1
			return "HELICOPTER"
		return "QUADCOPTER"
	if $a == 3
		if $s == 0
			return "SMALL BOAT"
		if $s == 1
			return "MEDIUM BOAT"
		return "LARGE SHIP"
	if $s == 0
		return "ROCKET"
	if $s == 1
		return "LANDER"
	return "STATION"

function @arch_question($a : number) : text
	if $a == 0
		return "WHAT KIND OF BASE?"
	if $a == 1
		return "WHAT KIND OF VEHICLE?"
	if $a == 2
		return "WHAT KIND OF AIRCRAFT?"
	if $a == 3
		return "HOW BIG IS THE BOAT?"
	return "WHAT KIND OF SPACECRAFT?"

function @arch_count_type($ct : text) : number
	var $cn = 0
	var $c_n = $db_id.size
	repeat $c_n ($ci)
		if (($db_seen.$ci >= $scan_gen - 1)) and contains($db_type.$ci, $ct)
			$cn += 1
	return $cn

; Extents (m) and component mass from every present device's record.
function @arch_measure()
	var $mx1 = 1000000
	var $mx2 = -1000000
	var $mz1 = 1000000
	var $mz2 = -1000000
	$ar_mass = 0
	var $m_n = $db_id.size
	repeat $m_n ($mi)
		if ($db_seen.$mi >= $scan_gen - 1)
			var $md = device($db_id.$mi)
			var $m_x = $md.x:number
			var $m_z = $md.z:number
			var $m_m = $md.mass:number
			$mx1 = min($mx1, $m_x)
			$mx2 = max($mx2, $m_x)
			$mz1 = min($mz1, $m_z)
			$mz2 = max($mz2, $m_z)
			$ar_mass += $m_m
	var $m_dx = max($mx2 - $mx1, 0)
	var $m_dz = max($mz2 - $mz1, 0)
	$ar_len = max($m_dx, $m_dz)
	$ar_wid = min($m_dx, $m_dz)

function @arch_detect()
	var $props = @arch_count_type("Propeller")
	var $ails = @arch_count_type("Aileron")
	var $jets = @arch_count_type("Turbojet")
	var $thr = @arch_count_type("Thruster")
	var $wheels = @arch_count_type("Wheel")
	var $vols = @arch_count_type("Volume")
	var $pivots = @arch_count_type("Pivot")
	var $beacons = @arch_count_type("Beacon")
	var $bats = @arch_count_type("Battery")
	var $solar = @arch_count_type("SolarPanel")
	var $conts = @arch_count_type("Container")
	var $craft = @arch_count_type("Crafter") + @arch_count_type("Furnace") + @arch_count_type("Centrifuge") + @arch_count_type("Electrolyser") + @arch_count_type("Crusher")
	var $anchor = @arch_count_type("Anchor")
	var $seats = @arch_count_type("Seat") + @arch_count_type("Throttle") + @arch_count_type("VehiclePhysics")
	; Propellers can be wind generators now: weigh flight against base evidence.
	var $prop_w = 1
	if ($ails > 0) or ($pivots >= $props)
		$prop_w = 2
	var $flight = $ails * 3 + $jets * 3 + $props * $prop_w + $seats * 2
	var $basey = 0
	if $solar >= 4
		$basey += 3
	if $bats >= 10
		$basey += 2
	if ($conts + $craft) >= 3
		$basey += 2
	if $beacons >= 3
		$basey += 1
	var $props_gen = ($props > 0) and ($ails == 0) and ($jets == 0) and ($flight <= $basey)
	@arch_measure()
	$ar_guess = 0
	$ar_sub_guess = 3
	var $why = ""
	if ($vols > 0) and ($wheels == 0) and ($ails == 0) and ($props < 4) and (($props + $thr) > 0)
		$ar_guess = 3
		$why = text("Found: {} buoyancy volume(s), {} propeller(s)/thruster(s), no wheels or ailerons", $vols, $props + $thr)
		$ar_sub_guess = 1
		if $ar_len < 8
			$ar_sub_guess = 0
		elseif $ar_len > 25
			$ar_sub_guess = 2
	elseif (($props + $jets + $ails) > 0) and (!$props_gen)
		$ar_guess = 2
		if ($props >= 4) and (($ails == 0) or ($pivots >= $props))
			$ar_sub_guess = 2
			$why = text("Found: {} propellers, {} pivots, {} ailerons", $props, $pivots, $ails)
		elseif ($ails > 0) or ($jets > 0)
			$ar_sub_guess = 0
			$why = text("Found: {} propeller(s), {} jet(s), {} ailerons", $props, $jets, $ails)
		else
			$ar_sub_guess = 1
			$why = text("Found: {} propeller(s), no ailerons", $props)
	elseif $wheels >= 2
		$ar_guess = 1
		$ar_sub_guess = 1
		if ($wheels >= 8) and ($ar_len > 3 * max($ar_wid, 1))
			$ar_sub_guess = 2
		elseif $ar_len < 4
			$ar_sub_guess = 0
		$why = text("Found: {} wheels, about {0} m long", $wheels, $ar_len)
	elseif $thr > 0
		$ar_guess = 4
		$ar_sub_guess = 0
		if ($anchor > 0) or ($thr <= 2)
			$ar_sub_guess = 1
		$why = text("Found: {} thruster(s), no propellers or wheels", $thr)
	else
		$ar_guess = 0
		if ($conts + $craft) >= 3
			$ar_sub_guess = 1
		elseif ($bats >= 10) or ($solar >= 4)
			$ar_sub_guess = 2
		elseif $beacons >= 3
			$ar_sub_guess = 0
		else
			$ar_sub_guess = 3
		$why = text("No propulsion. Found: {} beacons, {} batteries, {} solar panels, {} containers/machines", $beacons, $bats, $solar, $conts + $craft)
		if $props_gen
			$why = text("Base equipment plus {} propeller(s) - counted as wind generators. Found: {} beacons, {} batteries, {} solar panels", $props, $beacons, $bats, $solar)
	$ar_reason = $why
	var $lg_a = @arch_name($ar_guess)
	var $lg_s = @sub_name($ar_guess, $ar_sub_guess)
	@os_log(text("WHAT AM I guess: {} / {} - {}", $lg_a, $lg_s, $why))

; Home tile order for the chosen archetype (most relevant categories first).
function @home_order_build()
	$home_order.clear()
	var $ha = $cfg_arch
	if $ha == 0
		if $cfg_sub == 1
			$home_order.append(8, 9, 7, 3, 13, 2, 1, 4)
		elseif $cfg_sub == 2
			$home_order.append(3, 13, 2, 9, 7, 1, 4, 8)
		else
			$home_order.append(4, 3, 13, 2, 1, 7, 8, 9)
	elseif $ha == 2
		$home_order.append(3, 11, 1, 12, 4, 10, 2, 7)
	elseif $ha == 1
		$home_order.append(3, 11, 1, 7, 12, 4, 8, 2)
	elseif $ha == 3
		$home_order.append(3, 11, 7, 1, 12, 4, 8, 2)
	elseif $ha == 4
		$home_order.append(3, 11, 7, 12, 4, 13, 1, 2)
	else
		$home_order.append(1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 13)
	; Everything else after, OTHER last.
	repeat $cat_count ($hb)
		var $hc = mod($hb + 1, $cat_count)
		var $h_have = 0
		var $h_n = $home_order.size
		repeat $h_n ($hk)
			if $home_order.$hk == $hc
				$h_have = 1
		if !$h_have
			$home_order.append($hc)

xc_files.name: weather.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - WEATHER station: a Density Sensor (air density + composition),
; a thermometer (Temperature Sensor) and a Nav Instrument or Altitude Sensor.
; The user confirms they are OUTSIDE before the app turns on.
; Wind: two or more Nav Instruments facing different ways (each one's
; forward airspeed is the wind along its heading), or one Nav Instrument on
; a pivot that ChipOS turns all the way round to sample every heading.
; Weather maths (air pressure from density, humidity, dew point, cloud
; base) follows the user's own Smart Quad weather page.
storage var $ws_ver : number
storage var $ws_state : number          ; 0 ask, 1 on (outside), 2 declined
storage var $ws_nans : number           ; sensors counted when declined
storage var $ws_bc : number             ; broadcast: 0 off, 1 in ChipOS broadcast, 2 own frequency
storage var $ws_freq : text             ; own broadcast frequency
storage var $ws_vane : text             ; pivot that carries the wind nav
storage var $ws_vnav : text             ; ... and that nav
storage array $ws_ph : number           ; pressure history (hPa), one every 10 min
storage array $ws_tt : number           ; temperature history (K), same times
storage var $ws_hnext : number
var $ws_dens = ""
var $ws_therm = ""
var $ws_alt = ""
var $ws_ndens = 0
var $ws_ntherm = 0
var $ws_navs = 0
var $ws_avail = 0                       ; instruments for a station are here
var $ws_scan_t = 0
var $ws_t = 0                           ; next reading
var $ws_ok = 0                          ; a reading worked
var $ws_tk = 0                          ; air temperature K
var $ws_rho = 0
var $ws_molar = 0
var $ws_h2o = -1
var $ws_comp = 0
var $ws_comp_seen = "!"
var $ws_p = 0                           ; pressure Pa
var $ws_rh = -1
var $ws_dew = -1000                     ; C
var $ws_cloud = -1                      ; m
var $ws_altm = 0
var $ws_day = -1
var $ws_cond = "NO DATA"
var $ws_fore = ""
var $ws_icon = 3                        ; 0 sun 1 moon 2 cloud 3 unknown 4 fog 5 worse
var $ws_seen = 0                        ; last good reading (time)
; wind
array $wn_a : text                      ; nav aliases
array $wn_c : text                      ; v0.25.1: candidates (all navs but the solar one)
storage array $ws_navsel : text         ; navs the user picked for wind
var $ws_nav_ask = 0                     ; more than 4 candidates and none picked
var $ws_nav_later = 0
var $wn_ok = 0
var $wn_spd = 0                         ; m/s
var $wn_from = 0                        ; degrees the wind comes from
var $wn_how = ""
var $wn_t = 0
var $vn_k = -1                          ; vane sweep step (-1 idle)
var $vn_t = 0
var $vn_next = 0
var $vn_sx = 0                          ; least-squares sums
var $vn_sy = 0
var $vn_sxx = 0
var $vn_syy = 0
var $vn_sxy = 0
var $vn_find = 0                        ; finding which pivot turns the nav
var $vn_fi = 0
var $vn_h0 = 0
array $vn_piv : text
var $ws_pkt = ""                        ; chip.weather packet of this station

function @ws_load()
	if $ws_ver != 1
		$ws_state = 0
		$ws_nans = 0
		$ws_bc = 0
		$ws_freq = ""
		$ws_vane = ""
		$ws_vnav = ""
		$ws_ph.clear()
		$ws_tt.clear()
		$ws_hnext = 0
		$ws_ver = 1

function @ws_species($name : text) : number
	var $k = lower($name)
	if $k == "n2"
		return 0.0280134
	if $k == "o2"
		return 0.0319988
	if $k == "ar"
		return 0.039948
	if $k == "co2"
		return 0.0440095
	if $k == "ch4"
		return 0.016043
	if $k == "h2o"
		return 0.01801528
	if $k == "h2"
		return 0.00201588
	if $k == "he"
		return 0.004002602
	if $k == "co"
		return 0.0280101
	if $k == "ne"
		return 0.0201797
	if $k == "kr"
		return 0.083798
	return 0

function @ws_composition($p : text)
	if $p == $ws_comp_seen
		return
	$ws_comp_seen = $p
	$ws_comp = 0
	$ws_molar = 0
	$ws_h2o = -1
	if (size($p) == 0) or (size($p) > 2048)
		return
	var $tot = 0
	var $wt = 0
	var $water = -1
	var $cnt = 0
	foreach $p ($name, $value)
		$cnt += 1
		if ($cnt > 16) or !isnumeric($value)
			return
		var $f = $value:number
		if ($f < 0) or ($f > 102)
			return
		var $m = @ws_species($name)
		if ($f > 0) and ($m <= 0)
			return
		if lower($name) == "h2o"
			$water = $f
		$tot += $f
		$wt += $f * $m
	if !((($tot >= 0.98) and ($tot <= 1.02)) or (($tot >= 98) and ($tot <= 102)))
		return
	if ($cnt == 0) or ($wt <= 0)
		return
	$ws_molar = $wt / $tot
	if $water >= 0
		$ws_h2o = $water / $tot
	$ws_comp = 1

; Find the instruments (every 3 s).
function @ws_scan()
	if time < $ws_scan_t
		return
	$ws_scan_t = time + 3
	$ws_dens = ""
	$ws_therm = ""
	$ws_alt = ""
	$ws_ndens = 0
	$ws_ntherm = 0
	$wn_a.clear()
	$wn_c.clear()
	$vn_piv.clear()
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			var $t = $db_type.$j
			var $a = $db_alias.$j
			if $t == "DensitySensor"
				$ws_ndens += 1
				if $ws_dens == ""
					$ws_dens = $a
			elseif $t == "TemperatureSensor"
				$ws_ntherm += 1
				if $ws_therm == ""
					$ws_therm = $a
			elseif $t == "AltitudeSensor"
				if $ws_alt == ""
					$ws_alt = $a
			elseif contains($t, "NavInstrument")
				if $a != @so_nav_used()
					$wn_c.append($a)
			elseif $t == "SmallPivot"
				$vn_piv.append($a)
	; v0.25.1: picked navs only; up to 4 are used as they are; more: ask.
	var $nc = $wn_c.size
	var $nsel = $ws_navsel.size
	$ws_nav_ask = 0
	if $nsel > 0
		repeat $nc ($c1)
			var $ca = $wn_c.$c1
			repeat $nsel ($c2)
				if $ws_navsel.$c2 == $ca
					$wn_a.append($ca)
	elseif $nc > 4
		$ws_nav_ask = 1
	else
		repeat $nc ($c3)
			$wn_a.append($wn_c.$c3)
	$ws_navs = $wn_a.size
	$ws_avail = ($ws_ndens > 0) and ($ws_ntherm > 0) and (($nc > 0) or ($ws_alt != ""))
	; declined before: ask again once more instruments like these are added
	if ($ws_state == 2) and ($ws_ndens + $ws_ntherm > $ws_nans)
		$ws_state = 0

function @ws_on() : number
	return $ws_avail and ($ws_state == 1)

; One reading of the station.
function @ws_read()
	$ws_ok = 0
	$ws_rho = @in_n($ws_dens, 0)
	@ws_composition(@in_t($ws_dens, 1))
	$ws_tk = @in_n($ws_therm, 0)
	if $ws_alt != ""
		$ws_altm = @in_n($ws_alt, 0)
	elseif $ws_navs > 0
		$ws_altm = @in_n($wn_a.0, 2)
	$ws_p = 0
	$ws_rh = -1
	$ws_dew = -1000
	$ws_cloud = -1
	$ws_cond = "NO DATA"
	if ($ws_tk < 150) or ($ws_tk > 500)
		$ws_cond = "NO TEMPERATURE"
		return
	if !(($ws_rho > 0) and ($ws_rho < 100))
		$ws_cond = "NO AIR DATA"
		return
	if !$ws_comp
		$ws_cond = "CHECK DENSITY SENSOR"
		return
	$ws_ok = 1
	$ws_seen = time
	$ws_p = $ws_rho * 8.314462618 * $ws_tk / $ws_molar
	var $c = $ws_tk - 273.15
	if ($ws_h2o >= 0) and ($c > -40) and ($c < 50)
		var $sat = 611.2 * pow(2.718281828459045, 17.67 * $c / ($c + 243.5))
		var $vap = $ws_h2o * $ws_p
		$ws_rh = clamp(100 * $vap / $sat, 0, 100)
		if $vap > 0
			var $vl = log($vap / 611.2, 2.718281828459045)
			var $dew = 243.5 * $vl / (17.67 - $vl)
			if ($dew > -80) and ($dew < 50)
				$ws_dew = min($dew, $c)
				$ws_cloud = max(0, $c - $ws_dew) * 121.92
	; day or night: the sun model, else solar panels making power
	$ws_day = @sun_up()
	if $ws_day < 0
		if $ps_idx.size > 0
			$ws_day = $pw_solar > 50

; Pressure tendency over the stored history (hPa per 3 h, 9999 = unknown).
function @ws_trend() : number
	var $n = $ws_ph.size
	if $n < 4
		return 9999
	var $k = max(0, $n - 19)
	var $dt = ($n - 1 - $k) / 6
	if $dt <= 0
		return 9999
	return ($ws_ph.($n - 1) - $ws_ph.$k) * 3 / $dt

function @ws_classify()
	if !$ws_ok
		$ws_icon = 3
		$ws_fore = ""
		return
	var $tr = @ws_trend()
	$ws_fore = "COLLECTING PRESSURE TREND"
	if $tr != 9999
		$ws_fore = "STEADY"
		if $tr < -3
			$ws_fore = "GETTING WORSE"
			if $tr < -6
				$ws_fore = "STORMY"
		elseif $tr > 3
			$ws_fore = "IMPROVING"
	if $ws_rh >= 98
		$ws_cond = "FOG / LOW CLOUD"
		$ws_icon = 4
	elseif ($ws_rh >= 80) or ($ws_fore == "GETTING WORSE") or ($ws_fore == "STORMY")
		$ws_cond = "CLOUDY"
		$ws_icon = 2
		if ($ws_rh >= 90) and (($ws_fore == "GETTING WORSE") or ($ws_fore == "STORMY"))
			$ws_cond = "RAIN LIKELY"
			$ws_icon = 5
	elseif $ws_day == 0
		$ws_cond = "CLEAR NIGHT"
		$ws_icon = 1
	else
		$ws_cond = "CLEAR"
		$ws_icon = 0

; ---- wind ----
; Least squares: airspeed a = -(wind . forward), forward = (sin h, cos h).
function @wn_add($h : number, $a : number)
	var $fx = sin($h * pi / 180)
	var $fy = cos($h * pi / 180)
	$vn_sxx += $fx * $fx
	$vn_syy += $fy * $fy
	$vn_sxy += $fx * $fy
	$vn_sx += -$a * $fx
	$vn_sy += -$a * $fy

function @wn_clear()
	$vn_sx = 0
	$vn_sy = 0
	$vn_sxx = 0
	$vn_syy = 0
	$vn_sxy = 0

; Solve; returns 1 when the headings were spread enough.
function @wn_solve($how : text) : number
	var $det = $vn_sxx * $vn_syy - $vn_sxy * $vn_sxy
	if $det < 0.2
		return 0
	var $wx = ($vn_sx * $vn_syy - $vn_sy * $vn_sxy) / $det
	var $wy = ($vn_sy * $vn_sxx - $vn_sx * $vn_sxy) / $det
	$wn_spd = sqrt($wx * $wx + $wy * $wy)
	; meteorological: where it comes FROM
	$wn_from = @posmod(atan(-$wx, -$wy) * 180 / pi, 360)
	if $wn_spd < 0.2
		$wn_from = 0
	$wn_ok = 1
	$wn_t = time
	$wn_how = $how
	return 1

; Is the build standing still (wind only makes sense then)?
function @wn_still() : number
	if $ws_navs == 0
		return 1
	return abs(@in_n($wn_a.0, 10)) < 0.5

function @db_has_alias($a : text) : number
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if ($db_alias.$j == $a) and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			return 1
	return 0

; Which pivot turns the nav: turn each a quarter and watch the heading.
function @wn_vane_tick()
	; v0.24.1: the solar tracker owns its pivot. If the weather station was
	; switched on first, its vane search could pick the solar pivot (it turns
	; the array's mini nav) and then sweep it back to 0 every 2 minutes,
	; fighting the tracker. Hand it back, and never search while the solar
	; tracker is still finding its own joints.
	if ($ws_vane != "") and (@sol_uses($ws_vane) or @wt_uses($ws_vane))
		$ws_vane = ""
		$ws_vnav = ""
		$vn_find = 0
		$vn_k = 0
		$vn_next = time + 600
		return
	if ((($so_state == 1) and ($so_piv == "")) or ($wt_mode == 1)) and ($ws_vane == "")
		$vn_find = 0
		return
	var $pv = $ws_vane
	if ($pv == "") or !@db_has_alias($pv)
		if !$vn_find
			if time < $vn_next
				return
			$vn_find = 1
			$vn_fi = 0
			$vn_k = 0
		if $vn_fi >= $vn_piv.size
			$vn_find = 0
			$vn_next = time + 600
			return
		var $cand = $vn_piv.$vn_fi
		if @sol_uses($cand) or @wt_uses($cand)
			$vn_fi += 1
			return
		if $vn_k == 0
			@out_n($cand, 0, 0)
			$vn_t = time + 3
			$vn_k = 1
		elseif ($vn_k == 1) and (time >= $vn_t)
			$vn_h0 = @in_n($wn_a.0, 6)
			@out_n($cand, 0, 0.25)
			$vn_t = time + 4
			$vn_k = 2
		elseif ($vn_k == 2) and (time >= $vn_t)
			var $dh = abs(@posmod(@in_n($wn_a.0, 6) - $vn_h0 + 180, 360) - 180)
			@out_n($cand, 0, 0)
			if ($dh > 45) and ($dh < 135)
				$ws_vane = $cand
				$ws_vnav = $wn_a.0
				$vn_find = 0
				$vn_k = -1
				$vn_next = time + 3
			else
				$vn_fi += 1
				$vn_k = 0
		return
	; sweep: 12 steps of 30 degrees, 1.5 s each
	if $vn_k < 0
		if time < $vn_next
			return
		@wn_clear()
		$vn_k = 0
		@out_n($pv, 0, 0)
		$vn_t = time + 2
		return
	if time < $vn_t
		return
	var $nv = $ws_vnav
	if $nv == ""
		$nv = $wn_a.0
	@wn_add(@in_n($nv, 6), @in_n($nv, 0))
	$vn_k += 1
	if $vn_k >= 12
		var $ok = @wn_solve("VANE")
		$vn_k = -1
		$vn_next = time + 120
		@out_n($pv, 0, 0)
		return
	@out_n($pv, 0, $vn_k / 12)
	$vn_t = time + 1.5


function @wn_tick()
	if !@wn_still()
		$wn_ok = 0
		$wn_how = "MOVING"
		return
	; several navs facing different ways: read them all at once
	if ($ws_navs >= 2) and (time >= $wn_t + 2)
		@wn_clear()
		repeat $ws_navs ($i)
			@wn_add(@in_n($wn_a.$i, 6), @in_n($wn_a.$i, 0))
		if @wn_solve(text("{} NAVS", $ws_navs))
			return
	; one nav on a pivot: sweep it round every 2 minutes
	if ($vn_piv.size == 0) or ($ws_navs == 0)
		return
	@wn_vane_tick()

; ---- display helpers ----
function @ws_compass($d : number) : text
	var $k = @posmod(floor(($d + 22.5) / 45), 8)
	if $k == 0
		return "N"
	if $k == 1
		return "NE"
	if $k == 2
		return "E"
	if $k == 3
		return "SE"
	if $k == 4
		return "S"
	if $k == 5
		return "SW"
	if $k == 6
		return "W"
	return "NW"

function @ws_temp_s($k : number) : text
	if $cfg_units
		return text("{0}F", ($k - 273.15) * 1.8 + 32)
	return text("{0}C", $k - 273.15)

function @ws_press_s() : text
	if $cfg_units
		return text("{0.00} inHg", $ws_p / 3386.39)
	return text("{0} hPa", $ws_p / 100)

function @ws_wind_s() : text
	if !$wn_ok
		return "--"
	var $s = text("{0} km/h", $wn_spd * 3.6)
	if $cfg_units
		$s = text("{0} mph", $wn_spd * 2.23694)
	return $s & " FROM " & @ws_compass($wn_from)

; chip.weather packet (same fields a weather station sends).
function @ws_packet() : text
	var $p = ""
	$p.protocol = "chip.weather"
	; v0.29: the stand-alone weather station's fields too (what the Badger reads)
	$p.schema = "chip.weather"
	$p.version = 1
	$p.name = "ChipOS weather"
	$p.sequence = floor(time)
	$p.temperaturevalid = 1
	var $k_tempK = "tempK"
	$p.$k_tempK = text("{0.00}", $ws_tk)
	$p.pressurevalid = 1
	var $k_pressurePa = "pressurePa"
	$p.$k_pressurePa = text("{0.0}", $ws_p)
	$p.humidityvalid = $ws_rh >= 0
	$p.windvalid = $wn_ok
	$p.winddirectionvalid = $wn_ok
	if $wn_ok
		$p.gustms = text("{0.0}", $wn_spd)
	$p.conditionvalid = $ws_cond != ""
	var $tr = @ws_trend()
	$p.trendvalid = $tr != 9999
	if $tr != 9999
		$p.pressuretrend = text("{0.000}", $tr / 3)
	$p.futureconditionvalid = $ws_fore != ""
	$p.solarvalid = $ws_day >= 0
	if $ws_day >= 0
		$p.daylight = $ws_day
	$p.source = "chipos"
	var $k_tempC = "tempC"
	$p.$k_tempC = text("{0.0}", $ws_tk - 273.15)
	var $k_tempF = "tempF"
	$p.$k_tempF = text("{0.0}", ($ws_tk - 273.15) * 1.8 + 32)
	var $k_pressurehPa = "pressurehPa"
	$p.$k_pressurehPa = text("{0.0}", $ws_p / 100)
	if $ws_rh >= 0
		$p.humidity = text("{0}", $ws_rh)
	if $ws_dew > -1000
		var $k_dewpointC = "dewpointC"
		$p.$k_dewpointC = text("{0.0}", $ws_dew)
	if $wn_ok
		$p.windspeedms = text("{0.0}", $wn_spd)
		$p.winddirection = text("{0}", $wn_from)
	$p.condition = $ws_cond
	if $ws_fore != ""
		$p.futurecondition = $ws_fore
	$p.stamp = floor(time)
	return $p

function @ws_tick()
	@ws_scan()
	if !@ws_on()
		return
	if time >= $ws_t
		$ws_t = time + 5
		@ws_read()
		@ws_classify()
		if $ws_ok
			var $np = @ws_packet()
			; redraw only when something besides the stamp changed
			var $a1 = $np
			var $a2 = $ws_pkt
			$a1.stamp = 0
			$a2.stamp = 0
			if $a1 != $a2
				$ui_dirty = 1
			$ws_pkt = $np
			if time >= $ws_hnext
				$ws_hnext = time + 600
				$ws_ph.append($ws_p / 100)
				$ws_tt.append($ws_tk)
				if $ws_ph.size > 144
					$ws_ph.erase(0)
					$ws_tt.erase(0)
	@wn_tick()

; Weather icon: 0 sun 1 moon 2 cloud 3 unknown 4 fog 5 rain.
function @wx_icon_draw($k : number, $cx : number, $cy : number, $r : number)
	var $sun = color(250, 204, 60)
	var $cl = color(214, 222, 232)
	var $cl2 = color(140, 154, 170)
	if $k == 0
		@d_circle($cx, $cy, $r * 0.45, $sun, $sun)
		repeat 8 ($q)
			var $a = $q * pi / 4
			@d_line($cx + cos($a) * $r * 0.62, $cy + sin($a) * $r * 0.62, $cx + cos($a) * $r * 0.92, $cy + sin($a) * $r * 0.92, $sun)
			@d_line($cx + cos($a) * $r * 0.62 + 1, $cy + sin($a) * $r * 0.62, $cx + cos($a) * $r * 0.92 + 1, $cy + sin($a) * $r * 0.92, $sun)
		return
	if $k == 1
		@d_circle($cx, $cy, $r * 0.6, $cl, $cl)
		@d_circle($cx + $r * 0.3, $cy - $r * 0.2, $r * 0.5, $th_panel, $th_panel)
		return
	if $k == 3
		@d_circle($cx, $cy, $r * 0.7, $th_line, $th_bg)
		@ui_text_c($cx, $cy - $chh / 2, $th_dim, "?")
		return
	; cloud (2, 4, 5)
	var $cy2 = $cy - $r * 0.1
	if $k == 5
		$cy2 = $cy - $r * 0.3
	var $cc = $cl
	if $k == 5
		$cc = $cl2
	@d_circle($cx - $r * 0.35, $cy2 + $r * 0.1, $r * 0.32, $cc, $cc)
	@d_circle($cx + $r * 0.05, $cy2 - $r * 0.15, $r * 0.42, $cc, $cc)
	@d_circle($cx + $r * 0.45, $cy2 + $r * 0.12, $r * 0.3, $cc, $cc)
	$rt.draw_rect($cx - $r * 0.35 - $ox, $cy2 + $r * 0.1 - $oy, $cx + $r * 0.45 - $ox, $cy2 + $r * 0.42 - $oy, $cc, $cc)
	if $k == 4
		repeat 3 ($f)
			var $fy = $cy + $r * 0.45 + $f * $r * 0.18
			@d_line($cx - $r * 0.7, $fy, $cx + $r * 0.7, $fy, $cl2)
	if $k == 5
		var $blue = color(80, 160, 250)
		repeat 4 ($d)
			var $dx = $cx - $r * 0.45 + $d * $r * 0.3
			@d_line($dx, $cy + $r * 0.25, $dx - $r * 0.12, $cy + $r * 0.6, $blue)
			@d_line($dx + 1, $cy + $r * 0.25, $dx - $r * 0.12 + 1, $cy + $r * 0.6, $blue)


; Weather widget (home): icon, temperature, condition, wind.
function @wx_widget($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number)
	@ui_box($x, $y, $w, $h, $th_panel, $th_line)
	$ui_hv = 0
	@ui_hit($x, $y, $x + $w, $y + $h, "go:weather")
	if !@ws_on()
		@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $h / 2 - $chh / 2, $th_dim, "WEATHER: NO STATION", $w - $cw)
		return
	var $r = min($h * 0.4, $w * 0.16)
	@wx_icon_draw($ws_icon, $x + $cw + $r, $y + $h / 2, $r)
	var $tx = $x + $cw * 2 + $r * 2
	var $tw = $x + $w - $cw - $tx
	var $tt = "--"
	if $ws_ok
		$tt = @ws_temp_s($ws_tk)
	var $m = @fit_mul(size($tt), $tw, $h * 0.45, 3)
	@ui_text_big($tx + $tw / 2, $y + $chh * 0.3, $th_text, $tt, $m)
	var $ly = $y + $chh * 0.5 + $chh * $m
	@text_fit_c($tx + $tw / 2, $ly, $th_accent, $ws_cond, $tw)
	$ly += $chh * 1.1
	if ($ly + $chh <= $y + $h) and $wn_ok
		@text_fit_c($tx + $tw / 2, $ly, $th_dim, @ws_wind_s(), $tw)
		$ly += $chh * 1.1
	if ($ly + $chh <= $y + $h) and ($ws_rh >= 0)
		@text_fit_c($tx + $tw / 2, $ly, $th_dim, text("HUMIDITY {0}%", $ws_rh), $tw)

xc_files.name: craft.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - CRAFT: autocrafting with no special aliases.
; ChipOS finds the containers, item conveyors and crafters itself, tests
; each conveyor once (a short unfiltered pulse: which container lost items,
; which gained) and each crafter once (a small test craft: which container
; feeds it, where the product lands). Routes are learned and remembered;
; any move that teaches something new is remembered too.
; Container: in text 0 = items (ores in grams).
; ItemConveyor: out number 0 on, 1 items/s, 3 kg/s (ores), out text 2 filter.
; Crafter: out text 1 recipe, out number 0 start (short pulse), out text 2 cleared;
;          in number 0 progress (1 = done), in text 1 current recipe.
storage var $cr_ver : number
storage array $cv_a : text              ; conveyors (alias)
storage array $cv_src : text            ; "|box|box|" containers it takes from
storage array $cv_dst : text            ; "|box|" containers it fills ("" unknown)
storage array $cv_pr : number           ; 1 tested, 2 tested: moved nothing
storage array $cf_a : text              ; crafters
storage array $cf_feed : text           ; container it crafts from ("" unknown)
storage array $cf_out : text            ; container it puts products in
storage array $cf_pr : number           ; 1 tested, 2 failed
storage array $co_key : text            ; orders
storage array $co_qty : number
storage array $co_made : number
storage array $cv_fk : text             ; FILTER conveyors: "|item|" they carry
storage var $cr_buf : text              ; the crafting buffer container ("" none)
storage var $cr_done : text             ; completion buffer: products land here ("" none)
storage var $cr_ful : text              ; fulfillment: finished orders are moved here ("" none)
storage array $co_base : number         ; fulfillment count of the item when the order began
storage var $sx_tcv : text              ; SORTER: trash conveyor picked by the user ("" auto)
var $sx_active = 0                      ; SORTER uses the mover (no crafter needed)
var $mv_dur = 0.5                       ; next move pulse length
var $cr_boxes = 0
var $cr_trash = 0                       ; trash cans seen

var $cr_next_scan = 0
array $cb_a : text                      ; containers seen now
array $cb_inv : text                    ; their last contents
var $cb_rr = 0
var $cr_unnamed = 0                     ; crafting devices without an alias
array $ln_st : number                   ; crafter lanes: 0 idle 1 feed 2 start 3 craft 4 blocked
array $ln_key : text
array $ln_t : number
array $ln_note : text
array $ln_was : number                  ; product count in containers at start
array $ln_p0 : number
; edges (rebuilt from the learned routes)
array $ed_c : number
array $ed_s : number
array $ed_d : number
var $ed_dirty = 1
array $bx_dist : number
; mover: one conveyor pulse at a time
var $mv_on = 0                          ; 0 idle, 1 pulsing, 2 settling
var $mv_c = -1
var $mv_key = ""
var $mv_t = 0
var $mv_t0 = 0                          ; when the current pulse began
var $mv_to = ""                         ; container that should gain
array $mv_snap : number
var $mv_res = 0                         ; last result: 1 target gained, 0 not
var $mv_tried = ""                      ; "|c:key|" tried with nothing moving
var $mv_tried_t = 0
; tests
var $pr_on = 0                          ; 0 off 1 conveyors 2 crafters
var $pr_i = 0
var $pr_k = 0
var $pr_t = 0
array $pr_snap : text
var $pr_rkey = ""
var $pr_cand = 0
var $pr_scan = -1
var $pr_bufd = 0
var $pr_t0 = 0                          ; when the test start pulse began
var $cr_note = ""
var $cr_tick_t = 0

function @set_has($s : text, $a : text) : number
	return find($s, "|" & $a & "|") >= 0

function @set_add($s : text, $a : text) : text
	if @set_has($s, $a)
		return $s
	if $s == ""
		return "|" & $a & "|"
	return $s & $a & "|"

function @cr_load()
	if $cr_ver != 1
		$cv_a.clear()
		$cv_src.clear()
		$cv_dst.clear()
		$cv_pr.clear()
		$cf_a.clear()
		$cf_feed.clear()
		$cf_out.clear()
		$cf_pr.clear()
		$co_key.clear()
		$co_qty.clear()
		$co_made.clear()
		$cr_ver = 1
	@rc_load()

; ---------- items ----------
function @cr_is_ore($k : text) : number
	return (find($k, "ARCHEAN_celestial.") == 0) and (@rc_find($k) < 0)

; "12.5 kg" for ores (grams), plain count otherwise.
function @cr_amt($k : text, $n : number) : text
	if @cr_is_ore($k)
		if $n >= 1000000
			return text("{0.0} t", $n / 1000000)
		if $n >= 1000
			return text("{0.0} kg", $n / 1000)
		return text("{0} g", $n)
	return text("{0}", $n)

; ---------- devices ----------
function @cb_find($a : text) : number
	var $n = $cb_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $cb_a.$i == $a
			return $i
	return -1

function @cv_find($a : text) : number
	var $n = $cv_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $cv_a.$i == $a
			return $i
	return -1

; A conveyor the user filtered by hand: alias has filter / sort in it.
; ChipOS never changes its filter, only runs it for what it carries.
function @cv_is_flt($a : text) : number
	var $l = lower($a)
	return (find($l, "filter") >= 0) or (find($l, "sort") >= 0)

; Item name squeezed for matching an alias: "ARCHEAN_celestial.OilShale" -> "oilshale"
function @it_short($k : text) : text
	var $p = find($k, ".")
	if $p >= 0
		return lower(substring($k, $p + 1, size($k)))
	return lower($k)

; Guess what a filter conveyor carries from its alias ("Iron Sorter").
function @cv_guess($a : text) : text
	var $l = replace(replace(replace(lower($a), " ", ""), "_", ""), "-", "")
	var $best = ""
	var $bl = 0
	var $ores = "Aluminium,Carbon,Chrome,Copper,Fluorite,Gold,Iron,Lead,Nickel,OilShale,Silicon,Silver,Tin,Titanium,Tungsten,Uranium,WaterIce,Rock"
	var $no = @split_count($ores, ",")
	repeat $no ($i)
		var $nm = @split_part($ores, ",", $i)
		var $sh = lower($nm)
		if (find($l, $sh) >= 0) and (size($sh) > $bl)
			$best = "ARCHEAN_celestial." & $nm
			$bl = size($sh)
	if (find($l, "aluminum") >= 0) and ($bl < 8)
		$best = "ARCHEAN_celestial.Aluminium"
		$bl = 8
	var $n = $rc_key.size
	repeat $n ($r)
		var $sh2 = @it_short($rc_key.$r)
		if (size($sh2) > 3) and (find($l, $sh2) >= 0) and (size($sh2) > $bl)
			$best = $rc_key.$r
			$bl = size($sh2)
	if $best == ""
		return ""
	return "|" & $best & "|"

; Can conveyor c move item k? (Plain conveyors: anything, ChipOS sets the filter.)
function @cv_carries($c : number, $k : text) : number
	if !@cv_is_flt($cv_a.$c)
		return 1
	if $c >= $cv_fk.size
		return 0
	return @set_has($cv_fk.$c, $k)

function @cf_find($a : text) : number
	var $n = $cf_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $cf_a.$i == $a
			return $i
	return -1

function @cr_scan()
	if time < $cr_next_scan
		return
	$cr_next_scan = time + 3
	var $n = $db_id.size
	var $boxes = 0
	$cr_unnamed = 0
	var $crafters = 0
	$cr_trash = 0
	repeat $n ($j)
		if $db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1
			var $ty = $db_type.$j
			var $isb = ($ty == "Container") or ($ty == "SmallContainer")
			var $isc = $ty == "ItemConveyor"
			var $isf = $ty == "Crafter"
			if $ty == "TrashCan"
				$cr_trash += 1
			if $isb or $isc or $isf
				var $a = $db_alias.$j
				if $a == ""
					$cr_unnamed += 1
				elseif $isb
					$boxes += 1
					if @cb_find($a) < 0
						$cb_a.append($a)
						$cb_inv.append(@in_t($a, 0))
						$ed_dirty = 1
				elseif $isc
					if @cv_find($a) < 0
						$cv_a.append($a)
						$cv_src.append("")
						$cv_dst.append("")
						$cv_pr.append(0)
				else
					$crafters += 1
					if @cf_find($a) < 0
						$cf_a.append($a)
						$cf_feed.append("")
						$cf_out.append("")
						$cf_pr.append(0)
	$cr_present = $crafters > 0
	$cr_boxes = $boxes
	while $cv_fk.size < $cv_a.size
		$cv_fk.append("")
	var $ncv = $cv_a.size
	repeat $ncv ($c)
		if ($cv_fk.$c == "") and @cv_is_flt($cv_a.$c)
			$cv_fk.$c = @cv_guess($cv_a.$c)
	repeat 64 ($q)
		if $ln_st.size < $cf_a.size
			$ln_st.append(0)
			$ln_key.append("")
			$ln_t.append(0)
			$ln_note.append("IDLE")
			$ln_was.append(0)
			$ln_p0.append(0)

; Is this alias connected right now?
function @cr_live($a : text) : number
	if $a == ""
		return 0
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if $db_alias.$j == $a
			return $db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1
	return 0

; Read two containers a tick (all of them every couple of seconds).
function @cb_refresh()
	var $n = $cb_a.size
	if $n == 0
		return
	repeat 2 ($q)
		$cb_rr = @posmod($cb_rr + 1, $n)
		$cb_inv.$cb_rr = @in_t($cb_a.$cb_rr, 0)

function @cb_read_all()
	var $n = $cb_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		$cb_inv.$i = @in_t($cb_a.$i, 0)

; Count of an item over every container.
function @cr_have($k : text) : number
	var $s = 0
	var $n = $cb_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $inv = $cb_inv.$i
		$s += $inv.$k:number
	return $s

function @cb_have($i : number, $k : text) : number
	var $inv = $cb_inv.$i
	return $inv.$k:number

function @cb_have_a($a : text, $k : text) : number
	var $i = @cb_find($a)
	if $i < 0
		return 0
	return @cb_have($i, $k)

; ---------- learned routes ----------

function @ed_build()
	if !$ed_dirty
		return
	$ed_dirty = 0
	$ed_c.clear()
	$ed_s.clear()
	$ed_d.clear()
	var $nc = $cv_a.size
	var $nb = $cb_a.size
	repeat $nc ($c)
		var $ss = $cv_src.$c
		var $ds = $cv_dst.$c
		if ($ss != "") and ($ds != "")
			repeat $nb ($s)
				if @set_has($ss, $cb_a.$s)
					repeat $nb ($d)
						if ($d != $s) and @set_has($ds, $cb_a.$d)
							$ed_c.append($c)
							$ed_s.append($s)
							$ed_d.append($d)

; Hops from each container to container $f (9999 = no route).
function @bx_route($f : number)
	@ed_build()
	$bx_dist.clear()
	var $nb = $cb_a.size
	repeat $nb ($i)
		$bx_dist.append(9999)
	if $f < 0
		return
	$bx_dist.$f = 0
	var $ne = $ed_c.size
	repeat 8 ($r)
		var $chg = 0
		repeat $ne ($e)
			var $s = $ed_s.$e
			var $d = $ed_d.$e
			if $bx_dist.$d + 1 < $bx_dist.$s
				$bx_dist.$s = $bx_dist.$d + 1
				$chg = 1
		if !$chg
			break

; ---------- the mover ----------
function @mv_start($c : number, $k : text, $amt : number, $to : text)
	var $a = $cv_a.$c
	var $nb = $cb_a.size
	$mv_snap.clear()
	repeat $nb ($i)
		$cb_inv.$i = @in_t($cb_a.$i, 0)
		$mv_snap.append(@cb_have($i, $k))
	var $dur = $mv_dur
	$mv_dur = 0.5
	if !@cv_is_flt($a)
		@out_t($a, 2, $k)
	if @cr_is_ore($k)
		@out_n($a, 1, 1000)
		@out_n($a, 3, clamp($amt / 1000 / $dur, 0.002, 1000))
	else
		@out_n($a, 1, clamp(ceil($amt / $dur), 1, 1000))
		@out_n($a, 3, 0)
	@out_n($a, 0, 1)
	$mv_c = $c
	$mv_key = $k
	$mv_to = $to
	$mv_on = 1
	$mv_t = time + $dur
	$mv_t0 = time

; A crafter may change this container's count of $k by itself right now
; (using it as an input, or making it) - don't learn routes from that.
function @mv_noisy($i : number, $k : text) : number
	var $a = $cb_a.$i
	var $n = $ln_st.size
	repeat $n ($l)
		if ($ln_st.$l == 2) or ($ln_st.$l == 3) or ($ln_t.$l >= $mv_t0)
			if ($ln_key.$l == $k) and ($cf_out.$l == $a)
				return 1
			if $cf_feed.$l == $a
				var $r = @rc_find($ln_key.$l)
				if $r >= 0
					var $ins = $rc_in.$r
					if $ins.$k:number > 0
						return 1
	return 0

; Learn from what moved. Returns 1 when something moved.
function @mv_learn($c : number, $k : text) : number
	var $moved = 0
	var $nb = $cb_a.size
	repeat $nb ($i)
		$cb_inv.$i = @in_t($cb_a.$i, 0)
		if ($i < $mv_snap.size) and !@mv_noisy($i, $k)
			var $now = @cb_have($i, $k)
			if $now < $mv_snap.$i - 0.0001
				$cv_src.$c = @set_add($cv_src.$c, $cb_a.$i)
				$moved = 1
				$ed_dirty = 1
				if @cv_is_flt($cv_a.$c) and ($c < $cv_fk.size)
					$cv_fk.$c = @set_add($cv_fk.$c, $k)
			elseif $now > $mv_snap.$i + 0.0001
				$cv_dst.$c = @set_add($cv_dst.$c, $cb_a.$i)
				$moved = 1
				$ed_dirty = 1
	return $moved

function @mv_tick()
	if $mv_on == 0
		return
	if time < $mv_t
		return
	if $mv_on == 1
		@out_n($cv_a.$mv_c, 0, 0)
		$mv_on = 2
		$mv_t = time + 0.7
		return
	var $before = 0
	var $ti = @cb_find($mv_to)
	if ($ti >= 0) and ($ti < $mv_snap.size)
		$before = $mv_snap.$ti
	var $moved = @mv_learn($mv_c, $mv_key)
	$mv_res = 0
	if $ti >= 0
		$mv_res = @cb_have($ti, $mv_key) > $before
	if $moved
		; things moved: routes tried earlier may work now
		$mv_tried = ""
	else
		$mv_tried = $mv_tried & "|" & text("{}", $mv_c) & ":" & $mv_key & "|"
	$mv_on = 0

; Bring $amt of $k into container $f, one hop at a time. Returns
; 1 a move was started, 0 nothing to do, -1 no known way (yet).
function @mv_bring($k : text, $f : text, $amt : number) : number
	if $mv_on
		return 1
	var $fi = @cb_find($f)
	if $fi < 0
		return -1
	if time > $mv_tried_t
		$mv_tried = ""
		$mv_tried_t = time + 60
	@bx_route($fi)
	; best known hop: from the nearest container that has it
	var $best = -1
	var $bd = 9999
	var $ne = $ed_c.size
	repeat $ne ($e)
		var $s = $ed_s.$e
		var $d = $ed_d.$e
		if ($s != $fi) and ($bx_dist.$s < 9999) and ($bx_dist.$d == $bx_dist.$s - 1) and ($bx_dist.$s < $bd)
			if (@cb_have($s, $k) > 0) and @cv_carries($ed_c.$e, $k)
				if find($mv_tried, "|" & text("{}", $ed_c.$e) & ":" & $k & "|") < 0
					$best = $e
					$bd = $bx_dist.$s
	if $best >= 0
		var $sb = $ed_s.$best
		@mv_start($ed_c.$best, $k, min($amt, @cb_have($sb, $k)), $f)
		return 1
	; explore: a conveyor that fills $f (or any untested one) with this item
	var $nc = $cv_a.size
	repeat 2 ($pass)
		repeat $nc ($c)
			var $ok = @cr_live($cv_a.$c) and (find($mv_tried, "|" & text("{}", $c) & ":" & $k & "|") < 0)
			; never explore into the trash (or a conveyor that only empties things)
			if (find(lower($cv_a.$c), "trash") >= 0) or ($cv_a.$c == $sx_tcv) or (($cv_pr.$c == 1) and ($cv_src.$c != "") and ($cv_dst.$c == ""))
				$ok = 0
			if $ok and @cv_is_flt($cv_a.$c) and ($c < $cv_fk.size)
				if ($cv_fk.$c != "") and !@set_has($cv_fk.$c, $k)
					$ok = 0
			if $ok
				if (($pass == 0) and @set_has($cv_dst.$c, $f)) or (($pass == 1) and ($cv_dst.$c == ""))
					@mv_start($c, $k, $amt, $f)
					return 1
	return -1

; Amount to keep in a feed for a recipe (ores: a hair extra, moved ores
; arrive as fractions of a gram).
function @cr_need($k : text, $amt : number) : number
	if @cr_is_ore($k)
		return $amt * 1.002 + 0.05
	return $amt

; ---------- planning ----------
; Items promised to busy lanes (in feed, not yet used) and coming out of them.
function @cr_avail($k : text) : number
	var $a = @cr_have($k)
	var $n = $ln_st.size
	repeat $n ($l)
		var $r = @rc_find($ln_key.$l)
		if $r >= 0
			if ($ln_st.$l == 1) or ($ln_st.$l == 2)
				var $ins = $rc_in.$r
				$a -= $ins.$k:number
			if (($ln_st.$l >= 1) and ($ln_st.$l <= 3)) and ($ln_key.$l == $k)
				$a += $rc_yield.$r
	return $a

var $pl_note = ""
; Next recipe to craft for one more $root: walk down to the first missing part.
function @cr_plan($root : text) : number
	var $key = $root
	repeat 16 ($depth)
		var $r = @rc_find($key)
		if $r < 0
			$pl_note = "NEEDS " & upper(@rc_name($key))
			return -1
		var $ins = $rc_in.$r
		var $miss = ""
		foreach $ins ($ing, $amt)
			if ($miss == "") and (@cr_avail($ing) < $amt:number)
				$miss = $ing
		if $miss == ""
			return $r
		if @rc_find($miss) < 0
			$pl_note = "NEEDS " & @cr_amt($miss, $ins.$miss:number - max(0, @cr_avail($miss))) & " " & upper(@rc_name($miss))
			return -1
		$key = $miss
	$pl_note = "RECIPE TOO DEEP"
	return -1

; ---------- crafter lanes ----------
function @ln_set($l : number, $st : number, $note : text)
	if ($ln_st.$l != $st) or ($ln_note.$l != $note)
		$ui_dirty = 1
	$ln_st.$l = $st
	$ln_note.$l = $note
	$ln_t.$l = time

; Feed busy with another lane that hasn't started yet?
function @feed_busy($l : number) : number
	var $f = $cf_feed.$l
	var $n = $ln_st.size
	repeat $n ($o)
		if ($o != $l) and (($ln_st.$o == 1) or ($ln_st.$o == 2)) and ($cf_feed.$o == $f)
			return 1
	return 0

function @ln_start($l : number)
	var $a = $cf_a.$l
	@out_t($a, 2, "")
	@out_t($a, 1, $ln_key.$l)
	@out_n($a, 0, 1)
	$ln_p0.$l = @in_n($a, 0)
	$ln_was.$l = time
	@ln_set($l, 2, "STARTING " & upper(@rc_name($ln_key.$l)))

function @ln_done($l : number)
	var $k = $ln_key.$l
	var $r = @rc_find($k)
	; learn where the product lands
	@cb_read_all()
	if ($cf_out.$l == "") and (@cb_have_a($cr_done, $k) > 0)
		$cf_out.$l = $cr_done
	if $cf_out.$l == ""
		var $nb = $cb_a.size
		repeat $nb ($i)
			if ($cf_out.$l == "") and (@cb_have($i, $k) > 0)
				$cf_out.$l = $cb_a.$i
	if ($co_key.size > 0) and ($r >= 0)
		if $co_key.0 == $k
			$co_made.0 = $co_made.0 + $rc_yield.$r
	@ln_set($l, 0, "DONE " & upper(@rc_name($k)))

function @ln_tick($l : number)
	var $a = $cf_a.$l
	var $st = $ln_st.$l
	if $st == 1
		; bring the inputs into the feed container
		var $r = @rc_find($ln_key.$l)
		var $ins = $rc_in.$r
		var $f = $cf_feed.$l
		var $need = ""
		foreach $ins ($ing, $amt)
			if ($need == "") and (@cb_have_a($f, $ing) < @cr_need($ing, $amt:number))
				$need = $ing
		if $need == ""
			@ln_start($l)
			return
		if $mv_on
			return
		if @cr_have($need) - @cb_have_a($f, $need) <= 0
			; is another crafter making it? If not, plan again.
			var $mk = 0
			var $nl = $ln_st.size
			repeat $nl ($o)
				if ($o != $l) and ($ln_st.$o >= 1) and ($ln_st.$o <= 3) and ($ln_key.$o == $need)
					$mk = 1
			if !$mk
				@ln_set($l, 0, "IDLE")
				return
			if time > $ln_t.$l + 120
				@ln_set($l, 4, "NO " & upper(@rc_name($need)) & " ARRIVED")
			elseif find($ln_note.$l, "WAITING") != 0
				@ln_set($l, 1, "WAITING FOR " & upper(@rc_name($need)))
			return
		; bring a few batches' worth at once when there's plenty
		var $want = @cr_need($need, $ins.$need:number) * 1.01 - @cb_have_a($f, $need)
		var $spare = @cr_have($need) - @cb_have_a($f, $need)
		$want = max($want, min($ins.$need:number * 8, $spare / 2))
		var $m = @mv_bring($need, $f, $want)
		if $m < 0
			@ln_set($l, 4, "CAN'T REACH " & upper(@rc_name($need)))
		elseif time > $ln_t.$l + 90
			@ln_set($l, 4, "STUCK MOVING " & upper(@rc_name($need)))
		elseif find($ln_note.$l, "MOVING") != 0
			@ln_set($l, 1, "MOVING " & upper(@rc_name($need)))
		return
	if $st == 2
		var $p = @in_n($a, 0)
		if time > $ln_was.$l + 0.25
			@out_n($a, 0, 0)
		var $act = @in_t($a, 1)
		var $ack = 0
		if $act == $ln_key.$l
			if (($p > 0) and ($p < 1)) or ($p != $ln_p0.$l)
				$ack = 1
		if $ack
			@out_n($a, 0, 0)
			@ln_set($l, 3, "CRAFTING " & upper(@rc_name($ln_key.$l)))
			return
		if time > $ln_t.$l + 8
			@out_n($a, 0, 0)
			var $why = "WON'T START (POWER?)"
			var $rr = @rc_find($ln_key.$l)
			if $rr >= 0
				if $rc_fluid.$rr != ""
					$why = "WON'T START (NEEDS FLUID?)"
			@ln_set($l, 4, $why)
		return
	if $st == 3
		; keep the start a short pulse (held on, a crafter repeats)
		if time > $ln_was.$l + 0.25
			@out_n($a, 0, 0)
		var $p3 = @in_n($a, 0)
		if ($p3 >= 1) and (@in_t($a, 1) == $ln_key.$l)
			if time > $ln_t.$l + 0.3
				@out_n($a, 0, 0)
				@ln_done($l)
		elseif time > $ln_t.$l + 600
			@ln_set($l, 4, "TAKING TOO LONG")
		return
	if $st == 4
		if time > $ln_t.$l + 15
			@ln_set($l, 0, "IDLE")

; How many of order o's item have reached the fulfillment container.
function @cr_delivered($o : number) : number
	if $o >= $co_base.size
		return 0
	return @cb_have_a($cr_ful, $co_key.$o) - $co_base.$o

; Give idle crafters work from the first order.
function @cr_assign()
	if $co_key.size == 0
		return
	var $fin = $co_made.0 >= $co_qty.0
	if (@cb_find($cr_ful) >= 0) and (0 < $co_base.size)
		; with a fulfillment container the order is done once it's moved there
		$fin = @cr_delivered(0) >= $co_qty.0
	if $fin
		@snd_beep(880, 0.15)
		var $dn = "ORDER DONE: " & upper(@rc_name($co_key.0))
		if @cb_find($cr_ful) >= 0
			$dn = $dn & " - IN " & upper($cr_ful)
		@ui_toast($dn)
		$co_key.erase(0)
		$co_qty.erase(0)
		$co_made.erase(0)
		if $co_base.size > 0
			$co_base.erase(0)
		$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	if $co_made.0 >= $co_qty.0
		return
	var $n = $cf_a.size
	; finished roots still crafting count toward the order
	var $inflight = 0
	repeat $n ($l)
		if (($ln_st.$l >= 1) and ($ln_st.$l <= 3)) and ($ln_key.$l == $co_key.0)
			var $rq = @rc_find($co_key.0)
			if $rq >= 0
				$inflight += $rc_yield.$rq
	repeat $n ($l)
		if ($ln_st.$l == 0) and ($cf_feed.$l != "") and @cr_live($cf_a.$l) and !@feed_busy($l)
			var $r = @cr_plan($co_key.0)
			if $r >= 0
				if ($rc_key.$r == $co_key.0) and ($co_made.0 + $inflight >= $co_qty.0)
					return
				$ln_key.$l = $rc_key.$r
				@ln_set($l, 1, "PREPARING " & upper($rc_label.$r))
				return
			$cr_note = $pl_note

; ---------- one-time tests ----------
function @pr_begin()
	$pr_on = 1
	$pr_i = 0
	$pr_k = 0
	$cr_note = "TESTING CONVEYORS"
	$ui_dirty = 1

; A test recipe made only from raw materials that are in stock.
function @pr_pick() : number
	var $best = -1
	var $bm = 0
	var $n = $rc_key.size
	repeat $n ($r)
		if $rc_fluid.$r == ""
			var $ins = $rc_in.$r
			var $ok = 1
			var $mass = 0
			foreach $ins ($ing, $amt)
				if @rc_find($ing) >= 0
					$ok = 0
				elseif @cr_have($ing) < $amt:number
					$ok = 0
				$mass += $amt:number
			if $ok and (($best < 0) or ($mass < $bm))
				$best = $r
				$bm = $mass
	return $best

; Crafter test: try a start where the inputs already are; else bring the
; inputs to each likely feed container in turn and try again.
function @pr_crafter()
	var $n = $cf_a.size
	if $pr_i >= $n
		$pr_on = 0
		$cr_note = "TESTS DONE"
		$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	var $a = $cf_a.$pr_i
	if (($pr_k == 0) and ($cf_feed.$pr_i != "")) or !@cr_live($a)
		$pr_i += 1
		$pr_k = 0
		return
	if $pr_k == 0
		var $r = @pr_pick()
		if $r < 0
			$cf_pr.$pr_i = 2
			$cr_note = "NO RAW MATERIALS TO TEST " & $a
			$pr_i += 1
			return
		$pr_rkey = $rc_key.$r
		$pr_cand = -1
		$pr_scan = -1
		$pr_bufd = 0
		$pr_k = 1
	if $pr_k == 1
		; start with the inputs wherever they are now
		@cb_read_all()
		$pr_snap.clear()
		var $nb = $cb_a.size
		repeat $nb ($i)
			$pr_snap.append($cb_inv.$i)
		@out_t($a, 2, "")
		@out_t($a, 1, $pr_rkey)
		@out_n($a, 0, 1)
		$pr_t = time
		$pr_t0 = time
		$pr_k = 2
		$cr_note = "TEST CRAFT ON " & $a & ": " & upper(@rc_name($pr_rkey))
		$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	if $pr_k == 2
		if time > $pr_t + 0.25
			@out_n($a, 0, 0)
		var $p = @in_n($a, 0)
		@cb_read_all()
		; the container that lost the inputs is the feed
		var $nb2 = $cb_a.size
		var $feed = ""
		var $r2 = @rc_find($pr_rkey)
		var $ins = $rc_in.$r2
		repeat $nb2 ($i2)
			if $i2 < $pr_snap.size
				var $old = $pr_snap.$i2
				foreach $ins ($ing, $amt)
					if @cb_have($i2, $ing) < $old.$ing:number - 0.0001
						$feed = $cb_a.$i2
		if ($feed != "") or (($p > 0) and ($p < 1))
			if $feed == ""
				if $pr_cand >= 0
					$feed = $cb_a.$pr_cand
			$cf_feed.$pr_i = $feed
			$pr_k = 3
			$pr_t = time
			$ln_was.$pr_i = @cr_have($pr_rkey)
			return
		if time > $pr_t + 5
			@out_n($a, 0, 0)
			$pr_k = 4
		return
	if $pr_k == 3
		; wait for the product, to learn the output container
		if time > $pr_t0 + 0.25
			@out_n($a, 0, 0)
		@cb_read_all()
		var $nb3 = $cb_a.size
		var $snapk = 0
		repeat $nb3 ($i3)
			if $i3 < $pr_snap.size
				var $o3 = $pr_snap.$i3
				if @cb_have($i3, $pr_rkey) > $o3.$pr_rkey:number
					$cf_out.$pr_i = $cb_a.$i3
		if ($cf_out.$pr_i != "") or (time > $pr_t + 60)
			$cf_pr.$pr_i = 1
			@out_n($a, 0, 0)
			$pr_i += 1
			$pr_k = 0
		return
	if $pr_k == 4
		; next candidate feed: containers that conveyors fill
		if $mv_on
			return
