		var $nb4 = $cb_a.size
		var $nxt = -1
		var $bi = @cb_find($cr_buf)
		if !$pr_bufd and ($bi >= 0)
			; the crafting buffer the user picked is tried first
			$pr_bufd = 1
			$pr_cand = $bi
			$pr_k = 5
			return
		repeat $nb4 ($i4)
			if ($nxt < 0) and ($i4 > $pr_scan) and ($i4 != $bi)
				var $isdst = 0
				var $nc = $cv_a.size
				repeat $nc ($c)
					if @set_has($cv_dst.$c, $cb_a.$i4)
						$isdst = 1
				if $isdst
					$nxt = $i4
		if $nxt < 0
			$cf_pr.$pr_i = 2
			$cr_note = "COULDN'T FIND THE FEED FOR " & $a
			$pr_i += 1
			$pr_k = 0
			return
		$pr_cand = $nxt
		$pr_scan = $nxt
		$pr_k = 5
		return
	if $pr_k == 5
		; bring the test inputs into the candidate, then try a start
		if $mv_on
			return
		var $r5 = @rc_find($pr_rkey)
		var $ins5 = $rc_in.$r5
		var $cb = $cb_a.$pr_cand
		var $need = ""
		foreach $ins5 ($ing5, $amt5)
			if ($need == "") and (@cb_have($pr_cand, $ing5) < @cr_need($ing5, $amt5:number))
				$need = $ing5
		if $need == ""
			$pr_k = 1
			return
		$cr_note = "MOVING TEST " & upper(@rc_name($need)) & " TO " & $cb
		var $m = @mv_bring($need, $cb, @cr_need($need, $ins5.$need:number) * 1.01 - @cb_have($pr_cand, $need))
		if $m < 0
			$pr_k = 4

function @pr_tick()
	if $pr_on == 1
		; conveyors: unfiltered 2.5 s pulse each
		var $nc = $cv_a.size
		if $pr_i >= $nc
			$pr_on = 2
			$pr_i = 0
			$pr_k = 0
			$cr_note = "TESTING CRAFTERS"
			return
		var $a = $cv_a.$pr_i
		if ($cv_pr.$pr_i != 0) or !@cr_live($a)
			$pr_i += 1
			return
		if $pr_k == 0
			@cb_read_all()
			$pr_snap.clear()
			var $nb = $cb_a.size
			repeat $nb ($i)
				$pr_snap.append($cb_inv.$i)
			if find(lower($a), "trash") >= 0
				; a trash conveyor: never run until the user confirms it feeds
				; the trash can, and then only tested with a common ore
				var $tf = ""
				if $a != $sx_tcv
					$cv_pr.$pr_i = 2
					$pr_i += 1
					return
				var $tl = "Silicon,Rock,Iron,Carbon"
				repeat 4 ($tq)
					var $tk = "ARCHEAN_celestial." & @split_part($tl, ",", $tq)
					if ($tf == "") and (@cr_have($tk) > 0)
						$tf = $tk
				if $tf == ""
					$cv_pr.$pr_i = 2
					$pr_i += 1
					return
				@out_t($a, 2, $tf)
			elseif !@cv_is_flt($a)
				@out_t($a, 2, "")
			@out_n($a, 1, 2)
			@out_n($a, 3, 0.2)
			@out_n($a, 0, 1)
			$pr_k = 1
			$pr_t = time + 2.5
			$cr_note = text("TESTING CONVEYOR {} OF {}: ", $pr_i + 1, $nc) & $a
			$ui_dirty = 1
		elseif ($pr_k == 1) and (time >= $pr_t)
			@out_n($a, 0, 0)
			$pr_k = 2
			$pr_t = time + 0.8
		elseif ($pr_k == 2) and (time >= $pr_t)
			@cb_read_all()
			var $moved = 0
			var $nb2 = $cb_a.size
			repeat $nb2 ($i2)
				if $i2 < $pr_snap.size
					var $old = $pr_snap.$i2
					var $new = $cb_inv.$i2
					var $lost = 0
					var $gain = 0
					foreach $old ($k1, $v1)
						if $new.$k1:number < $v1:number - 0.0001
							$lost = 1
							if @cv_is_flt($a) and ($pr_i < $cv_fk.size)
								$cv_fk.$pr_i = @set_add($cv_fk.$pr_i, $k1)
					foreach $new ($k2, $v2)
						if $v2:number > $old.$k2:number + 0.0001
							$gain = 1
					if $lost
						$cv_src.$pr_i = @set_add($cv_src.$pr_i, $cb_a.$i2)
						$moved = 1
					if $gain
						$cv_dst.$pr_i = @set_add($cv_dst.$pr_i, $cb_a.$i2)
						$moved = 1
			$cv_pr.$pr_i = 1
			if !$moved
				$cv_pr.$pr_i = 2
			$ed_dirty = 1
			$pr_i += 1
			$pr_k = 0
		return
	if $pr_on == 2
		@pr_crafter()

function @cr_tick()
	@cr_scan()
	if ($cf_a.size == 0) and !$sx_active and !$pr_on
		return
	@cb_refresh()
	@mv_tick()
	if $pr_on
		@pr_tick()
		return
	var $n = $cf_a.size
	repeat $n ($l)
		if $ln_st.$l != 0
			@ln_tick($l)
	if time >= $cr_tick_t
		$cr_tick_t = time + 0.5
		@cr_assign()

; ---------- CRAFT's containers ----------
var $cr_bmode = 0                       ; CRAFT container being picked: 0 crafting buffer 1 completion 2 fulfillment

function @cr_role($a : text) : text
	if $a == ""
		return ""
	if $a == $cr_buf
		return "CRAFTING BUFFER"
	if $a == $cr_done
		return "COMPLETION BUFFER"
	if $a == $cr_ful
		return "FULFILLMENT (ORDERS)"
	return ""

function @cr_bname($m : number) : text
	if $m == 0
		return "CRAFTING BUFFER"
	if $m == 1
		return "COMPLETION BUFFER"
	return "FULFILLMENT"

function @cr_bget($m : number) : text
	if $m == 0
		return $cr_buf
	if $m == 1
		return $cr_done
	return $cr_ful

function @cr_bset($m : number, $a : text)
	; one role per container
	if ($a != "") and ($cr_buf == $a)
		$cr_buf = ""
	if ($a != "") and ($cr_done == $a)
		$cr_done = ""
	if ($a != "") and ($cr_ful == $a)
		$cr_ful = ""
	if $m == 0
		$cr_buf = $a
	elseif $m == 1
		$cr_done = $a
	else
		$cr_ful = $a

xc_files.name: kitcanvas.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - App Kit frame parsing, and the App Kit v4 map canvas: an app streams
; a picture layer (lines and filled spans) that ChipOS keeps in a buffer, then
; shows a window of it, turned and with lines/dots/labels on top, wherever the
; app's screen or widget is drawn (app page, home widget, other screens).
array $xf_f : text                      ; fields of the element being drawn
array $xb_id : text                     ; button ids of the current frame
array $bk_bid : text                    ; built-in app buttons this frame ...
array $bk_bapp : number                 ; ... and their app

; Split $s at $sep into $xf_f.
function @xf_split($s : text, $sep : text)
	$xf_f.clear()
	var $rest = $s
	var $done = 0
	repeat 64 ($si)
		var $p = find($rest, $sep)
		if $p < 0
			$xf_f.append($rest)
			break
		$xf_f.append(substring($rest, 0, $p))
		$rest = substring($rest, $p + 1, size($rest))

function @xf_num($i : number) : number
	if $i >= $xf_f.size
		return 0
	var $v = $xf_f.$i
	if isnumeric($v)
		return $v:number
	return 0

function @xf_txt($i : number) : text
	if $i >= $xf_f.size
		return ""
	return $xf_f.$i

function @xf_color($c : text) : number
	if $c == "text"
		return $th_text
	if $c == "dim"
		return $th_dim
	if $c == "accent"
		return $th_accent
	if $c == "ok"
		return $th_ok
	if $c == "warn"
		return $th_warn
	if $c == "bad"
		return $th_bad
	if $c == "panel"
		return $th_panel2
	var $hc = @hex_color($c)
	if $hc == 0
		return $th_text
	return $hc

function @grid_color($d : number) : number
	if $d == 1
		return color(0, 210, 230)
	if $d == 2
		return color(240, 210, 40)
	if $d == 3
		return color(170, 80, 230)
	if $d == 4
		return color(60, 210, 80)
	if $d == 5
		return color(230, 60, 60)
	if $d == 6
		return color(50, 110, 240)
	if $d == 7
		return color(245, 140, 30)
	if $d == 8
		return color(160, 165, 175)
	return color(240, 240, 240)


; ---- the canvas layer ----
const $kv_w = 860                       ; layer size (pixels), the same in the kit
const $kv_alpha = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_-"
var $kv_a = virtualscreen(860, 860)
var $kv_b = virtualscreen(860, 860)
var $kv_tmp = virtualscreen(560, 440)
var $kv_front = 0                       ; 0: a is shown, 1: b is shown
var $kv_owner = ""                      ; alias of the app that owns the layer
var $kv_lid_f = -1                      ; layer shown (complete)
var $kv_lid_o = -1                      ; the one before (still intact in the back buffer)
var $kv_lid_b = -1                      ; layer being drawn
var $kv_want = 0                        ; next part wanted
var $kv_d = ""                          ; part being drawn
var $kv_i = 0
var $kv_end = 0
var $kv_drawing = 0
var $kv_ack = ""
var $kv_bg = 0
array $kv_pal : number

function @kv_num() : number
	var $v = 0
	var $sh = 1
	repeat 8 ($q)
		var $c = find($kv_alpha, substring($kv_d, $kv_i, 1))
		$kv_i += 1
		if $c >= 32
			$v += ($c - 32) * $sh
			$sh = $sh * 32
		else
			$v += max($c, 0) * $sh
			if mod($v, 2) == 1
				return -($v + 1) / 2
			return $v / 2
	return 0

function @kv_col($i : number) : number
	if ($i >= 0) and ($i < $kv_pal.size)
		return $kv_pal.$i
	return color(200, 200, 200)

function @kv_bline($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number, $c : number)
	if $kv_front == 0
		$kv_b.draw_line($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2, $c)
	else
		$kv_a.draw_line($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2, $c)

function @kv_brect($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number, $c : number)
	if $kv_front == 0
		$kv_b.draw_rect($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2, $c, $c)
	else
		$kv_a.draw_rect($x1, $y1, $x2, $y2, $c, $c)

; Draw some of the current part into the back buffer.
function @kv_step()
	var $used = 0
	var $n = size($kv_d)
	repeat 400 ($k)
		if ($kv_i >= $n) or ($used >= 500)
			break
		if 1
			var $op = @kv_num()
			if $op == 0
				; polyline: colour, count, first point, then deltas
				var $c = @kv_col(@kv_num())
				var $pn = @kv_num()
				var $x = @kv_num()
				var $y = @kv_num()
				var $pm = max($pn - 1, 0)
				repeat $pm ($p)
					var $x2 = $x + @kv_num()
					var $y2 = $y + @kv_num()
					@kv_bline($x, $y, $x2, $y2, $c)
					$x = $x2
					$y = $y2
				$used += $pn * 2 + 4
			elseif $op == 1
				; filled spans on one row band: colour, top, height, count, (gap, length)...
				var $sc = @kv_col(@kv_num())
				var $sy = @kv_num()
				var $sh = @kv_num()
				var $sn = @kv_num()
				var $sx = 0
				repeat $sn ($s)
					$sx += @kv_num()
					var $sl = @kv_num()
					@kv_brect($sx, $sy, $sx + $sl, $sy + $sh, $sc)
					$sx += $sl
				$used += $sn * 2 + 4
			else
				$kv_i = $n

; The app that owns the layer: the first running app that asked for a canvas.
function @kv_find_owner()
	var $own = ""
	var $n = min($xa_alias.size, $xa_cv.size)
	repeat $n ($k)
		if ($own == "") and $xa_online.$k and ($xa_cv.$k != "")
			$own = $xa_alias.$k
	if $own != $kv_owner
		$kv_owner = $own
		$kv_lid_f = -1
		$kv_lid_o = -1
		$kv_lid_b = -1
		$kv_want = 0
		$kv_drawing = 0
		$kv_ack = ""

function @kv_tick()
	@kv_find_owner()
	if $kv_owner == ""
		return
	if !$kv_drawing
		var $pt = @in_t($kv_owner, 8)
		if $pt != ""
			var $lid = $pt.lid:number
			var $p = $pt.p:number
			if ($lid != $kv_lid_b) and ($p == 0)
				; a new layer: clear the back buffer to the background
				$kv_lid_b = $lid
				$kv_want = 0
				$kv_lid_o = -1
				$kv_bg = @hex_color($pt.bg)
				$kv_pal.clear()
				var $pl = $pt.pal
				repeat 16 ($q)
					if $pl != ""
						var $cp = find($pl, ",")
						var $one = $pl
						if $cp < 0
							$pl = ""
						else
							$one = substring($pl, 0, $cp)
							$pl = substring($pl, $cp + 1, size($pl))
						$kv_pal.append(@hex_color($one))
				if $kv_front == 0
					$kv_b.blank($kv_bg)
				else
					$kv_a.blank($kv_bg)
			if ($lid == $kv_lid_b) and ($p == $kv_want)
				$kv_d = $pt.d
				$kv_i = 0
				$kv_end = $pt.end:number
				$kv_drawing = 1
	if $kv_drawing
		@kv_step()
		if $kv_i >= size($kv_d)
			$kv_drawing = 0
			$kv_want += 1
			if $kv_end
				$kv_front = 1 - $kv_front
				$kv_lid_o = $kv_lid_f
				$kv_lid_f = $kv_lid_b
				$ui_dirty = 1
				$panels_dirty = 1
	var $ak = ".lid{" & text("{}", $kv_lid_b) & "}.want{" & text("{}", $kv_want) & "}.done{" & text("{}", $kv_lid_f) & "}"
	if $ak != $kv_ack
		$kv_ack = $ak
		@out_t($kv_owner, 2, $ak)

; ---- showing it ----
var $kv_ok = 0                          ; the view shows the app's layer
var $kv_cx = 0                          ; layer pixel at the view centre
var $kv_cy = 0
var $kv_c = 1                           ; cos / sin of the turn
var $kv_s = 0
var $kv_rot = 0                         ; turn (radians)
var $kv_vx = 0
var $kv_vy = 0
var $kv_vw = 0
var $kv_vh = 0
var $kv_ocx = 0
var $kv_ocy = 0
var $kv_px = 0                          ; result of @kv_place
var $kv_py = 0
var $kv_void = color(12, 14, 18)
array $kl_x : number                    ; labels drawn (to keep them apart)
array $kl_y : number
array $kl_w : number

function @kv_place($lx : number, $ly : number)
	var $dx = $lx - $kv_cx
	var $dy = $ly - $kv_cy
	$kv_px = $kv_ocx + $dx * $kv_c - $dy * $kv_s
	$kv_py = $kv_ocy + $dx * $kv_s + $dy * $kv_c

function @kv_in($m : number) : number
	return ($kv_px >= $kv_vx + $m) and ($kv_px <= $kv_vx + $kv_vw - $m) and ($kv_py >= $kv_vy + $m) and ($kv_py <= $kv_vy + $kv_vh - $m)

; Line clipped to the view.
function @kv_cline($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number, $c : number)
	var $t0 = 0
	var $t1 = 1
	var $dx = $x2 - $x1
	var $dy = $y2 - $y1
	var $ok = 1
	repeat 4 ($e)
		var $p = 0
		var $q = 0
		if $e == 0
			$p = -$dx
			$q = $x1 - $kv_vx
		elseif $e == 1
			$p = $dx
			$q = $kv_vx + $kv_vw - $x1
		elseif $e == 2
			$p = -$dy
			$q = $y1 - $kv_vy
		else
			$p = $dy
			$q = $kv_vy + $kv_vh - $y1
		if $p == 0
			if $q < 0
				$ok = 0
		else
			var $r = $q / $p
			if $p < 0
				$t0 = max($t0, $r)
			else
				$t1 = min($t1, $r)
	if $ok and ($t0 <= $t1)
		@d_line($x1 + $dx * $t0, $y1 + $dy * $t0, $x1 + $dx * $t1, $y1 + $dy * $t1, $c)

function @kv_ring($x : number, $y : number, $r : number, $c : number)
	repeat 12 ($q)
		var $a1 = $q * pi / 6
		var $a2 = ($q + 1) * pi / 6
		@d_line($x + sin($a1) * $r, $y - cos($a1) * $r, $x + sin($a2) * $r, $y - cos($a2) * $r, $c)

; The navigation arrow, pointing along screen angle a (radians, 0 = up).
function @kv_arrow($cx : number, $cy : number, $r : number, $a : number, $col : number)
	var $fx = sin($a)
	var $fy = -cos($a)
	var $rx = cos($a)
	var $ry = sin($a)
	var $tx = $cx + $fx * $r
	var $ty = $cy + $fy * $r
	var $lx = $cx - $fx * $r * 0.75 - $rx * $r * 0.7
	var $ly = $cy - $fy * $r * 0.75 - $ry * $r * 0.7
	var $qx = $cx - $fx * $r * 0.75 + $rx * $r * 0.7
	var $qy = $cy - $fy * $r * 0.75 + $ry * $r * 0.7
	var $nx = $cx - $fx * $r * 0.35
	var $ny = $cy - $fy * $r * 0.35
	@d_circle($cx, $cy, $r * 1.6, color(30, 70, 120), color(30, 70, 120))
	$rt.draw_triangle($tx - $ox, $ty - $oy, $lx - $ox, $ly - $oy, $nx - $ox, $ny - $oy, $col, $col)
	$rt.draw_triangle($tx - $ox, $ty - $oy, $qx - $ox, $qy - $oy, $nx - $ox, $ny - $oy, $col, $col)
	@d_line($tx, $ty, $lx, $ly, $th_text)
	@d_line($tx, $ty, $qx, $qy, $th_text)
	@d_line($lx, $ly, $nx, $ny, $th_text)
	@d_line($qx, $qy, $nx, $ny, $th_text)

; "V~x~y~w~h~layer~cx~cy~turn~flip": the window of the layer. x..h are % of
; the area; cx, cy the layer pixel at its centre; turn in degrees (the map
; turns that much clockwise on screen); flip -1 turns the picture the other way.
function @kv_view($ax : number, $ay : number, $aw : number, $ah : number)
	var $rx = $ax + $aw * @xf_num(1) / 100
	var $ry = $ay + $ah * @xf_num(2) / 100
	var $rw = $aw * @xf_num(3) / 100
	var $rh = $ah * @xf_num(4) / 100
	var $lid = @xf_num(5)
	$kv_cx = @xf_num(6)
	$kv_cy = @xf_num(7)
	$kv_rot = @xf_num(8) * pi / 180
	var $flip = @xf_num(9)
	if $flip == 0
		$flip = 1
	$kv_c = cos($kv_rot)
	$kv_s = sin($kv_rot)
	$kv_vw = floor(min($rw, 560))
	$kv_vh = floor(min($rh, 440))
	$kv_vx = floor($rx + ($rw - $kv_vw) / 2)
	$kv_vy = floor($ry + ($rh - $kv_vh) / 2)
	$kv_ocx = $kv_vx + $kv_vw / 2
	$kv_ocy = $kv_vy + $kv_vh / 2
	$kl_x.clear()
	$kl_y.clear()
	$kl_w.clear()
	@d_rect($rx, $ry, $rx + $rw, $ry + $rh, $kv_void, $kv_void)
	; which buffer holds that layer
	var $buf = -1
	if ($lid >= 0) and ($lid == $kv_lid_f)
		$buf = $kv_front
	elseif ($lid >= 0) and ($lid == $kv_lid_o)
		$buf = 1 - $kv_front
	$kv_ok = $buf >= 0
	if !$kv_ok
		@text_fit_c($kv_ocx, $kv_ocy - $chh / 2, $th_dim, "DRAWING MAP...", $kv_vw - $cw)
		return
	var $sx = floor($kv_cx - $kv_vw / 2)
	var $sy = floor($kv_cy - $kv_vh / 2)
	if $kv_rot == 0
		if $buf == 0
			screen_copy($kv_a, $rt, $sx, $sy, $kv_vx - $ox, $kv_vy - $oy, $kv_vw, $kv_vh, -1, 0, 0)
		else
			screen_copy($kv_b, $rt, $sx, $sy, $kv_vx - $ox, $kv_vy - $oy, $kv_vw, $kv_vh, -1, 0, 0)
	else
		var $q = ceil(sqrt($kv_vw * $kv_vw + $kv_vh * $kv_vh)) + 2
		$kv_tmp.blank($kv_void)
		if $buf == 0
			screen_copy($kv_a, $kv_tmp, floor($kv_cx - $q / 2), floor($kv_cy - $q / 2), floor(($kv_vw - $q) / 2), floor(($kv_vh - $q) / 2), $q, $q, -1, $kv_rot * 180 / pi * $flip, 0)
		else
			screen_copy($kv_b, $kv_tmp, floor($kv_cx - $q / 2), floor($kv_cy - $q / 2), floor(($kv_vw - $q) / 2), floor(($kv_vh - $q) / 2), $q, $q, -1, $kv_rot * 180 / pi * $flip, 0)
		screen_copy($kv_tmp, $rt, 0, 0, $kv_vx - $ox, $kv_vy - $oy, $kv_vw, $kv_vh, -1, 0, 0)

; A label: skipped when it would overlap one already drawn.
function @kv_label($x : number, $y : number, $c : number, $t : text)
	var $lw = $cw * size($t)
	if ($x + $lw > $kv_vx + $kv_vw) or ($y - $chh / 2 < $kv_vy) or ($y + $chh / 2 > $kv_vy + $kv_vh)
		return
	var $nl = $kl_x.size
	repeat $nl ($l)
		if (abs($kl_y.$l - $y) < $chh) and ($x < $kl_x.$l + $kl_w.$l + $cw) and ($x + $lw + $cw > $kl_x.$l)
			return
	@ui_text($x, $y - $chh / 2, $c, $t)
	$kl_x.append($x)
	$kl_y.append($y)
	$kl_w.append($lw)

; Things on top of the layer (layer pixels; sizes in screen pixels).
function @kv_over($kind : text)
	var $v = min($kv_vw, $kv_vh)
	if $kind == "Vw"
		@text_fit_c($kv_ocx, $kv_vy + $chh * 0.4, @xf_color(@xf_txt(1)), @xf_txt(2), $kv_vw - $cw)
		return
	if $kind == "Vb"
		if $kv_vh < $chh * 6
			return
		@ui_text($kv_vx + $cw * 0.5, $kv_vy + $kv_vh - $chh * 1.2, @xf_color(@xf_txt(1)), @xf_txt(2))
		return
	if !$kv_ok
		return
	if $kind == "Vl"
		@kv_place(@xf_num(1), @xf_num(2))
		var $x1 = $kv_px
		var $y1 = $kv_py
		@kv_place(@xf_num(3), @xf_num(4))
		var $lc = @xf_color(@xf_txt(5))
		@kv_cline($x1, $y1, $kv_px, $kv_py, $lc)
		@kv_cline($x1 + 1, $y1, $kv_px + 1, $kv_py, $lc)
	elseif $kind == "Vp"
		; polyline "x,y,x,y,..." (the trail)
		var $pc = @xf_color(@xf_txt(1))
		var $ps = @xf_txt(2)
		var $px = 0
		var $py = 0
		var $first = 1
		repeat 200 ($k)
			if $ps != ""
				var $c1 = find($ps, ",")
				var $xs = $ps
				var $ys = ""
				if $c1 < 0
					$ps = ""
				else
					$xs = substring($ps, 0, $c1)
					$ps = substring($ps, $c1 + 1, size($ps))
					var $c2 = find($ps, ",")
					if $c2 < 0
						$ys = $ps
						$ps = ""
					else
						$ys = substring($ps, 0, $c2)
						$ps = substring($ps, $c2 + 1, size($ps))
				if isnumeric($xs) and isnumeric($ys)
					@kv_place($xs:number, $ys:number)
					if !$first
						@kv_cline($px, $py, $kv_px, $kv_py, $pc)
					$px = $kv_px
					$py = $kv_py
					$first = 0
	elseif ($kind == "Vd") or ($kind == "Vo")
		@kv_place(@xf_num(1), @xf_num(2))
		if @kv_in(3)
			var $dc = @xf_color(@xf_txt(4))
			var $dr = max(@xf_num(3), 2)
			if $kind == "Vd"
				@d_circle($kv_px, $kv_py, $dr, $dc, $dc)
			else
				@kv_ring($kv_px, $kv_py, $dr, $dc)
	elseif $kind == "Vk"
		; a city: dot and name
		@kv_place(@xf_num(1), @xf_num(2))
		if @kv_in(2)
			@d_circle($kv_px, $kv_py, 2, $th_text, $th_text)
			@kv_label($kv_px + 5, $kv_py, $th_dim, @xf_txt(3))
	elseif $kind == "Vt"
		@kv_place(@xf_num(1), @xf_num(2))
		if @kv_in(2)
			@kv_label($kv_px + 5, $kv_py, @xf_color(@xf_txt(3)), @xf_txt(4))
	elseif $kind == "Va"
		@kv_place(@xf_num(1), @xf_num(2))
		if @kv_in(0)
			var $ar = max(5, $v / 40)
			@kv_arrow($kv_px, $kv_py, $ar, @xf_num(3) * pi / 180 + $kv_rot, @xf_color(@xf_txt(4)))
			; labels stay off the arrow
			$kl_x.append($kv_px - $ar * 1.8)
			$kl_y.append($kv_py)
			$kl_w.append($ar * 3.6)
	elseif $kind == "Vc"
		; compass ring (the map turns under a fixed arrow)
		var $cr = $v / 2 - 3
		repeat 36 ($rg)
			var $r1 = $rg * pi / 18
			var $r2 = ($rg + 1) * pi / 18
			@d_line($kv_ocx + sin($r1) * $cr, $kv_ocy - cos($r1) * $cr, $kv_ocx + sin($r2) * $cr, $kv_ocy - cos($r2) * $cr, color(90, 110, 130))
		repeat 8 ($p)
			var $pa = $p * pi / 4 + $kv_rot
			@d_line($kv_ocx + sin($pa) * $cr, $kv_ocy - cos($pa) * $cr, $kv_ocx + sin($pa) * ($cr - 6), $kv_ocy - cos($pa) * ($cr - 6), $th_text)
		@ui_text_c($kv_ocx + sin($kv_rot) * ($cr - $chh * 1.1), $kv_ocy - cos($kv_rot) * ($cr - $chh * 1.1) - $chh / 2, $th_bad, "N")
		@ui_text_c($kv_ocx, $kv_ocy - $cr + 2, $th_text, text("{0}", @posmod(-$kv_rot * 180 / pi, 360)))
	elseif $kind == "Vn"
		var $nx = $kv_vx + $kv_vw - $cw * 1.5
		var $ny = $kv_vy + $chh * 1.7
		@ui_text_c($nx + sin($kv_rot) * $chh, $ny - cos($kv_rot) * $chh - $chh / 2, $th_bad, "N")
		@d_line($nx, $ny, $nx + sin($kv_rot) * $chh * 0.6, $ny - cos($kv_rot) * $chh * 0.6, $th_bad)
	elseif $kind == "Vs"
		; scale bar for k km per pixel: a round number, at most a third of the view
		var $k = max(@xf_num(1), 0.000001)
		var $unit = 1
		if $cfg_units
			$unit = 1.609344
		var $lim = $kv_vw * $k / 3 / $unit
		var $nice = 0.001
		repeat 12 ($p)
			if $nice * 10 <= $lim
				$nice = $nice * 10
		if $nice * 5 <= $lim
			$nice = $nice * 5
		elseif $nice * 2 <= $lim
			$nice = $nice * 2
		var $sl = $nice * $unit / $k
		var $st = text("{} km", $nice)
		if $nice < 1
			$st = text("{} m", round($nice * 1000))
		if $cfg_units
			$st = text("{} mi", $nice)
			if $nice < 0.5
				$st = text("{} ft", round($nice * 5280))
		var $by = $kv_vy + $kv_vh - $chh * 0.6
		var $bx2 = $kv_vx + $kv_vw - $cw
		@d_line($bx2 - $sl, $by, $bx2, $by, $th_text)
		@d_line($bx2 - $sl, $by - 3, $bx2 - $sl, $by, $th_text)
		@d_line($bx2, $by - 3, $bx2, $by, $th_text)
		if $kv_vh >= $chh * 6
			@ui_text_r($bx2, $by - $chh * 1.3, $th_text, $st)

xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - device database. Survives reboot (storage); refreshed by a scan
; of every device on the data network every 3 s (25 devices per tick).
; Ids identify a device; only an ALIAS can read or control it (probe v3).
storage var $db_ver : number
storage array $db_id : text
storage array $db_type : text
storage array $db_alias : text
storage array $db_label : text
storage array $db_on : number       ; -1 leave alone, 0 off, 1 on (lights/relays)
storage array $db_ess : number      ; relay priority: 0 LOW, 1 NORMAL, 2 ESSENTIAL (v0.7)
storage array $lt_a : text              ; light colours: alias ...
storage array $lt_rgb : number          ; ... r*65536 + g*256 + b
storage var $cfg_relays_boot : number

array $db_seen : number             ; scan generation in which it was last seen
array $db_cat : number
array $db_isnew : number
var $scan_i = 0
var $scan_n = 0
var $scan_gen = 1
var $scan_next = 0
var $scan_done_once = 0
var $db_present = 0
var $db_unnamed = 0
var $db_missing = 0
var $db_newcount = 0
var $db_rev = 0                     ; bumps when anything visible changes
var $assert_next = 0
var $pw_shed = 0                    ; low-battery rule active (NORMAL tier)
var $pw_shed_low = 0                ; LOW-priority tier active
array $cat_counts : number
array $pc_last : number             ; devices per computer port (last full scan)
array $pc_new : number              ; ... being counted

function @db_load()
	if $db_ver != 1
		$db_id.clear()
		$db_type.clear()
		$db_alias.clear()
		$db_label.clear()
		$db_on.clear()
		$db_ess.clear()
		$cfg_relays_boot = 1
		$db_ver = 1
	$db_seen.clear()
	$db_cat.clear()
	$db_isnew.clear()
	var $dl_n = $db_id.size
	; 0.2: essential flags for databases made by 0.1.
	repeat 1000 ($dl_pad)
		if $db_ess.size < $dl_n
			$db_ess.append(1)
	repeat $dl_n ($dl_i)
		$db_seen.append(0)
		var $dl_t = $db_type.$dl_i
		$db_cat.append(@cat_of($dl_t))
		$db_isnew.append(0)

function @db_find($f_id : text, $f_hint : number) : number
	var $f_n = $db_id.size
	if ($f_hint >= 0) and ($f_hint < $f_n)
		if $db_id.$f_hint == $f_id
			return $f_hint
	repeat $f_n ($f_j)
		if $db_id.$f_j == $f_id
			return $f_j
	return -1

function @db_needs_name($j : number) : number
	if $db_alias.$j != ""
		return 0
	var $nn_c = $db_cat.$j
	if ($nn_c == 6) or ($nn_c == 14)
		return 0
	return 1

function @db_touch($t_id : text, $t_type : text, $t_alias : text, $t_hint : number)
	if $t_id == ""
		return
	var $j = @db_find($t_id, $t_hint)
	if $j < 0
		$db_id.append($t_id)
		$db_type.append($t_type)
		$db_alias.append($t_alias)
		$db_label.append("")
		var $t_cat = @cat_of($t_type)
		var $t_on = -1
		if ($t_cat == 2) and ($t_alias != "") and $cfg_relays_boot
			$t_on = 1
		$db_on.append($t_on)
		$db_ess.append(2)
		$db_seen.append($scan_gen)
		$db_cat.append($t_cat)
		$db_isnew.append($scan_done_once)
		$db_rev += 1
		return
	$db_seen.$j = $scan_gen
	if $db_type.$j != $t_type
		$db_type.$j = $t_type
		$db_cat.$j = @cat_of($t_type)
		$db_rev += 1
	if $db_alias.$j != $t_alias
		$db_alias.$j = $t_alias
		; A relay that just got its name joins the boot policy.
		if ($db_cat.$j == 2) and ($t_alias != "") and ($db_on.$j < 0) and $cfg_relays_boot
			$db_on.$j = 1
		$db_rev += 1

function @db_summarize()
	var $s_n = $db_id.size
	var $s_present = 0
	var $s_unnamed = 0
	var $s_missing = 0
	var $s_new = 0
	$cat_counts.clear()
	repeat $cat_count ($s_c)
		$cat_counts.append(0)
	repeat $s_n ($s_j)
		if $db_seen.$s_j == $scan_gen
			$s_present += 1
			var $s_cat = $db_cat.$s_j
			$cat_counts.$s_cat = $cat_counts.$s_cat + 1
			if @db_needs_name($s_j)
				$s_unnamed += 1
			if $db_isnew.$s_j
				$s_new += 1
		else
			$s_missing += 1
	if ($s_present != $db_present) or ($s_unnamed != $db_unnamed) or ($s_missing != $db_missing) or ($s_new != $db_newcount)
		$db_rev += 1
	$db_present = $s_present
	$db_unnamed = $s_unnamed
	$db_missing = $s_missing
	$db_newcount = $s_new

; One slice of the rolling scan (call every tick).
function @scan_tick()
	if ($scan_i == 0) and (time < $scan_next)
		return
	if $scan_i == 0
		$scan_n = device_count()
		$scan_gen += 1
		$pc_new.clear()
		repeat 32 ($pq)
			$pc_new.append(0)
	var $st_end = min($scan_i + 25, $scan_n)
	var $st_cnt = $st_end - $scan_i
	repeat $st_cnt ($st_k)
		var $st_ix = $scan_i + $st_k
		var $st_d = device_at($st_ix)
		var $st_id = $st_d.id
		var $st_type = $st_d.type
		var $st_alias = $st_d.alias
		; plugged straight into a port of this computer: no alias needed
		var $st_pt = text("{}", $st_d.port)
		var $st_p = -1
		if isnumeric($st_pt)
			$st_p = $st_pt:number
		if ($st_p >= 0) and ($st_p < 32)
			$pc_new.$st_p += 1
			if ($st_alias == "") and ($st_p < $pc_last.size) and !contains($st_type, "Router")
				if $pc_last.$st_p == 1
					$st_alias = "#" & text("{}", $st_p)
		@db_touch($st_id, $st_type, $st_alias, $st_ix)
	$scan_i = $st_end
	if $scan_i >= $scan_n
		$pc_last.clear()
		repeat 32 ($pq2)
			$pc_last.append($pc_new.$pq2)
		$scan_i = 0
		$scan_next = time + 3
		@db_summarize()
		$scan_done_once = 1

; Full scan in one go (boot).
function @scan_all()
	$scan_i = 0
	$scan_next = 0
	; twice: the first pass counts what is on each port
	repeat 2 ($sa_p)
		$scan_i = 0
		$scan_next = 0
		repeat 100 ($sa_k)
			if ($sa_k == 0) or ($scan_i > 0)
				@scan_tick()

; Lights / power switches ChipOS manages: re-assert once a second.
function @db_assert()
	if time < $assert_next
		return
	$assert_next = time + 1
	var $as_n = $db_id.size
	repeat $as_n ($as_j)
		var $as_on = $db_on.$as_j
		if $as_on >= 0
			var $as_a = $db_alias.$as_j
			if ($as_a != "") and (($db_seen.$as_j >= $scan_gen - 1))
				if $db_cat.$as_j == 2
					var $as_p = $db_ess.$as_j
					if ($as_p == 0) and ($pw_shed_low or $pw_shed)
						$as_on = 0
					elseif ($as_p == 1) and $pw_shed
						$as_on = 0
				@out_n($as_a, 0, $as_on)
				if $db_cat.$as_j == 1
					var $ln = $lt_a.size
					repeat $ln ($lq)
						if $lt_a.$lq == $as_a
							var $rgb = $lt_rgb.$lq
							@out_n($as_a, 1, floor($rgb / 65536))
							@out_n($as_a, 2, mod(floor($rgb / 256), 256))
							@out_n($as_a, 3, mod($rgb, 256))

; Next free alias like "light-03" for an unnamed device.
function @db_suggest($sg_j : number) : text
	var $sg_p = @cat_prefix($db_cat.$sg_j)
	if contains($db_type.$sg_j, "Wheel")
		$sg_p = "wheel"
	elseif contains($db_type.$sg_j, "Seat")
		$sg_p = "seat"
	if $sg_p == ""
		return ""
	var $sg_n = $db_alias.size
	repeat 99 ($sg_k)
		var $sg_num = @pad2($sg_k + 1)
		var $sg_name = text("{}-{}", $sg_p, $sg_num)
		var $sg_used = 0
		repeat $sg_n ($sg_i)
			if $db_alias.$sg_i == $sg_name
				$sg_used = 1
		if !$sg_used
			return $sg_name
	return $sg_p & "-xx"

function @db_name($j : number) : text
	var $nm = $db_alias.$j
	if $nm != ""
		return $nm
	var $nm_t = $db_type.$j
	return "(unnamed) " & $nm_t

; ---- data junctions / bridges wired to lamps count as lights (LIGHTS > JUNCTIONS) ----
storage var $lt_jx : text               ; data junctions the user ticked as running lights
storage var $lt_jno : text              ; ... and ones unticked (beats the name)

function @lt_is_jx($t : text) : number
	return ($t == "DataJunction") or ($t == "DataBridge")

function @lt_jfix()
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if @lt_is_jx($db_type.$j)
			var $a = $db_alias.$j
			var $l = lower($a)
			var $is = 0
			if $a != ""
				$is = (find($lt_jx, "|" & $a & "|") >= 0) or (((find($l, "light") >= 0) or (find($l, "lamp") >= 0)) and (find($lt_jno, "|" & $a & "|") < 0))
			var $c = 6
			if $is
				$c = 1
			if $db_cat.$j != $c
				$db_cat.$j = $c
				$db_rev += 1

xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - POWER: group editor and the automation rule builder.

; Relays and lights that can be switched (alias + present) -> $sl_txt/$sl_spec
function @switchable_rows($with_groups : number)
	@lt_jfix()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	if $with_groups
		var $gn = $gp_name.size
		repeat $gn ($g)
			var $gc = @gp_count($g)
			$sl_txt.append("GROUP: " & $gp_name.$g & text("  ({} DEVICES)", $gc))
			$sl_spec.append("group:" & $gp_name.$g)
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		var $c = $db_cat.$j
		if ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1) and (($c == 1) or ($c == 2))
			$sl_txt.append(@cat_name($c) & ": " & $db_alias.$j)
			$sl_spec.append($db_alias.$j)

; Group members: tap to add / remove.
function @page_gp_edit()
	if ($gp_cur < 0) or ($gp_cur >= $gp_name.size)
		@go("power")
		return
	@switchable_rows(0)
	var $n = $sl_txt.size
	repeat $n ($k)
		var $mark = "[  ]  "
		if @gp_has($gp_cur, $sl_spec.$k)
			$mark = "[X]  "
		$sl_txt.$k = $mark & $sl_txt.$k
	var $bw = $cw * 12
	@ui_btn($content_x + min($content_w, $cw * 70) - $bw, $content_y - $chh * 0.4, $bw, $chh * 2.2, "DONE", "gp_done", 3)
	@pick_list("GROUP: " & $gp_name.$gp_cur, "Tap devices to add or remove them.", "gp_mem")

; ---- rule builder ----
function @page_au_type()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$sl_txt.append("BATTERY BELOW A LEVEL   (e.g. start a generator)")
	$sl_txt.append("BATTERY ABOVE A LEVEL   (e.g. stop charging when full)")
	$sl_txt.append("TIME OF DAY   (e.g. lights 19:00 - 06:00)")
	$sl_txt.append("NIGHT - NO SOLAR   (e.g. lights on at dusk)")
	$sl_txt.append("NIGHT - SUNSET TO SUNRISE   (time server)")
	@pick_list("NEW RULE - WHEN?", "", "au_type")

function @page_au_tgt()
	@switchable_rows(1)
	@pick_list("NEW RULE - WHAT DOES IT SWITCH?", "", "au_tgt")

function @page_au_act()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$sl_txt.append("TURN IT ON   (and OFF again when it ends)")
	$sl_txt.append("TURN IT OFF   (and ON again when it ends)")
	@pick_list("NEW RULE - DO WHAT?", "", "au_act")

function @page_au_val()
	var $hd = "NEW RULE"
	if $aun_edit >= 0
		$hd = "EDIT RULE"
	var $y = @set_header($hd)
	var $mid = $content_x + min($content_w, $cw * 60) / 2
	var $dsc = @au_desc_of($aun_type, $aun_a, $aun_b, $aun_tgt, $aun_act)
	$y = @ui_para_c($mid, $y, $th_accent, $dsc, min($content_w, $cw * 60))
	$y += $chh * 0.6
	if $aun_type == 1
		$y = @set_stepper($y, "WHEN BELOW", text("{}%", $aun_a), "au_a-", "au_a+")
		$y = @set_stepper($y, "UNTIL ABOVE", text("{}%", $aun_b), "au_b-", "au_b+")
	elseif $aun_type == 2
		$y = @set_stepper($y, "WHEN ABOVE", text("{}%", $aun_a), "au_a-", "au_a+")
		$y = @set_stepper($y, "UNTIL BELOW", text("{}%", $aun_b), "au_b-", "au_b+")
	elseif $aun_type == 3
		var $ta = @hm_text($aun_a)
		var $tb = @hm_text($aun_b)
		$y = @set_stepper($y, "FROM", $ta, "au_a-", "au_a+")
		$y = @set_stepper($y, "TO", $tb, "au_b-", "au_b+")
	elseif $aun_type == 4
		var $sw = @fmt_power($aun_a)
		$y = @set_stepper($y, "SOLAR BELOW", $sw, "au_a-", "au_a+")
	else
		$y = @ui_para_c($mid, $y, $th_dim, @sun_line(), min($content_w, $cw * 60))
	$y += $chh * 0.4
	var $bw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	var $hb = ($bw - $cw) / 2
	$y = @bz_fit($y, $chh * 2.6)
	@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $hb, $chh * 2.6, "CANCEL", "au_cancel", 0)
	@ui_btn($content_x + $hb + $cw, $y, $hb, $chh * 2.6, "SAVE", "au_save", 3)

; Step a rule value. $which 0 = A, 1 = B; $d = -1 / +1.
function @aun_step($which : number, $d : number)
	if ($aun_type == 1) or ($aun_type == 2)
		if $which == 0
			$aun_a = clamp($aun_a + $d * 5, 5, 95)
		else
			$aun_b = clamp($aun_b + $d * 5, 5, 100)
		; keep the band the right way round
		if $aun_type == 1
			if $aun_b <= $aun_a
				if $which == 0
					$aun_b = min($aun_a + 5, 100)
				else
					$aun_a = max($aun_b - 5, 5)
		else
			if $aun_b >= $aun_a
				if $which == 0
					$aun_b = max($aun_a - 5, 5)
				else
					$aun_a = min($aun_b + 5, 100)
	elseif $aun_type == 3
		if $which == 0
			$aun_a = @posmod($aun_a + $d * 15, 1440)
		else
			$aun_b = @posmod($aun_b + $d * 15, 1440)
	else
		$aun_a = max($aun_a + $d * 50, 0)

; Load-shedding thresholds (narrow screens).
function @page_pw_shed()
	var $y = @set_header("POWER / LOAD SHEDDING")
	var $mid = $content_x + min($content_w, $cw * 60) / 2
	$y = @ui_para_c($mid, $y, $th_dim, "LOW-priority relays go off first, NORMAL ones later; ESSENTIAL never.", min($content_w, $cw * 60))
	$y += $chh * 0.4
	$y = @set_stepper($y, "LOW OFF BELOW", text("{}%", $pw_low2), "pw_l2-", "pw_l2+")
	$y = @set_stepper($y, "LOW BACK ABOVE", text("{}%", $pw_restore2), "pw_r2-", "pw_r2+")
	$y = @set_stepper($y, "NORMAL OFF BELOW", text("{}%", $pw_low), "pw_low-", "pw_low+")
	$y = @set_stepper($y, "NORMAL BACK ABOVE", text("{}%", $pw_restore), "pw_rs-", "pw_rs+")

xc_files.plain_code:
; ---- questions ChipOS asks once (weather station, solar tracking) ----
var $ask_id = ""
var $ask_q = ""
var $ask_a1 = ""
var $ask_a2 = ""
var $ask_t = 0
var $sx_tg = ""                         ; SORTER: trash conveyor guess being asked about
var $fl_back = "fluids"                 ; RULES goes back here
var $lt_cnt_t = 0
function @ask_open($id : text, $q : text, $a1 : text, $a2 : text)
	$ask_id = $id
	$ask_q = $q
	$ask_a1 = $a1
	$ask_a2 = $a2
	$ui_dirty = 1
	@snd_beep(988, 0.12)

function @ask_draw()
	@ui_hit(0, 0, $desk_w, $desk_h, "ask_none")
	var $mw = min($desk_w * 0.92, $cw * 50)
	var $bh = $chh * 2.4
	var $mx = $desk_w / 2 - $mw / 2
	var $lines = ceil(size($ask_q) * $cw / ($mw - $cw * 4)) + 1
	var $mh = $chh * (1.4 + $lines * 1.0) + ($bh + $chh * 0.5) * 2
	var $my = max($chh, $desk_h / 2 - $mh / 2)
	@ui_box($mx, $my, $mw, $mh, $th_panel2, $th_accent)
	var $y = @ui_para_c($desk_w / 2, $my + $chh * 0.8, $th_text, $ask_q, $mw - $cw * 2)
	$y += $chh * 0.6
	$ui_hv = 1
	@ui_btn($mx + $cw, $y, $mw - $cw * 2, $bh, $ask_a1, "ask:1", 3)
	$y += $bh + $chh * 0.5
	$ui_hv = 2
	@ui_btn($mx + $cw, $y, $mw - $cw * 2, $bh, $ask_a2, "ask:2", 0)

function @ask_answer($v : number)
	var $id = $ask_id
	$ask_id = ""
	if $id == "wx"
		if $v == 1
			$ws_state = 1
			$ws_t = 0
			@ui_toast("WEATHER STATION ON")
			@go("weather")
		else
			$ws_state = 2
			$ws_nans = $ws_ndens + $ws_ntherm
			@ui_toast("WEATHER OFF UNTIL MORE SENSORS ARE ADDED")
	elseif $id == "sol"
		if $v == 1
			$so_state = 1
			$so_mode = 0
			$so_t = 0
			@go("solar")
		else
			$so_state = 2
	elseif $id == "sonav"
		if $v == 1
			@go("so_navpick")
		else
			$so_navsel = "-"
			$so_cal = 0
	elseif $id == "wsnav"
		if $v == 1
			@go("ws_navpick")
		else
			$ws_nav_later = 1
	elseif $id == "rfrad"
		$rf_rad_n = $fr_a.size
		if $v == 1
			$rf_rad = 1
			$rf_rad_w = -1
			@ui_toast("RADIATORS RUN WITH THE REFINERY")
		else
			$rf_rad = 2
	elseif $id == "tsv"
		if $v == 1
			$tsv_on = 1
			@go("cm_srv")
		else
			$tsv_on = 2
	elseif $id == "sxtg"
		if $v == 1
			$sx_tcv = $sx_tg
			$sx_ovm = 1
			@go("sx_over")
		else
			@go("sx_tcv")
	elseif $id == "sxtp"
		if $v == 1
			@go("sx_tcv")
		else
			$sx_tcv = "-"
	elseif $id == "sxov"
		if $v == 1
			$sx_ovm = 2
			@go("sx_ovc")
		else
			$sx_ovm = 3
	elseif $id == "wtref"
		if $v == 1
			@go("wt_refpick")
		else
			$wt_refnav = "-"
	elseif $id == "wt"
		if $v == 1
			$wt_state = 1
			$wt_mode = 0
			$wt_t = 0
			@go("solar")
		else
			$wt_state = 2
	$ui_dirty = 1

; Ask when there's something to ask (and nothing else is going on).
function @ask_tick()
	$ws_present = @ws_on()
	$so_present = @so_on() or @wt_on()
	$so_label = "SOLAR"
	if @wt_on()
		$so_label = "WIND"
		if @so_on()
			$so_label = "SOLAR+WIND"
	$fl_app = $fl_present
	$rf_app = $rf_present
	$fy_app = $fy_present
	$bt_app = $bt_present
	if time >= $lt_cnt_t
		$lt_cnt_t = time + 3
		@lg_refresh()
		$lt_app = @lt_count() > 0
	$mn_app = @mn_present()
	$sx_app = $sx_present
	if ($ui_page == "fluids") or ($ui_page == "refinery")
		$fl_back = $ui_page
	if ($ask_id != "") or !$os_setup_done or $kb_on
		return
	; v0.25.2: questions only on the home screen, one at a time (never over
	; a page the user is busy with, or over a picker another answer opened)
	if $ui_page != "home"
		$ask_t = time + 2
		return
	if time < $ask_t
		return
	$ask_t = time + 2

	elseif $rf_present and ($rf_type == 1) and ($fr_a.size > 0) and ($rf_rad == 0) and ($rf_cool == "")
		@ask_open("rfrad", text("REFINERY: {} active radiator(s) found. Are they there to cool the chemical furnaces that process oil shale? If yes, ChipOS runs them while the refinery runs and turns them off when it stops.", $fr_a.size), "YES - RUN THEM WITH THE REFINERY", "NO - THEY ARE FOR SOMETHING ELSE")
	elseif $wt_avail and ($wt_state == 0) and !(($so_state == 1) and ($so_piv == "") and $so_avail)
		@ask_open("wt", "WIND GENERATORS: propellers and spare Small Pivots were found. Let ChipOS find which pivots turn a turbine (it turns each spare pivot briefly) and keep the turbines facing into the wind?", "YES - FACE THE WIND", "NO")
	elseif @wt_on() and @ws_on() and ($wt_refnav == "") and ($wt_pv.size > 0) and ($wt_mode >= 2)
		@ask_open("wtref", "WIND TURBINES: so they all face the wind together, ChipOS needs to know which wind instrument (nav) faces the SAME direction the turbines face when their pivots are at 0.", "PICK IT NOW", "NONE DOES - AIM BY SPIN")
	elseif 0
		@ask_open("tsv", "TIME SERVER: ChipOS can work out the solar cycle with the free nav '" & $tsv_nav & "' and put the time, sunrise / sunset and the Solar4488V2 solar data in this base's own broadcast (COMMS, structured), so craft like the Badger set themselves up from this one beacon.", "YES - BE THE TIME SERVER", "NO")
	elseif @sx_need_ask()
		$sx_tg = @sx_trash_guess()
		if ($sx_tcv == "") and ($sx_tg != "")
			@ask_open("sxtg", "SORTER: the conveyor '" & $sx_tg & "' has TRASH in its name. Is it connected to a trash can (taking from the ore container)? Trash cans only go on the conveyor network, so ChipOS can't see them.", "YES - IT FEEDS THE TRASH CAN", "NO - LET ME PICK THE CONVEYOR")
		elseif $sx_tcv == ""
			@ask_open("sxtp", "SORTER: trash cans only connect to the conveyor network, so ChipOS can't see them. Which conveyor feeds your trash can? (Extra ore past half full is thrown out through it - silicon first, then iron, copper, aluminium.)", "PICK THE TRASH CONVEYOR", "THERE IS NO TRASH CAN")
		elseif @sx_tcv_set()
			$sx_ovm = 1
		else
			@ask_open("sxov", "SORTER: there is no trash can. When an ore container fills up, what should ChipOS do with the extra ore?", "MOVE IT TO AN OVERFLOW CONTAINER", "NOTHING - KEEP IT")

var $dr_pend = -1                       ; drawer: app tapped, opens on release
var $ov_amenu = 0                       ; app menu (press and hold in the drawer)
var $am_app = 0
var $am_confirm = 0                     ; 1 clear data?, 2 uninstall?

function @app_open($id : number)
	$cm_back = "home"
	if ($id >= 6) and ($id <= 10)
		$ba_cur = $id
	var $ap_pg = @app_page($id)
	@go($ap_pg)
	if $id >= 100
		$xa_cur = $id - 100
		$xa_frame_seen = ""
		; ignore a keyboard request left over from before
		if $xa_cur < $xa_inq.size
			$xa_inq.$xa_cur = @in_t($xa_alias.$xa_cur, 2)
		var $ao_c = @clk_text()
		var $ao_d = @clk_day()
		@xa_send("open", "", $ao_c, $ao_d, $cfg_units, "")

; Called every tick: a drawer tap opens once the finger is lifted.
function @drawer_tick()
	if ($dr_pend >= 0) and (time - $hold_last > 0.25)
		var $dp = $dr_pend
		$dr_pend = -1
		if ($ui_page == "drawer") and (!$ov_amenu)
			@app_open($dp)
			$ui_dirty = 1

function @app_can_clear($id : number) : number
	return ($id >= 100) or ($id == 1) or ($id == 4) or (($id >= 6) and ($id <= 10))

; Wipe an app's saved data, as if new.
function @app_clear($id : number)
	if $id >= 100
		var $ck = @clk_text()
		var $cd = @clk_day()
		@xa_send_to($id - 100, "clear", "", $ck, $cd, $cfg_units, "")
	elseif ($id >= 6) and ($id <= 10)
		@ba_clear($id)
	elseif $id == 4
		$wc_zone.clear()
	elseif $id == 1
		$pw_low = 15
		$pw_restore = 25
		$pw_low2 = 30
		$pw_restore2 = 40
		$pw_main_alias = ""
		$au_type.clear()
		$au_a.clear()
		$au_b.clear()
		$au_tgt.clear()
		$au_act.clear()
		$au_en.clear()
		$au_st.clear()
		$gp_name.clear()
		$gp_mem.clear()
		var $cn = $db_ess.size
		repeat $cn ($cj)
			$db_ess.$cj = 2
		$assert_next = 0

; Forget an external app: ChipOS ignores its computer until restored.
function @app_uninstall($id : number)
	if $id < 100
		return
	var $k = $id - 100
	if $k >= $xa_alias.size
		return
	; tell the app to unload (App Kit v3 blanks its outputs until restarted)
	var $uc = @clk_text()
	var $ud = @clk_day()
	@xa_send_to($k, "uninstall", "", $uc, $ud, $cfg_units, "")
	var $uhb = 1000000000
	if $k < $xa_hb.size
		if isnumeric($xa_hb.$k)
			$uhb = $xa_hb.$k:number
	$xa_block.append($xa_alias.$k)
	$xa_block_hb.append($uhb)
	if $k < $xa_online.size
		$xa_online.$k = 0
	if $ui_page == "xapp"
		@go("home")
	var $hn = $hm_pg.size
	repeat $hn ($q)
		var $hi = $hn - 1 - $q
		if @item_app($hi) == $k
			@hm_remove($hi)

function @app_menu_draw()
	@ui_hit(0, 0, $desk_w, $desk_h, "am_close")
	var $mw = min($desk_w * 0.9, $cw * 36)
	var $bh = $chh * 2.4
	var $nm = @app_name($am_app)
	var $items = 2
	if @app_can_clear($am_app)
		$items += 1
	if $am_app >= 100
		$items += 1
	if $am_confirm
		$items = 2
	var $mh = $items * ($bh + $chh * 0.5) + $chh * 3
	var $mx = $desk_w / 2 - $mw / 2
	var $my = $desk_h / 2 - $mh / 2
	@ui_box($mx, $my, $mw, $mh, $th_panel2, $th_accent)
	var $y = $my + $chh * 2.4
	var $bx = $mx + $cw
	var $bw = $mw - $cw * 2
	if $am_confirm
		var $q = "CLEAR ALL DATA OF " & $nm & "?"
		if $am_confirm == 2
			$q = "UNINSTALL " & $nm & "?"
		@text_fit_c($desk_w / 2, $my + $chh * 0.7, $th_warn, $q, $mw - $cw * 2)
		@ui_btn($bx, $y, $bw, $bh, "YES", "am_yes", 2)
		$y += $bh + $chh * 0.5
		@ui_btn($bx, $y, $bw, $bh, "NO", "am_no", 0)
		return
	@text_fit_c($desk_w / 2, $my + $chh * 0.7, $th_text, $nm, $mw - $cw * 2)
	@ui_btn($bx, $y, $bw, $bh, "ADD TO HOME SCREEN", "am_add", 0)
	$y += $bh + $chh * 0.5
	if @app_can_clear($am_app)
		@ui_btn($bx, $y, $bw, $bh, "CLEAR DATA", "am_clear", 0)
		$y += $bh + $chh * 0.5
	if $am_app >= 100
		@ui_btn($bx, $y, $bw, $bh, "UNINSTALL", "am_uninst", 2)
		$y += $bh + $chh * 0.5
	@ui_btn($bx, $y, $bw, $bh, "CANCEL", "am_close", 0)

function @ui_action($act : text, $val : number)
	if $act == "go:home"
		@go("home")
	elseif $act == "nav:home"
		$ov_shade = 0
		$ov_menu = 0
		$ov_vol = 0
		$hm_edit = 0
		@go("home")
	elseif $act == "kb"
		@kb_press($val)
	elseif $act == "nav:back"
		if $kb_on
			@kb_finish(1)
		elseif $ov_shade or $ov_menu or $ov_vol or $ov_amenu
			$ov_shade = 0
			$ov_menu = 0
			$ov_vol = 0
			$ov_amenu = 0
		elseif $hm_edit
			$hm_edit = 0
		else
			var $par = @page_parent($ui_page)
			@go($par)
	elseif $act == "nav:apps"
		$ov_shade = 0
		$ov_menu = 0
		$ov_vol = 0
		@go("drawer")
	elseif $act == "shade"
		$ov_shade = !$ov_shade
		$ov_vol = 0
		if $ov_shade
			$nt_unread = 0
	elseif $act == "nt_clear"
		$nt_text.clear()
		$nt_time.clear()
		$nt_unread = 0
	elseif $act == "vol"
		$ov_vol = !$ov_vol
		$ov_shade = 0
	elseif $act == "vol_close"
		$ov_vol = 0
	elseif $act == "vol-"
		$cfg_volume = max($cfg_volume - 10, 0)
		@snd_beep(880, 0.15)
	elseif $act == "vol+"
		$cfg_volume = min($cfg_volume + 10, 100)
		@snd_beep(880, 0.15)
	elseif $act == "vol_mute"
		if $cfg_volume > 0
			$snd_premute = $cfg_volume
			$cfg_volume = 0
		else
			$cfg_volume = max($snd_premute, 10)
			@snd_beep(880, 0.15)
	elseif $act == "app"
		if $ui_page == "drawer"
			; open on release, so press-and-hold can show the app menu
			$dr_pend = $val
		else
			@app_open($val)
	elseif $act == "am_close"
		$ov_amenu = 0
	elseif $act == "am_add"
		$ov_amenu = 0
		@hm_grid()
		$hm_tc = 0
		$hm_tr = 0
		if @hm_add(1, $am_app)
			@ui_toast("ADDED TO HOME SCREEN")
		else
			@ui_toast("NO ROOM ON THIS HOME PAGE")
	elseif $act == "am_clear"
		$am_confirm = 1
	elseif $act == "am_uninst"
		$am_confirm = 2
	elseif $act == "am_no"
		$am_confirm = 0
	elseif $act == "am_yes"
		if $am_confirm == 1
			@app_clear($am_app)
			@ui_toast("DATA CLEARED")
		elseif $am_confirm == 2
			var $un_n = @app_name($am_app)
			@app_uninstall($am_app)
			@notify($un_n & " uninstalled. To reinstall, remove its hard drive and put it back (or reboot that computer).")
		$ov_amenu = 0
		$am_confirm = 0
	elseif $act == "xa_restore"
		$xa_block.clear()
		$xa_block_hb.clear()
		@ui_toast("APPS RESTORED")
	elseif $act == "bkbtn"
		if ($val >= 0) and ($val < $bk_bid.size)
			@ba_tap($bk_bapp.$val, $bk_bid.$val)
	elseif $act == "xwbtn"
		if $val < $xw_id.size
			var $xw_k = $xw_app.$val
			var $xw_t = $xw_id.$val
			var $xw_c = @clk_text()
			var $xw_d = @clk_day()
			if find($xw_t, "open:") == 0
				; open the app on that item
				@go("xapp")
				$xa_cur = $xw_k
				$xa_frame_seen = ""
				if $xa_cur < $xa_inq.size
					$xa_inq.$xa_cur = @in_t($xa_alias.$xa_cur, 2)
				@xa_send("open", substring($xw_t, 5, size($xw_t)), $xw_c, $xw_d, $cfg_units, "")
			else
				@xa_send_to($xw_k, "wtap", $xw_t, $xw_c, $xw_d, $cfg_units, "")
	elseif $act == "xbtn"
		if $val < $xb_id.size
			var $xb_c = @clk_text()
			var $xb_d = @clk_day()
			@xa_send("tap", $xb_id.$val, $xb_c, $xb_d, $cfg_units, "")
	elseif $act == "menu_close"
		$ov_menu = 0
	elseif $act == "mn_widget"
		$ov_menu = 0
		@go("pick_widget")
	elseif $act == "mn_app"
		$ov_menu = 0
		@go("pick_app")
	elseif $act == "mn_edit"
		$ov_menu = 0
		$hm_edit = 1
	elseif $act == "mn_addpage"
		$ov_menu = 0
		$hm_pages += 1
		$hm_cur = $hm_pages - 1
	elseif $act == "mn_delpage"
		$ov_menu = 0
		@hm_page_remove($hm_cur)
	elseif ($act == "pick") and ($ui_page == "pick_widget") and ($val == 0)
		@go("ck_type")
	elseif ($act == "pick") and ($ui_page == "pick_widget") and ($val == $widget_count + 6)
		@go("cw_cpick")
	elseif ($act == "pick") and ($ui_page == "pick_widget") and ($val == $widget_count + 7)
		@go("cw_bpick")
	elseif ($act == "pick") and ($ui_page == "pick_widget") and ($val >= $widget_count + 8)
		var $pw_j = $val - $widget_count - 8
		if $pw_j < $pk_wapp.size
			var $pw_a = $pk_wapp.$pw_j
			var $pw_i = $pk_widx.$pw_j
			var $pw_e = @split_part($xa_wdef.$pw_a, "|", $pw_i)
			var $pw_wt = @split_part($pw_e, "~", 1)
			var $pw_ht = @split_part($pw_e, "~", 2)
			var $pw_w = 2
			var $pw_h = 1
			if isnumeric($pw_wt)
				$pw_w = clamp($pw_wt:number, 1, 6)
			if isnumeric($pw_ht)
				$pw_h = clamp($pw_ht:number, 1, 6)
			@hm_grid()
			var $pw_ok = @hm_add_ref(4, $pw_a * 10 + $pw_i, $pw_w, $pw_h)
			if $pw_ok
				var $pw_last = $hm_pg.size - 1
				$hm_w.$pw_last = $pw_w
				$hm_h.$pw_last = $pw_h
			@go("home")
			if !$pw_ok
				@ui_toast("NO ROOM ON THIS PAGE")
	elseif ($act == "pick") and ($ui_page == "pick_widget") and ($val == $widget_count + 5)
		$cwn_type = 7
		@go("cw_src")
	elseif ($act == "pick") and ($ui_page == "pick_widget") and ($val >= $widget_count)
		$cwn_type = $val - $widget_count + 1
		@go("cw_src")
	elseif $act == "cw_pick"
		if $ui_page == "cw_src"
			var $cp_spec = $sl_spec.$val
			var $cp_k = @spec_part($cp_spec, 0)
			if ($cp_k == "dev") or ($cp_k == "out")
				$cwn_dev = @spec_part($cp_spec, 1)
				$cwn_src = $cp_k
				@go("cw_chan")
			else
				$cwn_src = $cp_spec
				var $cp_def = $sl_txt.$val
				var $cp_c = find($cp_def, ": ")
				if $cp_c >= 0
					$cp_def = substring($cp_def, $cp_c + 2, size($cp_def))
				if $cp_spec == "batt3"
					$cp_def = "BATTERY"
				@kb_open(-2, "cwname", "NAME THIS WIDGET", $cp_def)
		elseif $ui_page == "cw_cpick"
			if ($val < $sl_spec.size) and ($sl_spec.$val != "")
				var $cq = $sl_spec.$val
				if $cq == "*"
					$cwn_type = 8
					$cwn_src = "cdc:*"
					@kb_open(-2, "cwname", "NAME THIS WIDGET", "CONTACTS")
				else
					$cwn_dev = $cq
					var $cq_i = @cd_find($cq)
					if $cq_i >= 0
						if @cd_structured($cq_i)
							@go("cw_cfield")
						else
							$cwn_type = 8
							$cwn_src = "cdc:" & $cq
							@kb_open(-2, "cwname", "NAME THIS WIDGET", @cd_label($cq_i))
		elseif $ui_page == "cw_bpick"
			if ($val < $sl_spec.size) and ($sl_spec.$val != "")
				$cwn_type = 9
				$cwn_src = "box:" & $sl_spec.$val
				@kb_open(-2, "cwname", "NAME THIS WIDGET", upper($sl_spec.$val))
		elseif $ui_page == "cw_cfield"
			if $val < $sl_spec.size
				var $cf_k = $sl_spec.$val
				var $cf_i = @cd_find($cwn_dev)

; A tap on the desktop (sl = -1) or on projected screen sl.
function @ui_click_in($sl : number, $cx : number, $cy : number)
	var $hit = -1
	var $hn = $hit_act.size
	repeat $hn ($hi)
		if ($cx >= $hit_x1.$hi) and ($cx <= $hit_x2.$hi) and ($cy >= $hit_y1.$hi) and ($cy <= $hit_y2.$hi) and ($hit_sl.$hi == $sl)
			$hit = $hi
	if $hit < 0
		return
	var $ha = $hit_act.$hit
	var $hv = $hit_val.$hit
	if $ha == "vol_track"
		$cfg_volume = clamp(round(($cx - $vol_tx) / max($vol_tw, 1) * 10) * 10, 0, 100)
		@snd_beep(880, 0.15)
		$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	if $ha == "sc_track"
		var $frac = clamp(($cy - $sc_track_y) / max($sc_track_h, 1), 0, 1)
		$sc_pos = round($frac * max($sc_total - $sc_vis, 0))
		@ui_scroll_clamp()
		$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	@ui_action($ha, $hv)

; Click in desktop coordinates.
function @ui_click($cx : number, $cy : number)
	@ui_click_in(-1, $cx, $cy)

	$cfg_main_alias = $sl_alias.$k
	$cfg_primary_alias = $sl_alias.$k
	$cfg_primary_ch = $sl_ch.$k
	$cfg_mode = 0
	$pj_pick = -1
	@disp_group()
	@disp_layout_single()
	$panels_dirty = 1
	$ui_dirty = 1
	@snd_beep(880, 0.1)
	if $os_setup_done
		if $grp_n >= 2
			@go("wiz_detect")
		else
			@go("set_display")
			@ui_toast("MAIN SCREEN SET")

; Tap on a projected screen: its own tap areas (the picker keeps its own
; scroll position).
function @proj_click($k0 : number, $x0 : number, $y0 : number)
	if $jn_mode
		@jn_tap_slot($k0)
		return
	; joined screens: the click lands on the leader's big screen
	var $k = @jn_lead_of($k0)
	var $x = $x0
	var $y = $y0
	if $k0 < $sl_jdx.size
		$x += $sl_jdx.$k0
		$y += $sl_jdy.$k0
	var $sv = $sc_pos
	var $svt = $sc_total
	var $svv = $sc_vis
	if $pj_pick == $k
		$sc_pos = $pj_sc
		$sc_total = 999
		$sc_vis = 1
	@ui_click_in($k, $x, $y)
	if $pj_pick == $k
		$pj_sc = $sc_pos
	$sc_pos = $sv
	$sc_total = $svt
	$sc_vis = $svv
	$ui_dirty = 1

; Identify: tap order -> once all are tapped, build the span and confirm.
function @identify_tap($tk : number)
	if $sl_tag.$tk > 0
		; Tapping a green one starts over.
		repeat $slot_n ($tz)
			$sl_tag.$tz = 0
		$panels_dirty = 1
		return
	$sl_tag.$tk = @disp_identify_count() + 1
	$panels_dirty = 1
	if @disp_identify_count() < $grp_n
		return
	$span_order.clear()
	repeat $grp_n ($to)
		repeat $slot_n ($tq)
			if $sl_tag.$tq == $to + 1
				$span_order.append($sl_ch.$tq)
	$span_cols = @disp_guess_cols($grp_n)
	@disp_layout_span()
	$wz_deadline = time + 15
	@go("wiz_confirm")

; Long-press on the home screen (press + about 0.7 s of click_hold).
function @ui_longpress($lx : number, $ly : number)
	if ($ui_page == "drawer") and (!$ov_amenu) and (!$ov_shade)
		; which app icon is under the finger?
		var $lp_a = -1
		var $lp_n = $hit_act.size
		repeat $lp_n ($lp_i)
			if ($hit_act.$lp_i == "app") and ($lx >= $hit_x1.$lp_i) and ($lx <= $hit_x2.$lp_i) and ($ly >= $hit_y1.$lp_i) and ($ly <= $hit_y2.$lp_i)
				$lp_a = $hit_val.$lp_i
		if $lp_a > 0
			$dr_pend = -1
			$am_app = $lp_a
			$am_confirm = 0
			$ov_amenu = 1
			@snd_beep(660, 0.08)
			$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	if ($ui_page != "home") or $ov_menu or $ov_shade or $hm_edit
		return
	if ($ly < $sb_h) or ($ly > $desk_h - $nb_h)
		return
	@hm_grid()
	$hm_tc = clamp(floor(($lx - $g_ox) / $g_cw), 0, $g_cols - 1)
	$hm_tr = clamp(floor(($ly - $g_oy) / $g_ch), 0, $g_rows - 1)
	$ov_menu = 1
	@snd_beep(660, 0.08)
	$ui_dirty = 1

; Dragging (held finger): scrollbar thumb, volume slider.
function @ui_drag($dx : number, $dy : number) : number
	if $kb_on
		return 0
	if @bx_drag($dx, $dy)
		return 1
	if $ov_vol and ($dx >= $vol_tx - $chh) and ($dx <= $vol_tx + $vol_tw + $chh) and ($dy >= $sb_h) and ($dy <= $sb_h + $chh * 8)
		var $nv = clamp(round(($dx - $vol_tx) / max($vol_tw, 1) * 20) * 5, 0, 100)
		if $nv != $cfg_volume
			$cfg_volume = $nv
			$ui_dirty = 1
		return 1
	if $sc_list_on and ($sc_track_x >= 0) and ($dx >= $sc_track_x - $cw) and ($dx <= $sc_track_x + $sc_track_w + $cw) and ($dy >= $sc_track_y) and ($dy <= $sc_track_y + $sc_track_h)
		var $frac = clamp(($dy - $sc_track_y) / max($sc_track_h, 1), 0, 1)
		var $np = round($frac * max($sc_total - $sc_vis, 0))
		if $np != $sc_pos
			$sc_pos = $np
			$ui_dirty = 1
		return 1
	return 0

function @os_hold($k : number, $x : number, $y : number)
	if ($k >= $slot_n) or $pick_main
		return
	if ($sl_role.$k == 2) and (substring($ui_page, 0, 4) != "wiz_")
		if $jn_mode
			return
		if (time - $hold_last > 0.3) or ($hold_k != $k)
			$hold_k = $k
			$hold_start = time
			$hold_fired = 0
		$hold_last = time
		if (!$hold_fired) and (time - $hold_start >= 0.7)
			$hold_fired = 1
			$pj_pick = @jn_lead_of($k)
			$pj_sc = 0
			@snd_beep(660, 0.08)
			$ui_dirty = 1
			$panels_dirty = 1
		return
	if $sl_role.$k != 1
		return
	if @ui_drag($sl_dx.$k + $x, $sl_dy.$k + $y)
		$hold_fired = 1
		$hold_last = time
		return
	if (time - $hold_last > 0.3) or ($hold_k != $k)
		; A hold that started without a click event (or a new finger).
		$hold_k = $k
		$hold_start = time
		$hold_fired = 0
		$hold_page = $ui_page
	$hold_last = time
	if (!$hold_fired) and (time - $hold_start >= 0.7) and ($hold_page == $ui_page)
		$hold_fired = 1
		@ui_longpress($sl_dx.$k + $x, $sl_dy.$k + $y)

; Mouse wheel on any desktop screen: scroll the list / home pages / volume.
function @os_scroll($k : number, $d : number)
	if ($k < $slot_n) and ($pj_pick == @jn_lead_of($k))
		$pj_sc = max($pj_sc - sign($d) * 3, 0)
		$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	if ($k >= $slot_n) or ($sl_role.$k != 1) or $kb_on
		return
	if $ov_vol
		$cfg_volume = clamp($cfg_volume + sign($d) * 5, 0, 100)
		@snd_beep(880, 0.08)
	elseif @bx_wheel($d)
		$ui_dirty = 1
	elseif $sc_list_on
		$sc_pos -= sign($d) * max(1, floor($sc_vis / 4))
		@ui_scroll_clamp()
	elseif $pg_lim > 0
		@pg_step(-sign($d) * $chh * 3)
	elseif ($ui_page == "home") and ($hm_pages > 1)
		$hm_cur = mod($hm_cur - sign($d) + $hm_pages, $hm_pages)
	$ui_dirty = 1

; Every physical screen's click lands here.
function @os_click($k : number, $x : number, $y : number)
	if $k >= $slot_n
		return
	$hold_k = $k
	$hold_start = time
	$hold_last = time
	$hold_fired = 0
	$hold_page = $ui_page
	var $role = $sl_role.$k
	if $pick_main
		@main_pick($k)
	elseif $role == 1
		@bx_touch($sl_dx.$k + $x, $sl_dy.$k + $y)
		@ui_click($sl_dx.$k + $x, $sl_dy.$k + $y)
	elseif $role == 3
		@identify_tap($k)
	elseif ($role == 2) and @pj_active($k)
		@proj_click($k, $x, $y)

; Attitude displays refresh 10x a second: only the screens showing one.
var $att_fast_next = 0
function @att_fast()
	if (!$att_live) or (time < $att_fast_next) or $pick_main or $kb_on
		return
	$att_fast_next = time + 0.1
	var $sv_on = $hit_on
	$hit_on = 0
	repeat $slot_n ($k)
		if ($sl_role.$k == 2) and ($pj_pick != @jn_lead_of($k)) and (!$jn_mode) and (@pj_kind_of($k) == 2) and (@pj_ref_of($k) >= 6) and (@pj_ref_of($k) <= 9)
			@proj_draw($k)
		elseif ($sl_role.$k == 1) and ($ui_page == "home") and (!$hm_edit) and (!$ov_menu) and (!$ov_shade)
			var $n = $att_rx1.size
			var $hit = 0
			repeat $n ($q)
				if ($att_rx1.$q < $sl_dx.$k + $sl_w.$k) and ($att_rx2.$q > $sl_dx.$k) and ($att_ry1.$q < $sl_dy.$k + $sl_h.$k) and ($att_ry2.$q > $sl_dy.$k)
					$hit = 1
			if $hit
				@desk_slot_draw($k)
	$hit_on = $sv_on
	$ox = 0
	$oy = 0
	@ui_metrics()
	@shell_metrics()

function @ui_frame()
	if ($desk_w <= 0) or $pick_main
		return
	var $live = ($ui_page == "wiz_confirm") or (time >= $ui_next_draw)
	if (!$ui_dirty) and (!$live)
		return
	if $ui_page == "wiz_confirm"
		if time > $wz_deadline
			@wz_revert()
	$ui_dirty = 0
	$ui_fno += 1
	$ui_next_draw = time + 1
	$sc_list_on = 0
	$sc_track_x = -1
	$hit_x1.clear()
	$hit_y1.clear()
	$hit_x2.clear()
	$hit_y2.clear()
	$hit_act.clear()
	$hit_sl.clear()
	$att_rx1.clear()
	$att_ry1.clear()
	$att_rx2.clear()
	$att_ry2.clear()
	$att_live = 0
	$xw_id.clear()
	$bk_bid.clear()
	$bk_bapp.clear()
	$xw_app.clear()
	$hit_val.clear()
	; Draw the desktop once per physical screen, offset to its slice.
	$hit_sl_cur = -1
	$hit_on = 1
	repeat $slot_n ($fk)
		if $sl_role.$fk == 1
			@desk_slot_draw($fk)
			$hit_on = 0
	; other screens showing apps / widgets: each has its own tap areas
	$hit_on = 1
	repeat $slot_n ($pk)
		if @pj_active($pk)
			$hit_sl_cur = $pk
			@proj_draw($pk)
	$hit_sl_cur = -1
	@ui_metrics()
	@shell_metrics()
	$hit_on = 1
	$ox = 0
	$oy = 0

; ChipOS - real-time clock. Archean's `time` is a unix timestamp (UTC);
; ChipOS applies the time zone and daylight saving itself.
storage var $cfg_clock_ver : number
storage var $cfg_24h : number
storage var $cfg_zone : number          ; index into the zone table
storage var $cfg_dst : number           ; 0 automatic, 1 manual on, 2 manual off
storage var $cfg_datefmt : number       ; 0..7, see @fmt_date
storage var $cfg_tzc : number           ; custom zone offset, minutes
storage array $wc_zone : number         ; Clock app: world clock list

const $datefmt_count = 8

array $tz_nm : text
array $tz_sh : text
array $tz_off : number
array $tz_rule : number                 ; 0 none, 1 US/Canada, 2 EU/UK, 3 Australia, 4 New Zealand
array $mon_s : text
array $mon_f : text
array $wd_s : text
array $wd_f : text

; Lists built once per frame (not once per screen of a wall).
var $ui_fno = 0
var $lc_tag = ""
var $lc_tag_f = -1
function @sl_cached($tag : text) : number
	if ($lc_tag == $tag) and ($lc_tag_f == $ui_fno)
		return 1
	$lc_tag = $tag
	$lc_tag_f = $ui_fno
	return 0

; Result of @clk_calc
var $ck_y = 1970
var $ck_mo = 1
var $ck_d = 1
var $ck_wd = 4
var $ck_h = 0
var $ck_mi = 0
var $ck_s = 0
var $ck_dst = 0
var $ck_off = 0
var $ck_days = 0
var $cd_y = 1970
var $cd_m = 1
var $cd_d = 1

function @tz_add($n : text, $s : text, $o : number, $r : number)
	$tz_nm.append($n)

function @tz_custom() : number
	return $tz_nm.size - 1

function @posmod($a : number, $b : number) : number
	return $a - floor($a / $b) * $b

; Days since 1970-01-01 for a calendar date.
function @dfc($y : number, $m : number, $d : number) : number
	var $yy = $y
	var $mp = $m - 3
	if $m <= 2
		$yy = $y - 1
		$mp = $m + 9
	var $era = floor($yy / 400)
	var $yoe = $yy - $era * 400
	var $doy = floor((153 * $mp + 2) / 5) + $d - 1
	var $doe = $yoe * 365 + floor($yoe / 4) - floor($yoe / 100) + $doy
	return $era * 146097 + $doe - 719468

; Calendar date for days since 1970-01-01 -> $cd_y, $cd_m, $cd_d
function @cfd($z : number)
	var $zz = $z + 719468
	var $era = floor($zz / 146097)
	var $doe = $zz - $era * 146097
	var $yoe = floor(($doe - floor($doe / 1460) + floor($doe / 36524) - floor($doe / 146096)) / 365)
	var $doy = $doe - (365 * $yoe + floor($yoe / 4) - floor($yoe / 100))
	var $mp = floor((5 * $doy + 2) / 153)
	$cd_d = $doy - floor((153 * $mp + 2) / 5) + 1
	$cd_m = $mp + 3
	if $mp >= 10
		$cd_m = $mp - 9
	$cd_y = $yoe + $era * 400
	if $cd_m <= 2
		$cd_y += 1

; Day number of the n-th Sunday of a month / the last Sunday.
function @nth_sun($y : number, $m : number, $n : number) : number
	var $f = @dfc($y, $m, 1)
	var $w = @posmod($f + 4, 7)
	return $f + @posmod(7 - $w, 7) + ($n - 1) * 7

function @last_sun($y : number, $m : number) : number
	var $l = @dfc($y, $m + 1, 1) - 1
	return $l - @posmod($l + 4, 7)

; Is daylight saving in force? ($off = standard offset in minutes)
function @is_dst($rule : number, $utc : number, $off : number) : number
	if $rule == 0
		return 0
	var $os = $off * 60
	@cfd(floor(($utc + $os) / 86400))
	var $yr = $cd_y
	if $rule == 1
		var $u1 = @nth_sun($yr, 3, 2) * 86400 + 7200 - $os
		var $u2 = @nth_sun($yr, 11, 1) * 86400 + 3600 - $os
		return ($utc >= $u1) and ($utc < $u2)
	if $rule == 2
		var $e1 = @last_sun($yr, 3) * 86400 + 3600
		var $e2 = @last_sun($yr, 10) * 86400 + 3600
		return ($utc >= $e1) and ($utc < $e2)
	var $au2 = @nth_sun($yr, 4, 1) * 86400 + 7200 - $os
	var $au1 = @nth_sun($yr, 10, 1) * 86400 + 7200 - $os
	if $rule == 4
		$au1 = @last_sun($yr, 9) * 86400 + 7200 - $os
	return ($utc >= $au1) or ($utc < $au2)

function @tz_std($z : number) : number
	if $z == @tz_custom()
		return $cfg_tzc
	return $tz_off.$z

; Work out the local date and time. $zone < 0 = the system zone and DST
; setting; $dm: 0 automatic, 1 on, 2 off.
function @clk_calc_at($utc : number, $zone : number, $dm : number)
	var $z = $zone
	var $m = $dm
	if ($z < 0) or ($z >= $tz_nm.size)
		$z = $cfg_zone
		$m = $cfg_dst
	var $off = @tz_std($z)
	var $dst = 0
	if $m == 1
		$dst = 1
	elseif $m == 0
		$dst = @is_dst($tz_rule.$z, $utc, $off)
	$ck_dst = $dst
	$ck_off = $off + $dst * 60
	var $lt = $utc + $ck_off * 60
	var $days = floor($lt / 86400)
	var $sod = $lt - $days * 86400
	$ck_days = $days
	$ck_h = floor($sod / 3600)
	$ck_mi = floor(($sod - $ck_h * 3600) / 60)
	$ck_s = floor($sod - $ck_h * 3600 - $ck_mi * 60)
	$ck_wd = @posmod($days + 4, 7)
	@cfd($days)
	$ck_y = $cd_y
	$ck_mo = $cd_m
	$ck_d = $cd_d

function @clk_calc($zone : number, $dm : number)
	@clk_calc_at(time, $zone, $dm)

function @fmt_hm($h : number, $mi : number, $h24 : number) : text
	var $mm = @pad2($mi)
	if $h24
		var $hh = @pad2($h)
		return $hh & ":" & $mm
	var $ap = "AM"
	if $h >= 12
		$ap = "PM"
	var $h12 = @posmod($h, 12)
	if $h12 == 0
		$h12 = 12
	return text("{}", $h12) & ":" & $mm & " " & $ap

; Date from the last @clk_calc in format $f (0..7).
function @fmt_date($f : number) : text
	var $dd = @pad2($ck_d)
	var $mm = @pad2($ck_mo)
	var $yt = text("{}", $ck_y)
	var $mi = $ck_mo - 1
	var $ms = $mon_s.$mi
	var $mf = $mon_f.$mi
	var $wi = $ck_wd
	var $ws = $wd_s.$wi
	var $wf = $wd_f.$wi
	if $f == 1
		return $dd & " " & $ms & " " & $yt
	if $f == 2
		return $mf & " " & $dd & ", " & $yt
	if $f == 3
		return $ws & ", " & $ms & " " & $dd & ", " & $yt
	if $f == 4
		return $wf & ", " & $mf & " " & $dd & ", " & $yt
	if $f == 5
		return $yt & "-" & $mm & "-" & $dd
	if $f == 6
		return $mm & "/" & $dd & "/" & $yt
	if $f == 7
		return $dd & "/" & $mm & "/" & $yt
	return $ms & " " & $dd & ", " & $yt

; "UTC-4", "UTC+5:30"
function @fmt_utc($min : number) : text
	var $sg = "+"
	if $min < 0
		$sg = "-"
	var $a = abs($min)
	var $hh = floor($a / 60)
	var $rm = $a - $hh * 60
	var $t = "UTC" & $sg & text("{}", $hh)
	if $rm > 0
		$t = $t & ":" & @pad2($rm)
	return $t

function @tz_name($z : number) : text
	if $z == @tz_custom()
		var $cu = @fmt_utc($cfg_tzc)
		return "Custom (" & $cu & ")"
	return $tz_nm.$z

function @tz_short($z : number) : text
	if $z == @tz_custom()
		return @fmt_utc($cfg_tzc)
	return $tz_sh.$z

; ---- system clock (used by the status bar, apps, notifications) ----
function @clk_text() : text
	@clk_calc(-1, 0)
	return @fmt_hm($ck_h, $ck_mi, $cfg_24h)

function @clk_date() : text
	@clk_calc(-1, 0)
	return @fmt_date($cfg_datefmt)

; Day of the month (sent to apps).
function @clk_day() : number
	@clk_calc(-1, 0)
	return $ck_d

; Local minutes since 1970 (system zone).
function @clk_now() : number
	@clk_calc(-1, 0)
	return floor((time + $ck_off * 60) / 60)

; ---- drawing ----
function @d_thick($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number, $t : number, $c : number)
	var $dx = $x2 - $x1
	var $dy = $y2 - $y1
	var $ln = max(sqrt($dx * $dx + $dy * $dy), 0.001)
	var $px = -$dy / $ln
	var $py = $dx / $ln
	var $n = floor($t)
	var $cnt = $n * 2 + 1
	repeat $cnt ($k)
		var $o = $k - $n
		@d_line($x1 + $px * $o, $y1 + $py * $o, $x2 + $px * $o, $y2 + $py * $o, $c)

; Analog face for the last @clk_calc.
function @clock_face($cx : number, $cy : number, $r : number)
	@d_circle($cx, $cy, $r, $th_line, $th_panel2)
	var $tk = max(1, floor($r / 45))
	repeat 12 ($k)
		var $an = $k * pi / 6 - pi / 2
		var $ri = $r * 0.86
		var $tc = $th_dim
		var $tt = 0
		if @posmod($k, 3) == 0
			$ri = $r * 0.74
			$tc = $th_text
			$tt = $tk
		@d_thick($cx + cos($an) * $ri, $cy + sin($an) * $ri, $cx + cos($an) * $r * 0.95, $cy + sin($an) * $r * 0.95, $tt, $tc)
	var $ha = (@posmod($ck_h, 12) + $ck_mi / 60) * pi / 6 - pi / 2
	var $ma = ($ck_mi + $ck_s / 60) * pi / 30 - pi / 2
	var $sa = $ck_s * pi / 30 - pi / 2
	@d_thick($cx, $cy, $cx + cos($ha) * $r * 0.5, $cy + sin($ha) * $r * 0.5, max(1, floor($r / 30)), $th_text)
	@d_thick($cx, $cy, $cx + cos($ma) * $r * 0.78, $cy + sin($ma) * $r * 0.78, max(1, floor($r / 55)), $th_text)
	@d_line($cx - cos($sa) * $r * 0.15, $cy - sin($sa) * $r * 0.15, $cx + cos($sa) * $r * 0.86, $cy + sin($sa) * $r * 0.86, $th_accent)
	@d_circle($cx, $cy, max(2, $r * 0.06), $th_accent, $th_accent)

; Centered text, shrunk (then trimmed) to fit $wmax.
function @text_fit_c($cx : number, $y : number, $c : number, $t : text, $wmax : number)
	var $need = size($t) * $cw
	if $need <= $wmax
		@ui_text_c($cx, $y, $c, $t)
		return
	var $nts = max(1, floor($ts * $wmax / $need))
	var $mul = $nts / $ts
	var $cwn = $cw * $mul
	var $tf = @ui_fit($t, floor($wmax / max($cwn, 1)))
	@ui_text_big($cx, $y + $chh * (1 - $mul) / 2, $c, $tf, $mul)

; Text size multiplier so $n characters fit in $w wide and $h tall.
function @fit_mul($n : number, $w : number, $h : number, $mx : number) : number
	var $m = min($w / max($cw * $n, 1), $h / max($chh, 1))
	; whole text sizes only
	$m = max(1, floor(clamp($m, 1, $mx) * $ts + 0.001)) / $ts
	return $m

; A clock widget. $style 0 digital 12h, 1 digital 24h, 2 analog, 3 digital
; (system 12/24). $zone < 0 = system. $df: -1 system format, 8 = no date.
function @clock_widget($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $style : number, $zone : number, $dm : number, $df : number)
	@clk_calc($zone, $dm)
	@ui_box($x, $y, $w, $h, $th_panel, $th_line)
	var $dt = ""
	if $df < 0
		$dt = @fmt_date($cfg_datefmt)
	elseif $df < $datefmt_count
		$dt = @fmt_date($df)
	var $lb = ""
	if $zone >= 0
		$lb = @tz_short($zone)
		if $ck_dst
			$lb = $lb & " DST"
	var $h24 = $cfg_24h
	if $style == 0
		$h24 = 0
	elseif $style == 1
		$h24 = 1
	var $tt = @fmt_hm($ck_h, $ck_mi, $h24)
	var $top = 0
	if $lb != ""
		$top = $chh * 1.4
		var $lbf = @ui_fit($lb, floor(($w - $cw * 1.6) / $cw))
		@ui_text($x + $cw * 0.8, $y + $chh * 0.4, $th_dim, $lbf)
	var $bot = 0
	if $dt != ""
		$bot = $chh * 1.7
	if $style == 2
		if $w > $h * 1.5
			; wide: face on the left, time and date on the right
			var $r = min($h * 0.42, $w * 0.22)
			var $fx = $x + $cw + $r
			@clock_face($fx, $y + $h / 2, $r)
			var $rx0 = $fx + $r + $cw
			var $rw = $x + $w - $cw - $rx0
			var $rcx = $rx0 + $rw / 2
			var $tm = @fit_mul(size($tt), $rw, $h * 0.3, 4)
			var $blk = $chh * $tm + $bot
			var $ty = $y + ($h - $blk) / 2
			@ui_text_big($rcx, $ty, $th_text, $tt, $tm)
			if $dt != ""
				@text_fit_c($rcx, $ty + $chh * $tm + $chh * 0.5, $th_dim, $dt, $rw)
		else
			var $avail = $h - $top - $bot - $chh * 0.6
			var $r2 = max(min($w * 0.42, $avail / 2), $chh)
			@clock_face($x + $w / 2, $y + $top + $chh * 0.3 + $avail / 2, $r2)
			if $dt != ""
				@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $h - $chh * 1.4, $th_dim, $dt, $w - $cw)
	else
		var $tm2 = @fit_mul(size($tt), $w - $cw * 2, ($h - $top - $bot - $chh * 0.3) * 0.9, 6)
		var $blk2 = $chh * $tm2 + $bot
		var $ty2 = $y + $top + ($h - $top - $blk2) / 2
		@ui_text_big($x + $w / 2, $ty2, $th_text, $tt, $tm2)
		if $dt != ""
			@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $ty2 + $chh * $tm2 + $chh * 0.5, $th_dim, $dt, $w - $cw)
	@ui_hit($x, $y, $x + $w, $y + $h, "go:clock")
