xc_files.name: solar.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - SOLAR tracking: a Small Pivot (turns the array round) and a Small
; Hinge (tilts it), with Solar Panels. A Solar Sensor on the moving part
; tells how well the panels face the sun; ChipOS sweeps to find the sun,
; then keeps nudging both joints toward the best reading.
; With a Mini Nav Instrument on the moving part too, ChipOS learns which
; pivot / hinge move the array (when there are several) and, with the solar
; time server's sun model, turns straight to the sun and parks the panels
; facing the sunrise at night.
; Pivot input: -1..1 = -360..360 degrees (servo). Hinge input: -1..1 = -90..90.
storage var $so_ver : number
storage var $so_state : number          ; 0 ask, 1 on, 2 declined
storage var $so_piv : text              ; the pivot / hinge that move the array
storage var $so_hin : text
storage var $so_pc : number             ; pivot command now (-1..1)
storage var $so_hc : number             ; hinge command now
storage var $so_cal : number            ; 1 = nav calibration done
storage var $so_ps : number             ; heading change per pivot turn (+1 / -1)
storage var $so_h0 : number             ; nav heading at pivot command 0
storage var $so_daz : number            ; sun azimuth minus nav heading when aimed best
var $so_npiv = 0
var $so_nhin = 0
var $so_npan = 0
var $so_sens = ""
var $so_nav = ""                        ; a nav that moves with the array
storage var $so_navsel : text           ; v0.25.1: picked nav ("" not yet, "-" none)
var $so_nav_ask = 0                     ; several mini navs and none picked
array $so_pv : text
array $so_hg : text
array $so_navs : text
var $so_avail = 0
var $so_scan_t = 0
var $so_mode = 0                        ; 0 idle 1 identify 2 search 3 track 4 night 5 calibrate
var $so_k = 0
var $so_t = 0
var $so_best = -9
var $so_bp = 0
var $so_bh = 0
var $so_ref = 0
var $so_dir = 1
var $so_dirh = 1
var $so_axis = 0
var $so_note = ""
var $so_dark_t = 0
var $so_i = 0
var $so_r0 = 0
var $so_h1 = 0
array $so_score : number

function @so_load()
	if $so_ver != 1
		$so_state = 0
		$so_piv = ""
		$so_hin = ""
		$so_pc = 0
		$so_hc = 0.5
		$so_cal = 0
		$so_ps = 1
		$so_h0 = 0
		$so_daz = 0
		$so_ver = 1

; Wind generators (windgen.xc): pivots found to turn a propeller.
storage var $wt_state : number          ; 0 ask, 1 on, 2 declined
storage array $wt_pv : text             ; pivots that turn a wind turbine
storage array $wt_pr : text             ; ... the propeller each one turns
var $wt_mode = 0                        ; 0 idle 1 finding 2 sweep 3 track 4 wait
function @wt_uses($a : text) : number
	if ($wt_state != 1) or ($a == "")
		return 0
	var $n = $wt_pv.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $wt_pv.$i == $a
			return 1
	return 0

; The nav the solar tracker owns (the weather station leaves it out).
function @so_nav_used() : text
	if $so_state == 1
		return $so_nav
	return ""

; Is this pivot used by the solar tracker (so the wind vane leaves it alone)?
function @sol_uses($a : text) : number
	return ($so_state == 1) and ($a == $so_piv) and ($a != "")

array $so_pvx : text                    ; turbine / vane-named joints (last resort)
array $so_hgx : text
function @so_is_solar_name($a : text) : number
	var $l = lower($a)
	return ($a != "") and (contains($l, "solar") or contains($l, "panel") or contains($l, "sun"))

function @so_not_solar_name($a : text) : number
	var $l = lower($a)
	return contains($l, "turbine") or contains($l, "wind") or contains($l, "vane") or contains($l, "prop")

function @so_scan()
	if time < $so_scan_t
		return
	$so_scan_t = time + 3
	$so_pv.clear()
	$so_hg.clear()
	$so_pvx.clear()
	$so_hgx.clear()
	$so_navs.clear()
	$so_npan = 0
	$so_sens = ""
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if $db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1
			var $t = $db_type.$j
			var $a = $db_alias.$j
			if $t == "SolarPanel"
				$so_npan += 1
			elseif $a != ""
				if ($t == "SmallPivot") and !@wt_uses($a)
					if @so_not_solar_name($a)
						$so_pvx.append($a)
					else
						$so_pv.append($a)
				elseif $t == "SmallHinge"
					if @so_not_solar_name($a)
						$so_hgx.append($a)
					else
						$so_hg.append($a)
				elseif $t == "SolarSensor"
					if $so_sens == ""
						$so_sens = $a
				elseif $t == "MiniNavInstrument"
					$so_navs.append($a)
	; v0.25: names first. A joint whose alias says turbine / wind / vane / prop
	; is never the array's while another one exists; one that says solar /
	; panel / sun is taken straight away. (Wind turbines on pivots used to get
	; picked as the solar pivot, e.g. "turbine-6-pivot".)
	var $nx1 = $so_pvx.size
	if $so_pv.size == 0
		repeat $nx1 ($x1)
			$so_pv.append($so_pvx.$x1)
	var $nx2 = $so_hgx.size
	if $so_hg.size == 0
		repeat $nx2 ($x2)
			$so_hg.append($so_hgx.$x2)
	$so_npiv = $so_pv.size
	$so_nhin = $so_hg.size
	$so_avail = ($so_npiv > 0) and ($so_nhin > 0) and ($so_npan > 0)
	; a turbine / vane joint picked before (by mistake) is forgotten when a
	; better-named one exists, and a wind-turbine pivot always is
	; (XenonCode's "and" evaluates both sides: never index an empty list in one)
	var $pv0 = ""
	if $so_pv.size > 0
		$pv0 = $so_pv.0
	var $hg0 = ""
	if $so_hg.size > 0
		$hg0 = $so_hg.0
	if ($so_piv != "") and (@wt_uses($so_piv) or (@so_not_solar_name($so_piv) and ($pv0 != "") and !@so_not_solar_name($pv0)))
		$so_piv = ""
		$so_cal = 0
	if ($so_hin != "") and @so_not_solar_name($so_hin) and ($hg0 != "") and !@so_not_solar_name($hg0)
		$so_hin = ""
	; one named for the panels wins
	if !@so_is_solar_name($so_piv)
		repeat $so_npiv ($q3)
			if ($so_piv == "") or !@so_is_solar_name($so_piv)
				if @so_is_solar_name($so_pv.$q3)
					$so_piv = $so_pv.$q3
					$so_cal = 0
	if !@so_is_solar_name($so_hin)
		repeat $so_nhin ($q4)
			if ($so_hin == "") or !@so_is_solar_name($so_hin)
				if @so_is_solar_name($so_hg.$q4)
					$so_hin = $so_hg.$q4
	; v0.25.1: the mini nav on the array. One: use it. Several: the user picks
	; it (a weather station's navs must never be taken for the array's).
	$so_nav = ""
	$so_nav_ask = 0
	var $nnv = $so_navs.size
	if ($so_navsel != "") and ($so_navsel != "-")
		repeat $nnv ($q5)
			if $so_navs.$q5 == $so_navsel
				$so_nav = $so_navsel
	if ($so_nav == "") and ($so_navsel != "-")
		if $nnv == 1
			$so_nav = $so_navs.0
		elseif $nnv > 1
			$so_nav_ask = 1
	; one of each: no need to identify
	if ($so_npiv == 1) and ($so_piv == "")
		$so_piv = $so_pv.0
	if ($so_nhin == 1) and ($so_hin == "")
		$so_hin = $so_hg.0

function @so_on() : number
	return $so_avail and ($so_state == 1)

; How well the panels face the sun now (higher is better).
function @so_reward() : number
	; v0.26.3: what the panels actually make, when ChipOS can read it
	if ($ps_idx.size > 0) and ($pw_solar > 0)
		return $pw_solar
	return @in_n($so_sens, 0) * 1000 + @in_n($so_sens, 1) * 0.001

function @so_light() : number
	return @in_n($so_sens, 1)

function @so_cmd($p : number, $h : number)
	$so_pc = $p - floor(($p + 1) / 2) * 2
	$so_hc = clamp($h, -1, 1)
	@out_n($so_piv, 0, $so_pc)
	@out_n($so_hin, 0, $so_hc)

; Sun azimuth / elevation (degrees) from the time server model; -999 = unknown.
var $so_saz = 0
var $so_sel = -999
function @so_sun()
	$so_sel = -999
	if $sun_ok != 1
		return
	var $h = $sun_h0 + $sun_w * (time - $sun_t0)
	var $se = sin($sun_phi) * sin($sun_d) + cos($sun_phi) * cos($sun_d) * cos($h)
	$so_sel = atan($se, sqrt(max(0, 1 - $se * $se))) * 180 / pi
	$so_saz = @posmod(atan(-sin($h), tan($sun_d) * cos($sun_phi) - sin($sun_phi) * cos($h)) * 180 / pi, 360)

; Pivot command that turns the nav to heading $hd.
function @so_piv_for($hd : number) : number
	var $d = @posmod($hd - $so_h0 + 180, 360) - 180
	return $so_ps * $d / 360

function @so_start_search()
	$so_mode = 2
	$so_k = 0
	$so_best = -1000000000
	$so_t = time
	$so_note = "LOOKING FOR THE SUN"
	$ui_dirty = 1

; Several pivots or hinges: move each one and keep the one that changes
; the SOLAR SENSOR the most (it is on the moving part). Each joint goes to
; 0, a quarter / half turn and a half / full step, so a high sun cannot hide
; the change. Navs only decide when the sensor saw no change at all (night):
; a nav on a wind turbine or a weather vane must never win.
array $so_nscore : number
array $so_nh0 : number
var $so_r1 = 0
function @so_nav_ang($nv : text) : number
	return @in_n($nv, 6) + @in_n($nv, 4) * 90

function @so_identify()
	var $list = $so_npiv
	var $isp = $so_piv == ""
	if !$isp
		$list = $so_nhin
	if $so_k == 0
		$so_score.clear()
		$so_nscore.clear()
		$so_i = 0
		$so_k = 1
	if $so_i >= $list
		var $bi = 0
		var $bs = -1
		repeat $list ($q)
			if $so_score.$q > $bs
				$bs = $so_score.$q
				$bi = $q
		if $bs < 0.02
			; the sensor never changed (dark?): fall back to the navs
			$bs = -1
			repeat $list ($q2)
				if $so_nscore.$q2 > $bs
					$bs = $so_nscore.$q2
					$bi = $q2
		if $isp
			$so_piv = $so_pv.$bi
		else
			$so_hin = $so_hg.$bi
		$so_k = 0
		$so_mode = 2
		if ($so_piv == "") or ($so_hin == "")
			$so_mode = 1
		$so_t = time
		return
	var $a = $so_pv.$so_i
	var $amt = 0.25
	if !$isp
		$a = $so_hg.$so_i
		$amt = 0.5
	var $nn = 0
	if $so_nav != ""
		$nn = 1
	if $so_k == 1
		@out_n($a, 0, 0)
		$so_t = time + 3
		$so_k = 2
		$so_note = "FINDING WHICH JOINT MOVES THE PANELS: " & $a
		$ui_dirty = 1
	elseif $so_k == 2
		$so_r0 = @in_n($so_sens, 0)
		$so_nh0.clear()
		repeat $nn ($j)
			$so_nh0.append(@so_nav_ang($so_nav))
		@out_n($a, 0, $amt)
		$so_t = time + 3
		$so_k = 3
	elseif $so_k == 3
		$so_r1 = @in_n($so_sens, 0)
		@out_n($a, 0, $amt * 2)
		$so_t = time + 3
		$so_k = 4
	else
		var $r2 = @in_n($so_sens, 0)
		$so_score.append(max(abs($so_r1 - $so_r0), abs($r2 - $so_r0)))
		var $ns = 0
		repeat $nn ($j2)
			if $j2 < $so_nh0.size
				$ns = max($ns, abs(@posmod(@so_nav_ang($so_nav) - $so_nh0.$j2 + 180, 360) - 180) / 90)
		$so_nscore.append($ns)
		@out_n($a, 0, 0)
		$so_i += 1
		$so_k = 1
		$so_t = time + 1

; Coarse sweep: 12 pivot positions at 45 degrees tilt, then 9 tilts.
function @so_search()
	if $so_k < 12
		if $so_k > 0
			var $r = @so_reward()
			if $r > $so_best
				$so_best = $r
				$so_bp = $so_pc
		@so_cmd(($so_k) / 12, 0.5)
		$so_k += 1
		$so_t = time + 2.5
		$so_note = text("LOOKING FOR THE SUN ({}/21)", $so_k)
		$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	if $so_k == 12
		var $r12 = @so_reward()
		if $r12 > $so_best
			$so_best = $r12
			$so_bp = $so_pc
		$so_best = -1000000000
	var $hk = $so_k - 12
	if $hk > 0
		var $r2 = @so_reward()
		if $r2 > $so_best
			$so_best = $r2
			$so_bh = $so_hc
	if $hk < 9
		@so_cmd($so_bp, -1 + $hk * 0.25)
		$so_k += 1
		$so_t = time + 2.5
		$so_note = text("LOOKING FOR THE SUN ({}/21)", $so_k)
		return
	@so_cmd($so_bp, $so_bh)
	if @so_light() < 2
		$so_mode = 4
		$so_note = "NO SUN (NIGHT?) - WAITING FOR LIGHT"
		$so_t = time + 10
		return
	$so_mode = 3
	$so_k = 0
	$so_t = time + 2
	$so_note = "TRACKING THE SUN"
	; with a nav on the array and a sun model: learn the offset once
	if ($so_nav != "") and !$so_cal
		$so_mode = 5
		$so_k = 0

; Nav calibration: which way the pivot turns the heading.
function @so_calibrate()
	if $so_nav == ""
		$so_mode = 3
		$so_k = 0
		return
	if $so_k == 0
		$so_r0 = $so_pc
		@so_cmd(0, $so_hc)
		$so_t = time + 4
		$so_k = 1
		$so_note = "LEARNING THE PIVOT WITH THE MINI NAV"
	elseif $so_k == 1
		$so_h0 = @in_n($so_nav, 6)
		@so_cmd(0.25, $so_hc)
		$so_t = time + 4
		$so_k = 2
	else
		var $dh = @posmod(@in_n($so_nav, 6) - $so_h0 + 180, 360) - 180
		if abs($dh) > 30
			$so_ps = 1
			if $dh < 0
				$so_ps = -1
			@so_cmd($so_r0, $so_hc)
			$so_cal = 1
			; offset between the sun and the nav when aimed best
			@so_sun()
			if $so_sel > -900
				$so_t = time + 4
				$so_k = 3
				$so_mode = 3
				$so_daz = 9999
				$so_note = "TRACKING (MINI NAV CALIBRATED)"
				return
			$so_note = "TRACKING (MINI NAV CALIBRATED)"
		else
			$so_note = "THE MINI NAV DOESN'T TURN WITH THE PIVOT"
			$so_cal = 0
			@so_cmd($so_r0, $so_hc)
		$so_mode = 3
		$so_k = 0
		$so_t = time + 4

; Night: face where the sun will rise (needs the nav calibration + sun model).
function @so_park()
	if !$so_cal or ($so_daz == 9999)
		return
	var $t0 = @sun_next(0)
	if $t0 < 0
		return
	var $keep = time
	; azimuth at sunrise: model it at that time
	var $h = $sun_h0 + $sun_w * ($t0 - $sun_t0)
	var $az = @posmod(atan(-sin($h), tan($sun_d) * cos($sun_phi) - sin($sun_phi) * cos($h)) * 180 / pi, 360)
	@so_cmd(@so_piv_for($az - $so_daz), 0)

; Keep nudging toward a better reading; aim straight with the sun model.
function @so_track()
	if @so_light() < 2
		if $so_dark_t == 0
			$so_dark_t = time
		if time - $so_dark_t > 120
			@so_park()
			$so_mode = 4
			$so_note = "NIGHT - PARKED FACING SUNRISE"
			if !$so_cal
				$so_note = "NIGHT - WAITING FOR LIGHT"
			$ui_dirty = 1
			$so_t = time + 10
			return
	else
		$so_dark_t = 0
	if $so_cal and ($so_nav != "")
		@so_sun()
		if ($so_daz == 9999) and ($so_sel > -900)
			$so_daz = $so_saz - @in_n($so_nav, 6)
	; hill climb: try a small step on one axis, keep it only if better
	var $step = 0.006
	var $dir = $so_dir
	if $so_axis == 1
		$step = 0.03
		$dir = $so_dirh
	if $so_k == 0
		$so_ref = @so_reward()
		if $so_axis == 0
			@so_cmd($so_pc + $step * $dir, $so_hc)
		else
			@so_cmd($so_pc, $so_hc + $step * $dir)
		$so_k = 1
		$so_t = time + 2
		return
	var $now = @so_reward()
	if $now < $so_ref
		; worse: step back, try the other way on this axis next time
		if $so_axis == 0
			@so_cmd($so_pc - $step * $dir, $so_hc)
			$so_dir = -$so_dir
		else
			@so_cmd($so_pc, $so_hc - $step * $dir)
			$so_dirh = -$so_dirh
		$so_axis = 1 - $so_axis
		$so_k = 0
		$so_t = time + 8
		return
	; better: keep going this way soon
	$so_k = 0
	$so_t = time + 3

; ---- v0.26.3: tracking with the mini nav pointed at the SUN (the HQ1.11
; method, proven on the Main Base). The nav on the array is told to locate
; "Sun" with its UP axis as forward (the panel normal); its channels 24 / 25
; are then the pitch / yaw from the panels to the sun. ChipOS learns how a
; small pivot step and a small hinge step change them (a 2 x 2 response,
; coupling included), then steps straight toward zero error.
storage var $so_px : number             ; yaw / pitch change per pivot step
storage var $so_py : number
storage var $so_hx : number             ; ... per hinge step
storage var $so_hy : number
var $sn_phase = 0
var $sn_due = 0
var $sn_p = 0                           ; pivot command
var $sn_h = 0                           ; hinge command
var $sn_bx = 0
var $sn_by = 0
var $sn_base = 0
var $sn_delta = 0
var $sn_mp = 0
var $sn_mh = 0
var $sn_yaw = 0
var $sn_pitch = 0
var $sn_dist = 0
var $sn_setup_t = 0
var $sn_nav_set = ""
const $sn_sp = 0.0083333333             ; 3 degrees of pivot
const $sn_sh = 0.0333333333             ; 3 degrees of hinge
const $sn_hmax = 0.944444

function @sn_wrap($v : number) : number
	return $v - floor(($v + 1) / 2) * 2

function @sn_yd($v : number) : number
	return mod($v + 3, 2) - 1

function @sn_setup()
	if ($sn_nav_set == $so_nav) and (time < $sn_setup_t)
		return
	@out_t($so_nav, 0, "Sun")
	@out_n($so_nav, 5, 1)
	@out_n($so_nav, 6, 3)
	$sn_setup_t = time + 30
	if $sn_nav_set != $so_nav
		$sn_nav_set = $so_nav
		$sn_phase = 0
		$sn_due = time + 4
		$sn_p = $so_pc
		$sn_h = $so_hc

function @sn_read()
	$sn_dist = @in_n($so_nav, 23)
	$sn_pitch = @in_n($so_nav, 24)
	$sn_yaw = @sn_yd(@in_n($so_nav, 25))

function @sn_target($go : number)
	var $p = $sn_p
	var $h = $sn_h
	if $go
		$p = @sn_wrap($p + $sn_mp)
		$h = clamp($h + $sn_mh, -$sn_hmax, $sn_hmax)
	$so_pc = $p
	$so_hc = $h
	@out_n($so_piv, 0, $p)
	@out_n($so_hin, 0, $h)

function @sn_capture()
	$sn_p = $so_pc
	$sn_h = $so_hc
	$sn_bx = $sn_yaw
	$sn_by = $sn_pitch
	$sn_base = $sn_yaw * $sn_yaw + $sn_pitch * $sn_pitch

function @sn_track()
	@sn_setup()
	if time < $sn_due
		return
	@sn_read()
	if $sn_dist <= 0
		$so_mode = 4
		$so_note = "NO SUN IN SIGHT (NIGHT?) - HOLDING"
		$sn_phase = 0
		$sn_due = time + 10
		return
	$so_mode = 3
	if $sn_phase == 1
		$so_px = @sn_yd($sn_yaw - $sn_bx) / $sn_delta
		$so_py = ($sn_pitch - $sn_by) / $sn_delta
		@sn_target(0)
		$sn_phase = 2
	elseif $sn_phase == 2
		@sn_capture()
		$sn_mp = 0
		$sn_mh = $sn_sh
		if $sn_h > 0.9
			$sn_mh = -$sn_sh
		$sn_delta = $sn_mh
		@sn_target(1)
		$sn_phase = 3
		$so_note = "LEARNING THE HINGE WITH THE MINI NAV"
	elseif $sn_phase == 3
		$so_hx = @sn_yd($sn_yaw - $sn_bx) / $sn_delta
		$so_hy = ($sn_pitch - $sn_by) / $sn_delta
		@sn_target(0)
		$sn_phase = 4
	elseif $sn_phase == 4
		$so_cal = 1
		$sn_phase = 0
	elseif $sn_phase == 5
		var $err = $sn_yaw * $sn_yaw + $sn_pitch * $sn_pitch
		if $err > $sn_base + 0.00001
			@sn_target(0)
			$so_cal = 0
			$so_note = "RELEARNING THE JOINTS"
		else
			@sn_capture()
		$sn_phase = 0
	else
		@sn_capture()
		if !$so_cal
			$sn_mp = $sn_sp
			$sn_mh = 0
			$sn_delta = $sn_mp
			@sn_target(1)
			$sn_phase = 1
			$so_note = "LEARNING THE PIVOT WITH THE MINI NAV"
		else
			if (abs($sn_yaw) < 0.008) and (abs($sn_pitch) < 0.008)
				$so_note = "FACING THE SUN (MINI NAV)"
				$sn_due = time + 30
				return
			var $det = $so_px * $so_hy - $so_hx * $so_py
			if abs($det) < 0.001
				$so_cal = 0
				$so_note = "THE JOINTS DON'T MOVE THE MINI NAV - CHECK POWER / WHICH NAV"
				$sn_due = time + 30
				return
			$sn_mp = (-$sn_yaw * $so_hy + $so_hx * $sn_pitch) / $det
			$sn_mh = (-$so_px * $sn_pitch + $so_py * $sn_yaw) / $det
			var $sc = max(1, max(abs($sn_mp) / $sn_sp, abs($sn_mh) / $sn_sh))
			$sn_mp /= $sc
			$sn_mh /= $sc
			@sn_target(1)
			$sn_phase = 5
			$so_note = "TRACKING THE SUN (MINI NAV)"
	$sn_due = time + 4

function @so_tick()
	@so_scan()
	if !@so_on()
		$so_mode = 0
		return
	if time < $so_t
		return
	if ($so_piv == "") or ($so_hin == "")
		if $so_mode != 1
			$so_mode = 1
			$so_k = 0
		@so_identify()
		return
	; a mini nav on the array: point it at the sun and track by it
	if $so_nav != ""
		@sn_track()
		return
	if $so_sens == ""
		$so_mode = 0
		$so_note = "ADD A SOLAR SENSOR ON THE MOVING PART (OR PICK THE MINI NAV ON IT)"
		return
	if ($so_mode == 0) or ($so_mode == 1)
		@so_start_search()
		return
	if $so_mode == 2
		@so_search()
		return
	if $so_mode == 3
		@so_track()
		return
	if $so_mode == 4
		; night: wait for light, then look again
		if @so_light() > 5
			@so_start_search()
		else
			$so_t = time + 10
		return
	if $so_mode == 5
		@so_calibrate()

xc_files.name: craft_ui.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - CRAFT app pages.
var $cr_cat_sel = ""
var $cr_pick = ""                       ; recipe key being ordered
array $cr_cats : text
array $cr_ord_map : number              ; list row -> order index (-1 = info row)

function @cr_untested() : number
	var $n = 0
	var $nc = $cv_a.size
	repeat $nc ($c)
		if ($cv_pr.$c == 0) and @cr_live($cv_a.$c)
			$n += 1
	var $nf = $cf_a.size
	repeat $nf ($f)
		if ($cf_feed.$f == "") and ($cf_pr.$f == 0) and @cr_live($cf_a.$f)
			$n += 1
	return $n

function @cr_short($a : text) : text
	if $a == ""
		return "?"
	return upper($a)

function @cr_ready() : number
	var $n = 0
	var $nf = $cf_a.size
	repeat $nf ($f)
		if ($cf_feed.$f != "") and @cr_live($cf_a.$f)
			$n += 1
	return $n

; Three buttons in a row; returns the y below them.
function @cr_btns($y : number, $l1 : text, $a1 : text, $l2 : text, $a2 : text, $l3 : text, $a3 : text) : number
	var $bh = $chh * 2.2
	var $gap = $cw * 0.5
	var $bw = (min($content_w, $cw * 70) - $gap * 2) / 3
	@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $bw, $bh, $l1, $a1, 3)
	@ui_btn($content_x + $bw + $gap, $y, $bw, $bh, $l2, $a2, 0)
	@ui_btn($content_x + ($bw + $gap) * 2, $y, $bw, $bh, $l3, $a3, 0)
	return $y + $bh + $chh * 0.4

; The list area below the top part of a page.
function @cr_list($y : number, $title : text, $sub : text, $act : text)
	var $sv_y = $content_y
	var $sv_h = $content_h
	$content_y = $y
	$content_h = $sv_y + $sv_h - $y
	@pick_list($title, $sub, $act)
	$content_y = $sv_y
	$content_h = $sv_h

function @page_craft()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 64)
	var $y = $content_y
	if $cf_a.size == 0
		$y = @set_header("CRAFT")
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_warn, "No crafter found. Connect a Crafter (with any alias) and the containers and item conveyors around it.", $tw)
		return
	var $st = text("{} CRAFTERS ({} READY)  {} CONTAINERS  {} CONVEYORS", $cf_a.size, @cr_ready(), $cb_a.size, $cv_a.size)
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, $st, $tw)
	var $cbl = "CONTAINERS: BUFFER " & @cr_short($cr_buf) & "  DONE " & @cr_short($cr_done) & "  ORDERS TO " & @cr_short($cr_ful)
	@ui_btn($content_x, $y, min($content_w, $cw * 70), $chh * 2.2, $cbl, "go:cr_bufs", 0)
	$y += $chh * 2.6
	if $cr_unnamed > 0
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_warn, text("{} crafting devices have no alias - give each any alias so ChipOS can use them.", $cr_unnamed), $tw)
	if $pr_on
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_warn, $cr_note, $tw)
		$y = @cr_btns($y, "STOP TEST", "cr_prstop", "STOCK", "go:cr_stock", "LAYOUT", "go:cr_map")
	elseif @cr_untested() > 0
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "ChipOS tests each conveyor and crafter once to learn where things go: it moves a few items and crafts one small part.", $tw)
		$y = @cr_btns($y, "TEST NOW", "cr_prgo", "STOCK", "go:cr_stock", "LAYOUT", "go:cr_map")
	else
		if $cr_note != ""
			$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, $cr_note, $tw)
		$y = @cr_btns($y, "NEW ORDER", "go:cr_cat", "STOCK", "go:cr_stock", "LAYOUT", "go:cr_map")
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$cr_ord_map.clear()
	var $no = $co_key.size
	repeat $no ($o)
		var $ot = upper(@rc_name($co_key.$o)) & text(" x{}  - {} MADE", $co_qty.$o, $co_made.$o)
		if $o == 0
			$ot = $ot & "  (NOW)"
		$sl_txt.append($ot)
		$sl_spec.append("")
		$cr_ord_map.append($o)
	var $nl = $cf_a.size
	repeat $nl ($l)
		var $ln = "IDLE"
		if $l < $ln_note.size
			$ln = $ln_note.$l
		var $fd = ""
		if $cf_feed.$l == ""
			$fd = "  (NOT TESTED)"
		$sl_txt.append($cf_a.$l & ": " & $ln & $fd)
		$sl_spec.append("")
		$cr_ord_map.append(-1)
	var $sub = "Tap an order to cancel it."
	if $no == 0
		$sub = "No orders. Tap NEW ORDER."
	@cr_list($y, "ORDERS & CRAFTERS", $sub, "cr_ord")

function @page_cr_cat()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$cr_cats.clear()
	var $n = $rc_key.size
	repeat $n ($r)
		var $c = $rc_cat.$r
		var $have = 0
		var $nc = $cr_cats.size
		repeat $nc ($i)
			if $cr_cats.$i == $c
				$have = 1
		if !$have
			$cr_cats.append($c)
			$sl_txt.append($c)
			$sl_spec.append($c)
	@pick_list("NEW ORDER - WHAT KIND?", "", "cr_cat")

function @page_cr_items()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $n = $rc_key.size
	repeat $n ($r)
		if $rc_cat.$r == $cr_cat_sel
			var $h = @cr_have($rc_key.$r)
			var $t = upper($rc_label.$r)
			if $h > 0
				$t = $t & "   (HAVE " & @cr_amt($rc_key.$r, $h) & ")"
			$sl_txt.append($t)
			$sl_spec.append($rc_key.$r)
	@pick_list($cr_cat_sel, "Pick the item to make.", "cr_item")

function @page_cr_stock()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $tot = ""
	var $nb = $cb_a.size
	repeat $nb ($i)
		var $inv = $cb_inv.$i
		foreach $inv ($k, $v)
			$tot.$k = $tot.$k:number + $v:number
	foreach $tot ($k2, $v2)
		if $v2:number > 0
			$sl_txt.append(upper(@rc_name($k2)) & "   " & @cr_amt($k2, $v2:number))
			$sl_spec.append($k2)
	if $sl_txt.size == 0
		$sl_txt.append("NOTHING IN THE CONTAINERS")
		$sl_spec.append("")
	@pick_list("STOCK", text("All {} containers together.", $nb), "cr_stk")

function @page_cr_map()
	var $y = $content_y
	$y = @cr_btns($y, "TEST AGAIN", "cr_retest", "BACK", "go:craft", "STOCK", "go:cr_stock")
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $nf = $cf_a.size
	repeat $nf ($f)
		var $fi = $cf_feed.$f
		if $fi == ""
			$fi = "?"
		var $fo = $cf_out.$f
		if $fo == ""
			$fo = "?"
		$sl_txt.append("CRAFTER " & $cf_a.$f & ": " & $fi & " > " & $fo)
		$sl_spec.append("")
	var $nc = $cv_a.size
	repeat $nc ($c)
		var $s = replace(substring($cv_src.$c, 1, max(0, size($cv_src.$c) - 2)), "|", ", ")
		var $d = replace(substring($cv_dst.$c, 1, max(0, size($cv_dst.$c) - 2)), "|", ", ")
		if $s == ""
			$s = "?"
		if $d == ""
			$d = "?"
		var $tg = ""
		if $cv_pr.$c == 0
			$tg = "  (NOT TESTED)"
		elseif ($cv_pr.$c == 2) and ($cv_src.$c == "")
			$tg = "  (MOVED NOTHING)"
		$sl_txt.append("CONVEYOR " & $cv_a.$c & ": " & $s & " > " & $d & $tg)
		$sl_spec.append("")
	@cr_list($y, "LAYOUT", "What ChipOS learned (it keeps learning as it moves things).", "cr_none")

function @cr_kb_done($id : text, $ok : number, $t0 : text)
	if !$ok
		return
	if $id == "cr_qty"
		var $q = 0
		if isnumeric($t0)
			$q = $t0
		$q = floor($q)
		if ($q < 1) or ($cr_pick == "")
			@ui_toast("ENTER A NUMBER")
			return
		$co_key.append($cr_pick)
		$co_qty.append(min($q, 9999))
		$co_made.append(0)
		while $co_base.size < $co_key.size - 1
			$co_base.append(0)
		$co_base.append(@cb_have_a($cr_ful, $cr_pick))
		$cr_note = ""
		@ui_toast("ORDER ADDED")
		@go("craft")

function @cr_action($act : text, $val : number)
	if $act == "cr_prgo"
		@pr_begin()
	elseif $act == "cr_prstop"
		$pr_on = 0
		$cr_note = "TEST STOPPED"
		var $nc = $cv_a.size
		repeat $nc ($c)
			if @cr_live($cv_a.$c)
				@out_n($cv_a.$c, 0, 0)
	elseif $act == "cr_retest"
		var $nc2 = $cv_a.size
		repeat $nc2 ($c2)
			$cv_src.$c2 = ""
			$cv_dst.$c2 = ""
			$cv_pr.$c2 = 0
		var $nf = $cf_a.size
		repeat $nf ($f)
			$cf_feed.$f = ""
			$cf_out.$f = ""
			$cf_pr.$f = 0
		$ed_dirty = 1
		@pr_begin()
		@go("craft")
	elseif $act == "cr_bmode"
		if $val < 3
			$cr_bmode = $val
			@go("cr_buf")
	elseif $act == "cr_bufset"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			@cr_bset($cr_bmode, $sl_spec.$val)
			@go("cr_bufs")
	elseif $act == "cr_cat"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			$cr_cat_sel = $sl_spec.$val
			@go("cr_items")
	elseif $act == "cr_item"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			$cr_pick = $sl_spec.$val
			@kb_open(-2, "cr_qty", "HOW MANY " & upper(@rc_name($cr_pick)) & "?", "1")
	elseif $act == "cr_ord"
		if $val < $cr_ord_map.size
			var $o = $cr_ord_map.$val
			if ($o >= 0) and ($o < $co_key.size)
				$co_key.erase($o)
				if $o < $co_base.size
					$co_base.erase($o)
				$co_qty.erase($o)
				$co_made.erase($o)
				@ui_toast("ORDER CANCELLED")
	$ui_dirty = 1

xc_files.name: lights_ui.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - LIGHTS: groups (categories) the user makes, AUTOMATIC OUTSIDE
; LIGHTS (an AUTOMATE rule on the solar sensor, so it shows and can be
; changed there too) and data junctions that feed lamps.
var $gp_back = ""                       ; where the group editor's DONE goes

; A solar sensor with an alias ("" none).
function @lt_sun_sensor() : text
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if ($db_type.$j == "SolarSensor") and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			return $db_alias.$j
	return ""

; The AUTOMATE rule that runs group g as outside lights (-1 none).
function @lg_rule($g : number) : number
	if ($g < 0) or ($g >= $gp_name.size)
		return -1
	var $t = "group:" & $gp_name.$g
	var $n = $rz_idev.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if ($rz_tdev.$i == $t) and ($rz_tdo.$i == 1) and ($rz_iop.$i == 1) and ($rz_ich.$i == 1)
			var $k = @db_idx_alias($rz_idev.$i)
			if $k >= 0
				if $db_type.$k == "SolarSensor"
					return $i
	return -1

; On at dusk, off at dawn: sunlight on the sensor under 50 W/m2.
function @lg_auto_on($g : number) : number
	var $s = @lt_sun_sensor()
	if $s == ""
		return 0
	$rz_idev.append($s)
	$rz_ich.append(1)
	$rz_iop.append(1)
	$rz_ival.append(50)
	$rz_tdev.append("group:" & $gp_name.$g)
	$rz_tdo.append(1)
	$rz_tch.append(0)
	$rz_tval.append(0)
	$rz_trgb.append(0)
	$rz_ttxt.append("")
	$rz_else.append(1)
	$rz_eval.append(0)
	$rz_en.append(1)
	@rz_pad()
	return 1

function @lg_refresh()
	@lt_jfix()
	$lt_autos = "|"
	var $ng = $gp_name.size
	repeat $ng ($g)
		if @lg_rule($g) >= 0
			$lt_autos = $lt_autos & $gp_name.$g & "|"

function @lg_del($g : number)
	var $r = @lg_rule($g)
	repeat 8 ($q)
		if $r >= 0
			@rz_remove($r)
			$r = @lg_rule($g)
	$gp_name.erase($g)
	$gp_mem.erase($g)

function @page_lt_groups()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$sl_txt.append("+ NEW GROUP")
	$sl_spec.append("new")
	var $ng = $gp_name.size
	repeat $ng ($g)
		var $t = $gp_name.$g & text("   ({} DEVICES)", @gp_count($g))
		if @lg_rule($g) >= 0
			$t = $t & "   AUTOMATIC OUTSIDE LIGHTS"
		$sl_txt.append($t)
		$sl_spec.append(text("{}", $g))
	@pick_list("LIGHT GROUPS", "Make groups like EXTERIOR or HANGAR. Tap one to choose its lights or make it switch itself at dusk and dawn. Groups also show in AUTOMATE and POWER.", "lg_open")

function @page_lt_gp()
	if ($gp_cur < 0) or ($gp_cur >= $gp_name.size)
		@go("lt_groups")
		return
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 64)
	var $y = $content_y
	var $st = "OFF"
	if @tgt_state("group:" & $gp_name.$gp_cur)
		$st = "ON"
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, "GROUP " & upper($gp_name.$gp_cur) & text("  -  {} DEVICES, ", @gp_count($gp_cur)) & $st, $tw)
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$sl_txt.append("SWITCH ON / OFF")
	$sl_spec.append("tog")
	$sl_txt.append("CHOOSE ITS LIGHTS")
	$sl_spec.append("mem")
	var $s = @lt_sun_sensor()
	if @lg_rule($gp_cur) >= 0
		$sl_txt.append("[ON] AUTOMATIC OUTSIDE LIGHTS - on at dusk, off at dawn")
	elseif $s == ""
		$sl_txt.append("[  ] AUTOMATIC OUTSIDE LIGHTS - needs a solar sensor with an alias")
	else
		$sl_txt.append("[  ] AUTOMATIC OUTSIDE LIGHTS - by solar sensor " & $s)
	$sl_spec.append("auto")
	$sl_txt.append("DELETE THIS GROUP")
	$sl_spec.append("del")
	@cr_list($y, "", "", "lg_gp")

; Data junctions / bridges wired straight to lamps.
function @page_lt_jx()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		var $a = $db_alias.$j
		if ($a != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1) and @lt_is_jx($db_type.$j)
			var $mk = "[  ] "
			if $db_cat.$j == 1
				$mk = "[X] "
			$sl_txt.append($mk & $a & "   (" & $db_type.$j & ")")
			$sl_spec.append($a)
	if $sl_txt.size == 0
		$sl_txt.append("NO DATA JUNCTIONS OR BRIDGES WITH AN ALIAS")
		$sl_spec.append("")
	@pick_list("JUNCTIONS THAT RUN LIGHTS", "A data junction wired to lamps passes ON / OFF and colour to all of them. Tick the ones that run lights (names with LIGHT or LAMP are ticked already). They then act like one light everywhere.", "lg_jx")

function @lg_action($act : text, $val : number)
	if $act == "lg_open"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			var $sp = $sl_spec.$val
			if $sp == "new"
				$gp_back = "lt_groups"
				@kb_open(-2, "gpname", "NAME THIS GROUP", "EXTERIOR")
			else
				$gp_cur = $sp:number
				@go("lt_gp")
	elseif $act == "lg_gp"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			var $o = $sl_spec.$val
			var $gn = "group:" & $gp_name.$gp_cur
			if $o == "tog"
				@tgt_set($gn, !@tgt_state($gn))
			elseif $o == "mem"
				$gp_back = "lt_gp"
				@go("gp_edit")
			elseif $o == "auto"
				var $r = @lg_rule($gp_cur)
				if $r >= 0
					@rz_remove($r)
					@ui_toast("AUTOMATIC OUTSIDE LIGHTS OFF")
				elseif @lg_auto_on($gp_cur)
					@ui_toast("ON AT DUSK, OFF AT DAWN - SEE AUTOMATE")
				else
					@ui_toast("NO SOLAR SENSOR WITH AN ALIAS FOUND")
			elseif $o == "del"
				@lg_del($gp_cur)
				$gp_cur = -1
				@go("lt_groups")
	elseif $act == "lg_jx"
		if ($val < $sl_spec.size) and ($sl_spec.$val != "")
			var $a = $sl_spec.$val
			var $k = @db_idx_alias($a)
			if $k >= 0
				if $db_cat.$k == 1
					$lt_jx = replace($lt_jx, "|" & $a & "|", "|")
					$lt_jno = @set_add($lt_jno, $a)
				else
					$lt_jno = replace($lt_jno, "|" & $a & "|", "|")
					$lt_jx = @set_add($lt_jx, $a)
				@lt_jfix()
	$ui_dirty = 1

xc_files.name: drive_core.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - DRIVE: wheeled vehicles. A pilot seat's keys drive every named
; wheel. Setup learns which way each wheel spins, which end is the front,
; the steering sign and the seat's key bindings; then it runs 25x a second.
storage var $dv_ver : number
storage array $dw_alias : text          ; wheels (by alias) ...
storage array $dw_dir : number          ; ... and their drive sign (+1 / -1)
storage var $dv_front : number          ; map arrow that points forward: 0 up 1 right 2 down 3 left
storage var $dv_sdir : number           ; steering sign
storage var $dv_navs : number           ; nav forward-speed sign
storage var $dv_mode : number           ; 0 front steer, 1 rear steer, 2 all-wheel steer, 3 skid steer
storage var $dv_sens : number           ; less steering at speed
storage var $dv_limit : number          ; speed limit m/s (0 = none)
storage var $dv_regen : number
storage var $dv_on : number             ; ChipOS drives the wheels
storage var $dv_done : number           ; setup finished
storage var $dv_seat : text             ; chosen seat ("" = first pilot seat)
storage array $dc_ch : number           ; controls: 0 throttle 1 steer 2 brake 3 handbrake 4 cruise
storage array $dc_sign : number
storage array $dk_act : number          ; AUX 1-9,0 (seat ch 8-17): 0 none 1 switch 2 horn 3 regen 4 handbrake 5 cruise
storage array $dk_ref : text            ; switch target (relay, light or group:name)

; runtime
array $dw_ok : number                   ; wheel present (by $dw_alias index)
array $dw_px : number                   ; position (device x / z)
array $dw_pz : number
array $dw_f : number                    ; forward / right offset from the middle
array $dw_s : number
array $dw_role : number                 ; steering: 1 front, -1 rear, 0 none
array $dw_l0 : number                   ; last outputs (written only on change)
array $dw_l1 : number
array $dw_l2 : number
array $dw_l3 : number
array $dw_rot : number                  ; live rotation (rot/s)
array $dk_prev : number
var $dv_seat_now = ""
var $dv_nw = 0                          ; named wheels present
var $dv_unnamed = 0
var $dv_haspos = 0
var $dv_sync_next = 0
var $dv_refresh = 0
var $dv_seated = 0
var $dv_thr = 0
var $dv_st = 0
var $dv_acc = 0
var $dv_brk = 0
var $dv_v = 0
var $dv_vok = 0
var $dv_hb = 0                          ; handbrake latched (key action)
var $dv_hb_in = 0
var $dv_cruise = 0
var $dv_cr_v = 0
var $dv_cr_i = 0                        ; cruise integral (holds speed on hills)
var $dv_prev_cr = 0
var $dv_gear = "P"
var $dv_was_on = 0
var $dv_tmode = 0                       ; tests: 1 drive, 2 steer, 3 wiggle one wheel
var $dv_tend = 0
var $dv_wig = -1
var $dv_tnav = 0                        ; nav forward speed seen during the drive test
; automatic wheel mapping with the nav: spin one wheel at a time
var $wa_on = 0                          ; 1 running, 2 done
var $wa_k = 0                           ; wheel being spun
var $wa_ph = 0                          ; 0 settle, 1 spin, 2 stop
var $wa_t = 0
var $wa_h0 = 0
var $wa_v = 0
var $wa_n = 0
array $wa_fwd : number                  ; mean forward speed per wheel
array $wa_yaw : number                  ; heading change per wheel (deg)
var $wa_note = ""
var $dv_horn = 0
var $dv_live = 0                        ; a drive panel is on screen
var $dv_redraw = 0

function @dv_load()
	if $dv_ver != 1
		$dw_alias.clear()
		$dw_dir.clear()
		$dv_front = 0
		$dv_sdir = 1
		$dv_navs = 1
		$dv_mode = 0
		$dv_sens = 1
		$dv_limit = 0
		$dv_regen = 1
		$dv_on = 0
		$dv_done = 0
		$dv_seat = ""
		$dc_ch.clear()
		$dc_sign.clear()
		; W/S throttle (ch1), A/D steer (ch2), handbrake on up (ch3)
		$dc_ch.append(1)
		$dc_ch.append(2)
		$dc_ch.append(0)
		$dc_ch.append(3)
		$dc_ch.append(0)
		repeat 5 ($q)
			$dc_sign.append(1)
		$dk_act.clear()
		$dk_ref.clear()
		repeat 10 ($q2)
			$dk_act.append(0)
			$dk_ref.append("")
		$dv_ver = 1

function @dv_ctl_name($i : number) : text
	if $i == 0
		return "THROTTLE"
	if $i == 1
		return "STEERING"
	if $i == 2
		return "BRAKE"
	if $i == 3
		return "HANDBRAKE"
	return "CRUISE CONTROL"

; Seat channel name (Pilot Seat outputs).
function @dv_ch_name($c : number) : text
	if $c <= 0
		return "NOT SET"
	if $c == 1
		return "BACK/FORWARD"
	if $c == 2
		return "LEFT/RIGHT"
	if $c == 3
		return "DOWN/UP"
	if $c == 4
		return "PITCH"
	if $c == 5
		return "ROLL"
	if $c == 6
		return "YAW"
	if $c == 7
		return "THRUST"
	if $c == 17
		return "AUX 0"
	return text("AUX {}", $c - 7)

function @dv_mode_name($m : number) : text
	if $m == 1
		return "REAR WHEELS STEER"
	if $m == 2
		return "ALL WHEELS STEER"
	if $m == 3
		return "SKID STEER (TANK)"
	return "FRONT WHEELS STEER"

function @dv_find_wheel($a : text) : number
	var $n = $dw_alias.size
	repeat $n ($k)
		if $dw_alias.$k == $a
			return $k
	return -1

; Forward / right offsets and steering roles from positions + front.
function @dv_geometry()
	var $n = $dw_alias.size
	var $cx = 0
	var $cz = 0
	var $cn = 0
	repeat $n ($k)
		if $dw_ok.$k
			$cx += $dw_px.$k
			$cz += $dw_pz.$k
			$cn += 1
	if $cn > 0
		$cx = $cx / $cn
		$cz = $cz / $cn
	var $fx = 0
	var $fz = 1
	if $dv_front == 1
		$fx = 1
		$fz = 0
	elseif $dv_front == 2
		$fz = -1
	elseif $dv_front == 3
		$fx = -1
		$fz = 0
	var $mf = 0
	repeat $n ($k2)
		var $dx = $dw_px.$k2 - $cx
		var $dz = $dw_pz.$k2 - $cz
		$dw_f.$k2 = $dx * $fx + $dz * $fz
		$dw_s.$k2 = $dx * $fz - $dz * $fx
		if $dw_ok.$k2
			$mf = max($mf, abs($dw_f.$k2))
	repeat $n ($k3)
		var $ro = 0
		if $mf > 0.2
			var $fr = $dw_f.$k3 / $mf
			if $fr > 0.3
				$ro = 1
			elseif $fr < -0.3
				$ro = -1
		$dw_role.$k3 = $ro

; Every 2 s: seat, wheels, positions.
function @dv_sync()
	$dv_sync_next = time + 2
	; seat: the chosen one, else the first pilot seat, else any seat
	$dv_seat_now = ""
	var $any = ""
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if contains($db_type.$j, "Seat") and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			if $db_alias.$j == $dv_seat
				$dv_seat_now = $dv_seat
			if ($any == "") or (contains($db_type.$j, "Pilot") and !contains($any, "|p"))
				$any = $db_alias.$j
				if contains($db_type.$j, "Pilot")
					$any = $any & "|p"
	if $dv_seat_now == ""
		var $bar = find($any, "|")
		if $bar >= 0
			$any = substring($any, 0, $bar)
		$dv_seat_now = $any
	; wheels: add new named ones
	$dv_unnamed = 0
	repeat $n ($j2)
		if contains($db_type.$j2, "Wheel") and ($db_seen.$j2 >= $scan_gen - 1)
			if $db_alias.$j2 == ""
				$dv_unnamed += 1
			elseif @dv_find_wheel($db_alias.$j2) < 0
				$dw_alias.append($db_alias.$j2)
				$dw_dir.append(1)
	var $wn = $dw_alias.size
	repeat 50 ($q)
		if $dw_ok.size < $wn
			$dw_ok.append(0)
			$dw_px.append(0)
			$dw_pz.append(0)
			$dw_f.append(0)
			$dw_s.append(0)
			$dw_role.append(0)
			$dw_l0.append(-9)
			$dw_l1.append(-9)
			$dw_l2.append(-9)
			$dw_l3.append(-9)
			$dw_rot.append(0)
	$dv_nw = 0
	var $minx = 1000000
	var $maxx = -1000000
	var $minz = 1000000
	var $maxz = -1000000
	repeat $wn ($k)
		var $ok = 0
		var $di = @db_idx_alias($dw_alias.$k)
		if $di >= 0
			if ($db_seen.$di >= $scan_gen - 1) and contains($db_type.$di, "Wheel")
				$ok = 1
		$dw_ok.$k = $ok
		if $ok
			$dv_nw += 1
			var $dev = device($db_id.$di)
			var $tx = text("{}", $dev.x)
			var $tz = text("{}", $dev.z)
			var $nx = 0
			var $nz = 0
			$nx = $tx
			$nz = $tz
			$dw_px.$k = $nx
			$dw_pz.$k = $nz
			$minx = min($minx, $nx)
			$maxx = max($maxx, $nx)
			$minz = min($minz, $nz)
			$maxz = max($maxz, $nz)
	$dv_present = ($dv_nw > 0) or ($dv_unnamed > 0)
	$dv_haspos = ($dv_nw > 0) and (max($maxx - $minx, $maxz - $minz) > 0.1)
	if !$dv_haspos
		; no usable positions: lay them out in pairs, front first
		var $pk = 0
		repeat $wn ($k4)
			if $dw_ok.$k4
				var $side = -1
				if @posmod($pk, 2) == 1
					$side = 1
				$dw_px.$k4 = $side
				$dw_pz.$k4 = -floor($pk / 2) * 2
				$pk += 1
	@dv_geometry()
	repeat 10 ($q3)
		if $dk_prev.size < 10
			$dk_prev.append(0)

; Speed along the vehicle, m/s (+ forward). Sets $dv_vok.
function @dv_speed() : number
	@att_find_nav()
	if $att_nav != ""
		$dv_vok = 1
		return @in_n($att_nav, 11) * $dv_navs
	var $m = @spd_now()
	; direction from the wheels
	var $sum = 0
	var $wn = $dw_alias.size
	repeat $wn ($k)
		if $dw_ok.$k
			$sum += $dw_rot.$k * $dw_dir.$k
	if $m < 0
		$dv_vok = 0
		return $sum / max($dv_nw, 1)
	$dv_vok = 1
	if $sum < 0
		return -$m
	return $m

; One control's value (-1..1); 0 when not bound or nobody is seated.
function @dv_ctl($i : number) : number
	if ($i >= $dc_ch.size) or ($dv_seat_now == "")
		return 0
	var $c = $dc_ch.$i
	if $c <= 0
		return 0
	return clamp(@in_n($dv_seat_now, $c) * $dc_sign.$i, -1, 1)

; Write a wheel's four inputs.
; Setup tests (and wheel wiggle): send only what changed, plus a refresh every
; 2 s - this gives the gentle test moves.
function @dv_out_test($k : number, $a : number, $s : number, $r : number, $b : number)
	var $al = $dw_alias.$k
	if $dv_refresh or ($dw_l0.$k != $a)
		@out_n($al, 0, $a)
		$dw_l0.$k = $a
	if $dv_refresh or ($dw_l1.$k != $s)
		@out_n($al, 1, $s)
		$dw_l1.$k = $s
	if $dv_refresh or ($dw_l2.$k != $r)
		@out_n($al, 2, $r)
		$dw_l2.$k = $r
	if $dv_refresh or ($dw_l3.$k != $b)
		@out_n($al, 3, $b)
		$dw_l3.$k = $b

; Driving: every input, every tick.
function @dv_out($k : number, $a : number, $s : number, $r : number, $b : number)
	; written every tick: a wheel's inputs don't hold a value on their own
	var $al = $dw_alias.$k
	@out_n($al, 0, $a)
	@out_n($al, 1, $s)
	@out_n($al, 2, $r)
	@out_n($al, 3, $b)
	$dw_l0.$k = $a
	$dw_l1.$k = $s
	$dw_l2.$k = $r
	$dw_l3.$k = $b

; Key action on AUX key i (0..9) pressed.
function @dv_key($i : number)
	var $a = $dk_act.$i
	if $a == 1
		var $t = $dk_ref.$i
		if $t != ""
			@tgt_set($t, !@tgt_state($t))
	elseif $a == 3
		$dv_regen = !$dv_regen
	elseif $a == 4
		$dv_hb = !$dv_hb
	elseif $a == 5
		$dv_cruise = !$dv_cruise
		$dv_cr_v = max($dv_v, 1)
		$dv_cr_i = clamp($dv_acc, 0, 1)

function @wa_start()
	$wa_on = 1
	$wa_k = -1
	$wa_ph = 2
	$wa_t = time
	$wa_fwd.clear()
	$wa_yaw.clear()
	var $wn = $dw_alias.size
	repeat $wn ($k)
		$wa_fwd.append(0)
		$wa_yaw.append(0)
	$wa_note = "STARTING"
	$dv_refresh = 1

; Work out drive signs, sides and the front from what each wheel did.
function @wa_finish()
	var $wn = $dw_alias.size
	var $lx = 0
	var $lz = 0
	var $ln = 0
	var $rx = 0
	var $rz = 0
	var $rn = 0
	var $moved = 0
	repeat $wn ($k)
		if $dw_ok.$k and (abs($wa_fwd.$k) > 0.05)
			$moved += 1
			var $sg = 1
			if $wa_fwd.$k < 0
				$sg = -1
			$dw_dir.$k = $dw_dir.$k * $sg
			; pushing forward and turning right (heading up) = a LEFT wheel
			var $yw = $wa_yaw.$k * $sg
			if $yw > 0.3
				$lx += $dw_px.$k
				$lz += $dw_pz.$k
				$ln += 1
			elseif $yw < -0.3
				$rx += $dw_px.$k
				$rz += $dw_pz.$k
				$rn += 1
	$dv_navs = 1
	if $moved == 0
		$wa_note = "NOTHING MOVED - CHECK POWER, BRAKES AND THE NAV"
		$wa_on = 2
		return
	$wa_note = text("{} WHEEL(S) SET TO DRIVE FORWARD.", $moved)
	if ($ln > 0) and ($rn > 0) and $dv_haspos
		var $vx = $rx / $rn - $lx / $ln
		var $vz = $rz / $rn - $lz / $ln
		; forward is the right-hand vector turned a quarter: f = (-r.z, r.x)
		var $fx = -$vz
		var $fz = $vx
		var $best = 0
		var $bd = $fz
		if $fx > $bd
			$best = 1
			$bd = $fx
		if -$fz > $bd
			$best = 2
			$bd = -$fz
		if -$fx > $bd
			$best = 3
		$dv_front = $best
		@dv_geometry()
		$wa_note = $wa_note & " FRONT FOUND."
	else
		$wa_note = $wa_note & " COULDN'T TELL LEFT FROM RIGHT - PICK THE FRONT YOURSELF."
	$wa_on = 2

; Each wheel: settle 1 s, spin 2.5 s (others free), brake 2 s.
function @wa_tick()
	var $wn = $dw_alias.size
	if time < $wa_t
		; while spinning: average the nav's forward speed
		if $wa_ph == 1
			$wa_v += @in_n($att_nav, 11)
			$wa_n += 1
		return
	if $wa_ph == 2
		; next wheel
		$wa_k += 1
		repeat $wn ($q0)
			if $wa_k < $wn
				if !$dw_ok.$wa_k
					$wa_k += 1
		if $wa_k >= $wn
			repeat $wn ($q)
				if $dw_ok.$q
					@dv_out($q, 0, 0, 0, 0)
			@wa_finish()
			$ui_dirty = 1
			return
		repeat $wn ($q1)
			if $dw_ok.$q1
				@dv_out($q1, 0, 0, 0, 0)
		$wa_ph = 0
		$wa_t = time + 1
		$wa_note = text("WHEEL {} OF {}: ", $wa_k + 1, $wn) & $dw_alias.$wa_k
		$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	if $wa_ph == 0
		$wa_h0 = @in_n($att_nav, 6)
		$wa_v = 0
		$wa_n = 0
		repeat $wn ($q2)
			if $dw_ok.$q2
				var $a = 0
				if $q2 == $wa_k
					$a = 0.6 * $dw_dir.$q2
				@dv_out($q2, $a, 0, 0, 0)
		$wa_ph = 1
		$wa_t = time + 2.5
		return
	if $wa_ph == 1
		$wa_fwd.$wa_k = $wa_v / max($wa_n, 1)
		$wa_yaw.$wa_k = @posmod(@in_n($att_nav, 6) - $wa_h0 + 180, 360) - 180
		repeat $wn ($q3)
			if $dw_ok.$q3
				@dv_out($q3, 0, 0, 0, 1)
		$wa_ph = 2
		$wa_t = time + 2

function @dv_tick()
	if time >= $dv_sync_next
		@dv_sync()
		$dv_refresh = 1
	var $wn = $dw_alias.size
	repeat $wn ($k)
		if $dw_ok.$k
			$dw_rot.$k = @in_n($dw_alias.$k, 0)
	$dv_v = @dv_speed()
	if $wa_on == 1
		@wa_tick()
		return
	; ---- setup tests ----
	if $dv_tmode > 0
		var $tdone = time >= $dv_tend
		if $att_nav != ""
			$dv_tnav = $dv_tnav * 0.9 + @in_n($att_nav, 11) * 0.1
		repeat $wn ($k1)
			if $dw_ok.$k1
				var $ta = 0
				var $t_st = 0
				var $tb = 0
				if $tdone
					$tb = 1
				elseif $dv_tmode == 1
					$ta = 0.3 * $dw_dir.$k1
				elseif $dv_tmode == 2
					if $dv_mode == 3
						var $sd = 1
						if $dw_s.$k1 > 0.1
							$sd = -1
						elseif $dw_s.$k1 > -0.1
							$sd = 0
						$ta = 0.4 * $sd * $dv_sdir * $dw_dir.$k1
					elseif $dw_role.$k1 != 0
						$t_st = $dv_sdir * $dw_role.$k1
				elseif $k1 == $dv_wig
					$t_st = 1
					if @posmod(floor(($dv_tend - time) * 2.5), 2) == 1
						$t_st = -1
				@dv_out_test($k1, $ta, $t_st, 0, $tb)
		$dv_refresh = 0
		if $tdone
			$dv_tmode = 0
			$dv_wig = -1
			$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	; ---- driving ----
	if !$dv_on
		if $dv_was_on
			; hand the wheels back: everything off
			$dv_refresh = 1
			repeat $wn ($k2)
				if $dw_ok.$k2
					@dv_out($k2, 0, 0, 0, 0)
			$dv_was_on = 0
		$dv_refresh = 0
		$dv_gear = "-"
		return
	$dv_was_on = 1
	$dv_seated = 0
	if $dv_seat_now != ""
		$dv_seated = @in_n($dv_seat_now, 0) != 0
	var $thr = 0
	var $st = 0
	var $brk = 0
	var $learning = $ui_page == "dv_learn"
	$dv_hb_in = 0
	if $dv_seated and !$learning
		$thr = @dv_ctl(0)
		$st = @dv_ctl(1)
		$brk = max(@dv_ctl(2), 0)
		$dv_hb_in = @dv_ctl(3) > 0.5
		var $cr = @dv_ctl(4) > 0.5
		if $cr and !$dv_prev_cr
			$dv_cruise = !$dv_cruise
			$dv_cr_v = max($dv_v, 1)
			$dv_cr_i = clamp($dv_acc, 0, 1)
		$dv_cr_i = clamp($dv_acc, 0, 1)
		$dv_prev_cr = $cr
		; AUX keys
		repeat 10 ($ki)
			var $kc = 8 + $ki
			var $kv = @in_n($dv_seat_now, $kc) > 0.5
			if $kv and !$dk_prev.$ki
				@dv_key($ki)
			if $kv and ($dk_act.$ki == 2)
				@snd_beep(392, 0.12)
			$dk_prev.$ki = $kv
	var $v = $dv_v
	var $av = abs($v)
	var $acc = $thr
	; throttle against the motion = brake
	if ($av > 0.8) and ($thr * $v < 0)
		$brk = max($brk, abs($thr))
		$acc = 0
	; cruise: braking or reversing cancels; throttle can add
	if $dv_cruise
		if ($brk > 0.1) or ($thr < -0.1) or (!$dv_seated) or $dv_hb or $dv_hb_in
			$dv_cruise = 0
		else
			var $cerr = $dv_cr_v - $v
			$dv_cr_i = clamp($dv_cr_i + $cerr * 0.004, 0, 1)
			var $ca = clamp($cerr * 0.3 + $dv_cr_i, 0, 1)
			$acc = max($acc, $ca)
			if ($v > $dv_cr_v + 1.5) and ($thr < 0.05)
				$brk = max($brk, 0.3)
	; speed limit
	if ($dv_limit > 0) and ($av > $dv_limit) and ($acc * $v > 0)
		$acc = 0
		if $av > $dv_limit + 2
			$brk = max($brk, 0.3)
	; parked: nobody seated, handbrake, or stopped with no throttle
	var $park = (!$dv_seated) or $dv_hb or $dv_hb_in or $learning
	if $park
		$brk = 1
		$acc = 0
	elseif (abs($thr) < 0.05) and ($av < 0.5) and !$dv_cruise and ((abs($st) < 0.05) or ($dv_mode != 3))
		$brk = max($brk, 1)
	; steering
	var $sf = 1
	if $dv_sens and $dv_vok
		$sf = 1 / (1 + $av / 20)
	$dv_thr = $thr
	$dv_st = $st
	$dv_acc = $acc
	$dv_brk = $brk
	var $rg = $dv_regen
	repeat $wn ($k3)
		if $dw_ok.$k3
			var $wa = $acc
			var $ws = 0
			if $dv_mode == 3
				if !$park
					var $sd2 = 0
					if $dw_s.$k3 > 0.1
						$sd2 = -1
					elseif $dw_s.$k3 < -0.1
						$sd2 = 1
					var $ksk = $st * $dv_sdir * 0.8
					$wa = clamp(($acc + $ksk * $sd2) / max(1, abs($acc) + abs($ksk)), -1, 1)
			else
				var $ro = $dw_role.$k3
				if ($dv_mode == 0) and ($ro < 0)
					$ro = 0
				if ($dv_mode == 1) and ($ro > 0)
					$ro = 0
				$ws = clamp($st * $sf * $dv_sdir * $ro, -1, 1)
			@dv_out($k3, $wa * $dw_dir.$k3, $ws, $rg, $brk)
	$dv_refresh = 0
	; gear letter
	if $park
		$dv_gear = "P"
	elseif ($v < -0.5) or (($thr < -0.1) and ($av < 0.8))
		$dv_gear = "R"
	elseif ($v > 0.5) or ($thr > 0.1)
		$dv_gear = "D"
	else
		$dv_gear = "N"

; ---- drawing ----
function @dv_bar($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $v : number, $c : number, $centred : number)
	@ui_box($x, $y, $w, $h, $th_bg, $th_line)
	if $centred
		var $mid = $x + $w / 2
		var $e = $mid + $v * ($w / 2 - 1)
		if abs($e - $mid) >= 1
			@ui_box(min($mid, $e), $y + 1, abs($e - $mid), $h - 2, $c, $c)
		@d_line($mid, $y, $mid, $y + $h, $th_dim)
	else
		var $bh = clamp($v, 0, 1) * ($h - 2)
		if $bh >= 1
			@ui_box($x + 1, $y + $h - 1 - $bh, $w - 2, $bh, $c, $c)

; Wheel map. $raw: 1 = as built (x right, z up), 0 = front up.
; Taps: wheels -> "dv_wig" when $taps.
function @dv_map($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $raw : number, $taps : number)
	var $wn = $dw_alias.size
	var $minx = 1000000
	var $maxx = -1000000
	var $miny = 1000000
	var $maxy = -1000000
	var $cnt = 0
	repeat $wn ($k)
		if $dw_ok.$k
			var $mx = $dw_s.$k
			var $my = -$dw_f.$k
			if $raw
				$mx = $dw_px.$k
				$my = -$dw_pz.$k
			$minx = min($minx, $mx)
			$maxx = max($maxx, $mx)
			$miny = min($miny, $my)
			$maxy = max($maxy, $my)
			$cnt += 1
	if $cnt == 0
		@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $h / 2 - $chh / 2, $th_dim, "NO NAMED WHEELS", $w)
		return
	var $span = max(max($maxx - $minx, $maxy - $miny), 1)
	var $sc = min($w, $h) * 0.7 / $span
	var $cx = $x + $w / 2 - ($minx + $maxx) / 2 * $sc
	var $cy = $y + $h / 2 - ($miny + $maxy) / 2 * $sc
	var $ww = max(min($sc * 0.35, $w * 0.12), 4)
	var $wh = max(min($sc * 0.7, $h * 0.22), 6)
	; body outline
	@ui_box($x + $w / 2 - ($maxx - $minx) / 2 * $sc - $ww * 0.2, $y + $h / 2 - ($maxy - $miny) / 2 * $sc - $wh * 0.4, ($maxx - $minx) * $sc + $ww * 0.4, ($maxy - $miny) * $sc + $wh * 0.8, $th_panel2, $th_line)
	repeat $wn ($k2)
		if $dw_ok.$k2
			var $mx2 = $dw_s.$k2
			var $my2 = -$dw_f.$k2
			if $raw
				$mx2 = $dw_px.$k2
				$my2 = -$dw_pz.$k2
			var $px = $cx + $mx2 * $sc
			var $py = $cy + $my2 * $sc
			var $a = $dw_l0.$k2 * $dw_dir.$k2
			var $col = $th_dim
			if $dw_l0.$k2 < -5
				$col = $th_dim
			elseif $dw_l3.$k2 > 0.5
				$col = $th_bad
			elseif $a > 0.05
				$col = $th_ok
			elseif $a < -0.05
				$col = $th_warn
			if $k2 == $dv_wig
				$col = $th_accent
			@ui_box($px - $ww / 2, $py - $wh / 2, $ww, $wh, $th_bg, $col)
			; steering angle line (not meaningful in the raw view)
			var $sa = 0
			if (!$raw) and ($dw_l1.$k2 > -2)
				$sa = $dw_l1.$k2 * $dv_sdir * 0.5
			var $lx = sin($sa) * $wh * 0.45
			var $ly = cos($sa) * $wh * 0.45
			@d_line($px - $lx, $py + $ly, $px + $lx, $py - $ly, $col)
			if $wh > $chh * 2.2
				var $lab = @ui_fit($dw_alias.$k2, max(floor($sc * 0.9 / $cw), 3))
				@ui_text_c($px, $py + $wh / 2 + $chh * 0.2, $th_dim, $lab)
			if $taps
				$ui_hv = $k2
				@ui_hit($px - $ww, $py - $wh / 2, $px + $ww, $py + $wh / 2, "dv_wig")

; The live drive display (app page and widget).
function @dv_panel($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number)
	$dv_live = 1
	$att_live = 1
	@ui_box($x, $y, $w, $h, $th_panel, $th_line)
	if $dv_nw == 0
		@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $h / 2 - $chh * 1.2, $th_warn, "NO WHEELS", $w - $cw)
		@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $h / 2 + $chh * 0.4, $th_dim, "Name the wheels (DEVICES app)", $w - $cw)
		return
	var $k = 3.6
	var $su = "km/h"
	if $cfg_units
		$k = 2.23694
		$su = "mph"
	var $sv = text("{0}", abs($dv_v) * $k)
	if !$dv_vok
		$sv = "--"
	var $gcol = $th_text
	if $dv_gear == "P"
		$gcol = $th_bad
	elseif $dv_gear == "R"
		$gcol = $th_warn
	elseif $dv_gear == "D"
		$gcol = $th_ok
	var $wide = $w > $h * 1.3
	var $pad = $cw * 0.6
	; left (or top): speed + gear + bars;  right (or bottom): wheel map
	var $lw = $w - $pad * 2
	var $lh = $h * 0.55
	var $mx = $x + $pad
	var $my = $y + $h * 0.55
	var $mw = $w - $pad * 2
	var $mh = $h * 0.45 - $pad
	if $wide
		$lw = $w * 0.55 - $pad
		$lh = $h - $pad * 2
		$mx = $x + $w * 0.55
		$my = $y + $pad
		$mw = $w * 0.45 - $pad
		$mh = $h - $pad * 2
	var $lx = $x + $pad
	var $ly = $y + $pad
	; gear box + speed
	var $gm = @fit_mul(2, $lw * 0.3, $lh * 0.42, 5)
	var $gw = $cw * $gm * 1.6
	@ui_box($lx, $ly, $gw, $chh * $gm * 1.3, $th_bg, $gcol)
	@ui_text_big($lx + $gw / 2, $ly + $chh * $gm * 0.15, $gcol, $dv_gear, $gm)
	var $sx = $lx + $gw + $cw
	var $sw = $lw - $gw - $cw
	var $sm = @fit_mul(size($sv) + 1, $sw, $lh * 0.42, 5)
	@ui_text_big($sx + $sw / 2, $ly, $th_text, $sv, $sm)
	var $uy = $ly + $chh * $sm + $chh * 0.1
	@text_fit_c($sx + $sw / 2, $uy, $th_dim, $su, $sw)
	; flags
	var $fl = ""
	if $dv_cruise
		$fl = $fl & text("CRUISE {0} ", $dv_cr_v * $k)
	if $dv_hb or $dv_hb_in
		$fl = $fl & "HANDBRAKE "
	if $dv_limit > 0
		$fl = $fl & text("LIMIT {0} ", $dv_limit * $k)
	if !$dv_on
		$fl = "DRIVE CONTROL OFF"
	elseif !$dv_seated
		$fl = $fl & "SEAT EMPTY"
	var $fy = max($uy + $chh * 1.2, $ly + $chh * $gm * 1.3 + $chh * 0.3)
	@text_fit_c($lx + $lw / 2, $fy, $th_accent, $fl, $lw)
	; bars: throttle | brake (vertical), steering (horizontal)
	var $by = $fy + $chh * 1.4
	var $bh = $ly + $lh - $by - $chh * 1.4
	if $bh > $chh * 1.5
		var $bw = max($cw * 1.5, $lw * 0.08)
		var $bx2 = $lx + $bw + $cw * 0.5
		var $bx3 = $lx + ($bw + $cw * 0.5) * 2
		@dv_bar($lx, $by, $bw, $bh, max($dv_acc, 0), $th_ok, 0)
		@dv_bar($bx2, $by, $bw, $bh, max(-$dv_acc, 0), $th_warn, 0)
		@dv_bar($bx3, $by, $bw, $bh, $dv_brk, $th_bad, 0)
		var $l1 = "G"
		var $l2 = "R"
		var $l3 = "B"
		if $bw >= $cw * 3
			$l1 = "GO"
			$l2 = "REV"
			$l3 = "BRK"
		@ui_text_c($lx + $bw / 2, $by + $bh + $chh * 0.2, $th_dim, $l1)
		@ui_text_c($bx2 + $bw / 2, $by + $bh + $chh * 0.2, $th_dim, $l2)
		@ui_text_c($bx3 + $bw / 2, $by + $bh + $chh * 0.2, $th_dim, $l3)
		var $hx = $bx3 + $bw + $cw
		var $hw = $lx + $lw - $hx
		if $hw > $cw * 4
			@ui_text($hx, $by, $th_dim, "STEER")
			@dv_bar($hx, $by + $chh * 1.2, $hw, $chh * 1.2, $dv_st, $th_accent, 1)
	; wheel map
	@dv_map($mx, $my, $mw, $mh, 0, 0)

xc_files.name: comms.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - COMMS: beacons. Broadcasts this build (a name, or structured
; chipos.node data the user chooses), listens to a directory of
; frequencies, a weather station and the solar time server.
; Beacon channels: out text 0 = data to send, 1 = send frequency,
; 2 = listen frequency; in text 0 = data heard, number 1 = distance (m),
; 5 = receiving.
storage var $cm_ver : number
storage var $cm_name : text             ; network name
storage var $cm_freq : text             ; broadcast frequency
storage var $cm_mode : number           ; 0 off, 1 name only, 2 structured
storage var $cm_tx : text               ; sending beacon ("" = first found)
storage var $cm_wx : text               ; weather station frequency ("" = none)
storage var $cm_relay : number          ; broadcast flags: 1 type, 2 position, 4 sun, 8 weather
storage array $bf_key : text            ; broadcast fields chosen by the user
storage array $bf_src : text            ; source spec (as custom widgets: bat:all, dev:alias:ch ...)
storage array $bf_on : number
; contacts ($cd_*) live in contacts.xc

var $cm_bcn = ""                        ; sending beacon in use
var $cm_rx = ""                         ; listening beacon
var $cm_bcn_n = 0
var $ws_spare_ok = 0                    ; weather goes out on a spare beacon
var $cm_scan_next = 0
var $cm_sent = ""
var $cm_sent_f = ""
var $cm_sent_b = ""                     ; beacon the frequency was written to
var $cm_sent_ft = 0
var $cm_tx_next = 0
; listening job: -3 time server fallback, -2 time server, -1 weather, >= 0 directory index
var $cm_job = -9
var $cm_job_f = ""
var $cm_job_t = 0
var $cm_job_k = 0
var $cm_job_i = 0                       ; round-robin position
var $cm_tuned = ""                      ; frequency the listener is on
var $cd_shown = 0                       ; when contact cards were last redrawn
var $ts_fail = 0                        ; time server primary was silent
var $ts_next = 0                        ; next time-server refresh
var $wx_pkt = ""
var $wx_t = 0
var $wx_next = 0
var $cm_back = "home"                   ; CONTACTS / SCANNER go back here
var $cm_cur = -1                        ; directory entry shown
; Scanner: steps through frequencies 0000-9999 on the listening beacon.
storage var $sc_f : number              ; next frequency to try
storage var $sc_dwell : number          ; seconds per frequency
var $sc_on = 0                          ; 0 stopped, 1 scanning, 2 paused
var $sc_k = 0                           ; step: 0 blank, 1 tuned
var $sc_t = 0
var $sc_from = 0                        ; where this pass started
array $sh_freq : text                   ; hits this session
array $sh_data : text
array $sh_dist : number
array $sh_t : number
var $sh_cur = -1
var $bfn_src = ""                       ; field being added

function @cm_load()
	if $cm_ver != 1
		$cm_name = ""
		$cm_freq = ""
		$cm_mode = 0
		$cm_tx = ""
		$cm_wx = ""
		$cm_relay = 1 + 2 + 4 + 8
		$bf_key.clear()
		$bf_src.clear()
		$bf_on.clear()
		$cd_freq.clear()
		$cd_name.clear()
		$cd_data.clear()
		$cd_t.clear()
		$cd_dist.clear()
		$cm_ver = 1
	if $sc_dwell <= 0
		$sc_dwell = 0.3
	@ts_load()

function @cm_flag($bit : number) : number
	return mod(floor($cm_relay / $bit), 2)

; Frequency from a name: lower case, letters/digits/dashes, max 32.
function @cm_freq_of($n : text) : text
	var $l = lower($n)
	var $out = ""
	var $len = min(size($l), 32)
	repeat $len ($i)
		var $c = substring($l, $i, 1)
		if find("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-", $c) >= 0
			$out = $out & $c
		elseif ($c == " ") or ($c == "_")
			$out = $out & "-"
	return $out

function @cm_mode_name($m : number) : text
	if $m == 1
		return "NAME ONLY"
	if $m == 2
		return "STRUCTURED DATA"
	return "OFF"

; Beacons on the network: choose the sending and the listening one.
function @cm_scan()
	if time < $cm_scan_next
		return
	$cm_scan_next = time + 3
	; v0.29.5: sender = the one picked in COMMS, else the beacon aliased
	; "beacon", else one with BASE in its alias, else the first one. Listener =
	; one with LISTEN / RX / RECEIVE in its alias, else any other beacon that
	; isn't another program's (secure / comsec / link / dock / pad / land).
	var $want = ""
	var $named = ""
	var $based = ""
	var $first = ""
	var $lrx = ""
	var $other = ""
	$cm_bcn_n = 0
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if contains($db_type.$j, "Beacon") and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			var $a = $db_alias.$j
			var $l = lower($a)
			$cm_bcn_n += 1
			if $a == $cm_tx
				$want = $a
			if ($l == "beacon") and ($named == "")
				$named = $a
			if (find($l, "base") >= 0) and ($based == "")
				$based = $a
			if $first == ""
				$first = $a
			if ((find($l, "listen") >= 0) or (find($l, "rx") >= 0) or (find($l, "receive") >= 0)) and ($lrx == "")
				$lrx = $a
	$cm_present = $cm_bcn_n > 0
	$cm_bcn = $want
	if $cm_bcn == ""
		$cm_bcn = $named
	if $cm_bcn == ""
		$cm_bcn = $based
	if $cm_bcn == ""
		$cm_bcn = $first
	repeat $n ($j2)
		if ($other == "") and contains($db_type.$j2, "Beacon") and ($db_alias.$j2 != "") and ($db_seen.$j2 >= $scan_gen - 1)
			var $a2 = $db_alias.$j2
			var $l2 = lower($a2)
			if ($a2 != $cm_bcn) and (find($l2, "secure") < 0) and (find($l2, "comsec") < 0) and (find($l2, "link") < 0) and (find($l2, "dock") < 0) and (find($l2, "pad") < 0) and (find($l2, "land") < 0)
				$other = $a2
	$cm_rx = $lrx
	if ($cm_rx == "") or ($cm_rx == $cm_bcn)
		$cm_rx = $other
	if $cm_rx == ""
		$cm_rx = $cm_bcn

; Value of a source spec (same specs as custom widgets) as text.
function @cm_src_text($s : text) : text
	var $k = @spec_part($s, 0)
	if $k == "bat"
		return text("{0}", @bat_pct(@spec_part($s, 1)))
	if $k == "batv"
		return text("{0.0}", @bat_volt(@spec_part($s, 1)))
	if $k == "solar"
		return text("{0}", $pw_solar)
	if $k == "usage"
		return text("{0}", $pw_usage)
	if $k == "flow"
		return text("{0}", $pw_flow)
	if ($k == "batt3") or ($k == "hist") or ($k == "eta")
		return text("{0}", $pw_pct)
	if $k == "dev"
		var $a = @spec_part($s, 1)
		var $cht = @spec_part($s, 2)
		var $ch = $cht:number
		var $tv = @in_t($a, $ch)
		if $tv != ""
			return @bk_clean($tv)
		return text("{}", @in_n($a, $ch))
	if ($k == "relay") or ($k == "out")
		var $ra = @spec_part($s, 1)
		return text("{}", @tgt_state($ra))
	if $k == "group"
		return text("{}", @tgt_state($s))
	if $k == "lights"
		var $lon = 0
		var $ln = $db_id.size
		repeat $ln ($q)
			if ($db_cat.$q == 1) and ($db_on.$q == 1)
				$lon = 1
		return text("{}", $lon)
	return ""

; v0.29.2: the time server rides in this base's ONE structured broadcast
; (no extra beacons): the Solar4488V2 fields, the time and the sunrise /
; sunset countdown. solarfrequency = this base's own frequency, so craft
; tune their time receiver here.
function @tsv_fields($p : text) : text
	if ($tsv_on == 2) or ($tsv_nav == "") or !$tsv_ok or ($cm_mode != 2) or ($cm_freq == "")
		return $p
	var $q = $p
	var $tp = $tsv_packet
	foreach $tp ($tk, $tv)
		$q.$tk = $tv
	$q.solarfrequency = $cm_freq
	$q.solarprotocol = "Solar4488V2"
	$q.time = $tsv_time
	$q.solarcycle = $tsv_out1
	return $q

; Read a mixed-case key (tempC, pressurehPa): a key written in the code
; (.tempC) is lower-cased, one in a variable keeps its case.
function @kv($p : text, $k : text) : text
	var $q = $p
	var $r = $q.$k
	if $r == ""
		var $lk = lower($k)
		$r = $q.$lk
	return $r

; The structured packet (chipos.node v1).
function @cm_packet() : text
	var $p = ""
	$p.schema = "chipos.node"
	$p.version = 1
	$p.name = @bk_clean($cm_name)
	$p.stamp = floor(time)
	if @cm_flag(1)
		if $cfg_arch >= 0
			$p.type = lower(@arch_name($cfg_arch))
	if @cm_flag(2)
		@att_find_nav()
		if $att_nav != ""
			$p.lat = text("{0.00000}", @in_n($att_nav, 8))
			$p.lon = text("{0.00000}", @in_n($att_nav, 9))
			$p.alt = text("{0}", @in_n($att_nav, 2))
	if @cm_flag(4)
		if $sun_ok > 0
			$p.sunrise = floor(@sun_next(0))
			$p.sunset = floor(@sun_next(1))
			$p.sunup = @sun_up()
	var $wsrc = ""
	var $wfull = 0
	; v0.29.4: the weather station ALWAYS rides in this one structured
	; broadcast (no own frequency, no extra beacon)
	if @ws_on() and $ws_ok and ($ws_pkt != "")
		$wsrc = $ws_pkt
		$p.weatherstation = 1
		if $cm_freq != ""
			; v0.29.2: one beacon - the whole chip.weather reading rides in this
			; packet and craft read the weather on this base's own frequency
			var $wp = $ws_pkt
			foreach $wp ($wk, $wv)
				if ($wk != "schema") and ($wk != "version") and ($wk != "name") and ($wk != "sequence") and ($wk != "stamp") and ($wk != "protocol")
					$p.$wk = $wv
			$p.weather = $cm_freq
			$p.weatherconfigured = 1
			$p.weathermaxage = 15
			$wfull = 1
	elseif (@cm_flag(8)) and ($cm_wx != "") and ($wx_pkt != "") and (time - $wx_t < 60)
		$wsrc = $wx_pkt
		$p.weatherfrequency = $cm_wx
		$p.weather = $cm_wx
		$p.weatherconfigured = 1
		$p.weathermaxage = 15
	if $wsrc != ""
		$p.weatherprotocol = "chip.weather"
	if ($wsrc != "") and !$wfull
		var $w = $wsrc
		if @kv($w, "tempC") != ""
			$p.wxtempC = @kv($w, "tempC")
		if $w.humidity != ""
			$p.wxhumidity = $w.humidity
		if @kv($w, "pressurehPa") != ""
			$p.wxpressurehPa = @kv($w, "pressurehPa")
		if $w.windspeedms != ""
			$p.wxwindms = $w.windspeedms
		if $w.winddirection != ""
			$p.wxwinddir = $w.winddirection
		if $w.condition != ""
			$p.wxcondition = $w.condition
		if $w.futurecondition != ""
			$p.wxforecast = $w.futurecondition
	$p = @tsv_fields($p)
	var $n = min($bf_key.size, $bf_src.size)
	repeat $n ($i)
		if ($i < $bf_on.size) and $bf_on.$i
			var $kk = $bf_key.$i
			$p.$kk = @cm_src_text($bf_src.$i)
	return $p

; Send: once a second, only when it changed.
function @cm_send()
	if (time < $cm_tx_next) or ($cm_bcn == "")
		return
	$cm_tx_next = time + 1
	var $f = $cm_freq
	var $data = ""
	if ($cm_mode == 0) or ($f == "")
		$f = ""
	elseif $cm_mode == 1
		$data = @bk_clean($cm_name)
	else
		$data = @cm_packet()
	; a different sending beacon, or every 10 s: write the frequency again
	if ($cm_bcn != $cm_sent_b) or (time >= $cm_sent_ft)
		$cm_sent_b = $cm_bcn
		$cm_sent_ft = time + 10
		$cm_sent_f = "!"
		$cm_sent = "-"
	if $f != $cm_sent_f
		@out_t($cm_bcn, 1, $f)
		$cm_sent_f = $f
		$cm_sent = "-"
	if $data != $cm_sent
		@out_t($cm_bcn, 0, $data)
		$cm_sent = $data

function @cm_next_job()
	$cm_job = -9
	$cm_job_f = ""
	if $ts_on and !$tsv_ok and (time >= $ts_next)
		$cm_job = -2
		$cm_job_f = $ts_freq
		if $ts_fail
			; primary was silent last time: try the fallback
			$cm_job = -3
			$cm_job_f = $ts_fb
	elseif ($cm_wx != "") and (time >= $wx_next)
		$cm_job = -1
		$cm_job_f = $cm_wx
	elseif $cd_freq.size > 0
		; contacts: the followed one every second, the rest every 15-30 min
		@cd_pick_focus()
		var $pick = -1
		if $cd_focus >= 0
			if $cd_next.$cd_focus <= time
				$pick = $cd_focus
		if $pick < 0
			var $n = $cd_freq.size
			var $old = 0
			repeat $n ($i)
				if ($cd_next.$i <= time) and (($pick < 0) or ($cd_next.$i < $old))
					$pick = $i
					$old = $cd_next.$i
		if $pick >= 0
			$cm_job = $pick
			$cm_job_f = $cd_freq.$pick
	if $cm_job_f != ""
		if $cm_job_f == $cm_tuned
			; already listening there: just read again
			$cm_job_t = time + 0.05
			$cm_job_k = 2
		else
			@out_t($cm_rx, 2, "")
			$cm_tuned = ""
			$cm_job_t = time + 0.1
			$cm_job_k = 1

; Listening: retune, wait, read, next.
function @sc_fmt($f : number) : text
	var $t = text("{}", floor($f))
	repeat 4 ($q)
		if size($t) < 4
			$t = "0" & $t
	return $t

; One scanner step: blank, tune, wait, read, next.
function @sc_step()
	if time < $sc_t
		return
	if $sc_k == 0
		@out_t($cm_rx, 2, "")
		$cm_tuned = ""
		$sc_k = 1
		$sc_t = time + 0.05
		return
	if $sc_k == 1
		@out_t($cm_rx, 2, @sc_fmt($sc_f))
		$sc_k = 2
		$sc_t = time + max($sc_dwell, 0.15)
		return
	var $own = ($cm_mode > 0) and ($cm_bcn_n > 0) and (@sc_fmt($sc_f) == $cm_sent_f)
	if (@in_n($cm_rx, 5) != 0) and !$own
		var $fs = @sc_fmt($sc_f)
		var $d = @in_t($cm_rx, 0)
		var $at = -1
		var $n = $sh_freq.size
		repeat $n ($i)
			if $sh_freq.$i == $fs
				$at = $i
		if $at < 0
			$sh_freq.append($fs)
			$sh_data.append($d)
			$sh_dist.append(@in_n($cm_rx, 1))
			$sh_t.append(time)
			@snd_beep(1320, 0.08)
		else
			$sh_data.$at = $d
			$sh_dist.$at = @in_n($cm_rx, 1)
			$sh_t.$at = time
		$ui_dirty = 1
	$sc_f = @posmod($sc_f + 1, 10000)
	$sc_k = 0
	if $sc_f == $sc_from
		; full pass (all 10000) done
		$sc_on = 0
		$ui_dirty = 1

function @cm_listen()
	if $cm_rx == ""
		return
	if $sc_on == 1
		@sc_step()
		return
	if $sc_on == 2
		return
	if $cm_job == -9
		if time >= $cm_job_t
			@cm_next_job()
			if $cm_job == -9
				$cm_job_t = time + 1
		return
	if time < $cm_job_t
		return
	if $cm_job_k == 1
		@out_t($cm_rx, 2, $cm_job_f)
		$cm_tuned = $cm_job_f
		$cm_job_t = time + 1.2
		$cm_job_k = 2
		return
	; read what was heard
	var $on = @in_n($cm_rx, 5) != 0
	var $d = ""
	if $on
		$d = @in_t($cm_rx, 0)
	var $j = $cm_job
	if $j == -2
		var $ok = 0
		if $on
			@att_find_nav()
			if $att_nav != ""
				$ok = @sun_from_packet($d, @in_n($att_nav, 8), @in_n($att_nav, 9))
		$ts_next = time + 60
		$ts_fail = 0
		if !$ok
			$ts_next = time + 2
			$ts_fail = 1
		$cm_job_k = 0
	elseif $j == -3
		if $on
			var $ok2 = @sun_from_text($d)
		$ts_fail = 0
		$ts_next = time + 60
		$cm_job_k = 0
	elseif $j == -1
		if $on and ($d != "")
			$wx_pkt = $d
			$wx_t = time
		$wx_next = time + 10
		if $cd_focus >= 0
			$wx_next = time + 60
		$cm_job_k = 0
	elseif $j < $cd_freq.size
		@cd_pad()
		if $on
			if time - $cd_t.$j > 20
				$cd_prev.$j = $cd_dist.$j
			if abs(@in_n($cm_rx, 1) - $cd_dist.$j) > 1
				$ui_dirty = 1
			$cd_dist.$j = @in_n($cm_rx, 1)
			$cd_dx.$j = @in_n($cm_rx, 2)
			$cd_dy.$j = @in_n($cm_rx, 3)
			$cd_dz.$j = @in_n($cm_rx, 4)
			$cd_t.$j = time
		$cd_next.$j = time + @cd_interval($j)
		if !$on
			$cd_next.$j = time + min(@cd_interval($j), 300)
		; redraw for what changed (the age line at most every 10 s)
		if ($cd_data.$j != $d) or ($cd_t.$j - $cd_shown > 10)
			$ui_dirty = 1
			$cd_shown = $cd_t.$j
		if $on and ($d != "")
			$cd_data.$j = $d
			var $nm = $d.name
			if $nm == ""
				if find($d, ".") != 0
					$nm = substring($d, 0, 32)
			if $nm != ""
				$cd_name.$j = $nm
		$cm_job_k = 0
	$cm_job = -9
	$cm_job_t = time

; Weather on its own frequency, on a spare beacon (not the sender / listener).
var $ws_sent = ""
var $ws_sent_t = 0
function @ws_send()
	$ws_spare_ok = 0
	; v0.29.4: weather never needs its own beacon now
	if 1
		return
	var $sp = ""
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if ($sp == "") and contains($db_type.$j, "Beacon") and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			if ($db_alias.$j != $cm_bcn) and ($db_alias.$j != $cm_rx) and !@tsv_is_bcn($db_alias.$j)
				$sp = $db_alias.$j
	if $sp == ""
		return
	$ws_spare_ok = 1
	if ($ws_pkt == $ws_sent) and (time < $ws_sent_t + 30)
		return
	if time < $ws_sent_t + 2
		return
	@out_t($sp, 1, $ws_freq)
	@out_t($sp, 2, "")
	@out_t($sp, 0, $ws_pkt)
	$ws_sent = $ws_pkt
	$ws_sent_t = time

function @cm_tick()
	@cm_scan()
	if $cm_bcn_n == 0
		return
	@ws_send()
	@cm_send()
	@cm_listen()

; ---- text helpers for the pages ----
function @cm_age($t : number) : text
	if $t <= 0
		return "NEVER"
	var $a = time - $t
	if $a < 60
		return text("{0}s AGO", $a)
	if $a < 3600
		return text("{0}m AGO", $a / 60)
	return text("{0}h AGO", $a / 3600)

function @cm_dist($m : number) : text
	if $m <= 0
		return ""
	if $cfg_units
		return text("{0.0} mi", $m / 1609.34)
	return text("{0.0} km", $m / 1000)

function @wx_line() : text
	if $cm_wx == ""
		return "WEATHER: NO STATION SET"
	if ($wx_pkt == "") or (time - $wx_t > 60)
		return "WEATHER (" & $cm_wx & "): NO SIGNAL"
	var $w = $wx_pkt
	var $t = @kv($w, "tempC") & "C"
	if $cfg_units
		$t = @kv($w, "tempF") & "F"
	return "WEATHER: " & $t & "  " & $w.humidity & "%  " & $w.condition

; ChipOS - SORTER app pages.
var $sx_sel = ""                        ; container being set up
function @sx_desc($a : text) : text
	var $i = @sx_find($a)
	if $i < 0
		return "NOT SORTED"
	var $s = ""
	var $its = $sx_it.$i
	var $ni = @split_count($its, "|")
	repeat $ni ($q)
		var $k = @split_part($its, "|", $q)
		if $k != ""
			if $s != ""
				$s = $s & ", "
			$s = $s & upper(@bx_name($k))
	var $b = 1
	repeat 9 ($q2)
		if @bit($sx_cat.$i, $b)
			if $s != ""
				$s = $s & ", "
			$s = $s & @sx_cat_name($b)

function @page_sx_box()

	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, upper($a) & text("  {0}% FULL", @sx_fill($a) * 100), $tw)

	$sl_spec.append("add")

function @page_sx_item()
