			if $ov != ""
				$ov = $ov & ", "
			$ov = $ov & $sx_box.$i
	if $ov == ""
		$ov = "NONE - TAP TO PICK"
	$sl_txt.append("OVERFLOW CONTAINER: " & $ov)
	$sl_spec.append("ovc")
	@cr_list($y, "EXTRA ORE / OVERFLOW", "", "sx_ov")

function @page_sx_tcv()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$sl_txt.append("NONE - THERE IS NO TRASH CAN")
	$sl_spec.append("-")
	var $n = $cv_a.size
	repeat $n ($c)
		var $t = $cv_a.$c
		if $t == $sx_tcv
			$t = "[ON] " & $t
		$sl_txt.append($t)
		$sl_spec.append($cv_a.$c)
	@pick_list("WHICH CONVEYOR FEEDS THE TRASH CAN?", "Trash cans only connect to the conveyor network, so ChipOS can't see them. Pick the conveyor that takes from the ore container and puts into the trash can.", "sx_tcvset")

function @page_sx_ovc()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $nb = $cb_a.size
	repeat $nb ($i)
		var $a = $cb_a.$i
		var $t = $a
		if @bit(@sx_cats_of($a), 64)
			$t = "[ON] " & $a
		$sl_txt.append($t)
		$sl_spec.append($a)
	@pick_list("OVERFLOW CONTAINER", "Extra ore (and items with no other place) go here. Tap to switch.", "sx_ovcset")

; CRAFT > CONTAINERS: the three roles.
function @page_cr_bufs()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	repeat 3 ($m)
		var $v = @cr_bget($m)
		if $v == ""
			$v = "NOT SET - TAP TO PICK"
		$sl_txt.append(@cr_bname($m) & ": " & $v)
		$sl_spec.append(text("{}", $m))
	@pick_list("CRAFT CONTAINERS", "CRAFTING BUFFER: crafters craft from it (CRAFT fills it). COMPLETION BUFFER: crafters put products in it; the sorter empties it into your containers. FULFILLMENT: finished orders are moved here - an order is done once its items arrive. The sorter never touches the crafting buffer or fulfillment.", "cr_bmode")

function @page_cr_buf()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$sl_txt.append("NONE")
	$sl_spec.append("")
	var $cur = @cr_bget($cr_bmode)
	var $nb = $cb_a.size
	repeat $nb ($i)
		var $a = $cb_a.$i
		var $t = $a
		if $a == $cur
			$t = "[ON] " & $a
		elseif @cr_role($a) != ""
			$t = $a & "   (NOW " & @cr_role($a) & ")"
		$sl_txt.append($t)
		$sl_spec.append($a)
	@pick_list(@cr_bname($cr_bmode), "Pick the container.", "cr_bufset")

function @sx_action($act : text, $val : number)
	if $act == "sx_run"
		$sx_off = !$sx_off
	elseif $act == "sx_learn"
		if $pr_on
			@ui_toast("ALREADY LEARNING")
		else
			@pr_begin()
	elseif $act == "sx_open"
		if ($val < $sl_spec.size) and ($sl_spec.$val != "")
			$sx_sel = $sl_spec.$val
			@go("sx_box")
	elseif $act == "sx_bx"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			var $sp = $sl_spec.$val
			if $sp == "add"
				@go("sx_item")
			elseif find($sp, "buf") == 0
				var $bm = substring($sp, 3, 1):number
				if @cr_bget($bm) == $sx_sel
					@cr_bset($bm, "")
				else
					@cr_bset($bm, $sx_sel)
			elseif find($sp, "rm:") == 0
				var $i = @sx_find($sx_sel)
				if $i >= 0
					$sx_it.$i = replace($sx_it.$i, "|" & substring($sp, 3, size($sp)) & "|", "|")
					if $sx_it.$i == "|"
						$sx_it.$i = ""
			elseif find($sp, "c") == 0
				var $b = substring($sp, 1, size($sp)):number
				var $i2 = @sx_slot($sx_sel)
				if @bit($sx_cat.$i2, $b)
					$sx_cat.$i2 = $sx_cat.$i2 - $b
				else
					$sx_cat.$i2 = $sx_cat.$i2 + $b
			$sx_fail = ""
	elseif $act == "sx_it"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			var $k = $sl_spec.$val
			; an item has one home: take it off any other container
			var $n = $sx_box.size
			repeat $n ($j)
				if @set_has($sx_it.$j, $k)
					$sx_it.$j = replace($sx_it.$j, "|" & $k & "|", "|")
					if $sx_it.$j == "|"
						$sx_it.$j = ""
			var $i3 = @sx_slot($sx_sel)
			$sx_it.$i3 = @set_add($sx_it.$i3, $k)
			$sx_fail = ""
			@ui_toast(upper(@bx_name($k)) & " GOES IN " & upper($sx_sel))
			@go("sx_box")
	elseif $act == "sx_ov"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			var $o = $sl_spec.$val
			if $o == "m1"
				$sx_ovm = 1
				if !@sx_tcv_set()
					@go("sx_tcv")
			elseif $o == "m2"
				$sx_ovm = 2
			elseif $o == "m3"
				$sx_ovm = 3
			elseif $o == "stk"
				var $s = $sx_stk
				if $s < 1
					$s = 2
				$s += 1
				if $s > 10
					$s = 1
				$sx_stk = $s
			elseif $o == "rare"
				$sx_rare = !$sx_rare
			elseif $o == "tcv"
				@go("sx_tcv")
			elseif $o == "ovc"
				@go("sx_ovc")
	elseif $act == "sx_tcvset"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			$sx_tcv = $sl_spec.$val
			if @sx_tcv_set()
				if ($sx_ovm == 0) or ($sx_ovm == 3)
					$sx_ovm = 1
			elseif $sx_ovm == 1
				$sx_ovm = 0
			@go("sx_over")
	elseif $act == "sx_ovcset"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			var $i4 = @sx_slot($sl_spec.$val)
			if @bit($sx_cat.$i4, 64)
				$sx_cat.$i4 = $sx_cat.$i4 - 64
			else
				$sx_cat.$i4 = $sx_cat.$i4 + 64
			if $sx_ovm == 0
				$sx_ovm = 2
	$ui_dirty = 1

xc_files.name: rules_ui.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - AUTOMATE app pages: the rule list, one rule, and the IF / THEN /
; ELSE builder (pick a device, a channel, a condition; a device, what to do).
var $rz_sel = -1                        ; rule shown on ar_rule
var $rzn_edit = -1                      ; rule being edited (-1 = new)
var $rzn_idev = ""
var $rzn_ich = 0
var $rzn_iop = 0
var $rzn_ival = 0
var $rzn_tdev = ""
var $rzn_tdo = 1
var $rzn_tch = 0
var $rzn_tval = 0
var $rzn_trgb = 0
var $rzn_ttxt = ""
var $rzn_else = 0
var $rzn_eval = 0
var $rzn_vmode = ""                     ; value page: ival, tval, eval

function @rz_type_of($a : text) : text
	var $k = @db_idx_alias($a)
	if $k < 0
		return ""
	return $db_type.$k

; What a position number means for this device.
function @rz_pos_hint($a : text, $v : number) : text
	var $t = @rz_type_of($a)
	if $t == "SmallPivot"
		return text("= {0} deg  (-1 .. 1 is -360 .. 360 deg)", $v * 360)
	if $t == "SmallHinge"
		return text("= {0} deg  (-1 .. 1 is -90 .. 90 deg)", $v * 90)
	if $t == "LinearTrack"
		return text("= {0.00} m along the track", $v)
	return ""

function @rz_is_servo($a : text) : number
	var $t = @rz_type_of($a)
	return ($t == "SmallPivot") or ($t == "SmallHinge") or ($t == "LinearTrack") or contains($t, "Pivot") or contains($t, "Hinge")

; ---- the app page: all rules ----
function @page_auto()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	@rz_pad()
	var $n = $rz_idev.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $on = "[ON]  "
		if !$rz_en.$i
			$on = "[OFF] "
		$sl_txt.append($on & @rz_desc($i))
		$sl_spec.append(text("{}", $i))
	var $sub = "IF a device reads something, THEN do something to a device. Tap a rule to change it."
	if $n == 0
		$sub = "No rules yet. Tap + NEW RULE: pick IF (a device, a channel, a condition), THEN (a device and what to do)."
	if $rz_last != ""
		$sub = "Last: " & $rz_last
	var $bw = $cw * 14
	@ui_btn($content_x + min($content_w, $cw * 70) - $bw, $content_y - $chh * 0.4, $bw, $chh * 2.2, "+ NEW RULE", "rz_new", 3)
	@pick_list("AUTOMATE", $sub, "rz_open")

function @page_rz_rule()
	if ($rz_sel < 0) or ($rz_sel >= $rz_idev.size)
		@go("auto")
		return
	var $i = $rz_sel
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	var $y = @set_header(text("RULE {}", $i + 1))
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, @rz_desc($i), $tw)
	var $a = $rz_idev.$i
	var $now = "DEVICE NOT FOUND"
	var $e = @rz_eval_cond($i)
	if $e >= 0
		$now = "NOW: " & $a & text(" CH{} = {0.000}", $rz_ich.$i, @in_n($a, $rz_ich.$i))
		if $e
			$now = $now & "  -  TRUE"
		else
			$now = $now & "  -  FALSE"
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, $now, $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.4
	if $rz_en.$i
		$y = @set_row($y, "TURN THIS RULE OFF", "it stays saved", "rz_toggle", $th_bad)
	else
		$y = @set_row($y, "TURN THIS RULE ON", "it is off now", "rz_toggle", $th_ok)
	$y = @set_row($y, "TEST: DO THE THEN PART NOW", @tgt_name($rz_tdev.$i), "rz_test", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "CHANGE THIS RULE", "pick everything again", "rz_edit", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "DELETE THIS RULE", "", "rz_del", $th_bad)

; ---- IF: device ----
function @page_rz_idev()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		var $a = $db_alias.$j
		if ($a != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1) and !contains($db_type.$j, "Router")
			$sl_txt.append($a & "   (" & $db_type.$j & ")")
			$sl_spec.append($a)
	@pick_list("IF - WHICH DEVICE?", "The device whose reading starts the rule (e.g. a rock buffer, a battery, a sensor).", "rz_idev")

; ---- IF: channel ----
function @page_rz_ich()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	repeat 8 ($c)
		var $tv = @in_t($rzn_idev, $c)
		var $lv = text("{0.000}", @in_n($rzn_idev, $c))
		if ($tv != "") and !isnumeric($tv)
			$lv = @ui_fit($tv, 24)
		$sl_txt.append(text("CHANNEL {}   (now ", $c) & $lv & ")")
		$sl_spec.append(text("{}", $c))
	@pick_list("IF " & $rzn_idev & " - WHICH READING?", "Live values are shown: pick the channel that changes the way you want to watch.", "rz_ich")

; ---- IF: condition ----
function @page_rz_iop()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$sl_txt.append("IS NOT EMPTY / NOT ZERO")
	$sl_spec.append("4")
	$sl_txt.append("IS EMPTY / ZERO")
	$sl_spec.append("5")
	$sl_txt.append("MORE THAN ...")
	$sl_spec.append("0")
	$sl_txt.append("LESS THAN ...")
	$sl_spec.append("1")
	$sl_txt.append("AT LEAST ...")
	$sl_spec.append("6")
	$sl_txt.append("AT MOST ...")
	$sl_spec.append("7")
	$sl_txt.append("EQUALS ...")
	$sl_spec.append("2")
	$sl_txt.append("IS NOT ...")
	$sl_spec.append("3")
	var $nv = text("{0.000}", @in_n($rzn_idev, $rzn_ich))
	@pick_list("IF " & $rzn_idev & text(" CH{} ...", $rzn_ich), "Now it reads " & $nv & ".", "rz_iop")

; ---- a number: steppers + keyboard ----
function @rz_val_get() : number
	if $rzn_vmode == "ival"
		return $rzn_ival
	if $rzn_vmode == "eval"
		return $rzn_eval
	return $rzn_tval

function @rz_val_set($v : number)
	var $r = round($v * 10000) / 10000
	if $rzn_vmode == "ival"
		$rzn_ival = $r
	elseif $rzn_vmode == "eval"
		$rzn_eval = $r
	else
		$rzn_tval = $r

function @page_rz_val()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	var $hd = "IF " & $rzn_idev & text(" CH{} ", $rzn_ich) & @rz_op_text($rzn_iop, $rzn_ival)
	var $hint = text("Now it reads {0.000}.", @in_n($rzn_idev, $rzn_ich))
	var $big = 0
	if $rzn_vmode == "tval"
		$hd = "THEN " & @tgt_name($rzn_tdev) & " " & @rz_do_text($rzn_tdo, $rzn_tch, $rzn_tval, $rzn_trgb, $rzn_ttxt)
		$hint = @rz_pos_hint($rzn_tdev, $rzn_tval)
	elseif $rzn_vmode == "eval"
		$hd = text("ELSE (WHEN IT STOPS BEING TRUE): SET TO {}", $rzn_eval)
		$hint = @rz_pos_hint($rzn_tdev, $rzn_eval)
	var $y = @set_header("PICK THE NUMBER")
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, $hd, $tw)
	if $hint != ""
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, $hint, $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.3
	var $v = @rz_val_get()
	var $fine = ($rzn_vmode != "ival") and @rz_is_servo($rzn_tdev)
	if $fine
		$y = @set_stepper($y, "BY 0.05", text("{0.000}", $v), "rz_v-a", "rz_v+a")
		$y = @set_stepper($y, "BY 0.01", text("{0.000}", $v), "rz_v-b", "rz_v+b")
	else
		$y = @set_stepper($y, "BY 1", text("{}", $v), "rz_v-a", "rz_v+a")
		$y = @set_stepper($y, "BY 0.1", text("{}", $v), "rz_v-b", "rz_v+b")
	$y = @set_row($y, "TYPE A NUMBER", "exact value from the keyboard", "rz_vkb", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_button($y, "NEXT", "rz_vnext", 3)

; ---- THEN: device ----
function @page_rz_tdev()
	@switchable_rows(1)
	; switchable_rows lists groups, lights and relays; add every other device
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		var $a = $db_alias.$j
		var $c = $db_cat.$j
		if ($a != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1) and ($c != 1) and ($c != 2) and !contains($db_type.$j, "Router")
			$sl_txt.append($a & "   (" & $db_type.$j & ")")
			$sl_spec.append($a)
	@pick_list("THEN - WHICH DEVICE?", "The device the rule drives: a light, a relay, a pivot, a hinge, a rail, a conveyor, anything.", "rz_tdev")

; ---- THEN: what to do (depends on the device) ----
function @page_rz_tdo()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $a = $rzn_tdev
	var $grp = find($a, "group:") == 0
	var $k = @db_idx_alias($a)
	var $cat = -1
	if $k >= 0
		$cat = $db_cat.$k
	if @rz_is_servo($a)
		$sl_txt.append("MOVE TO A POSITION   (" & @rz_type_of($a) & ")")
		$sl_spec.append("3")
	$sl_txt.append("TURN DEVICE ON")
	$sl_spec.append("1")
	$sl_txt.append("TURN DEVICE OFF")
	$sl_spec.append("2")
	if $grp or ($cat == 1)
		$sl_txt.append("LIGHT: SET COLOUR AND BRIGHTNESS")
		$sl_spec.append("5")
	if !$grp
		$sl_txt.append("SEND A NUMBER TO A CHANNEL")
		$sl_spec.append("4")
		$sl_txt.append("SEND TEXT TO A CHANNEL")
		$sl_spec.append("6")
	@pick_list("THEN " & @tgt_name($a) & " - DO WHAT?", "", "rz_tdo")

function @page_rz_tch()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	repeat 8 ($c)
		$sl_txt.append(text("CHANNEL {}", $c))
		$sl_spec.append(text("{}", $c))
	@pick_list("THEN " & $rzn_tdev & " - WHICH CHANNEL?", "The device's input channel (port) to write to.", "rz_tch")

; ---- THEN: light colour + brightness ----
function @page_rz_col()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	var $y = @set_header("THEN " & @tgt_name($rzn_tdev) & " - COLOUR")
	var $bh = $chh * 2.4
	var $gap = $cw * 0.5
	var $bw = ($tw - $gap * 3) / 4
	repeat 8 ($i)
		var $cx = $content_x + mod($i, 4) * ($bw + $gap)
		var $cy = $y + floor($i / 4) * ($bh + $gap)
		var $st = 0
		if @lt_palette($i) == $rzn_trgb
			$st = 1
		$ui_hv = $i
		@ui_btn($cx, $cy, $bw, $bh, @rz_pal_name($i), "rz_col", $st)
	$y += ($bh + $gap) * 2 + $chh * 0.4
	$y = @set_stepper($y, "BRIGHTNESS", text("{}%", $rzn_tval), "rz_br-", "rz_br+")
	$y = @set_button($y, "NEXT", "rz_cnext", 3)

; ---- ELSE ----
function @page_rz_else()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$sl_txt.append("DO NOTHING   (leave it as it is)")
	$sl_spec.append("0")
	var $do = $rzn_tdo
	if ($do == 1) or ($do == 5)
		$sl_txt.append("TURN IT OFF AGAIN")
		$sl_spec.append("1")
	elseif $do == 2
		$sl_txt.append("TURN IT ON AGAIN")
		$sl_spec.append("1")
	elseif ($do == 3) or ($do == 4)
		$sl_txt.append("SET IT TO ANOTHER NUMBER")
		$sl_spec.append("2")
	@pick_list("ELSE - WHEN IT STOPS BEING TRUE?", "", "rz_else")

; ---- save ----
function @page_rz_save()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	var $hd = "NEW RULE"
	if $rzn_edit >= 0
		$hd = text("CHANGE RULE {}", $rzn_edit + 1)
	var $y = @set_header($hd)
	var $d = "IF " & $rzn_idev & text(" CH{} ", $rzn_ich) & @rz_op_text($rzn_iop, $rzn_ival) & "  THEN " & @tgt_name($rzn_tdev) & " " & @rz_do_text($rzn_tdo, $rzn_tch, $rzn_tval, $rzn_trgb, $rzn_ttxt)
	if $rzn_else == 1
		if $rzn_tdo == 2
			$d = $d & "  ELSE ON"
		else
			$d = $d & "  ELSE OFF"
	elseif $rzn_else == 2
		$d = $d & text("  ELSE SET TO {}", $rzn_eval)
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, $d, $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.6
	var $hb = ($tw - $cw) / 2
	$y = @bz_fit($y, $chh * 2.6)
	@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $hb, $chh * 2.6, "CANCEL", "rz_cancel", 0)
	@ui_btn($content_x + $hb + $cw, $y, $hb, $chh * 2.6, "SAVE", "rz_save", 3)

function @rz_value_page($mode : text)
	$rzn_vmode = $mode
	@go("rz_val")

function @rz_save()
	var $i = $rzn_edit
	if ($i < 0) or ($i >= $rz_idev.size)
		if $rz_idev.size >= 32
			@ui_toast("32 RULES IS THE LIMIT")
			return
		$rz_idev.append($rzn_idev)
		$rz_ich.append($rzn_ich)
		$rz_iop.append($rzn_iop)
		$rz_ival.append($rzn_ival)
		$rz_tdev.append($rzn_tdev)
		$rz_tdo.append($rzn_tdo)
		$rz_tch.append($rzn_tch)
		$rz_tval.append($rzn_tval)
		$rz_trgb.append($rzn_trgb)
		$rz_ttxt.append($rzn_ttxt)
		$rz_else.append($rzn_else)
		$rz_eval.append($rzn_eval)
		$rz_en.append(1)
		@ui_toast("RULE SAVED")
	else
		$rz_idev.$i = $rzn_idev
		$rz_ich.$i = $rzn_ich
		$rz_iop.$i = $rzn_iop
		$rz_ival.$i = $rzn_ival
		$rz_tdev.$i = $rzn_tdev
		$rz_tdo.$i = $rzn_tdo
		$rz_tch.$i = $rzn_tch
		$rz_tval.$i = $rzn_tval
		$rz_trgb.$i = $rzn_trgb
		$rz_ttxt.$i = $rzn_ttxt
		$rz_else.$i = $rzn_else
		$rz_eval.$i = $rzn_eval
		@ui_toast("RULE CHANGED")
	$rz_st.clear()
	$rz_pend.clear()
	$rz_pt.clear()
	@rz_pad()

; ---- taps ----
function @rz_action($act : text, $val : number)
	if $act == "rz_new"
		$rzn_edit = -1
		$rzn_ich = 0
		$rzn_iop = 4
		$rzn_ival = 0
		$rzn_tch = 0
		$rzn_tval = 0
		$rzn_trgb = @lt_palette(0)
		$rzn_ttxt = ""
		$rzn_else = 0
		$rzn_eval = 0
		@go("rz_idev")
	elseif ($act == "rz_open") and ($val >= 0) and ($val < $rz_idev.size)
		$rz_sel = $val
		@go("rz_rule")
	elseif ($act == "rz_toggle") and ($rz_sel >= 0) and ($rz_sel < $rz_en.size)
		$rz_en.$rz_sel = !$rz_en.$rz_sel
		$rz_st.clear()
		@rz_pad()
	elseif ($act == "rz_test") and ($rz_sel >= 0) and ($rz_sel < $rz_idev.size)
		@rz_run($rz_sel, 1)
		@ui_toast("DONE: " & $rz_last)
	elseif ($act == "rz_del") and ($rz_sel >= 0) and ($rz_sel < $rz_idev.size)
		@rz_remove($rz_sel)
		$rz_sel = -1
		@ui_toast("RULE DELETED")
		@go("auto")
	elseif ($act == "rz_edit") and ($rz_sel >= 0) and ($rz_sel < $rz_idev.size)
		var $i = $rz_sel
		$rzn_edit = $i
		$rzn_idev = $rz_idev.$i
		$rzn_ich = $rz_ich.$i
		$rzn_iop = $rz_iop.$i
		$rzn_ival = $rz_ival.$i
		$rzn_tdev = $rz_tdev.$i
		$rzn_tdo = $rz_tdo.$i
		$rzn_tch = $rz_tch.$i
		$rzn_tval = $rz_tval.$i
		$rzn_trgb = $rz_trgb.$i
		$rzn_ttxt = $rz_ttxt.$i
		$rzn_else = $rz_else.$i
		$rzn_eval = $rz_eval.$i
		@go("rz_idev")
	elseif ($act == "rz_idev") and ($val >= 0) and ($val < $sl_spec.size)
		$rzn_idev = $sl_spec.$val
		@go("rz_ich")
	elseif ($act == "rz_ich") and ($val >= 0) and ($val < $sl_spec.size)
		$rzn_ich = $sl_spec.$val:number
		@go("rz_iop")
	elseif ($act == "rz_iop") and ($val >= 0) and ($val < $sl_spec.size)
		$rzn_iop = $sl_spec.$val:number
		if ($rzn_iop == 4) or ($rzn_iop == 5)
			@go("rz_tdev")
		else
			@rz_value_page("ival")
	elseif ($act == "rz_tdev") and ($val >= 0) and ($val < $sl_spec.size)
		$rzn_tdev = $sl_spec.$val
		@go("rz_tdo")
	elseif ($act == "rz_tdo") and ($val >= 0) and ($val < $sl_spec.size)
		$rzn_tdo = $sl_spec.$val:number
		if $rzn_tdo == 3
			if $rzn_edit < 0
				$rzn_tval = round(@in_n($rzn_tdev, 0) * 100) / 100
			@rz_value_page("tval")
		elseif ($rzn_tdo == 4) or ($rzn_tdo == 6)
			@go("rz_tch")
		elseif $rzn_tdo == 5
			if $rzn_tval <= 0
				$rzn_tval = 100
			@go("rz_col")
		else
			@go("rz_else")
	elseif ($act == "rz_tch") and ($val >= 0) and ($val < $sl_spec.size)
		$rzn_tch = $sl_spec.$val:number
		if $rzn_tdo == 6
			@kb_open(-2, "rz_txt", text("TEXT TO SEND TO {} CHANNEL {}", $rzn_tdev, $rzn_tch), $rzn_ttxt)
		else
			@rz_value_page("tval")
	elseif ($act == "rz_col") and ($val >= 0) and ($val < 8)
		$rzn_trgb = @lt_palette($val)
	elseif $act == "rz_br-"
		$rzn_tval = clamp($rzn_tval - 10, 10, 100)
	elseif $act == "rz_br+"
		$rzn_tval = clamp($rzn_tval + 10, 10, 100)
	elseif $act == "rz_cnext"
		@go("rz_else")
	elseif find($act, "rz_v") == 0
		var $fine = ($rzn_vmode != "ival") and @rz_is_servo($rzn_tdev)
		var $sa = 1
		var $sb = 0.1
		if $fine
			$sa = 0.05
			$sb = 0.01
		var $v = @rz_val_get()
		if $act == "rz_v-a"
			@rz_val_set($v - $sa)
		elseif $act == "rz_v+a"
			@rz_val_set($v + $sa)
		elseif $act == "rz_v-b"
			@rz_val_set($v - $sb)
		elseif $act == "rz_v+b"
			@rz_val_set($v + $sb)
		elseif $act == "rz_vkb"
			@kb_open(-2, "rz_num", "TYPE A NUMBER", text("{}", $v))
		elseif $act == "rz_vnext"
			if $rzn_vmode == "ival"
				@go("rz_tdev")
			elseif $rzn_vmode == "tval"
				@go("rz_else")
			else
				@go("rz_save")
	elseif ($act == "rz_else") and ($val >= 0) and ($val < $sl_spec.size)
		$rzn_else = $sl_spec.$val:number
		if $rzn_else == 2
			if $rzn_edit < 0
				$rzn_eval = 0
			@rz_value_page("eval")
		else
			@go("rz_save")
	elseif $act == "rz_cancel"
		@go("auto")
	elseif $act == "rz_save"
		@rz_save()
		@go("auto")
	$ui_dirty = 1

; Keyboard results.
function @rz_kb_done($id : text, $ok : number, $t0 : text)
	if !$ok
		return
	if $id == "rz_num"
		if isnumeric($t0)
			@rz_val_set($t0:number)
		else
			@ui_toast("THAT IS NOT A NUMBER")
	elseif $id == "rz_txt"
		$rzn_ttxt = replace(replace($t0, "{", "("), "}", ")")
		@go("rz_else")
	$ui_dirty = 1

xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - MINING: a mining drill, the container it fills and the ground
; anchor(s). MINE locks the anchor first (and checks it locked), then runs
; the drill. A build that is already anchored (or has no anchor block) is
; drilled straight away.
storage var $mn_ver : number
storage var $mn_cont : text              ; container the user confirmed ("" = not yet)
array $mn_d : text                       ; drills (aliases)
array $mn_an : text                      ; ground anchors
array $mn_ct : text                      ; containers
var $mn_unnamed = 0                      ; drills / anchors / containers without an alias
var $mn_scan_t = 0
var $mn_state = 0                        ; 0 idle, 1 locking the anchor, 2 drilling
var $mn_t0 = 0
var $mn_note = ""
var $mn_bad = 0                          ; the note is a problem
var $mn_depth0 = 0
var $mn_rock_t = 0                       ; rock rate
var $mn_rock_last = -1
var $mn_rate = 0
var $mn_back = "mining"

function @mn_load()
	if $mn_ver != 1
		$mn_cont = ""
		$mn_ver = 1

function @mn_scan()
	if time < $mn_scan_t
		return
	$mn_scan_t = time + 3
	$mn_d.clear()
	$mn_an.clear()
	$mn_ct.clear()
	$mn_unnamed = 0
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if $db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1
			var $t = $db_type.$j
			var $a = $db_alias.$j
			var $k = 0
			if $t == "MiningDrill"
				$k = 1
			elseif contains($t, "Anchor")
				$k = 2
			elseif contains($t, "Container")
				$k = 3
			if $k > 0
				if $a == ""
					$mn_unnamed += 1
				elseif $k == 1
					$mn_d.append($a)
				elseif $k == 2
					$mn_an.append($a)
				else
					$mn_ct.append($a)

; Drill + container (+ anchor, unless the build is already anchored: an
; anchored build stays anchored even after its anchor block is removed).
function @mn_present() : number
	return ($mn_d.size > 0) and ($mn_ct.size > 0)

function @mn_anchored() : number
	var $n = $mn_an.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if @in_n($mn_an.$i, 0) > 0
			return 1
	return 0

function @mn_anchor_out($v : number)
	var $n = $mn_an.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		@out_n($mn_an.$i, 0, $v)

function @mn_drill_out($v : number)
	var $n = $mn_d.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		@out_n($mn_d.$i, 0, $v)

function @mn_depth() : number
	if $mn_d.size == 0
		return 0
	return @in_n($mn_d.0, 1)

; rock (1 rock = 1 kg) in a container
function @mn_rocks($a : text) : number
	if $a == ""
		return 0
	var $c = @in_t($a, 0)
	var $r = 0
	if isnumeric($c.Rock)
		$r = $c.Rock:number
	var $k = "ARCHEAN_celestial.Rock"
	if isnumeric($c.$k)
		$r = max($r, $c.$k:number)
	return $r

function @mn_kg($kg : number) : text
	if $cfg_units
		var $lb = $kg * 2.204622622
		if $lb >= 2000
			return text("{0.0} tons", $lb / 2000)
		return text("{0} lb", $lb)
	if $kg >= 1000
		return text("{0.0} t", $kg / 1000)
	return text("{0} kg", $kg)

function @mn_say($t : text, $bad : number)
	$mn_note = $t
	$mn_bad = $bad
	$ui_dirty = 1

function @mn_start_drill()
	@mn_drill_out(1)
	$mn_state = 2
	$mn_t0 = time
	$mn_depth0 = @mn_depth()
	@mn_say("DRILLING", 0)

function @mn_mine()
	if $mn_d.size == 0
		return
	if ($mn_an.size > 0) and !@mn_anchored()
		@mn_anchor_out(1)
		$mn_state = 1
		$mn_t0 = time
		@mn_say("LOCKING THE GROUND ANCHOR...", 0)
		return
	@mn_start_drill()

function @mn_stop($why : text, $bad : number)
	@mn_drill_out(0)
	$mn_state = 0
	@mn_say($why, $bad)

function @mn_tick()
	@mn_scan()
	; rock rate (per minute) from the confirmed container
	if ($mn_cont != "") and (time >= $mn_rock_t)
		var $r = @mn_rocks($mn_cont)
		if ($mn_rock_last >= 0) and ($mn_rock_t > 0)
			$mn_rate = ($r - $mn_rock_last) * 6
		$mn_rock_last = $r
		$mn_rock_t = time + 10
	if $mn_state == 1
		if @mn_anchored()
			@mn_start_drill()
		elseif time > $mn_t0 + 8
			@mn_anchor_out(0)
			$mn_state = 0
			@mn_say("THE ANCHOR DID NOT LOCK. IT ONLY HOLDS ON TERRAIN (NOT ON ANOTHER BUILD).", 1)
	elseif $mn_state == 2
		if ($mn_an.size > 0) and !@mn_anchored()
			@mn_stop("ANCHOR RELEASED - DRILL STOPPED", 1)
		elseif ($mn_an.size == 0) and (time > $mn_t0 + 8) and (time < $mn_t0 + 9)
			; no anchor block: make sure the drill really goes down
			if (@mn_depth() <= $mn_depth0) and (@in_n($mn_d.0, 4) <= 0)
				@mn_stop("THE DRILL IS NOT GOING DOWN. IS THE BUILD ANCHORED? ADD A GROUND ANCHOR.", 1)

; ---------- page ----------
function @mn_el_name($s : text) : text
	if $s == "H"
		return "HYDROGEN"
	if $s == "He"
		return "HELIUM"
	if $s == "Li"
		return "LITHIUM"
	if $s == "C"
		return "CARBON"
	if $s == "N"
		return "NITROGEN"
	if $s == "O"
		return "OXYGEN"
	if $s == "Na"
		return "SODIUM"
	if $s == "Mg"
		return "MAGNESIUM"
	if $s == "Al"
		return "ALUMINIUM"
	if $s == "Si"
		return "SILICON"
	if $s == "P"
		return "PHOSPHORUS"
	if $s == "S"
		return "SULFUR"
	if $s == "Cl"
		return "CHLORINE"
	if $s == "K"
		return "POTASSIUM"
	if $s == "Ca"
		return "CALCIUM"
	if $s == "Ti"
		return "TITANIUM"
	if $s == "Cr"
		return "CHROMIUM"
	if $s == "Mn"
		return "MANGANESE"
	if $s == "Fe"
		return "IRON"
	if $s == "Co"
		return "COBALT"
	if $s == "Ni"
		return "NICKEL"
	if $s == "Cu"
		return "COPPER"
	if $s == "Zn"
		return "ZINC"
	if $s == "Ag"
		return "SILVER"
	if $s == "Sn"
		return "TIN"
	if $s == "W"
		return "TUNGSTEN"
	if $s == "Pt"
		return "PLATINUM"
	if $s == "Au"
		return "GOLD"
	if $s == "Pb"
		return "LEAD"
	if $s == "Th"
		return "THORIUM"
	if $s == "U"
		return "URANIUM"
	return upper($s)

array $mn_es : text
array $mn_ev : number
function @mn_comp()
	$mn_es.clear()
	$mn_ev.clear()
	if $mn_d.size == 0
		return
	var $c = @in_t($mn_d.0, 0)
	foreach $c ($k, $v)
		if isnumeric($v)
			var $f = 0
			$f = $v
			; largest first
			var $at = $mn_ev.size
			var $n = $mn_ev.size
			repeat $n ($i)
				if ($at == $n) and ($f > $mn_ev.$i)
					$at = $i
			$mn_es.insert($at, $k)
			$mn_ev.insert($at, $f)

function @page_mining()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 64)
	var $y = $content_y
	if !@mn_present()
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "MINING needs a mining drill and a container (and a ground anchor, unless the build is already anchored).", $tw)
		return
	var $dl = $mn_d.0
	if $mn_d.size > 1
		$dl = $dl & text(" (+{} MORE)", $mn_d.size - 1)
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, "DRILL " & $dl & text("   DEPTH {0.0} m   EFFICIENCY {0}%", @mn_depth(), @in_n($mn_d.0, 2) * 100), $tw)
	var $an = "ANCHOR: NONE (BUILD MUST ALREADY BE ANCHORED)"
	if $mn_an.size > 0
		$an = "ANCHOR: RELEASED"
		if @mn_anchored()
			$an = "ANCHOR: LOCKED"
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, $an, $tw)
	if $mn_note != ""
		var $nc = $th_ok
		if $mn_bad
			$nc = $th_bad
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $nc, $mn_note, $tw)
	var $bh = $chh * 2.4
	var $gap = $cw * 0.5
	var $bw = ($tw - $gap) / 2
	if $mn_state == 0
		@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $bw, $bh, "MINE", "mn_mine", 3)
	else
		@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $bw, $bh, "STOP", "mn_stop", 2)
	if ($mn_state == 0) and ($mn_an.size > 0) and @mn_anchored()
		@ui_btn($content_x + $bw + $gap, $y, $bw, $bh, "RELEASE ANCHOR", "mn_release", 0)
	$y += $bh + $chh * 0.4
	; the container: confirmed by the user
	var $ok = 0
	var $n = $mn_ct.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $mn_ct.$i == $mn_cont
			$ok = 1
	if !$ok
		var $cand = $mn_ct.0
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_warn, "IS '" & $cand & "' THE CONTAINER THE DRILL FILLS?", $tw)
		@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $bw, $bh, "YES", "mn_yes", 3)
		@ui_btn($content_x + $bw + $gap, $y, $bw, $bh, "PICK ANOTHER", "go:mn_pick", 0)
		$y += $bh + $chh * 0.4
	else
		var $rl = "ROCK IN '" & $mn_cont & "': " & @mn_kg(@mn_rocks($mn_cont))
		if $mn_rate > 0
			$rl = $rl & "  (+" & @mn_kg($mn_rate) & "/MIN)"
		$y = @set_row($y, $rl, "tap to pick another container", "go:mn_pick", $th_accent)
	; what is under the drill: scrolls (wheel / drag the bar on the right)
	@mn_comp()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $ne = $mn_es.size
	repeat $ne ($e)
		$sl_txt.append(text("{0.0}%  ", $mn_ev.$e * 100) & @mn_el_name($mn_es.$e) & " (" & $mn_es.$e & ")")
		$sl_spec.append("")
	if $ne == 0
		$sl_txt.append("NOTHING READ FROM THE DRILL")
		$sl_spec.append("")
	var $sv_y = $content_y
	var $sv_h = $content_h
	$content_y = $y
	$content_h = $sv_y + $sv_h - $y
	@pick_list("UNDER THE DRILL", "", "mn_none")
	$content_y = $sv_y
	$content_h = $sv_h

function @page_mn_pick()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $n = $mn_ct.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		$sl_txt.append($mn_ct.$i & "   ROCK " & @mn_kg(@mn_rocks($mn_ct.$i)))
		$sl_spec.append($mn_ct.$i)
	@pick_list("WHICH CONTAINER DOES THE DRILL FILL?", "Rock shows up in it while the drill runs.", "mn_pickc")

function @mn_action($act : text, $val : number)
	if $act == "mn_mine"
		@mn_mine()
	elseif $act == "mn_stop"
		@mn_stop("STOPPED", 0)
	elseif $act == "mn_release"
		@mn_anchor_out(0)
		@mn_say("ANCHOR RELEASED", 0)
	elseif $act == "mn_yes"
		if $mn_ct.size > 0
			$mn_cont = $mn_ct.0
			$mn_rock_last = -1
	elseif $act == "mn_pickc"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			if $sl_spec.$val != ""
				$mn_cont = $sl_spec.$val
				$mn_rock_last = -1
				@go("mining")
	$ui_dirty = 1

xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - FLUIDS and REFINERY.
; FLUIDS: tanks (Small/Fluid/Big Fluid Tank: level 0-1, contents, K; Volume:
; level, m3, state, composition, Pa, K), electrolysers (in 0 = power 0-1;
; out 0 W, 1 water kg/s, 2 H2 kg/s, 3 O2 kg/s) and sabatier reactors (on/off
; on 0 - not documented, ChipOS checks it). ChipOS learns which tank feeds
; and which fills by switching each machine on alone and watching the tanks.
; REFINERY: chemical furnaces (in 0 target K, 1 purge; out 0 K).
;  - furnaces and no centrifuges: oil refinery (oil shale fed by a conveyor;
;    660 K and 3 kg/s from the user's own refinery).
;  - with enrichment centrifuges (in 0 on): enrichment line, checked by
;    measuring what reaches the tanks.
; Both follow a battery rule: off at a low %, back on at a higher %.
storage var $fl_ver : number
storage array $fm_a : text              ; learned machines (alias)
storage array $fm_in : text             ; "|tank|" it takes from
storage array $fm_out : text            ; "|tank|" it fills
storage array $fm_what : text           ; what it makes (species)
storage var $fe_auto : number           ; run electrolysers / sabatiers automatically
storage var $fe_lo : number             ; start when an output tank is below (%)
storage var $fe_hi : number             ; stop when an output tank reaches (%)
storage var $fp_off : number            ; battery rule: off at (%)
storage var $fp_on : number             ; ... back on at (%)
storage var $rf_on : number             ; refinery wanted on
storage var $rf_target : number         ; furnace target K
storage var $rf_feed : text             ; conveyor feeding the furnaces
storage var $rf_rate : number           ; feed kg/s (adapts)
storage var $rf_tank : text             ; product tank
storage var $rf_cpow : number           ; centrifuge power (0-1)
storage var $rf_relay : text            ; v0.26: relay powering the furnaces ("" none)
storage var $fe_relay : text            ; v0.26: relay powering electrolysers / sabatiers
var $rf_relay_w = -1
storage var $rf_rad : number            ; v0.26.2: active radiators: 0 not asked, 1 run with the refinery, 2 leave alone
storage var $rf_rad_n : number          ; ... how many there were when asked
array $fr_a : text                      ; active radiators
storage var $rf_cool : text             ; v0.28.1: cooling the user picked: "|alias|..." (radiators, relays, junctions, pumps)

; Switch one cooling device: relays / lights through ChipOS, others channel 0.
function @rf_cool_out($a : text, $on : number)
	var $k = @db_idx_alias($a)
	if $k < 0
		return
	if ($db_cat.$k == 1) or ($db_cat.$k == 2)
		@tgt_set($a, $on)
	else
		@out_n($a, 0, $on)
var $rf_rad_w = -1
var $fe_relay_w = -1
var $fl_rp_for = ""                     ; relay picker: "rf" or "fe"
; runtime lists
array $ft_a : text                      ; tanks
array $ft_kind : number                 ; 1 tank, 2 volume
array $fe_a : text                      ; electrolysers
array $fs_a : text                      ; sabatier reactors
array $ff_a : text                      ; chemical furnaces
array $fc_a : text                      ; enrichment centrifuges
var $fl_scan_t = 0
var $fl_present = 0
var $rf_present = 0
var $rf_type = 0                        ; 1 oil, 2 enrichment
var $fp_hold = 0                        ; battery rule holding things off
; learning
var $fl_lrn = 0                         ; 0 idle, 1 running
var $fl_li = 0
var $fl_lk = 0
var $fl_lt = 0
array $fl_snap : text
array $fl_slev : number
var $fl_note = ""
; refinery runtime
var $rf_note = ""
var $rf_feeding = 0
var $rf_hot = 0
var $rf_hot_t = 0
var $rf_cold_t = 0
var $rf_tick_t = 0
var $rf_buf = ""                        ; container holding oil shale
var $rf_shale = 0
var $rf_tlev = -1
var $rf_lev0 = -1
var $rf_lev_t = 0
var $rf_alert = ""
var $rf_alert_t = 0
var $rf_said = ""
var $rf_said_t = 0
var $rf_test = 0                        ; enrichment test run: 0 off, 1 running, 2 done
var $rf_test_t = 0
var $rf_test_l0 = 0
var $rf_test_r0 = -1
var $rf_test_res = ""
array $fe_run : number                  ; producer on (by $fm index)

function @fl_load()
	if $fl_ver != 1
		$fm_a.clear()
		$fm_in.clear()
		$fm_out.clear()
		$fm_what.clear()
		$fe_auto = 0
		$fe_lo = 80
		$fe_hi = 98
		$fp_off = 30
		$fp_on = 35
		$rf_on = 0
		$rf_target = 660
		$rf_feed = ""
		$rf_rate = 3
		$rf_tank = ""
		$rf_cpow = 1
		$fl_ver = 1

function @fl_scan()
	if time < $fl_scan_t
		return
	$fl_scan_t = time + 3
	$ft_a.clear()
	$ft_kind.clear()
	$fe_a.clear()
	$fs_a.clear()
	$ff_a.clear()
	$fc_a.clear()
	$fr_a.clear()
	$rf_buf = ""
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			var $t = $db_type.$j
			var $a = $db_alias.$j
			if contains($t, "FluidTank")
				$ft_a.append($a)
				$ft_kind.append(1)
			elseif $t == "Volume"
				$ft_a.append($a)
				$ft_kind.append(2)
			elseif $t == "Electrolyser"
				$fe_a.append($a)
			elseif $t == "SabatierReactor"
				$fs_a.append($a)
			elseif $t == "ChemicalFurnace"
				$ff_a.append($a)
			elseif $t == "EnrichmentCentrifuge"
				$fc_a.append($a)
			elseif $t == "ActiveRadiator"
				$fr_a.append($a)
	; oil shale store: only looked for when there are furnaces
	if $ff_a.size > 0
		repeat $n ($j2)
			if ($rf_buf == "") and ($db_alias.$j2 != "") and ($db_seen.$j2 >= $scan_gen - 1)
				if ($db_type.$j2 == "Container") or ($db_type.$j2 == "SmallContainer")
					if find(@in_t($db_alias.$j2, 0), "OilShale") >= 0
						$rf_buf = $db_alias.$j2
	$fl_present = ($ft_a.size + $fe_a.size + $fs_a.size) > 0
	$rf_type = 0
	if $ff_a.size > 0
		$rf_type = 1
		if $fc_a.size > 0
			$rf_type = 2
	$rf_present = $rf_type > 0
	; more radiators than when the user said no: ask again
	if ($rf_rad == 2) and ($fr_a.size > $rf_rad_n)
		$rf_rad = 0

; ---- tanks ----
function @ft_level($i : number) : number
	return @in_n($ft_a.$i, 0)

function @ft_contents($i : number) : text
	if $ft_kind.$i == 2
		return @in_t($ft_a.$i, 3)
	return @in_t($ft_a.$i, 1)

function @ft_temp($i : number) : number
	if $ft_kind.$i == 2
		return @in_n($ft_a.$i, 5)
	return @in_n($ft_a.$i, 2)

function @ft_find($a : text) : number
	var $n = $ft_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $ft_a.$i == $a
			return $i
	return -1

; Main thing in a tank ("" empty).
function @ft_main($c : text) : text
	var $best = ""
	var $bv = 0
	foreach $c ($k, $v)
		if isnumeric($v)
			if $v:number > $bv
				$bv = $v:number
				$best = $k
	return $best

; Machine record index (adds one).
function @fm_idx($a : text) : number
	var $n = $fm_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $fm_a.$i == $a
			return $i
	$fm_a.append($a)
	$fm_in.append("")
	$fm_out.append("")
	$fm_what.append("")
	return $fm_a.size - 1

; ---- battery rule ----
function @fp_tick()
	if $pw_pct < 0
		$fp_hold = 0
		return
	if $pw_pct <= $fp_off
		$fp_hold = 1
	elseif $pw_pct >= $fp_on
		$fp_hold = 0

; ---- learning: each machine on alone, watch the tanks ----
function @fl_learn_start()
	$fl_lrn = 1
	$fl_li = 0
	$fl_lk = 0
	$fl_lt = time
	$fl_note = "LEARNING"
	$ui_dirty = 1

function @fl_all_off()
	var $ne = $fe_a.size
	repeat $ne ($i)
		@out_n($fe_a.$i, 0, 0)
	var $ns = $fs_a.size
	repeat $ns ($j)
		@out_n($fs_a.$j, 0, 0)

function @fl_snapshot()
	$fl_snap.clear()
	$fl_slev.clear()
	var $n = $ft_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		$fl_snap.append(@ft_contents($i))
		$fl_slev.append(@ft_level($i))

function @fl_learn_tick()
	var $ne = $fe_a.size
	var $tot = $ne + $fs_a.size
	if $fl_li >= $tot
		$fl_lrn = 0
		@fl_all_off()
		$fl_note = "LEARNED - SEE THE MACHINES BELOW"
		$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	var $a = ""
	if $fl_li < $ne
		$a = $fe_a.$fl_li
	else
		$a = $fs_a.($fl_li - $ne)
	if time < $fl_lt
		return
	if $fl_lk == 0
		@fl_all_off()
		$fl_lk = 1
		$fl_lt = time + 5
		$fl_note = text("LEARNING {} OF {}: ", $fl_li + 1, $tot) & $a
		$ui_dirty = 1
	elseif $fl_lk == 1
		@fl_snapshot()
		@out_n($a, 0, 1)
		$fl_lk = 2
		$fl_lt = time + 20
	else
		; compare: what went up is its output, what went down its input
		var $m = @fm_idx($a)
		$fm_in.$m = ""
		$fm_out.$m = ""
		$fm_what.$m = ""
		var $n = $ft_a.size
		repeat $n ($i)
			if $i < $fl_snap.size
				var $old = $fl_snap.$i
				var $new = @ft_contents($i)
				var $up = ""
				var $upv = 0
				var $down = 0
				foreach $new ($k, $v)
					var $d = $v:number - $old.$k:number
					if $d > $upv
						$upv = $d
						$up = $k
				foreach $old ($k2, $v2)
					if $new.$k2:number < $v2:number - 0.000001
						$down = 1
				var $dl = @ft_level($i) - $fl_slev.$i
				if ($up != "") or ($dl > 0.0005)
					if !$down or ($dl > 0)
						$fm_out.$m = $fm_out.$m & "|" & $ft_a.$i
						if $up != ""
							$fm_what.$m = $fm_what.$m & " " & upper($up)
				if ($down and ($up == "")) or ($dl < -0.0005)
					$fm_in.$m = $fm_in.$m & "|" & $ft_a.$i
		if $fm_out.$m != ""
			$fm_out.$m = $fm_out.$m & "|"
		if $fm_in.$m != ""
			$fm_in.$m = $fm_in.$m & "|"
		@out_n($a, 0, 0)
		$fl_li += 1
		$fl_lk = 0
		$fl_lt = time + 2

; ---- running electrolysers / sabatiers ----
function @fl_set_has($s : text, $a : text) : number
	return find($s, "|" & $a & "|") >= 0

; Should machine m run? Outputs below hi (and one below lo to start),
; inputs not empty, battery rule not holding.
function @fe_want($a : text, $was : number) : number
	if $fp_hold
		return 0
	var $m = -1
	var $n = $fm_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $fm_a.$i == $a
			$m = $i
	if $m < 0
		return 0
	if $fm_out.$m == ""
		return 0
	var $nt = $ft_a.size
	var $low = 0
	var $full = 0
	repeat $nt ($t)
		var $ta = $ft_a.$t
		var $lv = @ft_level($t) * 100
		if @fl_set_has($fm_out.$m, $ta)
			if $lv >= $fe_hi
				$full = 1
			if $lv < $fe_lo
				$low = 1
		if @fl_set_has($fm_in.$m, $ta)
			if $lv < 1
				return 0
	if $full
		return 0
	if $was
		return 1
	return $low

function @fe_tick()
	if !$fe_auto or $fl_lrn
		return
	var $ne = $fe_a.size
	var $tot = $ne + $fs_a.size
	while $fe_run.size < $tot
		$fe_run.append(0)
	repeat $tot ($i)
		var $a = ""
		if $i < $ne
			$a = $fe_a.$i
		else
			$a = $fs_a.($i - $ne)
		var $w = @fe_want($a, $fe_run.$i)
		if $w != $fe_run.$i
			$fe_run.$i = $w
			$ui_dirty = 1
		@out_n($a, 0, $w)

; ---- power relays: on only while the machines are wanted ----
function @fl_relay($a : text, $on : number, $was : number) : number
	if $a == ""
		return -1
	if $on != $was
		@tgt_set($a, $on)
	return $on

function @fe_relay_tick()
	if $fe_relay == ""
		$fe_relay_w = -1
		return
	; AUTO off: ChipOS does not run them, so it leaves the relay alone
	if !$fe_auto and !$fl_lrn
		$fe_relay_w = -1
		return
	var $any = $fl_lrn
	var $nr = $fe_run.size
	repeat $nr ($i)
		if $fe_run.$i
			$any = 1
	$fe_relay_w = @fl_relay($fe_relay, $any, $fe_relay_w)

; ---- refinery ----
function @rf_temps_min() : number
	var $n = $ff_a.size
	var $mn = 100000
	repeat $n ($i)
		$mn = min($mn, @in_n($ff_a.$i, 0))
	if $n == 0
		return 0
	return $mn

function @rf_set_furnaces($k : number)
	var $n = $ff_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		@out_n($ff_a.$i, 0, $k)
		@out_n($ff_a.$i, 1, 0)

function @rf_feed_set($on : number)
	$rf_feeding = $on
	if $rf_feed == ""
		return
	@out_t($rf_feed, 2, "ARCHEAN_celestial.OilShale")
	@out_n($rf_feed, 3, $rf_rate)
	@out_n($rf_feed, 1, 1000)
	@out_n($rf_feed, 0, $on)

; Product tank: chosen, else the tank that filled up while feeding.
function @rf_tank_level() : number
	var $i = @ft_find($rf_tank)
	if $i < 0
		return -1
	return @ft_level($i)

var $rf_tl_snap = ""
var $rf_tl_t = 0
function @rf_find_tank()
	if time < $rf_tl_t
		return
	$rf_tl_t = time + 30
	var $n = $ft_a.size
	var $s = ""
	var $best = ""
	var $bd = 0.002
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $lv = @ft_level($i)
		var $k = $ft_a.$i
		if $rf_tl_snap != ""
			var $d = $lv - $rf_tl_snap.$k:number
			if $d > $bd
				$bd = $d
				$best = $k
		$s.$k = $lv
	$rf_tl_snap = $s
	if $best != ""
		$rf_tank = $best

function @rf_oil($tmin : number, $was_hot : number)
	if $rf_feed == ""
		$rf_note = "PICK THE CONVEYOR THAT FEEDS THE FURNACES"
		return
	if ($rf_tlev >= 0.98)
		@rf_feed_set(0)
		$rf_note = "PRODUCT TANK FULL - FEED STOPPED"
		return
	if $rf_shale <= 0
		@rf_feed_set(0)
		$rf_note = "WAITING FOR OIL SHALE"
		if $rf_buf == ""
			$rf_note = "NO CONTAINER WITH OIL SHALE FOUND"
		return
	if !$rf_hot
		if $rf_feeding and ($tmin < $rf_target - 40)
			; temperature fell while feeding: too much shale for the heat
			$rf_rate = max(0.2, $rf_rate * 0.75)
			$rf_alert = text("TEMPERATURE DROPPED WHILE FEEDING - FEED SLOWED TO {0.0} kg/s", $rf_rate)
			$rf_alert_t = time
		@rf_feed_set(0)
		$rf_note = text("HEATING ({0} / {0} K)", $tmin, $rf_target)
		return
	@rf_feed_set(1)
	$rf_note = text("REFINING - FEED {0.0} kg/s, FURNACES {0} K", $rf_rate, $tmin)
	; steady and hot for 2 minutes: try a little faster (up to 3 kg/s)
	if ($rf_hot_t > 0) and (time - $rf_hot_t > 120) and ($rf_rate < 3)
		$rf_rate = min(3, $rf_rate * 1.1)
		$rf_hot_t = time
	; learn the product tank: the one that fills while refining
	if $rf_tank == ""
		@rf_find_tank()

; Share of the lighter isotope in the product tank (-1 unknown): from
; contents keys that carry 235 / 238.
function @rf_ratio() : number
	var $i = @ft_find($rf_tank)
	if $i < 0
		return -1
	var $c = @ft_contents($i)
	var $l = 0
	var $h = 0
	foreach $c ($k, $v)
		if find($k, "235") >= 0
			$l += $v:number
		elseif find($k, "238") >= 0
			$h += $v:number
	if $l + $h <= 0
		return -1
	return $l / ($l + $h)

; Enrichment line: furnaces hot, then the centrifuges on; ChipOS measures
; what reaches the tanks (it can't know the game's exact cascade needs).
function @rf_enrich($tmin : number)
	var $nc = $fc_a.size
	var $run = $rf_hot
	repeat $nc ($c)
		@out_n($fc_a.$c, 0, $run * $rf_cpow)
	if !$run
		$rf_note = text("HEATING ({0} / {0} K) - CENTRIFUGES WAIT", $tmin, $rf_target)
	else
		$rf_note = text("RUNNING: {} FURNACES, {} CENTRIFUGES", $ff_a.size, $nc)
	if $rf_test == 1
		var $lv = @rf_tank_level()
		if time - $rf_test_t > 300
			$rf_test = 2
			var $dl = $lv - $rf_test_l0
			var $ri = @rf_ratio()
			$rf_test_res = text("5 MIN TEST: PRODUCT TANK {0.0}% ", $dl * 100)
			if $dl <= 0.0001
				$rf_test_res = $rf_test_res & "- NOTHING ARRIVED. CHECK PIPES, CENTRIFUGE POWER AND FURNACE INPUT."
				@notify("REFINERY TEST: NOTHING ARRIVED IN THE PRODUCT TANK")
			elseif ($rf_test_r0 >= 0) and ($ri >= 0) and ($ri <= $rf_test_r0)
				$rf_test_res = $rf_test_res & text("- FLOWING, BUT NOT RICHER ({0.000} -> {0.000}). ADD CENTRIFUGE STAGES?", $rf_test_r0, $ri)
				@notify("REFINERY TEST: PRODUCT IS NOT GETTING RICHER")
			else
				$rf_test_res = $rf_test_res & "- PRODUCT ARRIVING"
				if $ri >= 0
					$rf_test_res = $rf_test_res & text(", LIGHT FRACTION {0.000}", $ri)
			$ui_dirty = 1

function @rf_tick()
	if time < $rf_tick_t
		return
	$rf_tick_t = time + 1
	if !$rf_present
		return
	$rf_shale = 0
	if $rf_buf != ""
		var $inv = @in_t($rf_buf, 0)
		var $key = "ARCHEAN_celestial.OilShale"
		$rf_shale = $inv.$key:number
	$rf_tlev = @rf_tank_level()
	var $tmin = @rf_temps_min()
	var $old_alert = $rf_alert
	; an alert stays up for a minute after its cause last showed
	if time > $rf_alert_t + 60
		$rf_alert = ""
	$rf_relay_w = @fl_relay($rf_relay, $rf_on and !$fp_hold, $rf_relay_w)
	; active radiators cool the furnaces: on while refining (if the user said so)
	if $rf_cool != ""
		var $cw2 = $rf_on and !$fp_hold
		if $cw2 != $rf_rad_w
			var $cn = @split_count($rf_cool, "|")
			repeat $cn ($ci)
				var $ca = @split_part($rf_cool, "|", $ci)
				if $ca != ""
					@rf_cool_out($ca, $cw2)
			$rf_rad_w = $cw2
	elseif ($rf_rad == 1) and ($fr_a.size > 0)
		var $rw = $rf_on and !$fp_hold
		if $rw != $rf_rad_w
			var $nrd = $fr_a.size
			repeat $nrd ($ri)
				@out_n($fr_a.$ri, 0, $rw)
			$rf_rad_w = $rw
	else
		$rf_rad_w = -1
	if !$rf_on
		@rf_set_furnaces(0)
		if $rf_type == 1
			@rf_feed_set(0)
		else
			var $nc = $fc_a.size
			repeat $nc ($c)
				@out_n($fc_a.$c, 0, 0)
		$rf_note = "OFF"
		$rf_hot_t = 0
		$rf_cold_t = 0
		return
	if $fp_hold
		@rf_set_furnaces(0)
		@rf_feed_set(0)
		var $nc2 = $fc_a.size
		repeat $nc2 ($c2)
			@out_n($fc_a.$c2, 0, 0)
		$rf_note = text("PAUSED - BATTERY UNDER {0}% (BACK ON AT {0}%)", $fp_off, $fp_on)
		if $old_alert != $rf_alert
			$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	@rf_set_furnaces($rf_target)
	var $was_hot = $rf_hot
	$rf_hot = $tmin >= $rf_target - 15
	if $rf_hot
		$rf_cold_t = 0
		if $rf_hot_t == 0
			$rf_hot_t = time
	else
		$rf_hot_t = 0
		if $rf_cold_t == 0
			$rf_cold_t = time
		if time - $rf_cold_t > 180
			$rf_alert = "FURNACES NOT REACHING TEMPERATURE - CHECK POWER / BREAKER"
			$rf_alert_t = time
	if $rf_type == 1
		@rf_oil($tmin, $was_hot)
	else
		@rf_enrich($tmin)
	if $old_alert != $rf_alert
		$ui_dirty = 1
		if ($rf_alert != "") and (($rf_alert != $rf_said) or (time > $rf_said_t + 600))
			@notify("REFINERY: " & $rf_alert)
			$rf_said = $rf_alert
			$rf_said_t = time

function @rf_test_start()
	$rf_test = 1
	$rf_test_t = time
	$rf_test_l0 = max(0, @rf_tank_level())
	$rf_test_r0 = @rf_ratio()
	$rf_test_res = "TEST RUNNING (5 MIN)"
	$rf_on = 1

function @fl_tick()
	@fl_scan()
	if !$fl_present and !$rf_present
		return
	@fp_tick()
	if $fl_lrn
		@fl_learn_tick()
	else
		@fe_tick()
	@fe_relay_tick()
	@rf_tick()

; ChipOS - DRIVE app pages: live display, setup (front, tests), keys, options.
var $dv_ts = 0                          ; test stage
var $dv_ls = -1                         ; learning step (-1 = not learning)
array $dv_lbase : number
var $dv_lwait = 0                       ; waiting for the key to be released
var $dv_lch = 0
var $dv_kcur = 0                        ; AUX key being set
var $dv_ui_next = 0

function @dv_on_page() : number
	return ($ui_page == "drive") or (find($ui_page, "dv_") == 0)

function @dv_lbase_take()
	$dv_lbase.clear()
	repeat 18 ($c)
		var $bv = 0
		if ($c > 0) and ($dv_seat_now != "")
			$bv = @in_n($dv_seat_now, $c)
		$dv_lbase.append($bv)

function @dv_learn_start($i : number)
	$dv_ls = $i
	$dv_lwait = 0
	@dv_lbase_take()

; Every tick: key learning, test stage changes, live redraws.
function @dv_ui_tick()
	if $dv_ls >= 0
		if ($ui_page != "dv_learn") or ($dv_seat_now == "")
			if $ui_page != "dv_learn"
				$dv_ls = -1
		elseif $dv_lwait
			var $rv = @in_n($dv_seat_now, $dv_lch) - $dv_lbase.$dv_lch
			if abs($rv) < 0.3
				$dv_lwait = 0
				var $nx = $dv_ls + 1
				if $nx > 4
					$dv_ls = -1
					@go("drive")
				else
					@dv_learn_start($nx)
				$ui_dirty = 1
		else
			repeat 17 ($c0)
				var $c = $c0 + 1
				if !$dv_lwait
					var $d = @in_n($dv_seat_now, $c) - $dv_lbase.$c
					if abs($d) > 0.5
						$dc_ch.$dv_ls = $c
						$dc_sign.$dv_ls = 1
						if $d < 0
							$dc_sign.$dv_ls = -1
						$dv_lch = $c
						$dv_lwait = 1
						@snd_beep(988, 0.1)
						$ui_dirty = 1
	if ($dv_ts == 1) or ($dv_ts == 4)
		if $dv_tmode == 0
			$dv_ts += 1
			$ui_dirty = 1
	if @dv_on_page() and (time >= $dv_ui_next)
		$dv_ui_next = time + 0.2
		$ui_dirty = 1

function @dv_seat_label() : text
	if $dv_seat_now == ""
		return "NO SEAT FOUND"
	return $dv_seat_now

; ---- main page ----
function @page_drive()
	var $bh = $chh * 2.4
	var $ph = $content_h - $bh - $chh * 0.6
	@dv_panel($content_x, $content_y, $content_w, $ph)
	var $y = $content_y + $ph + $chh * 0.6
	if !$dv_done
		@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $content_w, $bh, "SET UP DRIVING", "dv_setup", 1)
		return
	var $gap = $cw * 0.5
	var $bw = ($content_w - $gap * 3) / 4
	var $ol = "CTRL OFF"
	var $os = 2
	if $dv_on
		$ol = "CTRL ON"
		$os = 3
	@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $bw, $bh, $ol, "dv_on", $os)
	@ui_btn($content_x + ($bw + $gap), $y, $bw, $bh, "WHEELS", "dv_setup", 0)
	@ui_btn($content_x + ($bw + $gap) * 2, $y, $bw, $bh, "KEYS", "dv_keys", 0)
	@ui_btn($content_x + ($bw + $gap) * 3, $y, $bw, $bh, "OPTIONS", "dv_opts", 0)

; ---- setup 1: which way is the front ----
function @page_dv_map()
	var $y = @set_header("DRIVE SETUP 1/3 - WHERE IS THE FRONT?")
	var $msg = "Tap the arrow that points to the FRONT. Tap a wheel to wiggle it so you can find it."
	if $dv_unnamed > 0
		$msg = text("{} wheel(s) have no name and will not drive - name them in DEVICES. ", $dv_unnamed) & $msg
	if !$dv_haspos
		$msg = "Wheel positions are not available; front/back can't be told apart. " & $msg
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, $msg, $content_w)
	var $bh = $chh * 2.4
	var $ab = $chh * 2.2
	var $mx = $content_x + $ab + $cw
	var $my = $y + $ab + $chh * 0.3
	var $mw = $content_w - ($ab + $cw) * 2
	var $mh = $content_y + $content_h - $bh - $chh * 0.8 - $ab - $my
	; tiny screens: keep the map usable; the page scrolls instead
	$mh = max($mh, $chh * 8)
	@dv_map($mx, $my, $mw, $mh, 1, 1)
	; arrows: up, right, down, left
	repeat 4 ($q)
		var $st = 0
		if $q == $dv_front
			$st = 1
		var $lb = "^ FRONT"
		var $bx = $mx + $mw / 2 - $cw * 6
		var $by = $my - $ab - $chh * 0.2
		var $bw = $cw * 12
		var $bhh = $ab
		if $q == 1
			$lb = ">"
			$bx = $mx + $mw + $cw * 0.5
			$by = $my + $mh / 2 - $chh * 3
			$bw = $ab
			$bhh = $chh * 6
		elseif $q == 2
			$lb = "v FRONT"
			$by = $my + $mh + $chh * 0.2
		elseif $q == 3
			$lb = "<"
			$bx = $mx - $ab - $cw * 0.5
			$by = $my + $mh / 2 - $chh * 3
			$bw = $ab
			$bhh = $chh * 6
		$ui_hv = $q
		@ui_btn($bx, $by, $bw, $bhh, $lb, "dv_front", $st)
	var $ny = max($content_y + $content_h - $bh, $my + $mh + $ab + $chh * 0.6)
	var $hw = ($content_w - $cw) / 2
	@att_find_nav()
	if ($att_nav != "") and ($dv_nw > 0)
		var $hw3 = ($content_w - $cw * 2) / 3
		@ui_btn($content_x, $ny, $hw3, $bh, "CANCEL", "dv_cancel", 0)
		@ui_btn($content_x + $hw3 + $cw, $ny, $hw3, $bh, "AUTO (NAV)", "dv_auto", 1)
		var $ns3 = 3
		@ui_btn($content_x + ($hw3 + $cw) * 2, $ny, $hw3, $bh, "NEXT", "dv_next", $ns3)
		return
	@ui_btn($content_x, $ny, $hw, $bh, "CANCEL", "dv_cancel", 0)
	var $ns = 3
	if $dv_nw == 0
		$ns = 4
	@ui_btn($content_x + $hw + $cw, $ny, $hw, $bh, "NEXT", "dv_next", $ns)

; ---- automatic setup with a Nav Instrument ----
function @page_dv_auto()
	var $y = @set_header("DRIVE SETUP - AUTOMATIC (NAV)")
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	var $mid = $content_x + $tw / 2
	var $bh = $chh * 2.6
	if $wa_on == 0
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "ChipOS spins one wheel at a time and watches the Nav Instrument: which way the vehicle moves tells the wheel's direction, which way it turns tells its side.", $tw)
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_warn, "The NAV / MINI NAV must point the way the driver's seat faces - the way you expect to go when you accelerate. Make sure there's room to roll a little.", $tw)
		$y += $chh * 0.4
		$y = @bz_fit($y, $bh)
		@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $tw, $bh, "START", "dv_astart", 1)
	elseif $wa_on == 1
		$y = @ui_para_c($mid, $y, $th_text, "TESTING... " & $wa_note, $tw)
	else
		$y = @ui_para_c($mid, $y, $th_accent, $wa_note, $tw)
		var $wn = $dw_alias.size
		repeat $wn ($k)
			if $dw_ok.$k and ($k < $wa_fwd.size)
				var $sd = "?"
				var $sg = 1
				if $wa_fwd.$k < 0
					$sg = -1
				if $wa_yaw.$k * $sg > 0.3
					$sd = "LEFT"
				elseif $wa_yaw.$k * $sg < -0.3
					$sd = "RIGHT"
				$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, $dw_alias.$k & text(":  {0.00} m/s  turn {0.0} deg  ", $wa_fwd.$k, $wa_yaw.$k) & $sd, $tw)
		$y += $chh * 0.4
		$y = @bz_fit($y, $bh)
		@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $tw, $bh, "NEXT: STEERING TEST", "dv_anext", 3)
		$y += $bh + $chh * 0.4
		@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $tw, $bh, "RUN AGAIN", "dv_astart", 0)
	var $ny = $content_y + $content_h - $chh * 2.4
	if $ny > $y + $bh
		@ui_btn($content_x, $ny, $cw * 12, $chh * 2.4, "CANCEL", "dv_acancel", 0)

; ---- setup 2 + 3: drive and steering tests ----
function @page_dv_test()
	var $hd = "DRIVE SETUP 2/3 - DRIVE TEST"
	if $dv_ts >= 3
		$hd = "DRIVE SETUP 3/3 - STEERING TEST"
	var $y = @set_header($hd)
	var $mid = $content_x + min($content_w, $cw * 60) / 2
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	var $bh = $chh * 2.6
	var $msg = ""
	if $dv_ts == 0
		$msg = "Make sure the area is clear. The wheels will drive gently FORWARD for 2 seconds."
	elseif ($dv_ts == 1) or ($dv_ts == 4)
		$msg = "TESTING..."
	elseif $dv_ts == 2
		$msg = "WHICH WAY DID IT GO?"
	elseif $dv_ts == 3
		$msg = "The front wheels will turn RIGHT for 2 seconds."
		if $dv_mode == 3
			$msg = "The vehicle will turn RIGHT on the spot for 2 seconds."
	elseif $dv_ts == 5
		$msg = "DID IT TURN RIGHT?"
	$y = @ui_para_c($mid, $y, $th_text, $msg, $tw)
	if ($dv_ts == 2) and ($att_nav != "")
		var $nt = "NAV: MOVED FORWARD"
		if $dv_tnav < -0.2
			$nt = "NAV: MOVED BACKWARD"
		elseif $dv_tnav < 0.2
			$nt = "NAV: HARDLY MOVED"
		$y = @ui_para_c($mid, $y, $th_dim, $nt, $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.5
	if ($dv_ts == 0) or ($dv_ts == 3)
		$y = @bz_fit($y, $bh)
		@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $tw, $bh, "START", "dv_tstart", 1)
	elseif $dv_ts == 2
		repeat 4 ($q)
			var $lb = "FORWARD"
			var $st = 3
			if $q == 1
				$lb = "BACKWARD"
				$st = 0
			elseif $q == 2
				$lb = "IT SPUN AROUND"
				$st = 0
			elseif $q == 3
				$lb = "IT DID NOT MOVE"
				$st = 0
			$y = @bz_fit($y, $bh)
			$ui_hv = $q
			@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $tw, $bh, $lb, "dv_ans", $st)
			$y += $bh + $chh * 0.4
	elseif $dv_ts == 5
		repeat 3 ($q2)
			var $lb2 = "YES"
			var $st2 = 3
			if $q2 == 1
				$lb2 = "NO - IT WENT LEFT"
				$st2 = 0
			elseif $q2 == 2
				$lb2 = "THE WHEELS DON'T STEER (USE SKID STEER)"
				$st2 = 0
				if $dv_mode == 3
					$lb2 = "IT DID NOT TURN (USE STEERING WHEELS)"
			$y = @bz_fit($y, $bh)
			$ui_hv = 10 + $q2
			@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $tw, $bh, $lb2, "dv_ans", $st2)
			$y += $bh + $chh * 0.4
	var $ny = $content_y + $content_h - $chh * 2.4
	if $ny > $y
		@ui_btn($content_x, $ny, $cw * 12, $chh * 2.4, "CANCEL", "dv_cancel", 0)

; ---- keys: learn the driving keys + AUX actions ----
function @page_dv_learn()
	var $y = @set_header("DRIVING KEYS")
	var $mid = $content_x + min($content_w, $cw * 60) / 2
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	if $dv_seat_now == ""
		$y = @ui_para_c($mid, $y, $th_warn, "No seat found. Give the pilot seat an alias.", $tw)
		return
	$y = @ui_para_c($mid, $y, $th_dim, "Sit in " & $dv_seat_now & " and press each key when asked.", $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.5
	var $ask = "PRESS THROTTLE / FORWARD (e.g. W)"
	if $dv_ls == 1
		$ask = "PRESS STEER RIGHT (e.g. D)"
	elseif $dv_ls == 2
		$ask = "PRESS THE BRAKE KEY"
	elseif $dv_ls == 3
		$ask = "PRESS THE HANDBRAKE KEY (e.g. SPACE)"
	elseif $dv_ls == 4
		$ask = "PRESS THE CRUISE CONTROL KEY"
	if $dv_lwait
		$ask = "GOT IT: " & @dv_ch_name($dv_lch) & " - LET GO"
	$y = @ui_para_c($mid, $y, $th_accent, $ask, $tw)
	var $cur = "NOW: " & @dv_ch_name($dc_ch.$dv_ls)
	$y = @ui_para_c($mid, $y, $th_dim, $cur, $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.5
	var $bh = $chh * 2.4
	var $hw = ($tw - $cw) / 2
	$y = @bz_fit($y, $bh)
	@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $hw, $bh, "KEEP AS IS", "dv_lkeep", 0)
	var $sl = "NONE"
	if $dv_ls <= 1
		$sl = "DONE"
	@ui_btn($content_x + $hw + $cw, $y, $hw, $bh, $sl, "dv_lnone", 0)
	if $dv_ls <= 1
		$ui_hv = -1

function @dv_kact_name($a : number, $r : text) : text
	if $a == 1
		return "SWITCH " & @tgt_name($r)
	if $a == 2
		return "HORN (HOLD)"
	if $a == 3
		return "REGEN ON/OFF"
	if $a == 4
		return "HANDBRAKE ON/OFF"
	if $a == 5
		return "CRUISE ON/OFF"
	return "-"

function @page_dv_keys()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$sl_txt.append("LEARN DRIVING KEYS (THROTTLE, STEERING...)")
	repeat 10 ($k)
		var $an = "AUX 0"
		if $k < 9
			$an = text("AUX {}", $k + 1)
		$sl_txt.append($an & ":  " & @dv_kact_name($dk_act.$k, $dk_ref.$k))
	@pick_list("DRIVE - KEYS", "AUX keys are the pilot seat's number keys.", "dv_krow")

function @page_dv_kact()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$sl_txt.append("NOTHING")
	$sl_txt.append("SWITCH A LIGHT, RELAY OR GROUP")
	$sl_txt.append("HORN (WHILE HELD)")
	$sl_txt.append("REGEN BRAKING ON/OFF")
	$sl_txt.append("HANDBRAKE ON/OFF")
	$sl_txt.append("CRUISE CONTROL ON/OFF")
	var $an = "AUX 0"
	if $dv_kcur < 9
		$an = text("AUX {}", $dv_kcur + 1)
	@pick_list($an & " - WHAT DOES IT DO?", "", "dv_kact")

function @page_dv_ktgt()
	@switchable_rows(1)
	@pick_list("WHAT DOES IT SWITCH?", "", "dv_ktgt")

; ---- options ----
function @page_dv_opts()
	var $y = @set_header("DRIVE - OPTIONS")
	$y = @set_row($y, "STEERING", @dv_mode_name($dv_mode) & "  (tap to change)", "dv_mode", $th_accent)
	var $ss = "OFF"
	if $dv_sens
		$ss = "ON"
	$y = @set_row($y, "LESS STEERING AT SPEED", $ss, "dv_sens", $th_accent)
	var $rs = "OFF"
	if $dv_regen
		$rs = "ON"
	$y = @set_row($y, "REGENERATIVE BRAKING", $rs, "dv_regen", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "SEAT", @dv_seat_label() & "  (tap to change)", "dv_seat", $th_accent)
	var $k = 3.6
	var $su = " km/h"
	if $cfg_units
		$k = 2.23694
		$su = " mph"
	var $lt = "NONE"
	if $dv_limit > 0
		$lt = text("{0}", $dv_limit * $k) & $su
	$y = @set_stepper($y, "SPEED LIMIT", $lt, "dv_lim-", "dv_lim+")

; Next seat with an alias after the current one.
function @dv_seat_next()
	var $n = $db_id.size
	var $first = ""
	var $take = 0
	var $pick = ""
	repeat $n ($j)
		if contains($db_type.$j, "Seat") and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			if $first == ""
				$first = $db_alias.$j
			if $take and ($pick == "")
				$pick = $db_alias.$j
			if $db_alias.$j == $dv_seat_now
				$take = 1
	if $pick == ""
		$pick = $first
	$dv_seat = $pick
	$dv_sync_next = 0

function @dv_action($act : text, $val : number)
	if $act == "dv_setup"
		$dv_sync_next = 0
		@go("dv_map")
	elseif $act == "dv_front"
		$dv_front = $val
		@dv_geometry()
	elseif $act == "dv_wig"
		if ($dv_tmode == 0) and ($val >= 0)
			$dv_wig = $val
			$dv_tmode = 3
			$dv_tend = time + 2.4
	elseif $act == "dv_next"
		$dv_ts = 0
		@go("dv_test")
	elseif $act == "dv_auto"
		$wa_on = 0
		@go("dv_auto")
	elseif $act == "dv_astart"
		@wa_start()
	elseif $act == "dv_anext"
		$wa_on = 0
		$dv_ts = 3
		@go("dv_test")
	elseif $act == "dv_acancel"
		$wa_on = 0
		$dv_ts = 0
		@go("dv_map")
	elseif $act == "dv_cancel"
		$dv_ts = 0
		@go("drive")
	elseif $act == "dv_tstart"
		if $dv_tmode == 0
			$dv_tnav = 0
			if $dv_ts == 0
				$dv_tmode = 1
				$dv_ts = 1
			else
				$dv_tmode = 2
				$dv_ts = 4
			$dv_tend = time + 2
	elseif $act == "dv_ans"
		var $wn = $dw_alias.size
		if $val == 0
			if abs($dv_tnav) > 0.2
				$dv_navs = 1
				if $dv_tnav < 0
					$dv_navs = -1
			$dv_ts = 3
		elseif $val == 1
			repeat $wn ($k)
				$dw_dir.$k = -$dw_dir.$k
			$dv_ts = 0
			@ui_toast("FLIPPED - TEST AGAIN")
		elseif $val == 2
			repeat $wn ($k2)
				if $dw_s.$k2 > 0.1
					$dw_dir.$k2 = -$dw_dir.$k2
			$dv_ts = 0
			@ui_toast("RIGHT SIDE FLIPPED - TEST AGAIN")
		elseif $val == 3
			$dv_ts = 0
			@ui_toast("CHECK POWER AND THE GEARBOX")
		elseif $val == 10
			$dv_ts = 0
			$dv_done = 1
			$dv_on = 1
			@go("dv_learn")
			@dv_learn_start(0)
		elseif $val == 11
			$dv_sdir = -$dv_sdir
			$dv_ts = 3
			@ui_toast("STEERING FLIPPED - TEST AGAIN")
		elseif $val == 12
			if $dv_mode == 3
				$dv_mode = 0
			else
				$dv_mode = 3
			$dv_ts = 3
	elseif $act == "dv_on"
		$dv_on = !$dv_on
	elseif $act == "dv_keys"
		@go("dv_keys")
	elseif $act == "dv_opts"
		@go("dv_opts")
	elseif $act == "dv_lkeep"
		$dv_lwait = 0
		if $dv_ls >= 4
			$dv_ls = -1
			@go("drive")
		else
			@dv_learn_start($dv_ls + 1)
	elseif $act == "dv_lnone"
		if $dv_ls >= 2
			$dc_ch.$dv_ls = 0
		if ($dv_ls >= 4) or ($dv_ls <= 1)
			$dv_ls = -1
			@go("drive")
		else
			@dv_learn_start($dv_ls + 1)
	elseif $act == "dv_krow"
		if $val == 0
			@go("dv_learn")
			@dv_learn_start(0)
		elseif $val > 0
			$dv_kcur = $val - 1
			@go("dv_kact")
	elseif $act == "dv_kact"
		if $val == 1
			@go("dv_ktgt")
		else
			$dk_act.$dv_kcur = $val
			$dk_ref.$dv_kcur = ""
			@go("dv_keys")
	elseif $act == "dv_ktgt"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			$dk_act.$dv_kcur = 1
			$dk_ref.$dv_kcur = $sl_spec.$val
		@go("dv_keys")
	elseif $act == "dv_mode"
		$dv_mode = @posmod($dv_mode + 1, 4)
	elseif $act == "dv_sens"
		$dv_sens = !$dv_sens
	elseif $act == "dv_regen"
		$dv_regen = !$dv_regen
	elseif $act == "dv_seat"
		@dv_seat_next()
	elseif ($act == "dv_lim-") or ($act == "dv_lim+")
		var $k3 = 3.6
		if $cfg_units
			$k3 = 2.23694
		var $lv = round($dv_limit * $k3 / 5) * 5
		if $act == "dv_lim+"
			$lv += 5
		else
			$lv = max($lv - 5, 0)
		$dv_limit = $lv / $k3
	$ui_dirty = 1
