; ChipOS - FLY and BOAT pages.
var $fy_back = "fly"

function @fy_status_line() : text
	var $s = "NOBODY IN THE SEAT"
	if $dv_seat_now == ""
		$s = "NO PILOT SEAT FOUND"
	elseif $fy_seated
		$s = text("SEATED - THROTTLE {0}%", $fy_thr * 100)
	return $s

function @fy_count_role($r : number) : number
	var $c = 0
	var $n = $cs_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if ($cs_role.$i == $r) and @db_has_alias($cs_a.$i)
			$c += 1
	return $c

function @fy_drive_count() : number
	var $c = 0
	var $n = $pp_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if ($pp_use.$i == 1) and @db_has_alias($pp_a.$i)
			$c += 1
	return $c

function @fy_lift_count() : number
	var $c = 0
	var $n = $pp_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if ($pp_use.$i == 3) and @db_has_alias($pp_a.$i)
			$c += 1
	return $c

function @page_fly()
	$fy_back = "fly"
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	var $y = @set_header("FLY")
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, @fy_status_line(), $tw)
	var $ol = "OFF - tap to let ChipOS fly the surfaces and engines"
	if $fy_on
		$ol = "ON - tap to hand control back"
	$y = @set_row($y, "CHIPOS FLIES", $ol, "fy_on", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "CONTROL SURFACES", text("{} aileron(s) L / {} R, {} elevator, {} rudder, {} flaps", @fy_count_role(1), @fy_count_role(2), @fy_count_role(3), @fy_count_role(4), @fy_count_role(5)), "go:fy_surf", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "ENGINES", text("{} main thrust, {} lift - profiles and limits", @fy_drive_count(), @fy_lift_count()), "go:fy_eng", $th_accent)
	var $fk = "NONE"
	if $fy_flapkey > 0
		$fk = text("AUX {}", @posmod($fy_flapkey, 10))
	$y = @set_row($y, "FLAPS KEY", $fk & text("  (flaps now {0}%)", $fy_flap * 100), "fy_flapk", $th_accent)
	var $iv = "NORMAL"
	if $fy_inv
		$iv = "INVERTED"
	$y = @set_row($y, "PITCH", $iv & "  (tap to flip)", "fy_inv", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_stepper($y, "CONTROL STRENGTH", text("{0}%", $fy_rate * 100), "fy_rate-", "fy_rate+")

function @page_boat()
	$fy_back = "boat"
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	var $y = @set_header("BOAT")
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, @fy_status_line(), $tw)
	var $ol = "OFF - tap to let ChipOS steer"
	if $bt_on
		$ol = "ON - W/S or the throttle lever drive, A/D steer"
	$y = @set_row($y, "CHIPOS STEERS", $ol, "bt_on", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "RUDDERS", text("{} rudder(s)", @fy_count_role(4)), "go:fy_surf", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "PROPELLERS", text("{} driving (manoeuvring ones are left alone)", @fy_drive_count()), "go:fy_eng", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_stepper($y, "RUDDER STRENGTH", text("{0}%", $fy_rate * 100), "fy_rate-", "fy_rate+")

; Surfaces: role button + TEST per row.
function @page_fy_surf()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 64)
	var $y = @set_header("CONTROL SURFACES")
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "Ailerons, data junctions and pivots / hinges that look like controls. Tap the role to set it, then TEST to move it and tell ChipOS which way it went.", $tw)
	var $bh = $chh * 2.2
	var $n = $fy_cand.size
	repeat $n ($k)
		var $a = $fy_cand.$k
		var $i = @cs_find($a)
		if $i >= 0
			$y = @bz_fit($y, $bh)
			var $tb = $cw * 8
			var $rw = $tw - $tb - $cw
			var $dir = "  ?"
			if $cs_sign.$i != 0
				$dir = "  OK"
			var $lab = @ui_fit($a & " - " & @cs_role_name($cs_role.$i) & $dir, floor(($rw - $cw) / $cw))
			var $st = 0
			if $cs_role.$i > 0
				$st = 1
			$ui_hv = $i
			@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $rw, $bh, $lab, "fy_role", $st)
			$ui_hv = $i
			@ui_btn($content_x + $rw + $cw, $y, $tb, $bh, "TEST", "fy_test", 0)
			$y += $bh + $chh * 0.3
	if $n == 0
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_warn, "Nothing found. Give the data junctions / pivots an alias (e.g. left-wing, rudder), or show all.", $tw)
	var $sa = "SHOW ALL JUNCTIONS & PIVOTS"
	if $fy_showall
		$sa = "SHOW ONLY LIKELY ONES"
	$y += $chh * 0.3
	$y = @bz_fit($y, $bh)
	@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $tw, $bh, $sa, "fy_showall", 0)

function @page_fy_test()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	var $y = @set_header("WHICH WAY DID IT MOVE?")
	if ($fy_tk < 0) or ($fy_tk >= $cs_a.size)
		return
	var $r = $cs_role.$fy_tk
	var $nm = $cs_a.$fy_tk & " (" & @cs_role_name($r) & ")"
	if $fy_tph == 1
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_text, "MOVING " & $nm & "... watch it.", $tw)
		return
	var $q = "Did the BACK EDGE of " & $nm & " go DOWN or UP?"
	var $a1 = "DOWN"
	var $a2 = "UP"
	if $r == 4
		$q = "Looking forward, did the BACK EDGE of " & $nm & " go LEFT or RIGHT?"
		$a1 = "RIGHT"
		$a2 = "LEFT"
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_text, $q, $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.4
	var $bh = $chh * 2.4
	repeat 4 ($k)
		var $lb = $a1
		var $st = 1
		if $k == 1
			$lb = $a2
		elseif $k == 2
			$lb = "IT DIDN'T MOVE"
			$st = 0
		elseif $k == 3
			$lb = "MOVE IT AGAIN"
			$st = 0
		if $k >= 2
			$st = 0
		$y = @bz_fit($y, $bh)
		$ui_hv = $k
		@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $tw, $bh, $lb, "fy_ans", $st)
		$y += $bh + $chh * 0.4

function @fy_use_name($u : number) : text
	if $u == 1
		return "MAIN THRUST"
	if $u == 2
		return "MANOEUVRING (LEFT ALONE)"
	if $u == 3
		return "LIFT (UP / DOWN KEYS)"
	return "NOT USED"

function @fy_kind_name($t : text) : text
	if $t == "Propeller"
		return "PROP"
	if $t == "Turbojet"
		return "JET"
	if contains($t, "Thruster")
		return "ROCKET"
	if contains($t, "Pump")
		return "FUEL PUMP"
	return "?"

; Each engine: line 1 role; line 2 profile, limit, direction / gimbal.
function @page_fy_eng()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 64)
	var $y = @set_header("ENGINES")
	@att_find_nav()
	@pp_pad()
	if $pt_on == 1
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_text, "TESTING... " & $pt_note, $tw)
		return
	if $pt_on == 2
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, $pt_note, $tw)
	if ($att_nav != "") and ($fy_nprop > 0)
		$y = @set_row($y, "TEST THE PROPELLERS (NAV)", "spins each one alone: finds which push forward and which are for manoeuvring", "fy_ptest", $th_accent)
	elseif $fy_nprop > 0
		$y = @set_row($y, "TEST THE PROPELLERS", "no nav: the strongest ones drive; set FWD / REV below", "fy_ptest", $th_accent)
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "PROFILE shapes the throttle: LINEAR, SMOOTH (gentle low end), PUNCHY (quick low end), IDLE 20% (keeps it turning). Rockets are switched on by the throttle; their turbopumps set the thrust.", $tw)
	var $bh = $chh * 2.2
	var $n = $pp_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if @db_has_alias($pp_a.$i)
			var $t = @fy_type_of($pp_a.$i)
			$y = @bz_fit($y, $bh * 2 + $chh * 0.3)
			var $lab = @ui_fit($pp_a.$i & " (" & @fy_kind_name($t) & ") - " & @fy_use_name($pp_use.$i), floor(($tw - $cw) / $cw))
			var $st = 0
			if ($pp_use.$i == 1) or ($pp_use.$i == 3)
				$st = 1
			$ui_hv = $i
			@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $tw, $bh, $lab, "fy_use", $st)
			$y += $bh + $chh * 0.15
			var $gap = $cw * 0.5
			var $bw = ($tw - $gap * 2) / 3
			$ui_hv = $i
			@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $bw, $bh, @pp_prof_name($pp_prof.$i), "fy_prof", 0)
			$ui_hv = $i
			@ui_btn($content_x + $bw + $gap, $y, $bw, $bh, text("MAX {0}%", $pp_max.$i), "fy_max", 0)
			var $l3 = ""
			var $a3 = ""
			if $t == "Propeller"
				$l3 = "FWD"
				if $pp_sign.$i < 0
					$l3 = "REV"
				$a3 = "fy_psign"
			elseif ($t == "SmallThruster") or ($t == "BigThruster")
				$l3 = "GIMBAL OFF"
				if $pp_gim.$i == 1
					$l3 = "GIMBAL ON"
				elseif $pp_gim.$i == -1
					$l3 = "GIMBAL REV"
				$a3 = "fy_gim"
			if $a3 != ""
				$ui_hv = $i
				@ui_btn($content_x + ($bw + $gap) * 2, $y, $bw, $bh, $l3, $a3, 0)
			$y += $bh + $chh * 0.5

function @fy_action($act : text, $val : number)
	if $act == "fy_on"
		$fy_on = !$fy_on
	elseif $act == "bt_on"
		$bt_on = !$bt_on
		if $bt_on and !$pp_tested and ($fy_nprop > 1)
			; find the manoeuvring propellers before driving with them
			@ui_toast("TESTING THE PROPELLERS FIRST")
			@pt_start()
			@go("fy_eng")
	elseif $act == "fy_inv"
		$fy_inv = !$fy_inv
	elseif $act == "fy_flapk"
		$fy_flapkey = @posmod($fy_flapkey + 1, 11)
	elseif $act == "fy_rate-"
		$fy_rate = max(0.2, $fy_rate - 0.1)
	elseif $act == "fy_rate+"
		$fy_rate = min(1, $fy_rate + 0.1)
	elseif $act == "fy_role"
		if ($val >= 0) and ($val < $cs_role.size)
			$cs_role.$val = @posmod($cs_role.$val + 1, 6)
			$cs_sign.$val = 0
	elseif $act == "fy_test"
		if ($val >= 0) and ($val < $cs_a.size)
			@cs_test_start($val)
			@go("fy_test")
	elseif $act == "fy_ans"
		if ($fy_tk >= 0) and ($fy_tk < $cs_a.size)
			if $val == 0
				$cs_sign.$fy_tk = 1
			elseif $val == 1
				$cs_sign.$fy_tk = -1
			elseif $val == 2
				@ui_toast("CHECK ITS POWER / CABLE (OR IT'S NOT A SURFACE)")
			if $val == 3
				@cs_test_start($fy_tk)
				return
		$fy_tph = 0
		@go("fy_surf")
	elseif $act == "fy_showall"
		$fy_showall = !$fy_showall
		$fy_scan_t = 0
	elseif $act == "fy_ptest"
		@pt_start()
	elseif $act == "fy_use"
		if ($val >= 0) and ($val < $pp_use.size)
			$pp_use.$val = @posmod($pp_use.$val + 1, 4)
	elseif $act == "fy_prof"
		if ($val >= 0) and ($val < $pp_prof.size)
			$pp_prof.$val = @posmod($pp_prof.$val + 1, 4)
	elseif $act == "fy_max"
		if ($val >= 0) and ($val < $pp_max.size)
			$pp_max.$val = $pp_max.$val - 25
			if $pp_max.$val < 25
				$pp_max.$val = 100
	elseif $act == "fy_gim"
		if ($val >= 0) and ($val < $pp_gim.size)
			$pp_gim.$val = $pp_gim.$val + 1
			if $pp_gim.$val > 1
				$pp_gim.$val = -1
	elseif $act == "fy_psign"
		if ($val >= 0) and ($val < $pp_sign.size)
			$pp_sign.$val = -$pp_sign.$val
	$ui_dirty = 1

xc_files.name: customw.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - custom widgets: BAR, GAUGE, READOUT (display a source) and
; BUTTON, SWITCH (control a target). Kept in storage; placed on home pages
; as item kind 3 (ref = definition index).
storage array $cw_type : number         ; 1 bar 2 gauge 3 readout 4 button 5 switch
storage array $cw_src : text            ; source / target spec
storage array $cw_name : text
storage array $cw_w : number
storage array $cw_h : number
storage array $cw_st : number           ; switch state (latched outputs)
storage array $cw_unit : number         ; temperatures: 0 settings (C/F), 1 Kelvin
array $cw_lo : number                   ; auto-range for raw channels
array $cw_hi : number
array $cw_pulse : number                ; button pulse end time
; builder state
var $cwn_type = 1
var $cwn_src = ""
var $cwn_label = ""
var $cwn_dev = ""
var $cwn_unit = 0
array $gh_sig : number                  ; graph: units the history was taken in
array $sl_txt : text
array $sl_spec : text
var $cw_next = 0

function @cw_type_name($t : number) : text
	if $t == 1
		return "BAR"
	if $t == 2
		return "GAUGE"
	if $t == 3
		return "READOUT"
	if $t == 4
		return "BUTTON"
	if $t == 6
		return "CLOCK"
	if $t == 7
		return "GRAPH"
	if $t == 8
		return "CONTACT"
	if $t == 9
		return "CONTAINER"
	return "SWITCH"

function @cw_is_control($t : number) : number
	return ($t == 4) or ($t == 5)

function @cw_pad()
	while $cw_unit.size < $cw_type.size
		$cw_unit.append(0)
	if $cw_lo.size >= $cw_type.size
		return
	repeat 300 ($p)
		if $cw_lo.size < $cw_type.size
			$cw_lo.append(1000000000)
			$cw_hi.append(-1000000000)
			$cw_pulse.append(0)

; "a:b:c" -> part n
function @spec_part($s : text, $n : number) : text
	var $rest = $s
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $p = find($rest, ":")
		if $p < 0
			return ""
		$rest = substring($rest, $p + 1, size($rest))
	var $q = find($rest, ":")
	if $q < 0
		return $rest
	return substring($rest, 0, $q)

function @db_by_alias($a : text) : number
	var $n = $db_alias.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if $db_alias.$j == $a
			return $j
	return -1

; Weighted charge % of batteries matching: "all", "hv", "lv", or one alias.
function @bat_pct($which : text) : number
	var $cap = 0
	var $st = 0
	var $n = $pb_idx.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $j = $pb_idx.$i
		var $ok = 0
		if $which == "all"
			$ok = 1
		elseif $which == "hv"
			$ok = contains($db_type.$j, "High")
		elseif $which == "lv"
			$ok = contains($db_type.$j, "Low")
		else
			$ok = $db_alias.$j == $which
		if $ok
			var $c = max($pb_cap.$i, 0.000001)
			$cap += $c
			$st += $c * $pb_charge.$i
	if $cap <= 0
		return -1
	return $st / $cap * 100

; Average voltage of the selected batteries (-1 if none).
function @bat_volt($which : text) : number
	var $sum = 0
	var $cnt = 0
	var $n = $pb_idx.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $j = $pb_idx.$i
		if ($which == "all") or ($db_alias.$j == $which)
			$sum += $pb_volt.$i
			$cnt += 1
	if $cnt == 0
		return -1
	return $sum / $cnt

var $cv_lo = 0
var $cv_hi = 100
var $cv_unit = ""
; What a device channel measures (sensor units from the Archean wiki):
; 1 temperature K, 2 density kg/m3, 3 volume m3, 4 pressure Pa,
; 5 level 0-1, 6 length m, 7 speed m/s, 8 rot/s, 9 force N, 10 percent,
; 11 mass flow kg/s, 0 plain number.
function @dev_kind($a : text, $ch : number) : number
	var $j = @db_by_alias($a)
	if $j < 0
		return 0
	var $t = $db_type.$j
	if ($t == "TemperatureSensor") or ($t == "TemperatureProbe")
		return ($ch == 0) * 1
	if $t == "DensitySensor"
		return ($ch == 0) * 2
	if $t == "Volume"
		if $ch == 0
			return 5
		if $ch == 1
			return 3
		if $ch == 4
			return 4
		if $ch == 5
			return 1
		return 0
	if contains($t, "FluidTank")
		if $ch == 0
			return 5
		if $ch == 2
			return 1
		return 0
	if ($t == "AltitudeSensor") or ($t == "DistanceSensor")
		if $ch <= 1
			return 6
		return 0
	if $t == "SpeedSensor"
		return ($ch == 0) * 7
	if $t == "Propeller"
		if $ch == 0
			return 8
		if $ch == 1
			return 9
		return 0
	if $t == "Turbojet"
		if $ch == 0
			return 10
		if $ch == 1
			return 9
		if $ch == 2
			return 1
		if ($ch == 4) or ($ch == 5)
			return 11
		return 0
	if contains($t, "Thruster")
		if $ch == 0
			return 9
		if ($ch == 1) or ($ch == 2)
			return 11
		return 0
	return 0

; Convert a raw value for display; sets $cv_unit. $kel = show Kelvin.
function @u_conv($kind : number, $v : number, $kel : number) : number
	$cv_unit = ""
	if $kind == 1
		if $kel
			$cv_unit = "K"
			return $v
		if $cfg_units
			$cv_unit = "F"
			return ($v - 273.15) * 1.8 + 32
		$cv_unit = "C"
		return $v - 273.15
	if $kind == 2
		if $cfg_units
			$cv_unit = "lb/ft3"
			return $v * 0.062428
		$cv_unit = "kg/m3"
		return $v
	if $kind == 3
		if $cfg_units
			$cv_unit = "ft3"
			return $v * 35.3147
		$cv_unit = "m3"
		return $v
	if $kind == 4
		if $cfg_units
			$cv_unit = "psi"
			return $v * 0.000145038
		$cv_unit = "kPa"
		return $v / 1000
	if $kind == 5
		$cv_unit = "%"
		return $v * 100
	if $kind == 6
		if $cfg_units
			$cv_unit = "ft"
			return $v * 3.28084
		$cv_unit = "m"
		return $v
	if $kind == 7
		if $cfg_units
			$cv_unit = "mph"
			return $v * 2.23694
		$cv_unit = "km/h"
		return $v * 3.6
	if $kind == 8
		$cv_unit = "rpm"
		return $v * 60
	if $kind == 9
		if $cfg_units
			$cv_unit = "klbf"
			return $v * 0.000224809
		$cv_unit = "kN"
		return $v / 1000
	if $kind == 10
		$cv_unit = "%"
		return $v
	if $kind == 11
		if $cfg_units
			$cv_unit = "lb/s"
			return $v * 2.20462
		$cv_unit = "kg/s"
		return $v
	return $v

; Current value of display widget i (and its range in $cv_lo / $cv_hi).
var $cw_src_now = ""
function @cw_value($i : number) : number
	var $s = $cw_src.$i
	$cw_src_now = $s
	var $k = @spec_part($s, 0)
	$cv_lo = 0
	$cv_hi = 100
	$cv_unit = "%"
	if $k == "bat"
		return @bat_pct(@spec_part($s, 1))
	if $k == "solar"
		$cv_unit = "W"
		$cv_hi = max($ps_idx.size * 2700, 1)
		return $pw_solar
	if $k == "batv"
		$cv_unit = "V"
		$cv_hi = 1000
		return @bat_volt(@spec_part($s, 1))
	if $k == "batt3"
		return $pw_pct
	if $k == "hist"
		return $pw_pct
	if $k == "eta"
		$cv_unit = "eta"
		return $pw_pct
	if $k == "usage"
		$cv_unit = "W"
		$cv_hi = max($pw_usage * 1.5, 1000)
		return $pw_usage
	if $k == "flow"
		$cv_unit = "W"
		$cv_hi = max(abs($pw_flow) * 1.5, 1000)
		$cv_lo = -$cv_hi
		return $pw_flow
	if $k == "dev"
		var $a = @spec_part($s, 1)
		var $cht = @spec_part($s, 2)
		var $ch = $cht:number
		var $v = @in_n($a, $ch)
		@cw_pad()
		var $kind = @dev_kind($a, $ch)
		if ($kind == 6) and ($v < 0)
			; distance sensor: -1 = nothing in range
			$v = 0
		$cw_lo.$i = min($cw_lo.$i, $v)
		$cw_hi.$i = max($cw_hi.$i, $v)
		if ($kind == 5) or ($kind == 10)
			$cv_lo = 0
			$cv_hi = 100
			return @u_conv($kind, $v, 0)
		if $kind > 0
			var $kel = $cw_unit.$i
			; temperatures: range around what was seen (not from zero)
			var $rlo = $cw_lo.$i
			if $kind != 1
				$rlo = min($rlo, 0)
			var $rhi = max($cw_hi.$i, $rlo + 0.000001)
			if $kind == 1
				$rlo = $rlo - 5
				$rhi = $rhi + 5
			$cv_lo = @u_conv($kind, $rlo, $kel)
			$cv_hi = @u_conv($kind, $rhi, $kel)
			return @u_conv($kind, $v, $kel)
		$cv_lo = min($cw_lo.$i, 0)
		$cv_hi = max($cw_hi.$i, $cv_lo + 0.000001)
		if ($cv_lo >= 0) and ($cv_hi <= 1)
			$cv_hi = 1
		$cv_unit = ""
		return $v
	if $k == "wx"
		var $wk = @spec_part($s, 1)
		@cw_pad()
		if $wk == "t"
			$cw_lo.$i = min($cw_lo.$i, $ws_tk)
			$cw_hi.$i = max($cw_hi.$i, $ws_tk)
			$cv_lo = @u_conv(1, $cw_lo.$i - 5, $cw_unit.$i)
			$cv_hi = @u_conv(1, $cw_hi.$i + 5, $cw_unit.$i)
			return @u_conv(1, $ws_tk, $cw_unit.$i)
		if $wk == "h"
			$cv_lo = 0
			$cv_hi = 100
			$cv_unit = "%"
			return max($ws_rh, 0)
		if $wk == "p"
			$cv_unit = "hPa"
			$cv_lo = 950
			$cv_hi = 1050
			if $cfg_units
				$cv_unit = "inHg"
				$cv_lo = 28
				$cv_hi = 31
				return $ws_p / 3386.39
			return $ws_p / 100
		$cv_lo = 0
		$cv_hi = 30
		$cv_unit = "km/h"
		var $ws = $wn_spd * 3.6
		if $cfg_units
			$cv_unit = "mph"
			$ws = $wn_spd * 2.23694
		$cv_hi = max(30, $ws * 1.5)
		return $ws
	if $k == "cd"
		; a contact's structured data: cd:<frequency>:<field>
		var $cv = @cd_field(@spec_part($s, 1), @spec_part($s, 2))
		@cw_pad()
		if $cd_fok
			$cw_lo.$i = min($cw_lo.$i, $cv)
			$cw_hi.$i = max($cw_hi.$i, $cv)
		$cv_lo = min($cw_lo.$i, 0)
		$cv_hi = max($cw_hi.$i, $cv_lo + 0.000001)
		if ($cv_lo >= 0) and ($cv_hi <= 1)
			$cv_hi = 1
		$cv_unit = ""
		if @spec_part($s, 2) == "_dist"
			$cv_unit = "m"
		return $cv
	return 0

function @cw_value_text($v : number) : text
	if $cv_unit == "V"
		return text("{0.0} V", $v)
	if $cv_unit == "eta"
		@pw_status_lines()
		if $pw_line_b != ""
			return replace(replace($pw_line_b, "FULL IN ", "FULL "), "EMPTY IN ", "EMPTY ")
		return "STEADY"
	if $cv_unit == "W"
		return @fmt_power($v)
	if $cv_unit == "%"
		if $v < 0
			return "--"
		return text("{0}%", $v)
	if ($cv_unit == "m") and (find($cw_src_now, "cd:") == 0)
		return @cm_dist_n($v)
	if $cv_unit != ""
		if abs($v) >= 100
			return text("{0} ", $v) & $cv_unit
		if abs($v) < 10
			return text("{0.00} ", $v) & $cv_unit
		return text("{0.0} ", $v) & $cv_unit
	if abs($v) >= 100
		return text("{0}", $v)
	return text("{0.00}", $v)

; Control state (1 on / 0 off).
function @cw_state($i : number) : number
	var $s = $cw_src.$i
	var $k = @spec_part($s, 0)
	if $k == "relay"
		var $j = @db_by_alias(@spec_part($s, 1))
		if $j >= 0
			return $db_on.$j == 1
		return 0
	if $k == "lights"
		var $n = $db_id.size
		repeat $n ($q)
			if ($db_cat.$q == 1) and ($db_on.$q == 1)
				return 1
		return 0
	if $k == "group"
		return @tgt_state($s)
	@cw_pad()
	if $cw_type.$i == 4
		return time < $cw_pulse.$i
	return $cw_st.$i

; Is display widget i showing a temperature?
function @cw_is_temp($i : number) : number
	var $s = $cw_src.$i
	if $s == "wx:t"
		return 1
	if @spec_part($s, 0) != "dev"
		return 0
	var $ct = @spec_part($s, 2)
	return @dev_kind(@spec_part($s, 1), $ct:number) == 1

function @cw_press($i : number)
	if (($cw_type.$i <= 3) or ($cw_type.$i == 7)) and @cw_is_temp($i)
		@cw_pad()
		$cw_unit.$i = !$cw_unit.$i
		if $cw_unit.$i
			@ui_toast("SHOWING KELVIN")
		elseif $cfg_units
			@ui_toast("SHOWING FAHRENHEIT")
		else
			@ui_toast("SHOWING CELSIUS")
		$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	if $cw_type.$i == 9
		return
	if $cw_type.$i == 8
		; contact card: next contact
		$cw_st.$i = $cw_st.$i + 1
		$ui_dirty = 1
		return
	var $s = $cw_src.$i
	var $k = @spec_part($s, 0)
	var $now = @cw_state($i)
	if $k == "relay"
		var $j = @db_by_alias(@spec_part($s, 1))
		if $j >= 0
			$db_on.$j = !$now
			$assert_next = 0
	elseif $k == "lights"
		var $n = $db_id.size
		repeat $n ($q)
			if ($db_cat.$q == 1) and ($db_alias.$q != "")
				$db_on.$q = !$now
		$assert_next = 0
	elseif $k == "group"
		@tgt_set($s, !$now)
	elseif $k == "out"
		@cw_pad()
		if $cw_type.$i == 4
			$cw_pulse.$i = time + 0.4
		else
			$cw_st.$i = !$cw_st.$i
		$cw_next = 0
	@snd_beep(1200, 0.04)

; ---- graph history: 120 samples per graph (one a minute = 2 hours) ----
const $gh_len = 120
array $gh_a : number                    ; series A (main value)
array $gh_b : number                    ; series B (battery voltage)
array $gh_c : number                    ; series C (battery flow)
array $gh_n : number                    ; samples stored per widget
var $gh_next = 0

function @gh_pad()
	repeat 20 ($q)
		if $gh_n.size < $cw_type.size
			$gh_n.append(0)
			var $gl = $gh_len
			repeat $gl ($r)
				$gh_a.append(0)
				$gh_b.append(0)
				$gh_c.append(0)

; Shift in one sample for graph widget i.
function @gh_push($i : number, $va : number, $vb : number, $vc : number)
	var $base = $i * $gh_len
	var $gl1 = $gh_len - 1
	repeat $gl1 ($r)
		$gh_a.($base + $r) = $gh_a.($base + $r + 1)
		$gh_b.($base + $r) = $gh_b.($base + $r + 1)
		$gh_c.($base + $r) = $gh_c.($base + $r + 1)
	var $e = $base + $gh_len - 1
	$gh_a.$e = $va
	$gh_b.$e = $vb
	$gh_c.$e = $vc
	$gh_n.$i = min($gh_n.$i + 1, $gh_len)

function @gh_tick()
	@gh_pad()
	@cw_pad()
	var $due = time >= $gh_next
	if $due
		$gh_next = time + 60
	var $n = $cw_type.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $cw_type.$i == 7
			while $gh_sig.size <= $i
				$gh_sig.append(-1)
			var $sig = $cfg_units * 10 + $cw_unit.$i
			if $gh_sig.$i != $sig
				$gh_sig.$i = $sig
				$gh_n.$i = 0
		if ($cw_type.$i == 7) and ($due or ($gh_n.$i == 0))
			var $v = @cw_value($i)
			var $vb = @bat_volt("all")
			@gh_push($i, $v, $vb, $pw_flow)

; Drive "out:" targets: switches hold their level, buttons pulse.
function @cw_tick()
	@gh_tick()
	@cw_pad()
	var $n = $cw_type.size
	var $pulsing = 0
	repeat $n ($i)
		if ($cw_type.$i == 4) and (time < $cw_pulse.$i + 0.1)
			$pulsing = 1
	if (time < $cw_next) and (!$pulsing)
		return
	$cw_next = time + 1
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $s = $cw_src.$i
		if @spec_part($s, 0) == "out"
			var $a = @spec_part($s, 1)
			var $cht2 = @spec_part($s, 2)
			var $ch = $cht2:number
			if $cw_type.$i == 4
				if time < $cw_pulse.$i + 0.1
					var $lvl = time < $cw_pulse.$i
					@out_n($a, $ch, $lvl)
			else
				@out_n($a, $ch, $cw_st.$i)
	if $pulsing
		$ui_dirty = 1

; ---------------- drawing ----------------
; One series as a line; lo/hi = vertical range.
function @gh_line($i : number, $ser : number, $gx : number, $gy : number, $gw : number, $gh : number, $lo : number, $hi : number, $col : number)
	var $n = $gh_n.$i
	if $n < 1
		return
	var $base = $i * $gh_len
	var $rng = max($hi - $lo, 0.000001)
	var $px = 0
	var $py = 0
	repeat $n ($k)
		var $idx = $base + $gh_len - $n + $k
		var $v = $gh_a.$idx
		if $ser == 1
			$v = $gh_b.$idx
		elseif $ser == 2
			$v = $gh_c.$idx
		var $hx = $gx + $gw * ($gh_len - $n + $k) / ($gh_len - 1)
		var $hy = $gy + $gh * (1 - clamp(($v - $lo) / $rng, 0, 1))
		if $k > 0
			@d_line($px, $py, $hx, $hy, $col)
		elseif $n == 1
			@d_circle($hx, $hy, 2, $col, $col)
		$px = $hx
		$py = $hy

; Range of a series over the stored samples -> $gr_lo / $gr_hi.
var $gr_lo = 0
var $gr_hi = 1
function @gh_range($i : number, $ser : number)
	var $n = $gh_n.$i
	var $base = $i * $gh_len
	$gr_lo = 1000000000
	$gr_hi = -1000000000
	repeat $n ($k)
		var $idx = $base + $gh_len - $n + $k
		var $v = $gh_a.$idx
		if $ser == 1
			$v = $gh_b.$idx
		elseif $ser == 2
			$v = $gh_c.$idx
		$gr_lo = min($gr_lo, $v)
		$gr_hi = max($gr_hi, $v)
	if $n == 0
		$gr_lo = 0
		$gr_hi = 1
	if $gr_hi - $gr_lo < 0.000001
		$gr_lo -= 1
		$gr_hi += 1
	var $pad = ($gr_hi - $gr_lo) * 0.1
	$gr_lo -= $pad
	$gr_hi += $pad

; History graph widget.
function @cw_graph($i : number, $x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number)
	@gh_pad()
	var $s = $cw_src.$i
	var $k = @spec_part($s, 0)
	@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $chh * 0.4, $th_dim, $cw_name.$i, $w - $cw * 1.6)
	var $gx = $x + $cw * 0.8
	var $gw = $w - $cw * 1.6
	var $gy = $y + $chh * 2.9
	var $gh = max($h - $chh * 3.4, $chh)
	@ui_box($gx, $gy, $gw, $gh, $th_bg, $th_line)
	var $cur = @cw_value($i)
	if ($k == "batt3") or ($k == "hist")
		; battery: charge 0-100 (green), voltage (cyan), flow around zero (amber)
		var $l1 = $gy + $gh * (1 - $pw_low / 100)
		@d_line($gx, $l1, $gx + $gw, $l1, $th_bad_dk)
		if $k == "batt3"
			@gh_range($i, 2)
			var $fm = max(abs($gr_lo), abs($gr_hi))
			var $zy = $gy + $gh / 2
			@d_line($gx, $zy, $gx + $gw, $zy, $th_line)
			@gh_line($i, 2, $gx, $gy, $gw, $gh, -$fm, $fm, $th_warn)
			@gh_range($i, 1)
			@gh_line($i, 1, $gx, $gy, $gw, $gh, $gr_lo, $gr_hi, $th_accent)
		@gh_line($i, 0, $gx, $gy, $gw, $gh, 0, 100, $th_ok)
		var $p1 = "--"
		if $pw_pct >= 0
			$p1 = text("{0}%", $pw_pct)
		if $k == "batt3"
			var $vv = @bat_volt("all")
			var $p2 = text("{0}V", $vv)
			var $p3 = @fmt_power($pw_flow)
			; drop the voltage, then the flow, if they don't fit
			if (size($p1) + size($p2) + size($p3) + 4) * $cw > $gw
				$p2 = ""
			if (size($p1) + size($p3) + 2) * $cw > $gw
				$p3 = ""
			var $lx = $gx
			@ui_text($lx, $y + $chh * 1.6, $th_ok, $p1)
			$lx += (size($p1) + 2) * $cw
			if $p2 != ""
				@ui_text($lx, $y + $chh * 1.6, $th_accent, $p2)
				$lx += (size($p2) + 2) * $cw
			@ui_text($lx, $y + $chh * 1.6, $th_warn, $p3)
		else
			@ui_text($gx, $y + $chh * 1.6, $th_ok, $p1)
	else
		@gh_range($i, 0)
		var $lo = $gr_lo
		var $hi = $gr_hi
		if $cv_unit == "%"
			$lo = 0
			$hi = 100
		@gh_line($i, 0, $gx, $gy, $gw, $gh, $lo, $hi, $th_accent)
		var $ct = @cw_value_text($cur)
		@ui_text($gx, $y + $chh * 1.6, $th_text, $ct)
		var $rgt = @cw_value_text($hi)
		var $rgb = @cw_value_text($lo)
		if $gh >= $chh * 3.5
			@ui_text_r($gx + $gw - $cw * 0.3, $gy + $chh * 0.2, $th_dim, $rgt)
			@ui_text_r($gx + $gw - $cw * 0.3, $gy + $gh - $chh * 1.2, $th_dim, $rgb)
	if ($gh_n.$i < 2) and ($gh >= $chh * 1.5)
		var $ct2 = "COLLECTING (1 A MINUTE)"
		if size($ct2) * $cw > $gw - $cw
			$ct2 = "COLLECTING"
		@text_fit_c($gx + $gw / 2, $gy + $gh / 2 - $chh / 2, $th_dim, $ct2, $gw - $cw)

; Contact card: which contact it shows now (-1 none).
function @cw_card_idx($i : number) : number
	var $f = @spec_part($cw_src.$i, 1)
	if $f != "*"
		return @cd_find($f)
	var $n = $cd_freq.size
	if $n == 0
		return -1
	return @posmod(floor(time / 8) + $cw_st.$i, $n)

function @cw_card($i : number, $x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number)
	var $j = @cw_card_idx($i)
	$ui_hv = $i
	@ui_hit($x, $y, $x + $w, $y + $h, "cw_press")
	if $j < 0
		@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $chh * 0.5, $th_dim, $cw_name.$i, $w - $cw * 1.6)
		@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $h / 2 - $chh / 2, $th_warn, "NO CONTACT", $w - $cw * 1.6)
		return
	@cd_pad()
	var $nm = @cd_label($j)
	var $all = @spec_part($cw_src.$i, 1) == "*"
	var $tc = $th_text
	if $j == $cd_focus
		$tc = $th_ok
	@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $chh * 0.4, $tc, $nm, $w - $cw * 1.6)
	var $st = $cd_freq.$j
	if $cd_t.$j <= 0
		$st = $st & "  NOT HEARD YET"
	elseif time - $cd_t.$j < 5
		$st = $st & "  LIVE"
	else
		$st = $st & "  " & @cm_age_s($cd_t.$j)
	if $j == $cd_focus
		$st = $st & "  FOLLOWING"
	@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $chh * 1.5, $th_dim, $st, $w - $cw * 1.6)
	var $top = $y + $chh * 2.8
	var $avh = $y + $h - $top - $chh * 0.4
	; direction arrow + distance
	var $b = @cd_bearing($j)
	var $r = max(min($avh / 2, $w / 4) - 2, $chh * 0.6)
	var $acx = $x + $cw + $r
	var $acy = $top + $r
	var $dt = "--"
	if $cd_dist.$j > 0
		$dt = @cm_dist_n($cd_dist.$j)
	if $b >= 0
		@d_circle($acx, $acy, $r, $th_line, $th_bg)
		var $ar = $b * pi / 180
		var $tx = $acx + sin($ar) * $r * 0.85
		var $ty = $acy - cos($ar) * $r * 0.85
		@d_line($acx - sin($ar) * $r * 0.5, $acy + cos($ar) * $r * 0.5, $tx, $ty, $th_accent)
		@d_line($tx, $ty, $tx - sin($ar - 0.5) * $r * 0.35, $ty + cos($ar - 0.5) * $r * 0.35, $th_accent)
		@d_line($tx, $ty, $tx - sin($ar + 0.5) * $r * 0.35, $ty + cos($ar + 0.5) * $r * 0.35, $th_accent)
		var $vx = $acx + $r + $cw
		var $vw = $x + $w - $cw - $vx
		var $vm = @fit_mul(size($dt), $vw, $r, 3)
		@ui_text_big($vx + $vw / 2, $acy - $chh * $vm / 2, $th_text, $dt, $vm)
		if $avh > $r * 2 + $chh
			@text_fit_c($vx + $vw / 2, $acy + $chh * $vm / 2 + 2, $th_dim, text("{0}°", $b), $vw)
	else
		var $vm2 = @fit_mul(size($dt), $w - $cw * 2, $avh, 3)
		@ui_text_big($x + $w / 2, $top + ($avh - $chh * $vm2) / 2, $th_text, $dt, $vm2)
	; a few values it sends, when there's room
	var $ly = $top + $r * 2 + $chh * 0.5
	if $b < 0
		$ly = $y + $h
	var $d = $cd_data.$j
	foreach $d ($k, $v)
		if isnumeric($v) and ($k != "version") and ($ly + $chh <= $y + $h - $chh * 0.2)
			var $lt = upper($k) & "  " & $v
			@ui_text($x + $cw, $ly, $th_dim, @ui_fit($lt, floor(($w - $cw * 2) / $cw)))
			$ly += $chh * 1.1
	if $all and ($cd_freq.size > 1)
		@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $h - $chh * 1.1, $th_dim, text("{}/{}  TAP FOR NEXT", $j + 1, $cd_freq.size), $w - $cw)

; ChipOS - CONTAINER CONTENTS widget (custom widget type 9, src "box:<alias>"):
; a scrolling list of what a container holds, most first. Scroll it by
; dragging on it or with the mouse wheel (after touching it).
array $cw_scr : number                  ; scroll position per widget
array $cw_bx1 : number                  ; where it was last drawn (desk coords)
array $cw_by1 : number
array $cw_bx2 : number
array $cw_by2 : number
array $cw_bt : number                   ; ... and when
array $cw_brh : number                  ; row height
array $cw_bmax : number                 ; largest scroll position
array $bx_k : text                      ; items being drawn
array $bx_v : number
var $wb_drag = -1                       ; widget being dragged
var $wb_hs = -1                         ; ... by the press that started at
var $wb_y0 = 0
var $wb_s0 = 0
var $wb_moved = 0
var $wb_px = -1                         ; last touch (desk coords)
var $wb_py = -1
var $wb_pt = -1000
var $bx_proj = 0                        ; drawing on a projected screen: pages turn by themselves

function @bx_pad($i : number)
	while $cw_scr.size <= $i
		$cw_scr.append(0)
		$cw_bx1.append(0)
		$cw_by1.append(0)
		$cw_bx2.append(0)
		$cw_by2.append(0)
		$cw_bt.append(-1000)
		$cw_brh.append(10)
		$cw_bmax.append(0)

function @bx_amt($k : text, $n : number) : text
	if find($k, "ARCHEAN_celestial.") == 0
		if $n >= 1000000
			return text("{0.0} t", $n / 1000000)
		if $n >= 1000
			return text("{0.0} kg", $n / 1000)
		return text("{0} g", $n)
	return text("{0}", $n)

; "ARCHEAN_celestial.OilShale" -> "OIL SHALE"
function @bx_name($k : text) : text
	var $s = $k
	var $p = find($s, ".")
	repeat 4 ($q)
		if $p >= 0
			$s = substring($s, $p + 1, size($s))
			$p = find($s, ".")
	var $o = ""
	var $n = size($s)
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $c = substring($s, $i, 1)
		if ($i > 0) and ($c != lower($c)) and (substring($s, $i - 1, 1) == lower(substring($s, $i - 1, 1)))
			$o = $o & " "
		$o = $o & $c
	return upper($o)

; Read and sort (most first) the container's contents into $bx_k / $bx_v.
function @bx_read($a : text)
	$bx_k.clear()
	$bx_v.clear()
	var $inv = @in_t($a, 0)
	foreach $inv ($k, $v)
		if isnumeric($v)
			var $q = $v:number
			if ($q > 0) and ($bx_k.size < 60)
				var $at = $bx_k.size
				var $nk = $bx_k.size
				repeat $nk ($j)
					if ($at == $nk) and ($q > $bx_v.$j)
						$at = $j
				if $at >= $nk
					$bx_k.append($k)
					$bx_v.append($q)
				else
					$bx_k.insert($at, $k)
					$bx_v.insert($at, $q)

function @cw_box($i : number, $x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number)
	@bx_pad($i)
	var $a = @spec_part($cw_src.$i, 1)
	@bx_read($a)
	var $n = $bx_k.size
	@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $chh * 0.5, $th_dim, $cw_name.$i, $w - $cw * 1.6)
	var $top = $y + $chh * 1.9
	var $rh = $chh * 1.3
	var $vis = max(floor(($y + $h - $chh * 0.4 - $top) / $rh), 1)
	var $mx = max($n - $vis, 0)
	$cw_scr.$i = clamp($cw_scr.$i, 0, $mx)
	var $scr = $cw_scr.$i
	if $bx_proj
		; other screens: show a page at a time, turning every 4 s
		var $pages = ceil(($mx + $vis) / $vis)
		$scr = min(@posmod(floor(time / 4), $pages) * $vis, $mx)
	else
		$cw_bx1.$i = $x
		$cw_by1.$i = $y - $pg_hdy
		$cw_bx2.$i = $x + $w
		$cw_by2.$i = $y + $h - $pg_hdy
		$cw_bt.$i = time
	$cw_brh.$i = $rh
	$cw_bmax.$i = $mx
	if $n == 0
		var $em = "EMPTY"
		if @db_idx_alias($a) < 0
			$em = "NOT FOUND"
		@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $top + $chh * 0.4, $th_dim, $em, $w - $cw * 1.6)
		return
	var $sbw = 0
	if $mx > 0
		$sbw = max($cw * 0.6, 4)
	var $tx = $x + $cw * 0.7
	var $tw = $w - $cw * 1.4 - $sbw
	var $nr = min($vis, $n - $scr)
	repeat $nr ($r)
		var $k = $scr + $r
		var $ry = $top + $r * $rh
		var $am = @bx_amt($bx_k.$k, $bx_v.$k)
		var $room = floor(($tw - $cw * (size($am) + 1)) / $cw)
		@ui_text($tx, $ry, $th_text, @ui_fit(@bx_name($bx_k.$k), max($room, 3)))
		@ui_text_r($tx + $tw, $ry, $th_accent, $am)
	if $mx > 0
		; a thin scrollbar on the right
		var $sx = $x + $w - $cw * 0.4 - $sbw
		var $sh = $vis * $rh
		@ui_box($sx, $top, $sbw, $sh, $th_bg, $th_line)
		var $tl = max($sh * $vis / $n, $chh * 0.6)
		var $ty = $top + ($sh - $tl) * $scr / $mx
		@ui_box($sx, $ty, $sbw, $tl, $th_accent, $th_accent)

; Which container widget (drawn in the last 2 s) is at desk point x, y?
function @bx_at($x : number, $y : number) : number
	var $n = $cw_bt.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if (time - $cw_bt.$i < 2) and ($x >= $cw_bx1.$i) and ($x <= $cw_bx2.$i) and ($y >= $cw_by1.$i) and ($y <= $cw_by2.$i)
			return $i
	return -1

; A press held and moved on a container widget scrolls it (called while the
; finger / button is held). Only a real move counts, so a long press still
; edits the home screen.
function @bx_drag($x : number, $y : number) : number
	$wb_px = $x
	$wb_py = $y
	$wb_pt = time
	if $ui_page != "home"
		return 0
	var $i = @bx_at($x, $y)
	if ($wb_drag < 0) or ($wb_hs != $hold_start)
		$wb_drag = $i
		$wb_hs = $hold_start
		$wb_y0 = $y
		$wb_moved = 0
		if $i >= 0
			$wb_s0 = $cw_scr.$i
		return 0
	if ($wb_drag < 0) or ($wb_drag >= $cw_scr.size)
		return 0
	var $d = $y - $wb_y0
	if abs($d) > $chh * 0.6
		$wb_moved = 1
	if !$wb_moved
		return 0
	var $k = $wb_drag
	var $np = clamp($wb_s0 - round($d / max($cw_brh.$k, 1)), 0, $cw_bmax.$k)
	if $np != $cw_scr.$k
		$cw_scr.$k = $np
		$ui_dirty = 1
	return 1

; Mouse wheel: the container widget touched last (in the last 30 s).
function @bx_wheel($d : number) : number
	if ($ui_page != "home") or (time - $wb_pt > 30)
		return 0
	var $i = @bx_at($wb_px, $wb_py)
	if $i < 0
		return 0
	$cw_scr.$i = clamp($cw_scr.$i - sign($d) * 2, 0, $cw_bmax.$i)
	$ui_dirty = 1
	return 1

function @bx_touch($x : number, $y : number)
	$wb_px = $x
	$wb_py = $y
	$wb_pt = time

function @cw_draw_in($i : number, $x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number)
	var $t = $cw_type.$i
	if $t == 6
		; clock:<style>:<zone>:<dst>:<date format>
		var $cs = $cw_src.$i
		var $c1 = @spec_part($cs, 1)
		var $c2 = @spec_part($cs, 2)
		var $c3 = @spec_part($cs, 3)
		var $c4 = @spec_part($cs, 4)
		@clock_widget($x, $y, $w, $h, $c1:number, $c2:number, $c3:number, $c4:number)
		return
	var $nm = @ui_fit($cw_name.$i, floor(($w - $cw * 1.6) / $cw))
	@ui_box($x, $y, $w, $h, $th_panel, $th_line)
	if (($t <= 3) or ($t == 7)) and @cw_is_temp($i)
		$ui_hv = $i
		@ui_hit($x, $y, $x + $w, $y + $h, "cw_press")
	if $t == 7
		@cw_graph($i, $x, $y, $w, $h)
		return
	if $t == 8
		@cw_card($i, $x, $y, $w, $h)
		return
	if $t == 9
		@cw_box($i, $x, $y, $w, $h)
		return
	var $tx = $x + $cw * 0.8
	if $t <= 3
		var $v = @cw_value($i)
		var $vt = @cw_value_text($v)
		var $frac = clamp(($v - $cv_lo) / max($cv_hi - $cv_lo, 0.000001), 0, 1)
		var $col = $th_accent
		if $cv_unit == "%"
			$col = $th_ok
			if $v < $pw_restore
				$col = $th_warn
			if $v < $pw_low
				$col = $th_bad
		var $cdk = $th_accent_dk
		if $col == $th_ok
			$cdk = $th_ok_dk
		elseif $col == $th_warn
			$cdk = color(92, 62, 10)
		elseif $col == $th_bad
			$cdk = $th_bad_dk
		; name: centered at the top, shrunk to fit
		@text_fit_c($x + $w / 2, $y + $chh * 0.5, $th_dim, $cw_name.$i, $w - $cw * 1.6)
		if $t == 1
			; bar fills the rest; value centered inside it, white on dark
			var $bx = $x + $cw * 0.8
			var $bw = $w - $cw * 1.6
			var $by = $y + $chh * 2
			var $bh = max($h - $chh * 2.6, $chh * 1.2)
			@ui_box($bx, $by, $bw, $bh, $th_bg, $th_line)
			if ($v >= $cv_lo) and ($frac > 0)
				@ui_box($bx, $by, max($bw * $frac, 2), $bh, $cdk, $col)
			var $bm = @fit_mul(size($vt), $bw - $cw * 1.2, $bh * 0.7, 4)
			@ui_text_big($bx + $bw / 2, $by + ($bh - $chh * $bm) / 2, $th_text, $vt, $bm)
		elseif $t == 2
			; semicircle gauge with needle
			var $gcx = $x + $w / 2
			var $gav = $h - $chh * 2 - $chh * 2.4
			var $gwide = $w > $h * 1.8
			if $gwide
				$gav = $h - $chh * 2.8
			var $gr = max(min($w * 0.42, $gav), $chh)
			if $gwide
				$gr = max(min($gav, $w * 0.22), $chh)
				$gcx = $x + $cw + $gr + $w * 0.04
			var $gcy = $y + $chh * 2 + $gr + max($gav - $gr, 0) / 2
			repeat 25 ($a)
				var $an = pi + $a * pi / 24
				var $an2 = pi + ($a + 1) * pi / 24
				var $acol = $th_line
				if ($a + 0.5) / 25 <= $frac
					$acol = $col
				if $a < 24
					@d_line($gcx + cos($an) * $gr, $gcy + sin($an) * $gr, $gcx + cos($an2) * $gr, $gcy + sin($an2) * $gr, $acol)
					@d_line($gcx + cos($an) * ($gr - 2), $gcy + sin($an) * ($gr - 2), $gcx + cos($an2) * ($gr - 2), $gcy + sin($an2) * ($gr - 2), $acol)
			var $na = pi + $frac * pi
			@d_line($gcx, $gcy, $gcx + cos($na) * $gr * 0.85, $gcy + sin($na) * $gr * 0.85, $th_text)
			@d_circle($gcx, $gcy, $chh * 0.3, $th_text, $th_text)
			if $gwide
				var $vx0 = $gcx + $gr + $cw
				var $vw = $x + $w - $cw - $vx0
				var $vm = @fit_mul(size($vt), $vw, $gr * 0.9, 4)
				@ui_text_big($vx0 + $vw / 2, $gcy - $gr / 2 - $chh * $vm / 2, $th_text, $vt, $vm)
			else
				var $vby = $gcy + $chh * 0.5
				var $vbh = $y + $h - $vby - $chh * 0.3
				var $vm2 = @fit_mul(size($vt), $gr * 1.6, $vbh, 3)
				@ui_text_big($gcx, $vby, $th_text, $vt, $vm2)
		else
			var $mul = clamp(min($w / ($cw * (size($vt) + 2)), ($h - $chh * 2) / ($chh * 1.4)), 1, 4)
			$mul = max(1, floor($mul * $ts + 0.001)) / $ts
			@ui_text_big($x + $w / 2, $y + $chh * 1.8 + ($h - $chh * 2 - $chh * $mul) / 2, $col, $vt, $mul)
	else
		var $on = @cw_state($i)
		var $st = 0
		if $on
			$st = 3
		var $lab = $nm
		if $t == 5
			$lab = $nm & "  " & "OFF"
			if $on
				$lab = $nm & "  " & "ON"
		$ui_hv = $i
		@ui_btn($x + $cw * 0.4, $y + $chh * 0.4, $w - $cw * 0.8, $h - $chh * 0.8, $lab, "cw_press", $st)

	if $ts != $sv_ts

xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - local sunrise / sunset from a solar time server (beacon).
; Primary: "Solar4488V2" packets (frequency 4488): a sun model that ChipOS
; turns into LOCAL times with this build's Nav latitude/longitude.
; Fallback: plain "SUN SET hh:mm:ss" / "SUN RISE hh:mm:ss" countdowns
; (frequency 8844) - the server's own events, not local ones.
storage var $ts_ver : number
storage var $ts_on : number             ; listen for the time server
storage var $ts_freq : text             ; primary (Solar4488V2)
storage var $ts_fb : text               ; fallback (SUN SET / SUN RISE text)
var $sun_ok = 0                         ; 0 none, 1 local model, 2 server countdown
var $sun_t0 = 0                         ; model reference time (unix)
var $sun_h0 = 0                         ; local hour angle at t0 (rad)
var $sun_w = 0                          ; hour angle rate (rad/s)
var $sun_d = 0                          ; declination (rad)
var $sun_phi = 0                        ; latitude (rad)
var $sun_ev_t = 0                       ; fallback: time of the next event
var $sun_ev_set = 0                     ; fallback: 1 = that event is a sunset
var $sun_heard = 0                      ; last time the server was heard

function @ts_load()
	if $ts_ver != 1
		$ts_on = 1
		$ts_freq = "4488"
		$ts_fb = "8844"
		$ts_ver = 1

function @sun_wrap($a : number) : number
	return $a - floor(($a + pi) / (2 * pi)) * 2 * pi

; Read one Solar4488V2 packet. $lat/$lon from the Nav (degrees).
function @sun_from_packet($p : text, $lat : number, $lon : number) : number
	if $p.protocol != "Solar4488V2"
		return 0
	if !isnumeric($p.solarhourangle) or !isnumeric($p.solardeclination) or !isnumeric($p.solarhouranglerate) or !isnumeric($p.sampletime)
		return 0
	if isnumeric($p.modelvalid)
		if $p.modelvalid:number != 1
			return 0
	var $rate = $p.solarhouranglerate:number
	if (abs($rate) < 2 * pi / 5184000) or (abs($rate) > 2 * pi / 3600)
		return 0
	var $age = time - $p.sampletime:number
	if ($age < -2) or ($age > 30)
		return 0
	var $sgn = 1
	if isnumeric($p.longitudehouranglesign)
		$sgn = $p.longitudehouranglesign:number
	var $slon = $lon
	if isnumeric($p.sourcelongitude)
		$slon = $p.sourcelongitude:number
	var $drift = 0
	if isnumeric($p.solardeclinationrate)
		$drift = $p.solardeclinationrate:number
	$sun_t0 = time
	$sun_w = $rate
	$sun_d = $p.solardeclination:number + $drift * $age
	$sun_phi = $lat * pi / 180
	$sun_h0 = @sun_wrap($p.solarhourangle:number + $rate * $age + $sgn * ($lon - $slon) * pi / 180)
	$sun_ok = 1
	$sun_heard = time
	return 1

; Fallback text: "SUN SET 01:23:45" / "SUN RISE 01:23:45".
function @sun_from_text($m : text) : number
	var $n = size($m)
	if $n < 16
		return 0
	var $hms = substring($m, $n - 8, 8)
	if (substring($hms, 2, 1) != ":") or (substring($hms, 5, 1) != ":")
		return 0
	var $hh = substring($hms, 0, 2)
	var $mm = substring($hms, 3, 2)
	var $ss = substring($hms, 6, 2)
	if !isnumeric($hh) or !isnumeric($mm) or !isnumeric($ss)
		return 0
	var $rem = $hh:number * 3600 + $mm:number * 60 + $ss:number
	if find($m, "SUN SET") == 0
		$sun_ev_set = 1
	elseif find($m, "SUN RISE") == 0
		$sun_ev_set = 0
	else
		return 0
	$sun_ev_t = time + $rem
	if $sun_ok != 1
		$sun_ok = 2
	$sun_heard = time
	return 1

; Half-day hour angle of the horizon crossing (-1 never sets, -2 never rises).
function @sun_h0x() : number
	var $c = -tan($sun_phi) * tan($sun_d)
	if $c <= -1
		return -1
	if $c >= 1
		return -2
	return atan(sqrt(1 - $c * $c), $c)

; Unix time of the next sunrise ($set = 0) or sunset ($set = 1); -1 = none.
function @sun_next($set : number) : number
	if $sun_ok == 2
		if ($sun_ev_set == $set) and ($sun_ev_t >= time)
			return $sun_ev_t
		return -1
	if $sun_ok != 1
		return -1
	var $hx = @sun_h0x()
	if $hx < 0
		return -1
	var $target = -$hx
	if $set
		$target = $hx
	var $h = $sun_h0 + $sun_w * (time - $sun_t0)
	var $dh = $target - $h
	var $per = 2 * pi / abs($sun_w)
	var $dt = $dh / $sun_w
	$dt = $dt - floor($dt / $per) * $per
	return time + $dt

; 1 sun up, 0 down, -1 unknown.
function @sun_up() : number
	if $sun_ok == 1
		var $h = $sun_h0 + $sun_w * (time - $sun_t0)
		var $alt = sin($sun_phi) * sin($sun_d) + cos($sun_phi) * cos($sun_d) * cos($h)
		return $alt > 0
	if $sun_ok == 2
		if $sun_ev_t >= time
			return $sun_ev_set
	return -1

; "06:42" in the system time zone ("--:--" when unknown).
function @sun_hm($t : number) : text
	if $t < 0
		return "--:--"
	@clk_calc_at($t, -1, 0)
	return @fmt_hm($ck_h, $ck_mi, $cfg_24h)

function @sun_line() : text
	if $sun_ok == 0
		return "SUN: NO TIME SERVER"
	var $hx = 0
	if $sun_ok == 1
		$hx = @sun_h0x()
	if $hx == -1
		return "SUN: UP ALL DAY (POLAR)"
	if $hx == -2
		return "SUN: DOWN ALL DAY (POLAR)"
	var $src = "LOCAL"
	if $sun_ok == 2
		$src = "SERVER"

; ChipOS - LIGHTS app: every light, the groups, all on / off, and colour
; (Lamp: in 0 on/off, 1-3 red/green/blue 0-255).
var $lt_tgt = 0                         ; colour target: 0 all, 1.. groups, then lights
array $lt_list : text                   ; light aliases now
var $lt_autos = ""                      ; "|group|" groups run as outside lights (from AUTOMATE)

function @lg_isauto($g : number) : number
	return find($lt_autos, "|" & $gp_name.$g & "|") >= 0

function @lt_scan()
	$lt_list.clear()
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if ($db_cat.$j == 1) and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			$lt_list.append($db_alias.$j)

function @lt_count() : number
	var $c = 0
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if ($db_cat.$j == 1) and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			$c += 1
	return $c

function @lt_set_color($a : text, $rgb : number)
	var $n = $lt_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $lt_a.$i == $a
			$lt_rgb.$i = $rgb
			return
	$lt_a.append($a)
	$lt_rgb.append($rgb)

function @lt_color_of($a : text) : number
	var $n = $lt_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $lt_a.$i == $a
			return $lt_rgb.$i
	return -1

; Target name for the colour row.
function @lt_tgt_name() : text
	var $ng = $gp_name.size
	if $lt_tgt == 0
		return "ALL LIGHTS"
	if $lt_tgt <= $ng
		return "GROUP " & $gp_name.($lt_tgt - 1)
	var $k = $lt_tgt - 1 - $ng
	if $k < $lt_list.size
		return $lt_list.$k
	return "ALL LIGHTS"

function @lt_palette($i : number) : number
	if $i == 0
		return 255 * 65536 + 244 * 256 + 214
	if $i == 1
		return 255 * 65536 + 255 * 256 + 255
	if $i == 2
		return 255 * 65536 + 60 * 256 + 40
	if $i == 3
		return 255 * 65536 + 150 * 256 + 20
	if $i == 4
		return 255 * 65536 + 230 * 256 + 40
	if $i == 5
		return 40 * 65536 + 230 * 256 + 80
	if $i == 6
		return 40 * 65536 + 140 * 256 + 255
	return 190 * 65536 + 60 * 256 + 255

function @page_lights()
	@lt_scan()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 64)
	var $y = $content_y
	var $on = 0
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if ($db_cat.$j == 1) and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1) and ($db_on.$j == 1)
			$on += 1
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, text("{} LIGHTS, {} ON", $lt_list.size, $on), $tw)
	var $bh = $chh * 2.2
	var $gap = $cw * 0.5
	var $bw = ($tw - $gap * 3) / 4
	@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $bw, $bh, "ALL ON", "lt_allon", 3)
	@ui_btn($content_x + $bw + $gap, $y, $bw, $bh, "ALL OFF", "lt_alloff", 0)
	@ui_btn($content_x + ($bw + $gap) * 2, $y, $bw, $bh, "GROUPS", "go:lt_groups", 0)
	@ui_btn($content_x + ($bw + $gap) * 3, $y, $bw, $bh, "JUNCTIONS", "go:lt_jx", 0)
	$y += $bh + $chh * 0.4
	; colour: target + swatches
	var $tl = @ui_fit("COLOUR: " & @lt_tgt_name(), floor(($tw * 0.45) / $cw))
	@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $tw * 0.45, $bh, $tl, "lt_tgt", 0)
	var $sx = $content_x + $tw * 0.45 + $gap
	var $sw = ($content_x + $tw - $sx) / 8
	repeat 8 ($p)
		var $c = @lt_palette($p)
		var $col = color(floor($c / 65536), mod(floor($c / 256), 256), mod($c, 256))
		@ui_box($sx + $p * $sw + 1, $y + 2, $sw - 2, $bh - 4, $col, $th_line)
		$ui_hv = $p
		@ui_hit($sx + $p * $sw, $y, $sx + ($p + 1) * $sw, $y + $bh, "lt_col")
	$y += $bh + $chh * 0.4
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $ng = $gp_name.size
	repeat $ng ($g)
		var $gs = "OFF"
		if @tgt_state("group:" & $gp_name.$g)
			$gs = "ON"
		var $ga = ""
		if @lg_isauto($g)
			$ga = "  (AUTO)"
		$sl_txt.append("GROUP " & $gp_name.$g & text(" ({})  ", @gp_count($g)) & $gs & $ga)
		$sl_spec.append("group:" & $gp_name.$g)
	; v0.29.3: straight from the device list (no search per light - a big
	; base ran out of instructions)
	var $ln = 0
	repeat $n ($l)
		if ($db_cat.$l == 1) and ($db_alias.$l != "") and ($db_seen.$l >= $scan_gen - 1)
			var $st = "OFF"
			if $db_on.$l == 1
				$st = "ON"
			$sl_txt.append($db_alias.$l & "   " & $st)
			$sl_spec.append($db_alias.$l)
			$ln += 1
	if $ln == 0
		$sl_txt.append("NO LIGHTS WITH AN ALIAS")
		$sl_spec.append("")
	var $sv_y = $content_y
	var $sv_h = $content_h
	$content_y = $y
	$content_h = $sv_y + $sv_h - $y
	@pick_list("TAP TO SWITCH", "", "lt_tog")
	$content_y = $sv_y
	$content_h = $sv_h

function @lt_action($act : text, $val : number)
	var $n = $db_id.size
	if ($act == "lt_allon") or ($act == "lt_alloff")
		var $v = $act == "lt_allon"
		repeat $n ($j)
			if ($db_cat.$j == 1) and ($db_alias.$j != "")
				$db_on.$j = $v
		$assert_next = 0
		$db_rev += 1
	elseif $act == "lt_tog"
		if ($val < $sl_spec.size) and ($sl_spec.$val != "")
			var $t = $sl_spec.$val
			@tgt_set($t, !@tgt_state($t))
	elseif $act == "lt_tgt"
		@lt_scan()
		$lt_tgt = @posmod($lt_tgt + 1, 1 + $gp_name.size + $lt_list.size)
	elseif $act == "lt_col"
		@lt_scan()
		var $c = @lt_palette($val)
		var $ng = $gp_name.size
		repeat $n ($j2)
			if ($db_cat.$j2 == 1) and ($db_alias.$j2 != "")
				var $a = $db_alias.$j2
				var $hit = $lt_tgt == 0
				if ($lt_tgt > 0) and ($lt_tgt <= $ng)
					$hit = @gp_has($lt_tgt - 1, $a)
				elseif $lt_tgt > $ng
					var $k = $lt_tgt - 1 - $ng
					if $k < $lt_list.size
						$hit = $lt_list.$k == $a
				if $hit
					@lt_set_color($a, $c)
		$assert_next = 0
	$ui_dirty = 1

; Recipe index for an item key (-1 = not craftable).
function @rc_find($k : text) : number
	var $n = $rc_key.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $rc_key.$i == $k
			return $i
	return -1

; Short name of an item key ("ARCHEAN_parts.Screw" -> "Screw"; recipe label if known).
function @rc_name($k : text) : text
	var $r = @rc_find($k)
	if $r >= 0
		return $rc_label.$r
	var $p = find($k, ".")
	if $p >= 0
		return substring($k, $p + 1, size($k))
	return $k

xc_files.name: auto.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - relay groups and automations (IF -> THEN rules).
; Groups: a name plus a member list ",alias1,alias2,".
storage array $gp_name : text
storage array $gp_mem : text
; Rules: type 1 battery below A% (until above B%), 2 battery above A%
; (until below B%), 3 time of day from A to B (minutes), 4 night: solar
; below A W.  Target: relay/light alias or "group:<name>".  Act: 1 turn ON,
; 0 turn OFF while the condition holds; the opposite when it ends.
storage array $au_type : number
storage array $au_a : number
storage array $au_b : number
storage array $au_tgt : text
storage array $au_act : number
storage array $au_en : number
array $au_st : number                   ; -2 not evaluated yet, -1 undecided, 0 / 1
var $au_next = 0
; rule being built
var $aun_type = 1
var $aun_tgt = ""
var $aun_act = 1
var $aun_a = 20
var $aun_b = 80
var $aun_edit = -1                      ; editing an existing rule (-1 = new)
var $gp_cur = -1                        ; group being edited

function @db_idx_alias($a : text) : number
	if $a == ""
		return -1
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if $db_alias.$j == $a
			return $j
	return -1

function @gp_find($nm : text) : number
	var $n = $gp_name.size
	repeat $n ($g)
		if $gp_name.$g == $nm
			return $g
	return -1

function @gp_has($g : number, $a : text) : number
	if ($g < 0) or ($g >= $gp_mem.size) or ($a == "")
		return 0
	return find($gp_mem.$g, "," & $a & ",") >= 0

function @gp_toggle($g : number, $a : text)
	if @gp_has($g, $a)
		var $m = $gp_mem.$g
		var $p = find($m, "," & $a & ",")
		$gp_mem.$g = substring($m, 0, $p) & substring($m, $p + size($a) + 1, size($m))
	else
		$gp_mem.$g = $gp_mem.$g & $a & ","

function @gp_count($g : number) : number
	var $c = 0
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if @gp_has($g, $db_alias.$j)
			$c += 1
	return $c

; Switch a relay/light or a whole group.
function @tgt_set($t : text, $on : number)
	if find($t, "group:") == 0
		var $g = @gp_find(substring($t, 6, size($t)))
		var $n = $db_id.size
		repeat $n ($j)
			if @gp_has($g, $db_alias.$j)
				$db_on.$j = $on
	else
		var $k = @db_idx_alias($t)
		if $k >= 0
			$db_on.$k = $on
	$assert_next = 0
	$db_rev += 1

; 1 if on (a group: all members on).
function @tgt_state($t : text) : number
	if find($t, "group:") == 0
		var $g = @gp_find(substring($t, 6, size($t)))
		var $n = $db_id.size
		var $any = 0
		var $all = 1
		repeat $n ($j)
			if @gp_has($g, $db_alias.$j)
				$any = 1
				if $db_on.$j != 1
					$all = 0
		return $any and $all
	var $k = @db_idx_alias($t)
	if $k < 0
		return 0
	return $db_on.$k == 1

function @tgt_name($t : text) : text
	if find($t, "group:") == 0
		return "GROUP " & upper(substring($t, 6, size($t)))
	return $t

function @au_pad()
	repeat 100 ($q)
		if $au_st.size < $au_type.size
			$au_st.append(-2)
	if $au_st.size > $au_type.size
		$au_st.clear()

function @hm_text($m : number) : text
	var $h = floor($m / 60)
	var $mi = $m - $h * 60
	return @fmt_hm($h, $mi, $cfg_24h)

function @au_desc_of($ty : number, $a : number, $b : number, $tg : text, $ac : number) : text
	var $an = "ON"
	var $nn = "OFF"
	if !$ac
		$an = "OFF"
		$nn = "ON"
	var $tn = @tgt_name($tg)
	if $ty == 1
		return text("BATTERY BELOW {}%: ", $a) & $tn & " " & $an & " (" & $nn & text(" ABOVE {}%)", $b)
	if $ty == 2
		return text("BATTERY ABOVE {}%: ", $a) & $tn & " " & $an & " (" & $nn & text(" BELOW {}%)", $b)
	if $ty == 3
		var $ta = @hm_text($a)
		var $tb = @hm_text($b)
		return $ta & " - " & $tb & ": " & $tn & " " & $an & " (" & $nn & " OTHERWISE)"
	if $ty == 5
		return "SUNSET TO SUNRISE: " & $tn & " " & $an & " (" & $nn & " BY DAY)"
	var $sw = @fmt_power($a)
	return "NIGHT (SOLAR UNDER " & $sw & "): " & $tn & " " & $an & " (" & $nn & " BY DAY)"

function @au_desc($i : number) : text
	return @au_desc_of($au_type.$i, $au_a.$i, $au_b.$i, $au_tgt.$i, $au_act.$i)

; 1 condition holds, 0 it has ended, -1 in between (keep the last state).
function @au_eval($i : number) : number
	var $ty = $au_type.$i
	var $a = $au_a.$i
	var $b = $au_b.$i
	if ($ty == 1) or ($ty == 2)
		if $pw_pct < 0
			return -1
		if $ty == 1
			if $pw_pct < $a
				return 1
			if $pw_pct > $b
				return 0
			return -1
		if $pw_pct > $a
			return 1
		if $pw_pct < $b
			return 0
		return -1
	if $ty == 3
		@clk_calc(-1, 0)
		var $m = $ck_h * 60 + $ck_mi
		if $a <= $b
			return ($m >= $a) and ($m < $b)
		return ($m >= $a) or ($m < $b)
	if $ty == 5
		var $up = @sun_up()
		if $up < 0
			return -1
		return !$up
	if $ps_idx.size == 0
		return -1
	if $pw_solar < $a
		return 1
	if $pw_solar > $a * 2 + 50
		return 0
	return -1

; Every 2 s: act only when a rule's condition changes, so the user can still
; flip things by hand in between.
function @au_tick()
	if time < $au_next
		return
	$au_next = time + 2
	@au_pad()
	var $n = $au_type.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $au_en.$i
			var $e = @au_eval($i)
			if ($e < 0) and ($au_st.$i == -2)
				$au_st.$i = -1
			if ($e >= 0) and ($e != $au_st.$i)
				var $first = $au_st.$i == -2
				$au_st.$i = $e
				var $want = $au_act.$i
				if !$e
					$want = !$want
				@tgt_set($au_tgt.$i, $want)
				if !$first
					var $wl = "OFF"
					if $want
						$wl = "ON"
					var $tn = @tgt_name($au_tgt.$i)
					$pw_nq.append("AUTOMATION: " & $tn & " " & $wl)

function @au_add($ty : number, $a : number, $b : number, $tg : text, $ac : number)
	$au_type.append($ty)
	$au_a.append($a)
	$au_b.append($b)
	$au_tgt.append($tg)
	$au_act.append($ac)
	$au_en.append(1)
	@au_pad()

function @au_remove($i : number)
	$au_type.erase($i)
	$au_a.erase($i)
	$au_b.erase($i)
	$au_tgt.erase($i)
	$au_act.erase($i)
	$au_en.erase($i)
	$au_st.clear()
	@au_pad()

; Defaults for a new rule of type $ty.
function @aun_defaults($ty : number)
	$aun_type = $ty
	if $ty == 1
		$aun_a = 20
		$aun_b = 80
	elseif $ty == 2
		$aun_a = 95
		$aun_b = 85
	elseif $ty == 3
		$aun_a = 19 * 60
		$aun_b = 6 * 60
	else
		$aun_a = 100
		$aun_b = 0

xc_files.name: kitfeed.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - App Kit v4 data feeds: apps that ask for them (manifest .want{...})
; get the nav position / heading / current target and the saved contacts,
; twice a second, on their input channel 1.
var $kf_next = 0

function @kf_clean($t : text) : text
	return replace(replace(replace(replace(replace($t, "~", "-"), "{", "("), "}", ")"), "|", "/"), ".", " ")

function @kf_nav() : text
	@att_find_nav()
	if $att_nav == ""
		return ".nok{0}"
	var $lat = @in_n($att_nav, 8)
	var $lon = @in_n($att_nav, 9)
	if ($lat == 0) and ($lon == 0)
		return ".nok{0}"
	var $hd = @in_n($att_nav, 6)
	var $f = ".nok{1}.lat{" & text("{0.000000}", $lat) & "}.lon{" & text("{0.000000}", $lon) & "}.hd{" & text("{0.0}", $hd) & "}"
	var $td = @in_n($att_nav, 23)
	if $td > 0
		var $tb = @posmod($hd + @in_n($att_nav, 25) * 180, 360)
		$f = $f & ".tdist{" & text("{0}", $td) & "}.tbrg{" & text("{0.0}", $tb) & "}"
	return $f

function @kf_contacts($hd : number) : text
	@cd_pad()
	var $n = min($cd_freq.size, 16)
	var $f = ".cn{" & text("{}", $n) & "}"
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $d = $cd_data.$i
		var $la = ""
		var $lo = ""
		if isnumeric($d.lat) and isnumeric($d.lon)
			$la = $d.lat
			$lo = $d.lon
		var $b = @cd_bearing($i)
		var $bt = "-1"
		if ($b >= 0) and ($cd_t.$i > 0)
			$bt = text("{0.0}", @posmod($b + $hd, 360))
		var $dt = "-1"
		if ($cd_dist.$i > 0) and ($cd_t.$i > 0)
			$dt = text("{0}", $cd_dist.$i)
		var $age = -1
		if $cd_t.$i > 0
			$age = max(0, time - $cd_t.$i)
		$f = $f & ".c" & text("{}", $i) & "{" & @kf_clean(@cd_label($i)) & "~" & $la & "~" & $lo & "~" & $bt & "~" & $dt & "~" & text("{0}", $age) & "}"
	return $f

function @kf_tick()
	if time < $kf_next
		return
	$kf_next = time + 0.5
	var $n = min($xa_alias.size, $xa_want.size)
	var $nav = ""
	var $con = ""
	repeat $n ($k)
		if $xa_online.$k and ($xa_want.$k != "")
			var $w = $xa_want.$k
			var $f = ""
			if contains($w, "nav") or contains($w, "contacts")
				if $nav == ""
					$nav = @kf_nav()
				$f = $nav
			if contains($w, "base")
				; v0.25.3: this build's name (COMMS network name) and the
				; frequency carrying chip.weather packets, when ChipOS has one
				var $wxf = ""
				if @ws_on() and $ws_ok and ($cm_mode == 2) and ($cm_freq != "")
					$wxf = $cm_freq
				elseif ($cm_wx != "") and ($wx_pkt != "") and (time - $wx_t < 60)
					$wxf = $cm_wx
				$f = $f & ".net{" & @kf_clean($cm_name) & "}.wxf{" & @kf_clean($wxf) & "}"
				; v0.29: the time server frequencies ChipOS sends on
				var $tq = @tsv_fields("")
				$f = $f & ".tsp{" & @kf_clean($tq.solarfrequency) & "}.tsl{" & @kf_clean($tq.solarfallbackfrequency) & "}.tst{" & @kf_clean($tq.timefrequency) & "}"
			if contains($w, "contacts")
				if $con == ""
					var $hd = 0
					if $nav.nok == "1"
						$hd = $nav.hd:number
					$con = @kf_contacts($hd)
				$f = $f & $con
			if $f != $xa_feed.$k
				$xa_feed.$k = $f
				@out_t($xa_alias.$k, 1, $f)

xc_files.name: power.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - POWER: batteries, solar, relays, low-battery rule.
; Battery: ch0 voltage, ch1 capacity, ch2 charge 0-1.  Solar panel: ch0
; generated W, ch1 delivered W.  Relay: output ch0 = on/off.
storage var $pw_ver : number
storage var $pw_low : number
storage var $pw_restore : number
storage var $pw_low2 : number           ; LOW-priority tier: off below
storage var $pw_restore2 : number       ; ... back on above
storage var $pw_main_alias : text       ; chosen main battery ("" = guess from names)

array $pb_idx : number          ; batteries (db index) with live readings
array $pb_charge : number
array $pb_volt : number
array $pb_cap : number
array $ps_idx : number          ; solar panels
array $ps_w : number
array $pp_idx : number          ; propellers (generation candidates)
array $pp_rps : number
array $pp_thr : number
array $pw_hist : number         ; total charge %, one sample a minute
array $pw_hist24 : number       ; total charge %, one sample every 12 minutes
array $pw_nq : text             ; notifications waiting to be posted
var $pw_hist24_next = 0
var $pw_usage = 0               ; estimated use, W (generation - flow)
var $pw_main_k = -1             ; index in $pb_idx of the main battery
var $pw_cap = 0
var $pw_stored = 0
var $pw_pct = -1
var $pw_flow = 0                ; W, + charging / - draining (smoothed)
var $pw_prev = -1
var $pw_prev_t = 0
var $pw_prev_cap = -1
var $pw_solar = 0
var $pw_spot = 0                        ; solar potential: every panel at its best output seen
storage var $ps_pk : text               ; ".panel{best W}" per solar panel
var $pw_next = 0
var $pw_hist_next = 0
var $pw_bat_count = 0
var $pw_main_pct = -1             ; the "main" battery if one is named so
var $pw_note = ""               ; pending notification (posted by main)
var $pw_sub = 0                 ; POWER sub tab: 0 batteries, 1 generation, 2 relays

function @pw_load()
	if ($pw_ver != 1) and ($pw_ver != 2)
		$pw_low = 15
		$pw_restore = 25
		$pw_main_alias = ""
	if $pw_ver != 2
		; v0.7: priorities 0 LOW, 1 NORMAL, 2 ESSENTIAL (old KEEP -> ESSENTIAL,
		; old SHED -> NORMAL, which keeps the old behaviour)
		var $mg_n = $db_ess.size
		repeat $mg_n ($mg)
			if $db_ess.$mg == 1
				$db_ess.$mg = 2
			else
				$db_ess.$mg = 1
		$pw_low2 = 30
		$pw_restore2 = 40
		$pw_ver = 2

function @fmt_power($w : number) : text
	var $fa = abs($w)
	if $fa >= 1000000
		return text("{0.00} MW", $w / 1000000)
	if $fa >= 1000
		return text("{0.0} kW", $w / 1000)
	return text("{0} W", $w)

function @fmt_energy($wh : number) : text
	if $wh >= 1000000
		return text("{0.00} MWh", $wh / 1000000)
	if $wh >= 1000
		return text("{0.0} kWh", $wh / 1000)
	return text("{0} Wh", $wh)

function @fmt_dur($s : number) : text
	if $s >= 86400 * 3
		return ">3 DAYS"
	var $fh = floor($s / 3600)
	var $fm = floor(mod($s, 3600) / 60)
	if $fh > 0
		return text("{}h {}m", $fh, $fm)
	return text("{}m", max($fm, 1))

; Once a second: read every named battery and solar panel.
function @pw_tick()
	if time < $pw_next
		return
	var $pt_dt = time - $pw_prev_t
	$pw_next = time + 1
	$pb_idx.clear()
	$pb_charge.clear()
	$pb_volt.clear()
	$pb_cap.clear()
	$ps_idx.clear()
	$ps_w.clear()
	$pp_idx.clear()
	$pp_rps.clear()
	$pp_thr.clear()
	var $cap = 0
	var $stored = 0
	var $solar = 0
	var $spot = 0
	var $pt_n = $db_id.size
	repeat $pt_n ($pj)
		var $pa = $db_alias.$pj
		if ($pa != "") and (($db_seen.$pj >= $scan_gen - 1))
			var $pc = $db_cat.$pj
			if $pc == 3
				var $b_v = @in_n($pa, 0)
				var $b_c = max(@in_n($pa, 1), 0)
				var $b_q = clamp(@in_n($pa, 2), 0, 1)
				$pb_idx.append($pj)
				$pb_volt.append($b_v)
				$pb_cap.append($b_c)
				$pb_charge.append($b_q)
				$cap += $b_c
				$stored += $b_c * $b_q
			elseif $pc == 13
				var $s_w = max(@in_n($pa, 0), 0)
				$ps_idx.append($pj)
				$ps_w.append($s_w)
				$solar += $s_w
				if $s_w > $ps_pk.$pa:number
					$ps_pk.$pa = $s_w
				$spot += max($ps_pk.$pa:number, $s_w)
			elseif contains($db_type.$pj, "Propeller")
				$pp_idx.append($pj)
				$pp_rps.append(@in_n($pa, 0))
				$pp_thr.append(@in_n($pa, 1))
	$pw_cap = $cap
	$pw_stored = $stored
	; Main battery: the one chosen in POWER, else alias with "main"/"primary",
	; else plain "battery".
	$pw_main_pct = -1
	$pw_main_k = -1
	var $mb_best = 0
	var $mb_n = $pb_idx.size
	repeat $mb_n ($mb)
		var $mb_a = lower($db_alias.($pb_idx.$mb))
		var $mb_s = 0
		if ($pw_main_alias != "") and ($db_alias.($pb_idx.$mb) == $pw_main_alias)
			$mb_s = 9
		elseif contains($mb_a, "main") or contains($mb_a, "primary")
			$mb_s = 3
		elseif $mb_a == "battery"
			$mb_s = 2
		if $mb_s > $mb_best
			$mb_best = $mb_s
			$pw_main_k = $mb
			$pw_main_pct = $pb_charge.$mb * 100
	$pw_solar = $solar
	$pw_spot = $spot
	$pw_bat_count = $pb_idx.size
	if $cap > 0
		$pw_pct = $stored / $cap * 100
	else
		$pw_pct = -1
	; Flow from the change in stored energy (Wh/s -> W), smoothed.
	if ($pw_prev >= 0) and ($pt_dt > 0.2) and ($pt_dt < 10) and ($cap == $pw_prev_cap)
		var $inst = ($stored - $pw_prev) / $pt_dt * 3600
		$pw_flow = $pw_flow + ($inst - $pw_flow) * 0.15
	$pw_prev = $stored
	$pw_prev_cap = $cap
	$pw_prev_t = time
	$pw_usage = max($pw_solar - $pw_flow, 0)
	if ($pw_pct >= 0) and (time >= $pw_hist24_next)
		$pw_hist24_next = time + 720
		$pw_hist24.append($pw_pct)
		if $pw_hist24.size > 120
			$pw_hist24.erase(0)
	if ($pw_pct >= 0) and (time >= $pw_hist_next)
		$pw_hist_next = time + 60
		$pw_hist.append($pw_pct)
		if $pw_hist.size > 120
			$pw_hist.erase(0)
	; Load shedding: LOW-priority relays first, then NORMAL; ESSENTIAL never.
	if $pw_pct >= 0
		if (!$pw_shed_low) and ($pw_pct < $pw_low2)
			$pw_shed_low = 1
			$assert_next = 0
			$pw_nq.append(text("BATTERY {0}% - LOW-priority relays OFF", $pw_pct))
		elseif $pw_shed_low and ($pw_pct > $pw_restore2)
			$pw_shed_low = 0
			$assert_next = 0
			$pw_nq.append(text("BATTERY {0}% - LOW-priority relays back ON", $pw_pct))
		if (!$pw_shed) and ($pw_pct < $pw_low)
			$pw_shed = 1
			$assert_next = 0
			$pw_nq.append(text("LOW BATTERY {0}% - NORMAL relays OFF too", $pw_pct))
		elseif $pw_shed and ($pw_pct > $pw_restore)
			$pw_shed = 0
			$assert_next = 0
			$pw_nq.append(text("BATTERY {0}% - NORMAL relays back ON", $pw_pct))

function @pw_prio_name($p : number) : text
	if $p == 0
		return "LOW"
	if $p == 1
		return "NORMAL"
	return "ESSENTIAL"

; Two short lines for narrow layouts: flow, and time to full / empty.
var $pw_line_a = ""
var $pw_line_b = ""
function @pw_status_lines()
	$pw_line_a = "STEADY"
	$pw_line_b = ""
	if $pw_pct < 0
		$pw_line_a = "NO NAMED BATTERIES"
		return
	if $pw_flow > 50
		var $sa_f = @fmt_power($pw_flow)
		$pw_line_a = "CHARGING +" & $sa_f
		if $pw_pct < 99.5
			$pw_line_b = "FULL IN " & @fmt_dur(($pw_cap - $pw_stored) / $pw_flow * 3600)
		else
			$pw_line_b = "FULL"
	elseif $pw_flow < -50
		var $sb_f = @fmt_power(-$pw_flow)
		$pw_line_a = "DRAINING -" & $sb_f
		$pw_line_b = "EMPTY IN " & @fmt_dur($pw_stored / (-$pw_flow) * 3600)

function @pw_status_text() : text
	if $pw_pct < 0
		return "NO NAMED BATTERIES"
	var $st_p = text("{0}%", $pw_pct)
	if $pw_flow > 50
		var $st_f = @fmt_power($pw_flow)
		var $st_t = ""
		if $pw_pct < 99.5
			$st_t = "  FULL IN " & @fmt_dur(($pw_cap - $pw_stored) / $pw_flow * 3600)
		return $st_p & "  CHARGING +" & $st_f & $st_t
	if $pw_flow < -50
		var $st_d = @fmt_power(-$pw_flow)
		var $st_e = @fmt_dur($pw_stored / (-$pw_flow) * 3600)
		return $st_p & "  DRAINING -" & $st_d & "  EMPTY IN " & $st_e
	return $st_p & "  STEADY"

xc_files.name: display.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - screens: discovery, single / spanned desktop, status panels.
storage var $cfg_disp_ver : number
storage var $cfg_mode : number          ; 0 single screen, 1 spanned
storage var $cfg_primary_alias : text
storage var $cfg_primary_ch : number
storage var $cfg_span_alias : text
storage var $cfg_span_cols : number
storage array $cfg_span_order : number  ; channels in reading order
storage var $cfg_main_alias : text      ; the dashboard ChipOS runs on ("" = not chosen)
; Projection: what each other screen shows (by dashboard alias + channel).
; kind 0 status panel, 1 app (ref = app id), 2 built-in widget, 3 custom
; widget, 4 app widget (ref = app*10 + n), 9 blank.
storage array $pj_alias : text
storage array $pj_ch : number
storage array $pj_kind : number
storage array $pj_ref : number
; Joined other screens: one big screen made of up to 4 same-size screens.
storage array $jn_mem : text                ; "|alias#ch|alias#ch|" in reading order
storage array $jn_cols : number
array $sl_jlead : number                    ; per slot: leader slot of its join (-1 = none)
array $sl_jdx : number                      ; offset of this screen inside the join
array $sl_jdy : number
array $sl_jw : number                       ; whole join size
array $sl_jh : number
var $jn_mode = 0                            ; tapping screens to join
array $jn_tap : number                      ; slots tapped so far
var $jn_new_cols = 2
var $pick_main = 0                      ; every screen shows "TAP HERE"
var $pj_pick = -1                       ; slot showing its own content picker
var $pj_sc = 0                          ; that picker's scroll position

array $sl_alias : text
array $sl_ch : number
array $sl_w : number
array $sl_h : number
array $sl_role : number                 ; 1 desktop part, 2 status panel, 3 identify
array $sl_dx : number
array $sl_dy : number
array $sl_tag : number                  ; identify: tap order (0 = not yet)
var $slot_n = 0
var $primary_slot = -1
var $desk_w = 0
var $desk_h = 0
var $pbuf_w = 0
var $pbuf_h = 0
var $disp_mode = 0
var $panels_next = 0
var $panels_dirty = 1
; Best group of identical screens on one dashboard (the span candidate).
var $grp_alias = ""
var $grp_w = 0
var $grp_h = 0
var $grp_n = 0
array $span_order : number              ; working order (wizard)
var $span_cols = 1

function @bar_count($t : text) : number
	return size($t) - size(replace($t, "|", ""))

function @jn_key($k : number) : text
	return text("{}#{}", $sl_alias.$k, $sl_ch.$k)

; Rebuild the per-slot join table (after screens or joins change).
; A join only counts while all its screens are present, the same size and
; not part of the main desktop.
function @jn_build()
	$sl_jlead.clear()
	$sl_jdx.clear()
	$sl_jdy.clear()
	$sl_jw.clear()
	$sl_jh.clear()
	repeat $slot_n ($k)
		$sl_jlead.append(-1)
		$sl_jdx.append(0)
		$sl_jdy.append(0)
		$sl_jw.append($sl_w.$k)
		$sl_jh.append($sl_h.$k)
	var $jn = $jn_mem.size
	repeat $jn ($j)
		var $m = $jn_mem.$j
		var $cnt = 0
		var $ok = 1
		var $lead = -1
		repeat $slot_n ($k2)
			if find($m, "|" & @jn_key($k2) & "|") >= 0
				$cnt += 1
				if $sl_role.$k2 != 2
					$ok = 0
				if find($m, "|" & @jn_key($k2) & "|") == 0
					$lead = $k2
		var $want = @bar_count($m) - 1
		if ($cnt < 2) or ($cnt != $want) or ($lead < 0)
			$ok = 0
		if $ok
			repeat $slot_n ($k3)
				if find($m, "|" & @jn_key($k3) & "|") >= 0
					if ($sl_w.$k3 != $sl_w.$lead) or ($sl_h.$k3 != $sl_h.$lead)
						$ok = 0
		if $ok
			var $cols = max(1, $jn_cols.$j)
			var $rows = ceil($want / $cols)
			repeat $slot_n ($k4)
				var $p = find($m, "|" & @jn_key($k4) & "|")
				if $p >= 0
					; position = number of "|" before it
					var $pos = @bar_count(substring($m, 0, $p + 1)) - 1
					$sl_jlead.$k4 = $lead
					$sl_jdx.$k4 = mod($pos, $cols) * $sl_w.$lead
					$sl_jdy.$k4 = floor($pos / $cols) * $sl_h.$lead
					$sl_jw.$k4 = $cols * $sl_w.$lead
					$sl_jh.$k4 = $rows * $sl_h.$lead

; Slot whose settings a screen uses: its join's leader, else itself.
function @jn_lead_of($k : number) : number
	if ($k >= 0) and ($k < $sl_jlead.size)
		if $sl_jlead.$k >= 0
			return $sl_jlead.$k
	return $k

; Remove every join that contains slot k.
function @jn_split($k : number)
	var $key = "|" & @jn_key($k) & "|"
	var $n = $jn_mem.size
	repeat $n ($q)
		var $j = $n - 1 - $q
		if find($jn_mem.$j, $key) >= 0
			$jn_mem.erase($j)
			$jn_cols.erase($j)
	@jn_build()
	$panels_dirty = 1

function @disp_load()
	if $cfg_disp_ver != 1
		$cfg_mode = 0
		$cfg_primary_alias = ""
		$cfg_primary_ch = 0
		$cfg_span_alias = ""
		$cfg_span_cols = 0
		$cfg_span_order.clear()
		$cfg_main_alias = ""
		$pj_alias.clear()
		$pj_ch.clear()
		$pj_kind.clear()
		$pj_ref.clear()
		$jn_mem.clear()
		$jn_cols.clear()
		$cfg_disp_ver = 1

function @disp_discover()
	$sl_alias.clear()
	$sl_ch.clear()
	$sl_w.clear()
	$sl_h.clear()
	$sl_role.clear()
	$sl_dx.clear()
	$sl_dy.clear()
	$sl_tag.clear()
	$slot_n = 0
	var $dd_n = $db_id.size
	repeat $dd_n ($dd_j)
		var $dd_a = $db_alias.$dd_j
		var $dd_t = $db_type.$dd_j
		if ($dd_a != "") and (($db_seen.$dd_j >= $scan_gen - 1)) and contains($dd_t, "Dashboard")
			var $dd_stop = 0
			repeat 64 ($dd_c)
				if (!$dd_stop) and ($slot_n < $slot_max)
					var $dd_s = $s_own
					var $dd_p = @io_port($dd_a)
					if $dd_p >= 0
						$dd_s = screen($dd_p, $dd_c)
					else
						$dd_s = screen($dd_a, $dd_c)
					var $dd_w = $dd_s.width
					var $dd_h = $dd_s.height
					if ($dd_w <= 0) or ($dd_h <= 0)
						$dd_stop = 1
					else
						$sl_alias.append($dd_a)
						$sl_ch.append($dd_c)
						$sl_w.append($dd_w)
						$sl_h.append($dd_h)
						$sl_role.append(2)
						$sl_dx.append(0)
						$sl_dy.append(0)
						$sl_tag.append(0)
						@slot_bind($slot_n, $dd_a, $dd_c)
						$slot_n += 1
	; no dashboards: run on the computer's own screen, if it has one
	$disp_own_only = 0
	if ($slot_n == 0) and ($s_own.width > 0) and ($s_own.height > 0)
		$sl_alias.append("computer")
		$sl_ch.append(0)
		$sl_w.append($s_own.width)
		$sl_h.append($s_own.height)
		$sl_role.append(2)
		$sl_dx.append(0)
		$sl_dy.append(0)
		$sl_tag.append(0)
		$slot_n = 1
		$disp_own_only = 1
		@os_log("No dashboard found: running on the computer's own screen.")
	@jn_build()
	@os_log(text("{} screens found", $slot_n))

; Is there a dashboard with a screen now? (to move off the computer's own screen)
function @disp_dash_exists() : number
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1) and contains($db_type.$j, "Dashboard")
			var $ds = $s_own
			var $dsp = @io_port($db_alias.$j)
			if $dsp >= 0
				$ds = screen($dsp, 0)
			else
				$ds = screen($db_alias.$j, 0)
			if $ds.width > 0
				return 1
	return 0

; Number of different dashboards with screens.
function @disp_dash_count() : number
	var $n = 0
	repeat $slot_n ($k)
		var $first = 1
		repeat $k ($q)
			if $sl_alias.$q == $sl_alias.$k
				$first = 0
		if $first
			$n += 1
	return $n

; Is slot k on the main dashboard (or is no main dashboard chosen/present)?
function @disp_on_main($k : number) : number
	if $cfg_main_alias == ""
		return 1
	var $present = 0
	repeat $slot_n ($q)
		if $sl_alias.$q == $cfg_main_alias
			$present = 1
	if !$present
		return 1
	return $sl_alias.$k == $cfg_main_alias

; Projection entry for slot k (-1 = none).
function @pj_idx($k0 : number) : number
	var $k = @jn_lead_of($k0)
	var $n = $pj_alias.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if ($pj_alias.$i == $sl_alias.$k) and ($pj_ch.$i == $sl_ch.$k)
			return $i
	return -1

function @pj_kind_of($k : number) : number
	var $i = @pj_idx($k)
	if $i < 0
		return 0
	return $pj_kind.$i

function @pj_ref_of($k : number) : number
	var $i = @pj_idx($k)
	if $i < 0
		return 0
	return $pj_ref.$i

function @pj_set($k0 : number, $kind : number, $ref : number)
	var $k = @jn_lead_of($k0)
	var $i = @pj_idx($k)
	if $i < 0
		$pj_alias.append($sl_alias.$k)
		$pj_ch.append($sl_ch.$k)
		$pj_kind.append($kind)
		$pj_ref.append($ref)
	else
		$pj_kind.$i = $kind
		$pj_ref.$i = $ref
	$panels_dirty = 1

; Does slot k draw projected content (rather than the status panel)?
function @pj_active($k : number) : number
	if $sl_role.$k != 2
		return 0
	if $jn_mode
		return 1
	return ($pj_pick == @jn_lead_of($k)) or (@pj_kind_of($k) != 0)

; Is external app index xk shown on any other screen?
function @pj_shows_app($xk : number) : number
	repeat $slot_n ($k)
		if ($sl_role.$k == 2) and (@pj_kind_of($k) == 1) and (@pj_ref_of($k) == 100 + $xk)
			return 1
	return 0

function @disp_find_slot($fa : text, $fc : number) : number
	repeat $slot_n ($fk)
		if ($sl_alias.$fk == $fa) and ($sl_ch.$fk == $fc)
			return $fk
	return -1

function @disp_group()
	$grp_alias = ""
	$grp_n = 0
	$grp_w = 0
	$grp_h = 0
	repeat $slot_n ($gi)
		var $g_cnt = 0
		var $g_a = $sl_alias.$gi
		var $g_w = $sl_w.$gi
		var $g_h = $sl_h.$gi
		repeat $slot_n ($gj)
			if ($sl_alias.$gj == $g_a) and ($sl_w.$gj == $g_w) and ($sl_h.$gj == $g_h)
				$g_cnt += 1
		if !@disp_on_main($gi)
			$g_cnt = 0
		if ($g_cnt > $grp_n) or (($g_cnt == $grp_n) and ($g_w * $g_h > $grp_w * $grp_h))
			$grp_n = $g_cnt
			$grp_alias = $g_a
			$grp_w = $g_w
			$grp_h = $g_h
	if $grp_n < 2
		$grp_n = 0

function @disp_size_buffers()
	var $sb_w = 1
	var $sb_h = 1
	repeat $slot_n ($sb_k)
		$sb_w = max($sb_w, $sl_w.$sb_k)
		$sb_h = max($sb_h, $sl_h.$sb_k)
	$pbuf_w = min($sb_w, $rt_w)
	$pbuf_h = min($sb_h, $rt_h)

; Startup only (the game allows virtual screens only in init): size the
; render target to the biggest screen found.
function @disp_alloc_rt()
	var $ar_w = 8
	var $ar_h = 8
	repeat $slot_n ($ar_k)
		$ar_w = max($ar_w, $sl_w.$ar_k)
		$ar_h = max($ar_h, $sl_h.$ar_k)
	$rt = virtualscreen($ar_w, $ar_h)
	$rt_w = $ar_w
	$rt_h = $ar_h

; A screen bigger than the render target appeared -> needs a reboot.
function @disp_need_reboot() : number
	repeat $slot_n ($nr_k)
		if ($sl_w.$nr_k > $rt_w) or ($sl_h.$nr_k > $rt_h)
			return 1
	return 0

function @disp_set_desk($sd_w : number, $sd_h : number)
	$desk_w = $sd_w
	$desk_h = $sd_h

; Main screen = the saved one, else the biggest.
function @disp_pick_primary()
	$primary_slot = @disp_find_slot($cfg_primary_alias, $cfg_primary_ch)
	if $primary_slot >= 0
		return
	var $pp_best = 0
	repeat $slot_n ($pp_k)
		var $pp_area = $sl_w.$pp_k * $sl_h.$pp_k
		if ($pp_area > $pp_best) and @disp_on_main($pp_k)
			$pp_best = $pp_area
			$primary_slot = $pp_k
	if $primary_slot >= 0
		$cfg_primary_alias = $sl_alias.$primary_slot
		$cfg_primary_ch = $sl_ch.$primary_slot

function @disp_layout_single()
	$disp_mode = 0
	@disp_pick_primary()
	repeat $slot_n ($ls_k)
		$sl_role.$ls_k = 2
		$sl_tag.$ls_k = 0
	if $primary_slot < 0
		return
	$sl_role.$primary_slot = 1
	$sl_dx.$primary_slot = 0
	$sl_dy.$primary_slot = 0
	@disp_set_desk($sl_w.$primary_slot, $sl_h.$primary_slot)
	@disp_size_buffers()
	@jn_build()
	$panels_dirty = 1

; Span the group across $span_order (channels, reading order) in $span_cols.
function @disp_layout_span()
	var $sp_n = $span_order.size
	if ($sp_n < 2) or ($span_cols < 1)
		@disp_layout_single()
		return
	$disp_mode = 1
	var $sp_rows = ceil($sp_n / $span_cols)
	repeat $slot_n ($sp_k)
		$sl_role.$sp_k = 2
		$sl_tag.$sp_k = 0
	repeat $sp_n ($sp_i)
		var $sp_slot = @disp_find_slot($grp_alias, $span_order.$sp_i)
		if $sp_slot >= 0
			$sl_role.$sp_slot = 1
			$sl_dx.$sp_slot = mod($sp_i, $span_cols) * $grp_w
			$sl_dy.$sp_slot = floor($sp_i / $span_cols) * $grp_h
	@disp_set_desk($span_cols * $grp_w, $sp_rows * $grp_h)
	@disp_size_buffers()
	@jn_build()
	$panels_dirty = 1

; Boot: apply the saved layout if the same screens are still there.
function @disp_apply_saved()
	@disp_group()
	var $as_ok = ($cfg_mode == 1) and ($grp_n >= 2) and ($cfg_span_alias == $grp_alias) and ($cfg_span_order.size == $grp_n) and ($cfg_span_cols >= 1)
	if $as_ok
		$span_order.clear()
		var $as_n = $cfg_span_order.size
		repeat $as_n ($as_i)
			var $as_c = $cfg_span_order.$as_i
			if @disp_find_slot($grp_alias, $as_c) < 0
				$as_ok = 0
			$span_order.append($as_c)
	if $as_ok
		$span_cols = $cfg_span_cols
		@disp_layout_span()
	else
		@disp_layout_single()

function @disp_save_span()
	$cfg_mode = 1
	$cfg_span_alias = $grp_alias
	$cfg_span_cols = $span_cols
	$cfg_span_order.clear()
	var $ss_n = $span_order.size
	repeat $ss_n ($ss_i)
		$cfg_span_order.append($span_order.$ss_i)

; Identify mode: every screen of the group shows its number; taps set order.
function @disp_identify_start()
	@disp_group()
	repeat $slot_n ($is_k)
		$sl_tag.$is_k = 0
		if ($sl_alias.$is_k == $grp_alias) and ($sl_w.$is_k == $grp_w) and ($sl_h.$is_k == $grp_h)
			$sl_role.$is_k = 3
		else
			$sl_role.$is_k = 2
	$panels_dirty = 1

function @disp_identify_count() : number
	var $ic_n = 0
	repeat $slot_n ($ic_k)
		if $sl_tag.$ic_k > 0
			$ic_n += 1
	return $ic_n

; Columns guess: the divisor of n giving the widest landscape layout <= 2.5:1.
function @disp_guess_cols($gc_n : number) : number
	var $gc_best = 1
	repeat $gc_n ($gc_i)
		var $gc_c = $gc_i + 1
		if mod($gc_n, $gc_c) == 0
			var $gc_r = $gc_n / $gc_c
			var $gc_aspect = ($gc_c * $grp_w) / ($gc_r * $grp_h)
			if $gc_aspect <= 2.5
				$gc_best = $gc_c
	return $gc_best

function @disp_next_cols($nc_dir : number)
	var $nc_n = $span_order.size
	var $nc_c = $span_cols
	repeat $nc_n ($nc_i)
		$nc_c += $nc_dir
		if ($nc_c >= 1) and ($nc_c <= $nc_n)
			if mod($nc_n, $nc_c) == 0
				$span_cols = $nc_c
				return

xc_files.name: weather_ui.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - WEATHER and SOLAR app pages, the weather widget and icons.

function @ws_bc_name() : text
	if $ws_bc == 1
		return "IN THE CHIPOS BROADCAST"
	if $ws_bc == 2
		var $f = $ws_freq
		if $f == ""
			$f = "(SET A FREQUENCY)"
		return "OWN FREQUENCY " & $f
	return "OFF"

function @ws_row($y : number, $k : text, $v : text, $tw : number) : number
	@ui_text($content_x, $y, $th_dim, $k)
	@ui_text_r($content_x + $tw, $y, $th_text, $v)
	return $y + $chh * 1.25

function @page_weather()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	var $y = $content_y
	if !@ws_on()
		$y = @set_header("WEATHER")
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "Needs a Density Sensor, a Temperature Sensor and a Nav Instrument (or Altitude Sensor), all outside.", $tw)
		return
	var $r = $chh * 2.4
	@wx_icon_draw($ws_icon, $content_x + $r, $y + $r, $r)
	var $tt = "--"
	if $ws_ok
		$tt = @ws_temp_s($ws_tk)
	var $tx = $content_x + $r * 2 + $cw * 2
	var $m = @fit_mul(size($tt), $tw - $r * 2 - $cw * 2, $r * 1.2, 3)
	@ui_text_big($tx + ($content_x + $tw - $tx) / 2, $y, $th_text, $tt, $m)
	@text_fit_c($tx + ($content_x + $tw - $tx) / 2, $y + $chh * $m + $chh * 0.2, $th_accent, $ws_cond, $content_x + $tw - $tx)
	$y += max($r * 2, $chh * ($m + 1.4)) + $chh * 0.6
	if $ws_fore != ""
		$y = @ws_row($y, "OUTLOOK", $ws_fore, $tw)
	if $ws_rh >= 0
		$y = @ws_row($y, "HUMIDITY", text("{0}%", $ws_rh), $tw)
