	if $ws_dew > -1000
		$y = @ws_row($y, "DEW POINT", @ws_temp_s($ws_dew + 273.15), $tw)
	if $ws_ok
		var $tr = @ws_trend()
		var $tsd = ""
		if $tr != 9999
			$tsd = "  STEADY"
			if $tr > 1
				$tsd = "  RISING"
			elseif $tr < -1
				$tsd = "  FALLING"
		$y = @ws_row($y, "PRESSURE", @ws_press_s() & $tsd, $tw)
	var $wl = @ws_wind_s()
	if !$wn_ok
		$wl = "NO WIND SENSING"
		if $wn_how == "MOVING"
			$wl = "WAITING - THE BUILD IS MOVING"
		elseif ($ws_navs >= 2) or (($ws_navs >= 1) and ($vn_piv.size > 0))
			$wl = "MEASURING..."
	$y = @ws_row($y, "WIND", $wl, $tw)
	if $ws_cloud >= 0
		var $cb = text("{0} m", $ws_cloud)
		if $cfg_units
			$cb = text("{0} ft", $ws_cloud * 3.28084)
		$y = @ws_row($y, "CLOUD BASE (EST.)", $cb, $tw)
	var $al = text("{0} m", $ws_altm)
	if $cfg_units
		$al = text("{0} ft", $ws_altm * 3.28084)
	$y = @ws_row($y, "ALTITUDE", $al, $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.4
	var $bw = "BROADCAST: IN THIS BASE'S STRUCTURED BROADCAST ON " & $cm_freq & " (no extra beacon)"
	if ($cm_mode != 2) or ($cm_freq == "")
		$bw = "BROADCAST: TURN ON THE STRUCTURED BROADCAST IN COMMS (with a frequency) - the weather rides in it"
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, $bw, $tw)
	var $hw = "WIND: NONE"
	if $ws_navs >= 2
		$hw = text("WIND: {} NAV INSTRUMENTS", $ws_navs)
	elseif ($ws_navs >= 1) and ($vn_piv.size > 0)
		$hw = "WIND: NAV ON A PIVOT (SWEEPS EVERY 2 MIN)"
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, $hw & "   SENSORS: " & $ws_dens & ", " & $ws_therm, $tw)
	if $wn_c.size > 1
		$y = @set_row($y, "CHOOSE THE WIND NAVS", text("{} of {} used", $ws_navs, $wn_c.size), "ws_navgo", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "THE SENSORS ARE NOT OUTSIDE", "turn the weather station off", "ws_off", $th_bad)

; ---- SOLAR ----
function @so_mode_name() : text
	if $so_mode == 1
		return "FINDING THE PIVOT / HINGE"
	if $so_mode == 2
		return "LOOKING FOR THE SUN"
	if $so_mode == 3
		return "TRACKING"
	if $so_mode == 4
		return "NIGHT"
	if $so_mode == 5
		return "LEARNING WITH THE MINI NAV"
	return "WAITING"

; ---- v0.25.1: picking navs ----
function @page_so_navpick()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $n = $so_navs.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $a = $so_navs.$i
		var $mk = "   "
		if $a == $so_navsel
			$mk = "> "
		$sl_txt.append($mk & $a & text("   heading {0}", @in_n($a, 6)))
		$sl_spec.append($a)
	$sl_txt.append("NONE OF THEM IS ON THE ARRAY")
	$sl_spec.append("-")
	@pick_list("SOLAR - WHICH MINI NAV IS ON THE ARRAY?", "Tap the mini nav that turns with the panels. Watch the headings: the array's one changes when the pivot turns.", "so_navpick")

function @page_ws_navpick()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $n = $wn_c.size
	var $ns = $ws_navsel.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $a = $wn_c.$i
		var $on = 0
		repeat $ns ($k)
			if $ws_navsel.$k == $a
				$on = 1
		var $mk = "[ ] "
		if $on
			$mk = "[X] "
		$sl_txt.append($mk & $a & text("   heading {0}", @in_n($a, 6)))
		$sl_spec.append($a)
	$sl_txt.append(text("DONE ({} PICKED)", $ns))
	$sl_spec.append("")
	@pick_list("WEATHER - WIND NAV INSTRUMENTS", "Tap to pick 2 to 4 fixed navs facing different ways (the solar array's nav is not listed). Then DONE.", "ws_navpick")

; Which wind instrument faces the way the turbines face at pivot 0?
function @page_wt_refpick()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		var $a = $db_alias.$j
		if ($a != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1) and contains($db_type.$j, "NavInstrument") and ($a != $so_nav)
			$sl_txt.append($a & text("   (faces {0} deg)", @posmod(@in_n($a, 6), 360)))
			$sl_spec.append($a)
	$sl_txt.append("NONE OF THEM - AIM BY SPIN")
	$sl_spec.append("-")
	@pick_list("WHICH NAV FACES LIKE THE TURBINES AT PIVOT 0?", "Pick the wind (weather) instrument that points the same way the turbines point when their pivots are at 0. All turbines then turn together to face where the weather station says the wind comes from.", "wt_refset")

; ---- WIND GENERATORS (on the solar page) ----
function @page_wind($y0 : number, $tw : number)
	var $y = $y0
	if !@wt_on()
		return
	if @so_on()
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_text, "WIND GENERATORS", $tw)
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, $wt_note, $tw)
	var $wl = "WEATHER WIND: NOT AVAILABLE - turbines aim by their own spin"
	if @wt_wind_ok()
		$wl = "WEATHER WIND: FROM " & @ws_compass($wn_from) & text(" ({0} deg), {0.0} m/s - turbines aim at it", $wn_from, $wn_spd)
	elseif !@ws_on()
		$wl = "WEATHER WIND: WEATHER STATION OFF - turbines aim by their own spin"
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, $wl, $tw)
	var $n = $wt_pv.size
	if $n == 0
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "No pivot found turning a propeller yet. Put the turbine's propeller on a Small Pivot, give both an alias, and keep some wind blowing while ChipOS looks.", $tw)
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $pc = 0
		if $i < $wt_pc.size
			$pc = $wt_pc.$i
		$y = @ws_row($y, $wt_pv.$i, text("{0} deg   ", @posmod($pc * 360, 360)) & $wt_pr.$i & text("  {0.0} rot/s", abs(@in_n($wt_pr.$i, 0))), $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.4
	var $rn = "NOT PICKED - TAP TO PICK"
	if $wt_refnav == "-"
		$rn = "NONE (TURBINES AIM BY THEIR SPIN)"
	elseif $wt_refnav != ""
		$rn = $wt_refnav
	$y = @set_row($y, "TURBINE DIRECTION NAV: " & $rn, "faces the same way as the turbines at pivot 0", "go:wt_refpick", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "TURBINES TURN THE WRONG WAY? REVERSE", "all turbines swap which way they turn", "wt_rev", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "TURBINES FACE AWAY FROM THE WIND? TURN ROUND", "all turbines turn 180 degrees", "wt_flip", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "FIND TURBINES AGAIN", "forget them and test every spare pivot", "wt_relearn", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "TURN WIND GENERATOR AIMING OFF", "the turbines stay where they are", "wt_off", $th_bad)

function @page_solar()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	if !@so_on()
		var $yw = @set_header("WIND GENERATORS")
		if !@wt_on()
			$yw = @ui_para_l($content_x, $yw, $th_dim, "Needs a Small Pivot, a Small Hinge and Solar Panels (solar), or a propeller on a Small Pivot (wind).", $tw)
		@page_wind($yw, $tw)
		return
	var $y = @set_header("SOLAR TRACKING")
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, $so_note, $tw)
	if $so_sens == ""
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_warn, "Add a SOLAR SENSOR on the moving part (next to the panels, facing the same way). ChipOS uses it to see how well the panels face the sun.", $tw)
	if $so_navs.size == 0
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "Tip: add a MINI NAV INSTRUMENT on the moving part too. ChipOS then works out the pivot by itself, turns straight to the sun and parks facing the sunrise at night.", $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.3
	$y = @ws_row($y, "PIVOT", $so_piv & text("  {0} deg", $so_pc * 360), $tw)
	$y = @ws_row($y, "HINGE", $so_hin & text("  {0} deg", $so_hc * 90), $tw)
	if $so_sens != ""
		$y = @ws_row($y, "SUN ON SENSOR", text("{0}%  ({0} W/m2)", max(0, @in_n($so_sens, 0)) * 100, @in_n($so_sens, 1)), $tw)
	$y = @ws_row($y, "PANELS MAKING", @fmt_power($pw_solar), $tw)
	var $cl = "NOT YET"
	if $so_cal
		$cl = "DONE"
	if $so_navs.size == 0
		$cl = "NO MINI NAV"
	$y = @ws_row($y, "MINI NAV CALIBRATION", $cl, $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.4
	if $so_navs.size > 1
		var $nvl = $so_nav
		if $nvl == ""
			$nvl = "none"
		$y = @set_row($y, "CHOOSE THE MINI NAV", "now: " & $nvl, "so_navgo", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "LOOK FOR THE SUN NOW", "sweep round and tilt", "so_search", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "LEARN AGAIN", "forget the pivot / hinge / nav calibration", "so_relearn", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "TURN SOLAR TRACKING OFF", "the panels stay where they are", "so_off", $th_bad)
	@page_wind($y + $chh * 0.6, $tw)

function @ws_kb_done($id : text, $ok : number, $t0 : text)
	if !$ok
		return
	if $id == "ws_freq"
		$ws_freq = @bk_clean($t0)

function @ws_action($act : text, $val : number)
	if $act == "ws_bc"
		$ws_bc = @posmod($ws_bc + 1, 3)
		if ($ws_bc == 2) and ($ws_freq == "")
			@kb_open(-2, "ws_freq", "WEATHER BROADCAST FREQUENCY", "")
	elseif $act == "ws_kb_freq"
		@kb_open(-2, "ws_freq", "WEATHER BROADCAST FREQUENCY", $ws_freq)
	elseif $act == "ws_off"
		$ws_state = 2
		$ws_nans = $ws_ndens + $ws_ntherm
		@ui_toast("WEATHER OFF UNTIL MORE SENSORS ARE ADDED")
		@go("home")
	elseif $act == "so_search"
		@so_start_search()
	elseif $act == "so_relearn"
		$so_cal = 0
		$so_daz = 0
		if $so_npiv > 1
			$so_piv = ""
		if $so_nhin > 1
			$so_hin = ""
		$so_mode = 0
		$so_t = 0
	elseif $act == "so_navgo"
		@go("so_navpick")
	elseif $act == "ws_navgo"
		@go("ws_navpick")
	elseif ($act == "so_navpick") and ($val < $sl_spec.size)
		$so_navsel = $sl_spec.$val
		$so_cal = 0
		$so_daz = 0
		$so_mode = 0
		$so_t = 0
		$so_scan_t = 0
		@go("home")
	elseif ($act == "ws_navpick") and ($val < $sl_spec.size)
		var $pa = $sl_spec.$val
		if $pa == ""
			if $ws_navsel.size == 1
				@ui_toast("PICK AT LEAST 2 (OR NONE TO USE ALL)")
			else
				$ws_nav_later = 0
				$ws_scan_t = 0
				@wn_clear()
				@go("home")
		else
			var $fi = -1
			var $nsl = $ws_navsel.size
			repeat $nsl ($k)
				if $ws_navsel.$k == $pa
					$fi = $k
			if $fi >= 0
				$ws_navsel.erase($fi)
			elseif $nsl < 4
				$ws_navsel.append($pa)
			else
				@ui_toast("4 ARE ENOUGH - TAP ONE TO DROP IT")
			$ws_scan_t = 0
	elseif $act == "wt_relearn"
		$wt_pv.clear()
		$wt_pr.clear()
		$wt_pc.clear()
		$wt_dir.clear()
		$wt_off.clear()
		$wt_offok.clear()
		$wt_wl.clear()
		$wt_sgn.clear()
		$wt_tried.clear()
		$wt_mode = 0
		$wt_t = 0
	elseif $act == "wt_rev"
		if $wt_rsg == 0
			$wt_rsg = -1
		else
			$wt_rsg = -$wt_rsg
		$wt_k = 0
		$wt_t = 0
	elseif $act == "wt_flip"
		$wt_flip = 1 - $wt_flip
		$wt_k = 0
		$wt_t = 0
	elseif $act == "wt_refset"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			$wt_refnav = $sl_spec.$val
			$wt_k = 0
			$wt_t = 0
			if $wt_mode >= 2
				$wt_mode = 3
			@go("solar")
	elseif $act == "wt_off"
		$wt_state = 2
		@ui_toast("WIND GENERATOR AIMING OFF")
		@go("home")
	elseif $act == "so_off"
		$so_state = 2
		@ui_toast("SOLAR TRACKING OFF")
		@go("home")
	$ui_dirty = 1

xc_files.name: core.xc
apps_core.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - external apps (registry). An app is any computer with an alias
; that publishes a manifest on its channel 0 (ChipOS App Kit).
storage array $xa_alias : text          ; every app ever seen (keeps shortcut ids stable)
storage array $xa_block : text          ; uninstalled apps (their computers are ignored)
storage array $xa_block_hb : number     ; ... their last heartbeat (a restart starts it over)
array $xa_name : text
array $xa_color : number
array $xa_glyph : text
array $xa_online : number
array $xa_inq : text                    ; last input request seen (per app)
array $xa_bpq : text                    ; last beep request seen (per app)
var $xa_next = 0
var $xa_cur = -1
var $xa_seq = 0
var $xa_frame_seen = ""
var $xa_tick_next = 0
var $xa_new = ""                        ; name of a newly found app (main posts a notification)
array $xa_hb : text                     ; last heartbeat seen (App Kit v3)
array $xa_hb_t : number                 ; when it last changed
array $xa_wdef : text                   ; widgets: "NAME~w~h|NAME~w~h"
array $xa_icon : text                   ; the app's own icon shapes ("" = glyph)
array $xa_hex : text                    ; its colour as #rrggbb
array $xa_cv : text                     ; App Kit v4: it draws a map canvas ("1")
array $xa_want : text                   ; ... and the data feeds it wants ("nav,contacts")
array $xa_feed : text                   ; last feed sent to it
var $xa_nokit = 0                       ; app computers seen that send nothing
var $xa_nokit_n = 0                     ; scans in a row with that
var $xa_alias_warn = 0                  ; this computer is probably not aliased "chipos"
var $xa_warn_new = 0                    ; main posts the notification
var $xa_lost = ""                       ; the open app just went away (main handles)
var $xa_back = ""                       ; an uninstalled app was restarted (reinstalled)

; Part $n of $s split at $sep ("" if missing).
function @split_part($s : text, $sep : text, $n : number) : text
	var $rest = $s
	repeat $n ($q)
		var $p = find($rest, $sep)
		if $p < 0
			return ""
		$rest = substring($rest, $p + 1, size($rest))
	var $e = find($rest, $sep)
	if $e < 0
		return $rest
	return substring($rest, 0, $e)

function @split_count($s : text, $sep : text) : number
	if $s == ""
		return 0
	var $c = 1
	var $rest = $s
	repeat 64 ($q)
		var $p = find($rest, $sep)
		if $p >= 0
			$c += 1
			$rest = substring($rest, $p + 1, size($rest))
		else
			return $c
	return $c

; An add-on app with a built-in twin (same name) is ignored.
function @ba_is_builtin_name($n : text) : number
	var $u = upper($n)
	return ($u == "CALC") or ($u == "CALCULATOR") or ($u == "NOTEPAD") or ($u == "NOTES") or ($u == "STOPWATCH") or ($u == "TIMER") or ($u == "COUNTDOWN")


function @xa_is_online($k : number) : number
	if ($k < 0) or ($k >= $xa_online.size)
		return 0
	if $k < $xa_name.size
		if @ba_is_builtin_name($xa_name.$k)
			return 0
	return $xa_online.$k

; "#rrggbb" -> colour (0 if malformed)
function @hex_color($h : text) : number
	var $hx = lower($h)
	if (size($hx) != 7) or (substring($hx, 0, 1) != "#")
		return 0
	var $digs = "0123456789abcdef"
	var $r = find($digs, substring($hx, 1, 1)) * 16 + find($digs, substring($hx, 2, 1))
	var $g = find($digs, substring($hx, 3, 1)) * 16 + find($digs, substring($hx, 4, 1))
	var $b = find($digs, substring($hx, 5, 1)) * 16 + find($digs, substring($hx, 6, 1))
	return color(max($r, 0), max($g, 0), max($b, 0))

function @xa_find($a : text) : number
	var $fn = $xa_alias.size
	repeat $fn ($fi)
		if $xa_alias.$fi == $a
			return $fi
	return -1

; Every 3 s: look at every "app-..." computer, read its manifest.
function @xa_scan()
	if time < $xa_next
		return
	$xa_next = time + 3
	; runtime arrays follow the registry size
	repeat 200 ($pad)
		if $xa_inq.size < $xa_alias.size
			$xa_inq.append("")
			$xa_bpq.append("")
		if $xa_name.size < $xa_alias.size
			$xa_name.append("")
			$xa_color.append(color(120, 120, 130))
			$xa_glyph.append("?")
			$xa_online.append(0)
		if $xa_hb.size < $xa_alias.size
			$xa_hb.append("")
			$xa_hb_t.append(time)
			$xa_wdef.append("")
		if $xa_icon.size < $xa_alias.size
			$xa_icon.append("")
			$xa_hex.append("")
		if $xa_cv.size < $xa_alias.size
			$xa_cv.append("")
			$xa_want.append("")
			$xa_feed.append("")
	var $xn = $xa_alias.size
	var $was_cur = @xa_is_online($xa_cur)
	repeat $xn ($xi)
		$xa_online.$xi = 0
	var $dn = $db_id.size
	var $silent = 0
	var $heard = 0
	repeat $dn ($dj)
		var $da = $db_alias.$dj
		if ($db_cat.$dj == 14) and ($db_seen.$dj >= $scan_gen - 1) and ($da != "") and ($da != "chipos")
			var $man = @in_t($da, 0)
			if contains($man, ".kit{")
				$heard += 1
			elseif find($da, "app-") == 0
				$silent += 1
			; Uninstalled? Stay blocked until that program restarts (drive out
			; and back in, or the computer rebooted): its heartbeat starts over.
			var $bi = -1
			var $bkn = $xa_block.size
			repeat $bkn ($bk)
				if $xa_block.$bk == $da
					$bi = $bk
			if $bi >= 0
				repeat 50 ($bp)
					if $xa_block_hb.size < $xa_block.size
						$xa_block_hb.append(1000000000)
				if contains($man, ".kit{") and ($man.hb != "")
					var $bh = $man.hb:number
					if $bh < $xa_block_hb.$bi
						$xa_block.erase($bi)
						$xa_block_hb.erase($bi)
						$xa_back = $man.name
						$bi = -1
					else
						$xa_block_hb.$bi = $bh
			if ($bi < 0) and contains($man, ".kit{")
				var $k = @xa_find($da)
				if $k < 0
					$xa_alias.append($da)
					$xa_name.append("")
					$xa_color.append(0)
					$xa_glyph.append("?")
					$xa_online.append(0)
					$xa_inq.append("")
					$xa_bpq.append("")
					$xa_hb.append("")
					$xa_hb_t.append(time)
					$xa_wdef.append("")
					$xa_icon.append("")
					$xa_hex.append("")
					$xa_cv.append("")
					$xa_want.append("")
					$xa_feed.append("")
					$k = $xa_alias.size - 1
					$xa_new = $man.name
				$xa_name.$k = upper($man.name)
				var $mc = @hex_color($man.color)
				if $mc == 0
					$mc = color(120, 120, 130)
				$xa_color.$k = $mc
				$xa_glyph.$k = upper(substring($man.glyph, 0, 1))
				$xa_wdef.$k = $man.widgets
				$xa_icon.$k = $man.icon
				$xa_hex.$k = $man.color
				if $k < $xa_cv.size
					$xa_cv.$k = $man.canvas
					$xa_want.$k = $man.want
				; Kit v3 heartbeat: a latched manifest from a stopped computer
				; (drive pulled, power off) stops changing.
				var $hb = $man.hb
				var $alive = 1
				if $hb != ""
					if $hb != $xa_hb.$k
						$xa_hb.$k = $hb
						$xa_hb_t.$k = time
					$alive = (time - $xa_hb_t.$k) < 8
				$xa_online.$k = $alive
	if $was_cur and (!@xa_is_online($xa_cur))
		$xa_lost = $xa_name.$xa_cur
	; "app-..." computers but not one manifest heard: add-ons send to the alias
	; "chipos", so this computer is most likely not called that
	if ($silent > 0) and ($heard == 0)
		$xa_nokit_n += 1
	else
		$xa_nokit_n = 0
		$xa_alias_warn = 0
	$xa_nokit = $silent
	if ($xa_nokit_n >= 4) and !$xa_alias_warn
		$xa_alias_warn = 1
		$xa_warn_new = 1

xc_files.name: ui.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
storage var $cfg_seams : number          ; 1 = keep rows off the seams between screens
; ChipOS - UI framework: metrics, widgets, hit regions, scrolling lists.
storage var $cfg_tscale : number        ; text size % (Settings > Display)
var $ts = 1
var $cw = 6
var $chh = 8
var $ui_page = "boot"
var $ui_dirty = 1
var $ui_next_draw = 0
var $ui_rev_drawn = -1
array $hit_x1 : number
array $hit_y1 : number
array $hit_x2 : number
array $hit_y2 : number
array $hit_act : text
array $hit_val : number
array $hit_sl : number                  ; -1 desktop, else the projected screen (slot)
var $hit_sl_cur = -1
var $ui_hv = -1
; Scrolling list state (one list visible at a time).
var $sc_pos = 0
var $sc_total = 0
var $sc_vis = 1
var $sc_track_y = 0
var $sc_track_h = 1
var $sc_track_x = -1
var $sc_track_w = 0
var $sc_list_on = 0                    ; a scrolling list is on screen this frame
var $toast = ""
var $toast_until = 0
var $content_x = 0
var $content_y = 0
var $content_w = 0
var $content_h = 0
; Current screen being drawn: its desktop offset and size.
var $ox = 0
var $oy = 0
var $cur_w = 300
var $cur_h = 300
var $hit_on = 1

; Page scrolling (pages taller than the screen): content is drawn shifted
; up by $pg_sy; $pg_maxy records how far down it reaches.
var $pg_sy = 0
var $pg_hdy = 0                         ; shift applied to tap areas while drawing
var $pg_track = 0
var $pg_maxy = 0
var $pg_lim = 0                         ; how far the current page can scroll

function @d_rect($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number, $edge : number, $fill : number)
	if $pg_track
		$pg_maxy = max($pg_maxy, $y2)
	if ($x2 < $ox) or ($y2 < $oy) or ($x1 > $ox + $cur_w) or ($y1 > $oy + $cur_h)
		return
	$rt.draw_rect($x1 - $ox, $y1 - $oy, $x2 - $ox, $y2 - $oy, $edge, $fill)

function @d_line($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number, $c : number)
	$rt.draw_line($x1 - $ox, $y1 - $oy, $x2 - $ox, $y2 - $oy, $c)

function @d_circle($x : number, $y : number, $r : number, $c : number, $f : number)
	if ($x + $r < $ox) or ($y + $r < $oy) or ($x - $r > $ox + $cur_w) or ($y - $r > $oy + $cur_h)
		return
	$rt.draw_circle($x - $ox, $y - $oy, $r, $c, $f)

function @d_write($x : number, $y : number, $c : number, $t : text)
	if $pg_track
		$pg_maxy = max($pg_maxy, $y + $rt.char_h)
	if ($y > $oy + $cur_h) or ($y + $chh * 4 < $oy)
		return
	$rt.write($x - $ox, $y - $oy, $c, $t)

function @ui_metrics()
	; text grows with the screen in half steps (keeps ~300 x 260 of layout room);
	; the computer's own screen is small, so it uses the smallest text.
	; Screens draw text in whole sizes only (1x, 2x, 3x...): never ask for 1.5.
	var $mn = min($desk_w, $desk_h * 1.15)
	var $base = max(1, floor($mn / 300 + 0.25))
	if $disp_own_only
		$base = 1
	; Settings > Display > TEXT SIZE
	var $tsc = $cfg_tscale
	if $tsc <= 0
		$tsc = 100
	$ts = max(1, round($base * $tsc / 100))
	$rt.text_size(@tsz($ts))
	$rt.text_align(top_left)
	$cw = $rt.char_w
	$chh = $rt.char_h

function @ui_hit($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number, $act : text)
	if !$hit_on
		$ui_hv = -1
		return
	$hit_x1.append($x1)
	$hit_y1.append($y1 - $pg_hdy)
	$hit_x2.append($x2)
	$hit_y2.append($y2 - $pg_hdy)
	$hit_act.append($act)
	$hit_val.append($ui_hv)
	$hit_sl.append($hit_sl_cur)
	$ui_hv = -1

function @ui_fit($ft : text, $fmax : number) : text
	if size($ft) <= $fmax
		return $ft
	if $fmax <= 1
		return ""
	return substring($ft, 0, $fmax - 1) & "~"

function @ui_text($x : number, $y : number, $c : number, $t : text)
	@d_write($x, $y, $c, $t)

function @ui_text_c($cx : number, $y : number, $c : number, $t : text)
	@d_write($cx - size($t) * $cw / 2, $y, $c, $t)

function @ui_text_r($rx : number, $y : number, $c : number, $t : text)
	@d_write($rx - size($t) * $cw, $y, $c, $t)

; Centered paragraph, wrapped at spaces to fit $wmax pixels; returns the
; y just below it.
function @ui_para_c($cx : number, $y : number, $c : number, $t : text, $wmax : number) : number
	var $pmax = max(4, floor(min($wmax, $cw * 64) / $cw))
	var $pline = ""
	var $pword = ""
	var $py = $y
	var $pn = size($t)
	repeat $pn ($pi)
		var $pch = substring($t, $pi, 1)
		if $pch == " "
			if size($pline) + size($pword) + 1 > $pmax
				@ui_text_c($cx, $py, $c, $pline)
				$py += $chh * 1.25
				$pline = $pword
			elseif $pline == ""
				$pline = $pword
			else
				$pline = $pline & " " & $pword
			$pword = ""
		else
			$pword = $pword & $pch
	if size($pline) + size($pword) + 1 > $pmax
		@ui_text_c($cx, $py, $c, $pline)
		$py += $chh * 1.25
		$pline = $pword
	elseif $pline == ""
		$pline = $pword
	else
		$pline = $pline & " " & $pword
	@ui_text_c($cx, $py, $c, $pline)
	return $py + $chh * 1.25

; Left-aligned paragraph (same wrapping).
function @ui_para_l($cx : number, $y : number, $c : number, $t : text, $wmax : number) : number
	var $pmax = max(4, floor(min($wmax, $cw * 64) / $cw))
	var $pline = ""
	var $pword = ""
	var $py = $y
	var $pn = size($t)
	repeat $pn ($pi)
		var $pch = substring($t, $pi, 1)
		if $pch == " "
			if size($pline) + size($pword) + 1 > $pmax
				@ui_text($cx, $py, $c, $pline)
				$py += $chh * 1.25
				$pline = $pword
			elseif $pline == ""
				$pline = $pword
			else
				$pline = $pline & " " & $pword
			$pword = ""
		else
			$pword = $pword & $pch
	if size($pline) + size($pword) + 1 > $pmax
		@ui_text($cx, $py, $c, $pline)
		$py += $chh * 1.25
		$pline = $pword
	elseif $pline == ""
		$pline = $pword
	else
		$pline = $pline & " " & $pword
	@ui_text($cx, $py, $c, $pline)
	return $py + $chh * 1.25

; Text at another size (restores the standard size afterwards).
function @ui_text_big($cx : number, $y : number, $c : number, $t : text, $mul : number)
	$rt.text_size(@tsz($ts * $mul))
	var $tb_w = $rt.char_w
	@d_write($cx - size($t) * $tb_w / 2, $y, $c, $t)
	$rt.text_size(@tsz($ts))

function @ui_box($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $fill : number, $edge : number)
	@d_rect($x, $y, $x + $w, $y + $h, $edge, $fill)

; style: 0 normal, 1 selected, 2 danger, 3 go, 4 disabled
function @ui_btn($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $label : text, $act : text, $style : number)
	var $b_fill = $th_panel2
	var $b_edge = $th_line
	var $b_ink = $th_text
	if $style == 1
		$b_fill = $th_accent_dk
		$b_edge = $th_accent
	elseif $style == 2
		$b_fill = $th_bad_dk
		$b_edge = $th_bad
	elseif $style == 3
		$b_fill = $th_ok_dk
		$b_edge = $th_ok
	elseif $style == 4
		$b_ink = $th_dim
	@ui_box($x, $y, $w, $h, $b_fill, $b_edge)
	if (size($label) * $cw > $w - $cw) and ($ts > 1)
		; too long: one text size smaller before cutting it
		$rt.text_size(@tsz($ts - 1))
		var $scw = $rt.char_w
		var $sch = $rt.char_h
		var $s_lab = @ui_fit($label, floor(($w - $scw) / $scw))
		@d_write($x + $w / 2 - size($s_lab) * $scw / 2, $y + ($h - $sch) / 2, $b_ink, $s_lab)
		$rt.text_size(@tsz($ts))
	else
		var $b_lab = @ui_fit($label, floor(($w - $cw) / $cw))
		@ui_text_c($x + $w / 2, $y + ($h - $chh) / 2, $b_ink, $b_lab)
	if ($style != 4) and ($act != "")
		@ui_hit($x, $y, $x + $w, $y + $h, $act)

; Scrollbar for the current list; returns nothing, sets the track geometry.
function @ui_scrollbar($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number)
	var $bh = min($w, $h / 4)
	@ui_btn($x, $y, $w, $bh, "^", "sc_up", 0)
	@ui_btn($x, $y + $h - $bh, $w, $bh, "v", "sc_dn", 0)
	$sc_track_y = $y + $bh + 2
	$sc_track_h = max($h - 2 * $bh - 4, 1)
	$sc_track_x = $x
	$sc_track_w = $w
	$sc_list_on = 1
	@ui_box($x, $sc_track_y, $w, $sc_track_h, $th_panel, $th_line)
	if $sc_total > $sc_vis
		var $th_len = max($sc_track_h * $sc_vis / $sc_total, $chh)
		var $th_pos = $sc_track_y + ($sc_track_h - $th_len) * $sc_pos / max($sc_total - $sc_vis, 1)
		@ui_box($x + 2, $th_pos, $w - 4, $th_len, $th_accent_dk, $th_accent)
	else
		@ui_box($x + 2, $sc_track_y + 2, $w - 4, $sc_track_h - 4, $th_accent_dk, $th_accent_dk)
	@ui_hit($x, $sc_track_y, $x + $w, $sc_track_y + $sc_track_h, "sc_track")

function @ui_scroll_clamp()
	$sc_pos = clamp($sc_pos, 0, max($sc_total - $sc_vis, 0))

; Bezel-aware: a box that would straddle a screen edge on a spanned desktop
; moves down to start just below that edge.
function @bz_fit($by : number, $bh : number) : number
	if ($disp_mode != 1) or ($grp_h <= 0) or (!$cfg_seams)
		return $by
	var $b_top = floor($by / $grp_h)
	var $b_bot = floor(($by + $bh - 1) / $grp_h)
	if $b_top != $b_bot
		return ($b_top + 1) * $grp_h + 3
	return $by

function @ui_toast($t : text)
	$toast = $t
	$toast_until = time + 3
	$ui_dirty = 1

; Status panel on a screen that is not part of the desktop.
function @panel_draw($pk : number)
	var $pw = $sl_w.$pk
	var $ph = $sl_h.$pk
	var $p_ts = max(1, round(min($pw, $ph) / 300))
	$rt.blank($th_bg)
	$rt.text_align(top_left)
	$rt.draw_rect(0, 0, $pw - 1, $ph - 1, $th_line, $th_bg)
	$rt.text_size(@tsz($p_ts * 2))
	var $p_cw2 = $rt.char_w
	var $p_ch2 = $rt.char_h
	$rt.write($pw / 2 - 3 * $p_cw2, $ph * 0.18, $th_accent, "ChipOS")
	$rt.text_size(@tsz($p_ts))
	var $p_cw = $rt.char_w
	var $p_ch = $rt.char_h
	var $p_l1 = text("{} devices", $db_present)
	$rt.write($pw / 2 - size($p_l1) * $p_cw / 2, $ph * 0.18 + $p_ch2 * 1.6, $th_text, $p_l1)
	var $p_up = @uptime_text()
	$rt.write($pw / 2 - size($p_up) * $p_cw / 2, $ph * 0.18 + $p_ch2 * 1.6 + $p_ch * 1.6, $th_dim, $p_up)
	var $p_al = $sl_alias.$pk
	var $p_ch_n = $sl_ch.$pk
	var $p_id = text("{} #{}", $p_al, $p_ch_n)
	$rt.write($pw / 2 - size($p_id) * $p_cw / 2, $ph - $p_ch * 4.2, $th_dim, $p_id)
	var $p_hint = ""
	if substring($ui_page, 0, 4) == "wiz_"
		$p_hint = "SETUP IS ON THE MAIN SCREEN"
	else
		$p_hint = "HOLD: CHOOSE WHAT TO SHOW"
	$rt.write($pw / 2 - size($p_hint) * $p_cw / 2, $ph - $p_ch * 2.4, $th_accent, $p_hint)
	@slot_panel($pk, $pw, $ph)

; Identify panel: big number; green with its order once tapped.
function @panel_identify($pk : number)
	var $iw = $sl_w.$pk
	var $ih = $sl_h.$pk
	var $i_tag = $sl_tag.$pk
	var $i_bg = $th_panel
	var $i_ink = $th_text
	if $i_tag > 0
		$i_bg = $th_ok_dk
		$i_ink = $th_ok
	$rt.blank($i_bg)
	$rt.text_align(top_left)
	$rt.draw_rect(2, 2, $iw - 3, $ih - 3, $i_ink, $i_bg)
	var $i_big = max(2, floor(min($iw, $ih) / 40))
	$rt.text_size(@tsz($i_big))
	var $i_cw = $rt.char_w
	var $i_chh = $rt.char_h
	var $i_txt = "?"
	if $i_tag > 0
		$i_txt = text("{}", $i_tag)
	$rt.write($iw / 2 - size($i_txt) * $i_cw / 2, $ih / 2 - $i_chh / 2, $i_ink, $i_txt)
	var $i_small = max(1, round(min($iw, $ih) / 300))
	$rt.text_size(@tsz($i_small))
	var $i_scw = $rt.char_w
	var $i_sch = $rt.char_h
	var $i_l1 = "TAP THE SCREENS IN"
	var $i_l2 = "READING ORDER:"
	var $i_l3 = "TOP-LEFT FIRST, ROW BY ROW"
	if $i_tag > 0
		$i_l1 = ""
		$i_l2 = "OK"
		$i_l3 = ""
	$rt.write($iw / 2 - size($i_l1) * $i_scw / 2, $i_sch * 1.5, $i_ink, $i_l1)
	$rt.write($iw / 2 - size($i_l2) * $i_scw / 2, $i_sch * 2.8, $i_ink, $i_l2)
	$rt.write($iw / 2 - size($i_l3) * $i_scw / 2, $i_sch * 4.1, $i_ink, $i_l3)
	var $i_done = @disp_identify_count()
	var $i_cnt = text("{} / {}", $i_done, $grp_n)
	$rt.write($iw / 2 - size($i_cnt) * $i_scw / 2, $ih - $i_sch * 2.5, $th_dim, $i_cnt)
	@slot_panel($pk, $iw, $ih)

; Choosing the main dashboard: every screen offers itself.
function @panel_pickmain($pk : number)
	var $pw = $sl_w.$pk
	var $ph = $sl_h.$pk
	$rt.blank($th_panel)
	$rt.text_align(top_left)
	$rt.draw_rect(2, 2, $pw - 3, $ph - 3, $th_accent, $th_panel)
	var $p_ts = max(1, round(min($pw, $ph) / 300))
	$rt.text_size(@tsz($p_ts * 2))
	var $c2 = $rt.char_w
	var $h2 = $rt.char_h
	$rt.write($pw / 2 - 3 * $c2, $ph * 0.22, $th_accent, "ChipOS")
	$rt.text_size(@tsz($p_ts))
	if $rt.char_w * 23 * 2 <= $pw
		$rt.text_size(@tsz($p_ts * 2))
	elseif $rt.char_w * 23 * 1.5 <= $pw
		$rt.text_size(@tsz($p_ts * 1.5))
	var $c1 = $rt.char_w
	var $h1 = $rt.char_h
	var $l1 = "TAP HERE TO RUN"
	var $l2 = "CHIPOS ON THIS SCREEN"
	var $l3 = text("{} #{}", $sl_alias.$pk, $sl_ch.$pk)
	$rt.write($pw / 2 - size($l1) * $c1 / 2, $ph * 0.5, $th_text, $l1)
	$rt.write($pw / 2 - size($l2) * $c1 / 2, $ph * 0.5 + $h1 * 1.5, $th_text, $l2)
	$rt.write($pw / 2 - size($l3) * $c1 / 2, $ph - $h1 * 2.5, $th_dim, $l3)
	@slot_panel($pk, $pw, $ph)

function @panels_tick()
	if (!$panels_dirty) and (time < $panels_next)
		return
	$panels_dirty = 0
	$panels_next = time + 2
	repeat $slot_n ($pt_k)
		var $pt_r = $sl_role.$pt_k
		if $pick_main
			@panel_pickmain($pt_k)
		elseif ($pt_r == 2) and (!@pj_active($pt_k))
			@panel_draw($pt_k)
		elseif $pt_r == 3
			@panel_identify($pt_k)

; Page scroll: start (shift content) / end (unshift, arrows if it overflows).
function @pg_begin($fk : number)
	$oy = $sl_dy.$fk + $pg_sy
	$pg_hdy = $pg_sy
	$pg_track = 1
	$pg_maxy = 0

function @pg_end($fk : number, $bottom : number)
	if !$pg_track
		return
	$pg_track = 0
	$pg_hdy = 0
	$oy = $sl_dy.$fk
	$pg_lim = max(0, $pg_maxy + $chh * 0.5 - $bottom)
	if $pg_sy > $pg_lim
		$pg_sy = $pg_lim
	if $pg_lim <= 0
		return
	; tap arrows on the right edge
	var $aw = $cw * 3
	var $ah = $chh * 2.2
	var $ax = $desk_w - $aw - $cw * 0.3
	if $pg_sy > 0
		@ui_btn($ax, $bottom - $ah * 2 - $chh * 0.6, $aw, $ah, "^", "pg_up", 1)
	if $pg_sy < $pg_lim
		@ui_btn($ax, $bottom - $ah - $chh * 0.3, $aw, $ah, "v", "pg_dn", 1)

function @pg_step($d : number)
	$pg_sy = clamp($pg_sy + $d, 0, $pg_lim)
	$ui_dirty = 1

xc_files.name: rules.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - AUTOMATE: IF <device channel condition> THEN <do something to a
; device>, and optionally ELSE (when it stops being true). Any aliased
; device can be read or driven. Rules act when their condition CHANGES
; (held 2 s, so a value hovering on the line cannot flicker a device), so
; the user can still switch things by hand in between.
storage var $rz_ver : number
storage array $rz_idev : text           ; IF device
storage array $rz_ich : number          ; ... channel
storage array $rz_iop : number          ; 0 > 1 < 2 = 3 not = 4 not empty/zero 5 empty/zero 6 >= 7 <=
storage array $rz_ival : number         ; ... value
storage array $rz_tdev : text           ; THEN device (alias or "group:name")
storage array $rz_tdo : number          ; 1 on 2 off 3 set position 4 number to channel 5 colour 6 text to channel
storage array $rz_tch : number          ; channel (4, 6)
storage array $rz_tval : number         ; number / position / brightness %
storage array $rz_trgb : number         ; colour (5)
storage array $rz_ttxt : text           ; text (6)
storage array $rz_else : number         ; 0 nothing, 1 undo (on/off swap, colour: off), 2 set a number
storage array $rz_eval : number         ; ... that number
storage array $rz_en : number
array $rz_st : number                   ; -2 never evaluated, 0 / 1 last state acted on
array $rz_pend : number                 ; candidate state
array $rz_pt : number                   ; ... since
var $rz_next = 0
var $rz_last = ""                       ; last thing a rule did (for the app page)

function @rz_load()
	if $rz_ver != 1
		$rz_idev.clear()
		$rz_ich.clear()
		$rz_iop.clear()
		$rz_ival.clear()
		$rz_tdev.clear()
		$rz_tdo.clear()
		$rz_tch.clear()
		$rz_tval.clear()
		$rz_trgb.clear()
		$rz_ttxt.clear()
		$rz_else.clear()
		$rz_eval.clear()
		$rz_en.clear()
		$rz_ver = 1

function @rz_pad()
	var $n = $rz_idev.size
	if $rz_st.size > $n
		$rz_st.clear()
		$rz_pend.clear()
		$rz_pt.clear()
	repeat 64 ($q)
		if $rz_st.size < $n
			$rz_st.append(-2)
			$rz_pend.append(-2)
			$rz_pt.append(0)

function @rz_op_text($op : number, $v : number) : text
	var $vt = text("{}", $v)
	if $op == 0
		return "MORE THAN " & $vt
	if $op == 1
		return "LESS THAN " & $vt
	if $op == 2
		return "EQUALS " & $vt
	if $op == 3
		return "IS NOT " & $vt
	if $op == 4
		return "IS NOT EMPTY / NOT ZERO"
	if $op == 5
		return "IS EMPTY / ZERO"
	if $op == 6
		return "AT LEAST " & $vt
	return "AT MOST " & $vt

function @rz_pal_name($i : number) : text
	if $i == 0
		return "WARM WHITE"
	if $i == 1
		return "WHITE"
	if $i == 2
		return "RED"
	if $i == 3
		return "ORANGE"
	if $i == 4
		return "YELLOW"
	if $i == 5
		return "GREEN"
	if $i == 6
		return "BLUE"
	return "PURPLE"

function @rz_col_name($rgb : number) : text
	repeat 8 ($i)
		if @lt_palette($i) == $rgb
			return @rz_pal_name($i)
	return "COLOUR"

function @rz_do_text($do : number, $ch : number, $v : number, $rgb : number, $tx : text) : text
	if $do == 1
		return "TURN ON"
	if $do == 2
		return "TURN OFF"
	if $do == 3
		return text("SET TO {}", $v)
	if $do == 4
		return text("SEND {} TO CHANNEL {}", $v, $ch)
	if $do == 5
		return @rz_col_name($rgb) & text(" AT {}%", $v)
	return "SEND '" & $tx & text("' TO CHANNEL {}", $ch)

function @rz_else_text($i : number) : text
	var $e = $rz_else.$i
	if $e == 0
		return ""
	if $e == 2
		var $do = $rz_tdo.$i
		if $do == 4
			return text("  ELSE SEND {}", $rz_eval.$i)
		return text("  ELSE SET TO {}", $rz_eval.$i)
	var $d = $rz_tdo.$i
	if $d == 1
		return "  ELSE OFF"
	if $d == 2
		return "  ELSE ON"
	return "  ELSE OFF"

function @rz_desc($i : number) : text
	var $s = "IF " & $rz_idev.$i & text(" CH{} ", $rz_ich.$i) & @rz_op_text($rz_iop.$i, $rz_ival.$i)
	$s = $s & "  THEN " & @tgt_name($rz_tdev.$i) & " " & @rz_do_text($rz_tdo.$i, $rz_tch.$i, $rz_tval.$i, $rz_trgb.$i, $rz_ttxt.$i)
	return $s & @rz_else_text($i)

; 1 holds, 0 does not, -1 cannot tell (device missing).
function @rz_eval_cond($i : number) : number
	var $a = $rz_idev.$i
	if @db_idx_alias($a) < 0
		return -1
	var $ch = $rz_ich.$i
	var $v = @in_n($a, $ch)
	var $op = $rz_iop.$i
	var $k = $rz_ival.$i
	if $op == 0
		return $v > $k
	if $op == 1
		return $v < $k
	if $op == 2
		return abs($v - $k) < 0.0005
	if $op == 3
		return abs($v - $k) >= 0.0005
	if ($op == 4) or ($op == 5)
		var $t = @in_t($a, $ch)
		var $full = (abs($v) > 0.000001) or (($t != "") and !isnumeric($t))
		if $op == 4
			return $full
		return !$full
	if $op == 6
		return $v >= $k
	return $v <= $k

; Is this a relay / light ChipOS already switches (keep its saved ON/OFF)?
function @rz_switchable($a : text) : number
	if find($a, "group:") == 0
		return 1
	var $k = @db_idx_alias($a)
	if $k < 0
		return 0
	var $c = $db_cat.$k
	return ($c == 1) or ($c == 2)

function @rz_onoff($a : text, $on : number)
	if @rz_switchable($a)
		@tgt_set($a, $on)
	else
		@out_n($a, 0, $on)

; Do the THEN (or the ELSE) part of rule $i.
function @rz_run($i : number, $then : number)
	var $a = $rz_tdev.$i
	var $do = $rz_tdo.$i
	if !$then
		var $e = $rz_else.$i
		if $e == 0
			return
		if $e == 2
			if $do == 4
				@out_n($a, $rz_tch.$i, $rz_eval.$i)
			else
				@out_n($a, 0, $rz_eval.$i)
			$rz_last = @tgt_name($a) & text(" SET TO {}", $rz_eval.$i)
			return
		if $do == 2
			@rz_onoff($a, 1)
			$rz_last = @tgt_name($a) & " ON"
		else
			@rz_onoff($a, 0)
			$rz_last = @tgt_name($a) & " OFF"
		return
	if $do == 1
		@rz_onoff($a, 1)
	elseif $do == 2
		@rz_onoff($a, 0)
	elseif $do == 3
		@out_n($a, 0, $rz_tval.$i)
	elseif $do == 4
		@out_n($a, $rz_tch.$i, $rz_tval.$i)
	elseif $do == 5
		var $rgb = $rz_trgb.$i
		var $pc = clamp($rz_tval.$i, 0, 100) / 100
		var $r = floor(floor($rgb / 65536) * $pc)
		var $g = floor(mod(floor($rgb / 256), 256) * $pc)
		var $b = floor(mod($rgb, 256) * $pc)
		@lt_set_color($a, $r * 65536 + $g * 256 + $b)
		@rz_onoff($a, 1)
	else
		@out_t($a, $rz_tch.$i, $rz_ttxt.$i)
	$rz_last = @tgt_name($a) & " " & @rz_do_text($do, $rz_tch.$i, $rz_tval.$i, $rz_trgb.$i, $rz_ttxt.$i)

var $rz_rev = 0
function @rz_dirty_note()
	$rz_rev += 1

; Every second. A rule acts when its condition has been in a new state 2 s.
function @rz_tick()
	if time < $rz_next
		return
	$rz_next = time + 1
	@rz_pad()
	var $n = $rz_idev.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $rz_en.$i
			var $e = @rz_eval_cond($i)
			if ($e >= 0) and ($e != $rz_st.$i)
				if $e != $rz_pend.$i
					$rz_pend.$i = $e
					$rz_pt.$i = time
				elseif time - $rz_pt.$i >= 2
					$rz_st.$i = $e
					@rz_run($i, $e)
					@rz_dirty_note()
			else
				$rz_pend.$i = $rz_st.$i

function @rz_remove($i : number)
	$rz_idev.erase($i)
	$rz_ich.erase($i)
	$rz_iop.erase($i)
	$rz_ival.erase($i)
	$rz_tdev.erase($i)
	$rz_tdo.erase($i)
	$rz_tch.erase($i)
	$rz_tval.erase($i)
	$rz_trgb.erase($i)
	$rz_ttxt.erase($i)
	$rz_else.erase($i)
	$rz_eval.erase($i)
	$rz_en.erase($i)
	$rz_st.clear()
	$rz_pend.clear()
	$rz_pt.clear()
	@rz_pad()

xc_files.name: tsrv.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - TIME SERVER (v0.29): ChipOS works out the solar cycle itself with
; a FIXED nav instrument (the same Solar4488V2 model and packet as the
; stand-alone Time Server by Chip Patton) and broadcasts, like that server:
;   TIME        "OCT 30, 2026 15:40:00"          (default 8888)
;   SOLAR CYCLE "SUN RISE 01:23:45"              (default 8844)
;   SOLAR DATA  Solar4488V2 packet               (default 4488)
; each on its own beacon (aliases with TIME / SOLAR or CYCLE / EVENT in the
; name, like the time server's time-cycle, solar-cycle, solar-events).
; ChipOS's own sunrise / sunset then come from it, and the base packet
; tells craft (the Badger) which frequencies to use.
storage var $tsv_ver : number
storage var $tsv_on : number            ; 0 ask, 1 on, 2 off
storage var $tsv_navsel : text          ; nav the user picked ("" automatic)
storage var $tsv_ft : text              ; time frequency
storage var $tsv_fs : text              ; solar cycle text frequency
storage var $tsv_fe : text              ; Solar4488V2 frequency
var $tsv_nav = ""
var $tsv_dbg = 0
var $tsv_sec = -1
var $tsv_booted = 0
var $tsv_bt = ""                        ; beacons in use
var $tsv_bs = ""
var $tsv_be = ""
var $tsv_bscan = 0
var $tsv_time = ""
var $tsv_ok = 0                         ; the model is valid now
var $tsv_sent_t = ""
var $tsv_sent_s = ""
var $tsv_sent_e = ""
var $tsv_sf_t = ""
var $tsv_sf_s = ""
var $tsv_sf_e = ""
;; Chip Patton / ClockCP1: continuously validate the Solar4488V2 motion model.
;; A good startup fit cannot authorize inconsistent later observations.
var $tsv_cycle_seconds = 0
const $tsv_model_count = 24
var $tsv_out1 = "-- CALIBRATING --"
var $tsv_packet : text
var $tsv_lat = 0
var $tsv_lon = 0
var $tsv_hour = 0
var $tsv_decl = 0
var $tsv_elevation = 0
var $tsv_rate = 0
var $tsv_decl_rate = 0
var $tsv_ready = 0
var $tsv_since = -1
var $tsv_until = -1
var $tsv_day = -1
var $tsv_night = -1
var $tsv_last = ""
var $tsv_next = ""
var $tsv_status = "Waiting for navigation"
var $tsv_printed_status = ""
var $tsv_sample_at = 0
var $tsv_selected = -1
var $tsv_deadline = 0
var $tsv_last_at = 0
var $tsv_was_day = 0
var $tsv_best_score = 999
array $tsv_model_hour : number
array $tsv_model_decl : number
array $tsv_candidate_valid : number
array $tsv_mid_hour : number
array $tsv_first_rate : number
var $tsv_mid_at = 0
var $tsv_refined = 0
var $tsv_mount_pitch = 0
var $tsv_mount_roll = 0
var $tsv_mount_heading = 0
storage var $tsv_pitch_sign : number
storage var $tsv_sensor_revision : number
var $tsv_navigation_at = 0
var $tsv_geometry_key = ""
var $tsv_diagnostic_at = 0
var $tsv_best_model = -1
var $tsv_best_rate = 0
var $tsv_best_drift = 0
var $tsv_raw_pitch_start = 0
var $tsv_raw_yaw_start = 0

;; V2 model validity is independent of this installation's local horizon events.
storage var $tsv_server_id : text
storage var $tsv_identity_located : number
storage var $tsv_boot_serial : number
var $tsv_session_id : text
var $tsv_generation = 0
var $tsv_sequence = 0
var $tsv_model_ready = 0
var $tsv_snapshot_valid = 0
var $tsv_snapshot_at = 0
var $tsv_snapshot_hour = 0
var $tsv_snapshot_decl = 0
var $tsv_snapshot_rate = 0
var $tsv_snapshot_decl_rate = 0
var $tsv_snapshot_lat = 0
var $tsv_snapshot_lon = 0
var $tsv_snapshot_celestial : text
var $tsv_model_celestial : text
var $tsv_snapshot_cycle = 0
var $tsv_observed_pitch = 0
var $tsv_observed_yaw = 0
var $tsv_drift_reference_at = 0
var $tsv_drift_reference_decl = 0
var $tsv_decode_current = 0
var $tsv_rate_reference_at = 0
var $tsv_rate_reference_hour = 0
var $tsv_rate_reference_decl = 0
var $tsv_live_score = 0

function @tsv_wrap($angle : number) : number
	return $angle - floor($angle / (2 * pi)) * (2 * pi)

function @tsv_signed($angle : number) : number
	return @tsv_wrap($angle + pi) - pi

function @tsv_invalidate_model()
	$tsv_model_ready = 0
	$tsv_snapshot_valid = 0
	$tsv_ready = 0
	$tsv_decl_rate = 0
	$tsv_drift_reference_at = 0
	$tsv_rate_reference_at = 0

function @tsv_reject_motion($reason : text)
	;; Invalidate immediately; do not clamp an unsupported drift to zero.
	;; Retry calibration from fresh data, retaining identity and changing session.
	if $tsv_model_ready
		$tsv_dbg += 1
		if time > $tsv_rate_reference_at and ($tsv_rate_reference_at > 0)
			var $span = time - $tsv_rate_reference_at
			$tsv_dbg += 1
	@tsv_invalidate_model()
	$tsv_sample_at = 0
	$tsv_navigation_at = 0
	$tsv_status = $reason

function @tsv_begin_session()
	if !$tsv_identity_located
		$tsv_server_id = text("{}-{}-{0.000000}-{0.000000}", $tsv_server_id, @in_t($tsv_nav, 13), $tsv_lat * 180 / pi, $tsv_lon)
		$tsv_identity_located = 1
	$tsv_generation += 1
	$tsv_session_id = text("{}-boot{0}-model{0}", $tsv_server_id, $tsv_boot_serial, $tsv_generation)
	$tsv_sequence = 0

function @tsv_observe()
	var $body = @in_t($tsv_nav, 13)
	if ($body == "") or ($body != $tsv_model_celestial)
		$tsv_snapshot_valid = 0
		return
	var $raw_pitch = @in_n($tsv_nav, 24)
	var $raw_yaw = @in_n($tsv_nav, 25)
	;; A repeated angle pair is a retransmission, not a new Sun observation.
	;; Native numeric == is tolerant. Relational comparisons preserve tiny motion.
	if ($tsv_sequence > 0) and (abs($raw_pitch - $tsv_observed_pitch) <= 0) and (abs($raw_yaw - $tsv_observed_yaw) <= 0)
		return
	if (abs($tsv_rate) < 2 * pi / 5184000) or (abs($tsv_rate) > 2 * pi / 3600)
		@tsv_reject_motion("V2 rejected: hour rate outside supported range")
		return
	if abs($tsv_decl_rate) > abs($tsv_rate) * 0.02
		@tsv_reject_motion("V2 rejected: declination drift exceeds supported model")
		return
	if ($tsv_rate_reference_at > 0) and (time > $tsv_rate_reference_at)
		var $span = time - $tsv_rate_reference_at
		;; This reference is refreshed every 30 seconds, well inside a half-cycle.
		;; A long observation gap cannot be resolved with a shortest-angle alias.
		if $span > 120
			@tsv_reject_motion("V2 rejected: observation gap; recalibrating")
			return
		var $measured_rate = @tsv_signed($tsv_hour - $tsv_rate_reference_hour) / $span
		var $measured_drift = ($tsv_decl - $tsv_rate_reference_decl) / $span
		if $span >= 1
			if $measured_rate * $tsv_rate <= 0
				@tsv_reject_motion("V2 rejected: hour-angle direction changed")
				return
			$tsv_live_score = abs($measured_rate / $tsv_rate - 1) + 8 * abs($measured_drift / $measured_rate)
			if (abs($measured_drift) > abs($measured_rate) * 0.02) or (abs($measured_rate / $tsv_rate - 1) > 0.1)
				@tsv_reject_motion("V2 rejected: live motion no longer matches fit")
				return
		if $span >= 30
			;; Publish measured derivatives in the SAME decoded frame as the angles.
			;; Refresh both derivatives together; never retain an old hour rate.
			$tsv_rate = $measured_rate
			$tsv_decl_rate = $measured_drift
			$tsv_cycle_seconds = 2 * pi / abs($tsv_rate)
			$tsv_best_score = $tsv_live_score
			$tsv_rate_reference_at = time
			$tsv_rate_reference_hour = $tsv_hour
			$tsv_rate_reference_decl = $tsv_decl
	else
		$tsv_rate_reference_at = time
		$tsv_rate_reference_hour = $tsv_hour
		$tsv_rate_reference_decl = $tsv_decl
	;; Check the preceding snapshot's prediction before calling this one usable.
	if $tsv_snapshot_valid and ($tsv_snapshot_at > 0) and (time > $tsv_snapshot_at)
		var $age = time - $tsv_snapshot_at
		var $hour_error = abs(@tsv_signed($tsv_hour - $tsv_snapshot_hour - $tsv_snapshot_rate * $age))
		var $decl_error = abs($tsv_decl - $tsv_snapshot_decl - $tsv_snapshot_decl_rate * $age)
		var $allowance = abs($tsv_rate) * max(2, $age * 0.05)
		if ($hour_error > $allowance) or ($decl_error > $allowance)
			@tsv_reject_motion("V2 rejected: observed direction differs from prediction")
			return
	$tsv_observed_pitch = $raw_pitch
	$tsv_observed_yaw = $raw_yaw
	$tsv_snapshot_hour = $tsv_hour
	$tsv_snapshot_decl = $tsv_decl
	$tsv_snapshot_rate = $tsv_rate
	$tsv_snapshot_decl_rate = $tsv_decl_rate
	$tsv_snapshot_celestial = $body
	$tsv_snapshot_lat = $tsv_lat * 180 / pi
	$tsv_snapshot_lon = $tsv_lon
	$tsv_snapshot_cycle = $tsv_cycle_seconds
	$tsv_snapshot_at = time
	$tsv_snapshot_valid = 1
	$tsv_sequence += 1

function @tsv_boot()
	;; Recorded MiniNav samples verify positive locator elevation, negative yaw.
	;; Repair the TS6 forced-negative sign once; subsequent user changes persist.
	if $tsv_sensor_revision < 7
		$tsv_pitch_sign = 1
		$tsv_sensor_revision = 7
	$tsv_navigation_at = 0
	$tsv_geometry_key = ""
	$tsv_sample_at = 0
	@tsv_invalidate_model()
	$tsv_boot_serial += 1
	$tsv_generation = 0
	$tsv_sequence = 0
	$tsv_snapshot_at = 0
	if $tsv_server_id == ""
		$tsv_server_id = text("Solar-{0.000000}", time)
		$tsv_identity_located = 0
	$tsv_dbg += 1

function @tsv_diagnostics()
	if time - $tsv_diagnostic_at < 10
		return
	$tsv_diagnostic_at = time
	$tsv_dbg += 1
	$tsv_dbg += 1
	$tsv_dbg += 1

function @tsv_unknown()
	$tsv_last = ""
	$tsv_next = ""
	$tsv_since = -1
	$tsv_until = -1
	$tsv_day = -1
	$tsv_night = -1
	$tsv_out1 = "-- CALIBRATING --"

;; Test projected and spherical locator angles, candidate normalizations,
;; and the two roll sign conventions. Phase-speed consistency and a stable
;; solar declination select the interpretation before accepting its day length.
function @tsv_decode($model : number) : number
	var $local_model = mod($model, 12)
	var $shape = mod($local_model, 3)
	var $pitch_scale = 1
	if mod(floor($local_model / 3), 2) == 1
		$pitch_scale = 0.5
	var $roll_sign = 1
	if $local_model >= 6
		$roll_sign = -1
	var $pitch = $tsv_mount_pitch * pi * $pitch_scale
	var $roll = $tsv_mount_roll * pi * $roll_sign
	var $heading = $tsv_mount_heading * pi / 180
	var $sun_pitch = @in_n($tsv_nav, 24) * pi
	;; Archean relative yaw is subtracted from heading (left positive).
	;; First 12 candidates use that convention; retain the opposite as fallback.
	var $yaw_sign = -1
	if $model >= 12
		$yaw_sign = 1
	var $sun_yaw = @in_n($tsv_nav, 25) * pi * $yaw_sign
	var $forward = 0
	var $right = 0
	var $up = 0
	if $shape == 0
		var $hemisphere = sign(cos($sun_pitch))
		$forward = cos($sun_pitch) * cos($sun_yaw) * $hemisphere
		$right = cos($sun_pitch) * sin($sun_yaw) * $hemisphere
		$up = $tsv_pitch_sign * sin($sun_pitch) * cos($sun_yaw) * $hemisphere
	else
		if $shape == 2
			$sun_pitch *= 0.5
		$forward = cos($sun_pitch) * cos($sun_yaw)
		$right = cos($sun_pitch) * sin($sun_yaw)
		$up = $tsv_pitch_sign * sin($sun_pitch)
	var $length = sqrt($forward * $forward + $right * $right + $up * $up)
	if ($length < 0.00000001) or (abs(cos($pitch)) < 0.00001)
		return 0
	$forward /= $length
	$right /= $length
	$up /= $length
	var $along = $forward * cos($pitch) + sin($pitch) * ($up * cos($roll) - $right * sin($roll))
	var $across = $right * cos($roll) + $up * sin($roll)
	var $vertical = -$forward * sin($pitch) + cos($pitch) * ($up * cos($roll) - $right * sin($roll))
	var $east = $along * sin($heading) + $across * cos($heading)
	var $north = $along * cos($heading) - $across * sin($heading)
	$tsv_hour = atan(-$east, $vertical * cos($tsv_lat) - $north * sin($tsv_lat))
	$tsv_decl = asin(clamp($north * cos($tsv_lat) + $vertical * sin($tsv_lat), -1, 1))
	$tsv_elevation = asin(clamp($vertical, -1, 1)) * 180 / pi
	return 1

;; One fixed event timestamp. Between observed crossings it only counts down.
function @tsv_anchor() : number
	var $crossing_cos = -tan($tsv_lat) * tan($tsv_decl)
	if abs($crossing_cos) >= 1
		$tsv_status = "Polar day/night: no daily crossing"
		return 0
	var $crossing = acos($crossing_cos)
	var $speed = 2 * pi / $tsv_cycle_seconds
	var $direction = sign($tsv_rate)
	$tsv_day = 2 * $crossing / $speed
	$tsv_night = $tsv_cycle_seconds - $tsv_day
	var $last_target = $direction * $crossing
	var $next_target = -$direction * $crossing
	$tsv_last = "Sunset"
	$tsv_next = "Sunrise"
	$tsv_was_day = $tsv_elevation > 0
	if $tsv_was_day
		$last_target = -$direction * $crossing
		$next_target = $direction * $crossing
		$tsv_last = "Sunrise"
		$tsv_next = "Sunset"
	$tsv_last_at = time - @tsv_wrap($direction * ($tsv_hour - $last_target)) / $speed
	$tsv_deadline = time + @tsv_wrap($direction * ($next_target - $tsv_hour)) / $speed
	return 1

function @tsv_update()
	var $latitude = @in_n($tsv_nav, 8) * pi / 180
	var $longitude = @in_n($tsv_nav, 9)
	if (@in_n($tsv_nav, 23) <= 0) or (@in_t($tsv_nav, 13) == "") or (abs(cos($latitude)) < 0.00001)
		@tsv_unknown()
		@tsv_invalidate_model()
		$tsv_sample_at = 0
		$tsv_navigation_at = 0
		$tsv_geometry_key = ""
		$tsv_status = "Navigation unavailable or polar reference"
		return
	if $tsv_sample_at == 0
		;; Data routes and the instrument settle asynchronously after spawn.
		var $geometry = text("{0.00000}/{0.00000}/{0.00000}/{0.00000}/{0.00000}", @in_n($tsv_nav, 4), @in_n($tsv_nav, 5), @in_n($tsv_nav, 6), @in_n($tsv_nav, 8), @in_n($tsv_nav, 9))
		if ($tsv_navigation_at == 0) or ($geometry != $tsv_geometry_key)
			$tsv_geometry_key = $geometry
			$tsv_navigation_at = time
			$tsv_status = "Waiting for stable navigation"
			return
		if time - $tsv_navigation_at < 2
			return
	if ($tsv_sample_at == 0) or (time < $tsv_sample_at)
		;; This is a fixed surface installation. Capture its geometry once.
		$tsv_lat = $latitude
		$tsv_lon = $longitude
		$tsv_mount_pitch = @in_n($tsv_nav, 4)
		$tsv_mount_roll = @in_n($tsv_nav, 5)
		$tsv_mount_heading = @in_n($tsv_nav, 6)
		@tsv_unknown()
		@tsv_invalidate_model()
		@tsv_begin_session()
		$tsv_model_celestial = @in_t($tsv_nav, 13)
		$tsv_selected = -1
		$tsv_sample_at = time
		$tsv_raw_pitch_start = @in_n($tsv_nav, 24)
		$tsv_raw_yaw_start = @in_n($tsv_nav, 25)
		$tsv_diagnostic_at = 0
		$tsv_model_hour.clear()
		$tsv_model_decl.clear()
		$tsv_candidate_valid.clear()
		$tsv_mid_hour.clear()
		$tsv_first_rate.clear()
		$tsv_mid_at = 0
		$tsv_refined = 0
		repeat $tsv_model_count ($model)
			var $ok = @tsv_decode($model)
			$tsv_model_hour.append($tsv_hour)
			$tsv_model_decl.append($tsv_decl)
			$tsv_candidate_valid.append($ok)
			$tsv_mid_hour.append(0)
			$tsv_first_rate.append(0)
		$tsv_status = "Checking Sun motion"
		return
	if !$tsv_model_ready
		var $elapsed = time - $tsv_sample_at
		;; Fit two separate 15-second windows instead of trusting a six-second fit.
		if $elapsed < 15
			return
		if $tsv_mid_at == 0
			repeat $tsv_model_count ($model)
				var $ok = @tsv_decode($model)
				$tsv_candidate_valid.$model = $tsv_candidate_valid.$model and $ok
				$tsv_first_rate.$model = @tsv_signed($tsv_hour - $tsv_model_hour.$model) / $elapsed
				$tsv_mid_hour.$model = $tsv_hour
			$tsv_mid_at = time
			return
		if time - $tsv_mid_at < 15
			return
		var $best_model = -1
		var $best_rate = 0
		$tsv_best_score = 999
		$tsv_best_model = -1
		$tsv_best_rate = 0
		$tsv_best_drift = 0
		repeat $tsv_model_count ($model)
			if @tsv_decode($model) and $tsv_candidate_valid.$model
				var $rate = @tsv_signed($tsv_hour - $tsv_model_hour.$model) / $elapsed
				var $drift = ($tsv_decl - $tsv_model_decl.$model) / $elapsed
				var $second_rate = @tsv_signed($tsv_hour - $tsv_mid_hour.$model) / (time - $tsv_mid_at)
				if (abs($rate) > 2 * pi / 5184000) and (abs($rate) < 2 * pi / 3600)
					var $score = 8 * abs($drift) / abs($rate) + abs($second_rate - $tsv_first_rate.$model) / abs($rate)
					if $score < $tsv_best_score
						$tsv_best_score = $score
						$best_model = $model
						$best_rate = $rate
						$tsv_best_model = $model
						$tsv_best_rate = $rate
						$tsv_best_drift = $drift
		if ($best_model < 0) or ($tsv_best_score > 0.05)
			@tsv_unknown()
			$tsv_status = text("Sun model mismatch: {0.000}", $tsv_best_score)
			@tsv_diagnostics()
			;; Never lock all future attempts to a bad startup sample.
			if $elapsed >= 120
				$tsv_sample_at = 0
				$tsv_navigation_at = 0
			return
		$tsv_selected = $best_model
		@tsv_diagnostics()
		$tsv_rate = $best_rate
		$tsv_cycle_seconds = 2 * pi / abs($best_rate)
		var $ok = @tsv_decode($tsv_selected)
		if !$ok
			@tsv_invalidate_model()
			return
		$tsv_model_ready = 1
		$tsv_decl_rate = $tsv_best_drift
		$tsv_drift_reference_at = $tsv_sample_at
		$tsv_drift_reference_decl = $tsv_model_decl.$tsv_selected
		@tsv_observe()
		if !$tsv_model_ready
			@tsv_unknown()
			return
		$tsv_ready = @tsv_anchor()
	else
		if @in_t($tsv_nav, 13) != $tsv_model_celestial
			@tsv_invalidate_model()
			@tsv_unknown()
			$tsv_sample_at = 0
			$tsv_navigation_at = 0
			$tsv_status = "Celestial changed: recalibrating"
			return
		$tsv_decode_current = @tsv_decode($tsv_selected)
		if !$tsv_decode_current
			$tsv_snapshot_valid = 0
			$tsv_status = "Sun reference singular, countdown retained"
		else
			;; Refine the cycle once from a full minute, without moving the current
			;; event timestamp backward/forward on every noisy sensor update.
			if !$tsv_refined and (time - $tsv_sample_at >= 60)
				var $elapsed = time - $tsv_sample_at
				var $long_rate = @tsv_signed($tsv_hour - $tsv_model_hour.$tsv_selected) / $elapsed
				var $long_drift = ($tsv_decl - $tsv_model_decl.$tsv_selected) / $elapsed
				if (sign($long_rate) == sign($tsv_rate)) and (abs($long_rate / $tsv_rate - 1) < 0.1) and (abs($long_drift) < abs($long_rate) * 0.02)
					$tsv_rate = $long_rate
					$tsv_cycle_seconds = 2 * pi / abs($long_rate)
					var $crossing_cos = -tan($tsv_lat) * tan($tsv_decl)
					if abs($crossing_cos) < 1
						$tsv_day = 2 * acos($crossing_cos) / abs($long_rate)
						$tsv_night = $tsv_cycle_seconds - $tsv_day
				$tsv_refined = 1
			@tsv_observe()
			if !$tsv_model_ready
				@tsv_unknown()
				return
			if !$tsv_ready
				$tsv_ready = @tsv_anchor()
			;; Only an observed horizon crossing establishes another event.
			var $is_day = $tsv_elevation > 0
			if $tsv_ready and ($is_day != $tsv_was_day) and (abs($tsv_elevation) > 0.02)
				var $observed_at = time
				$tsv_ready = @tsv_anchor()
				$tsv_last_at = $observed_at
				if !$tsv_ready
					@tsv_unknown()
					return
	if !$tsv_ready
		@tsv_unknown()
		$tsv_status = "Model ready; polar day/night at server"
		return
	$tsv_since = max(0, time - $tsv_last_at)
	$tsv_until = max(0, $tsv_deadline - time)
	var $label = "SUN RISE"
	if $tsv_next == "Sunset"
		$label = "SUN SET"
	var $seconds = floor($tsv_until)
	$tsv_out1 = text("{} {00}:{00}:{00}", $label, floor($seconds / 3600), floor(mod($seconds, 3600) / 60), mod($seconds, 60))
	$tsv_status = text("Solar cycle {0.00}h, model {0}, fit {0.000}", $tsv_cycle_seconds / 3600, $tsv_selected, $tsv_best_score)

function @tsv_publish()
	$tsv_packet = ""
	$tsv_packet.lastevent = $tsv_last
	$tsv_packet.lasteventtime = floor($tsv_since)
	$tsv_packet.nextevent = $tsv_next
	$tsv_packet.nexteventtime = floor($tsv_until)
	$tsv_packet.secondsinday = round($tsv_day)
	$tsv_packet.secondsinnight = round($tsv_cycle_seconds) - round($tsv_day)
	if $tsv_day < 0
		$tsv_packet.secondsinnight = -1
	;; Defend the wire contract too, even if an internal state is inconsistent.
	var $motion_supported = (abs($tsv_snapshot_rate) >= 2 * pi / 5184000) and (abs($tsv_snapshot_rate) <= 2 * pi / 3600) and (abs($tsv_snapshot_decl_rate) <= abs($tsv_snapshot_rate) * 0.02)
	var $fresh_model = $tsv_model_ready and $tsv_snapshot_valid and $motion_supported and ($tsv_snapshot_at > 0) and (time >= $tsv_snapshot_at) and (time - $tsv_snapshot_at <= 10)
	var $model_status = $tsv_status
	if $tsv_model_ready
		$model_status = "Missing or stale observation"
		if $fresh_model
			$model_status = "Ready"
			if !$tsv_ready
				$model_status = "Ready: server polar day/night"
	$tsv_packet.protocol = "Solar4488V2"
	$tsv_packet.modelvalid = $fresh_model
	$tsv_packet.serverid = $tsv_server_id
	$tsv_packet.sampletime = text("{0.000000}", $tsv_snapshot_at)
	$tsv_packet.celestial = $tsv_snapshot_celestial
	$tsv_packet.sourcelatitude = text("{0.000000000000}", $tsv_snapshot_lat)
	$tsv_packet.sourcelongitude = text("{0.000000000000}", $tsv_snapshot_lon)
	;; Game's bundled HUD reference documents east-positive longitude.
	;; This decoder's H is west-positive, therefore H_local = H_source + dLon.
	$tsv_packet.longitudehouranglesign = 1
	$tsv_packet.solarhourangle = text("{0.000000000000}", $tsv_snapshot_hour)
	$tsv_packet.solardeclination = text("{0.000000000000}", $tsv_snapshot_decl)
	$tsv_packet.solarhouranglerate = text("{0.00000000000000}", $tsv_snapshot_rate)
	$tsv_packet.solardeclinationrate = text("{0.00000000000000}", $tsv_snapshot_decl_rate)
	$tsv_packet.horizonaltitude = 0
	$tsv_packet.sessionid = $tsv_session_id
	$tsv_packet.sequence = $tsv_sequence
	$tsv_packet.modelstatus = $model_status
	$tsv_packet.fiterror = text("{0.000000000000}", $tsv_best_score)
	$tsv_packet.solarcycleseconds = text("{0.000000}", $tsv_snapshot_cycle)
	if ($tsv_status != $tsv_printed_status) and (($tsv_ready != 0) or (time - $tsv_diagnostic_at >= 10) or !contains($tsv_status, "Sun model mismatch"))
		$tsv_dbg += 1
		$tsv_printed_status = $tsv_status

function @tsv_load()
	if $tsv_ver != 1
		$tsv_on = 0
		$tsv_navsel = ""
		$tsv_ft = "8888"
		$tsv_fs = "8844"
		$tsv_fe = "4488"
		$tsv_ver = 1

function @tsv_is_nav($j : number) : number
	return contains($db_type.$j, "NavInstrument") and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)

; v0.29.1: a FREE nav - one whose target nothing else uses. Never the
; solar array's nav (its target is the Sun for tracking), a weather vane's,
; or the nav ChipOS reads position / heading / the current target from for
; DRIVE, the attitude display and apps (setting its target to the Sun would
; take that target away).
; (no device-list search here: callers looping over the devices already
; know it is there - v0.29.3, a big base ran out of instructions)
function @tsv_free_ok($a : text) : number
	if $a == ""
		return 0
	return ($a != $so_nav) and ($a != $ws_vnav) and ($a != $att_nav) and !@so_is_solar_name($a)

function @tsv_free($a : text) : number
	if ($a == "") or !@db_has_alias($a)
		return 0
	return @tsv_free_ok($a)

; The one picked, else one named for it (TIME / CLOCK / SUN / SERVER), else
; a weather (wind) nav, else any free one.
function @tsv_pick_nav() : text
	@att_find_nav()
	if @tsv_free($tsv_navsel)
		return $tsv_navsel
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if @tsv_is_nav($j)
			var $l = lower($db_alias.$j)
			if (find($l, "time") >= 0) or (find($l, "clock") >= 0) or (find($l, "server") >= 0) or ((find($l, "sun") >= 0) and (find($l, "solar") < 0))
				if @tsv_free_ok($db_alias.$j)
					return $db_alias.$j
	var $ns = $ws_navsel.size
	repeat $ns ($i)
		if @tsv_free($ws_navsel.$i)
			return $ws_navsel.$i
	repeat $n ($j2)
		if @tsv_is_nav($j2)
			if @tsv_free_ok($db_alias.$j2)
				return $db_alias.$j2
	return ""

; Beacons by name: EVENT -> solar data, SOLAR / CYCLE -> solar cycle, TIME -> time.
function @tsv_beacons()
	if time < $tsv_bscan
		return
	$tsv_bscan = time + 3
	$tsv_bt = ""
	$tsv_bs = ""
	$tsv_be = ""
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if contains($db_type.$j, "Beacon") and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			var $a = $db_alias.$j
			var $l = lower($a)
			if find($l, "event") >= 0
				if $tsv_be == ""
					$tsv_be = $a
			elseif (find($l, "solar") >= 0) or ((find($l, "cycle") >= 0) and (find($l, "time") < 0))
				if $tsv_bs == ""
					$tsv_bs = $a
			elseif find($l, "time") >= 0
				if $tsv_bt == ""
					$tsv_bt = $a

; COMMS and weather keep off the time server's beacons.
function @tsv_is_bcn($a : text) : number
	; v0.29.2: no beacons of its own any more
	if 1
		return 0
	return ($a == $tsv_bt) or ($a == $tsv_bs) or ($a == $tsv_be)

function @tsv_month($m : number) : text
	var $s = "JANFEBMARAPRMAYJUNJULAUGSEPOCTNOVDEC"
	var $k = clamp(floor($m) - 1, 0, 11)
	return substring($s, $k * 3, 3)

var $tsv_pick_t = 0
function @tsv_tick()
	; which nav: every 5 s, not every tick (big bases have hundreds of devices)
	if time >= $tsv_pick_t
		$tsv_pick_t = time + 5
		$tsv_nav = @tsv_pick_nav()
	if ($tsv_on == 2) or ($tsv_nav == "") or ($cfg_arch != 0)
		$tsv_ok = 0
		return
	if floor(time) == $tsv_sec
		return
	$tsv_sec = floor(time)
	if !$tsv_booted
		$tsv_booted = 1
		@tsv_boot()
		@tsv_unknown()
	@out_t($tsv_nav, 0, "sun")
	@out_n($tsv_nav, 5, 0)
	@out_n($tsv_nav, 6, 3)
	@tsv_update()
	@tsv_publish()
	@clk_calc(-1, 0)
	$tsv_time = @tsv_month($ck_mo) & text(" {0}, {0000} {00}:{00}:{00}", $ck_d, $ck_y, $ck_h, $ck_mi, $ck_s)
	$tsv_ok = $tsv_packet.modelvalid == "1"
	if $tsv_ok
		var $okp = @sun_from_packet($tsv_packet, @in_n($tsv_nav, 8), @in_n($tsv_nav, 9))

function @tsv_line() : text
	if $tsv_on == 2
		return "OFF"
	if $tsv_nav == ""
		return "NO FREE NAV INSTRUMENT - add a fixed nav (not the one ChipOS reads position from, not on the solar array)"
	if $tsv_ok
		return $tsv_out1 & "   (" & $tsv_status & ")"
	return $tsv_status

xc_files.name: notices.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - one-time notices: the first time an app is opened it explains
; how to wire and name things for it. GOT IT hides it for good.
storage var $nt_seen : text             ; "|page|page|" already dismissed

function @nt_text($pg : text) : text
	if $pg == "sorter"
		return "SORTER - HOW TO CONNECT IT. 1) Give every container and item conveyor an alias (any name) and connect each one to this computer with a data cable. 2) Item conduits: each conveyor takes from the container on its input side and fills the one on its output side - add one conveyor for each path you want things to move along. 3) Trash: a trash can only connects to the conveyor network (no data cable), so ChipOS can't see it - run a conveyor from the ore container into the trash can, put TRASH in that conveyor's alias, and confirm it when ChipOS asks (or pick it under OVERFLOW). 4) Conveyors with FILTER or SORT in the alias keep the filter you set; ChipOS only runs them for the item they carry. 5) Tap LEARN once: ChipOS runs each conveyor briefly to learn the routes. Then tap a container to give it items or categories."
	if $pg == "craft"
		return "CRAFT - HOW TO CONNECT IT. 1) Give every crafter, container and item conveyor an alias and connect each one to this computer with a data cable. 2) Tap CONTAINERS and pick three: the CRAFTING BUFFER (on the crafters' item input - they craft from it), the COMPLETION BUFFER (on the crafters' item output - products land in it, the sorter empties it) and FULFILLMENT (where finished orders are delivered - an order is done once its items get there; the sorter never touches it). 3) Conveyors: storage containers into the crafting buffer, and the completion buffer into fulfillment and into your storage containers. 4) Conveyors with FILTER or SORT in the alias keep their filter; ChipOS only runs them for the item they carry. 5) TEST NOW moves a few items and crafts one small part to learn the layout."
	if $pg == "refinery"
		return "REFINERY - HOW TO CONNECT IT. Give the chemical furnaces, the container holding the oil shale and the tanks an alias and connect them to this computer with data cables. Put the furnaces' power behind a relay with an alias and pick it here, so ChipOS can turn them off when they have nothing to do. Active radiators that cool the furnaces are run while refining (ChipOS asks once)."
	if $pg == "fluids"
		return "FLUIDS - HOW TO CONNECT IT. Give the tanks, pumps, valves and electrolysers an alias and connect them to this computer with data cables. Put the electrolysers' power behind a relay with an alias and pick it in RULES, so ChipOS can switch them off when the tanks are full."
	if $pg == "mining"
		return "MINING - HOW TO CONNECT IT. Give the drill and the container it fills an alias and connect both to this computer with data cables. The drill's item output goes into that container with an item conduit (add a conveyor in between if you want to move the rock on)."
	if $pg == "solar"
		return "SOLAR / WIND - HOW TO CONNECT IT. Solar: panels on a Small Hinge, the hinge on a Small Pivot, and a mini nav instrument mounted ON the panels so it turns with them - connect pivot, hinge, nav and a solar sensor to this computer. Wind: each propeller on its own Small Pivot, both connected here. Turbines follow the weather station's wind only when its nav instruments are fixed to the base (not on a pivot or the solar array)."
	if $pg == "weather"
		return "WEATHER STATION - HOW TO CONNECT IT. A density sensor and a thermometer out in the open air, and 2 to 4 nav instruments fixed to the base facing different ways - not on a pivot or on the solar array. Connect them all to this computer with data cables."
	if $pg == "lights"
		return "LIGHTS - HOW TO CONNECT THEM. Give each lamp an alias and connect it to this computer with a data cable. Lamps can also hang off a data junction: ChipOS then switches the junction like one light (tick it under JUNCTIONS - names with LIGHT or LAMP are ticked by themselves). Make groups under GROUPS, e.g. EXTERIOR, and mark one AUTOMATIC OUTSIDE LIGHTS: with a solar sensor (with an alias) it comes on at dusk and goes off at dawn. That rule shows in AUTOMATE, where you can change it."
	if $pg == "auto"
		return "AUTOMATE - Every device a rule reads or drives needs an alias and a data cable to this computer. A rule acts when its condition changes and has held for 2 seconds, so you can still switch things by hand in between."
	return ""

function @nt_want() : number
	if find($nt_seen, "|" & $ui_page & "|") >= 0
		return 0
	return @nt_text($ui_page) != ""

function @nt_draw()
	var $q = @nt_text($ui_page)
	@ui_hit(0, 0, $desk_w, $desk_h, "nt_none")
	var $mw = min($desk_w * 0.94, $cw * 66)
	var $bh = $chh * 2.4
	var $mx = $desk_w / 2 - $mw / 2
	var $lines = ceil(size($q) * $cw / ($mw - $cw * 4)) + 2
	var $mh = min($chh * (1.6 + $lines * 1.0) + $bh + $chh, $desk_h - $chh)
	var $my = max($chh * 0.5, $desk_h / 2 - $mh / 2)
	@ui_box($mx, $my, $mw, $mh, $th_panel2, $th_accent)
	var $y = @ui_para_l($mx + $cw, $my + $chh * 0.8, $th_text, $q, $mw - $cw * 2)
	$y = min($y + $chh * 0.4, $my + $mh - $bh - $chh * 0.5)
	@ui_btn($mx + $cw, $y, $mw - $cw * 2, $bh, "GOT IT", "nt_ok", 3)

function @nt_action($act : text)
	if $act == "nt_ok"
		if $nt_seen == ""
			$nt_seen = "|"
		$nt_seen = $nt_seen & $ui_page & "|"
	$ui_dirty = 1

xc_files.name: sorter.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - SORTER: every container can be given items (direct) and / or
; categories. Direct items always win: an item assigned to one container is
; never kept by another container's category (it is moved out to its own).
; Containers marked INPUT are emptied into the others. Ore containers that
; fill past half throw out (or move to overflow) the extra of ores there
; are several stacks of - silicon first, then iron, copper, aluminium...
; It moves things with the CRAFT mover (same learned conveyor routes).
storage var $sx_ver : number
storage array $sx_box : text            ; container alias
storage array $sx_it : text             ; "|item|item|" assigned directly
storage array $sx_cat : number          ; categories (bits below)
storage var $sx_off : number            ; 1 = sorting paused
storage var $sx_ovm : number            ; extra ore: 0 not asked 1 trash 2 overflow container 3 keep
storage var $sx_stk : number            ; stacks of an ore to keep (0 = 2)
storage var $sx_rare : number           ; 1 = rare ores may be thrown out too
var $sx_present = 0
var $sx_next = 0
var $sx_rr = 0
var $sx_note = ""
var $sx_fail = ""                       ; "|box>item|" no way found (cleared each minute)
var $sx_fail_t = 0
var $sx_ck_a = ""                       ; last exploring move: did this container lose it?
var $sx_ck_k = ""
var $sx_ck_q = 0
; category bits
; 1 DEVICES 2 BUILDING MATERIALS 4 HAND TOOLS 8 ORES 16 COMMON ORES
; 32 RARE ORES 64 OVERFLOW 128 INPUT (empty into the others)

function @sx_load()
	if $sx_ver != 1
		$sx_box.clear()
		$sx_it.clear()
		$sx_cat.clear()
		$sx_ver = 1

function @bit($c : number, $b : number) : number
	return mod(floor($c / $b), 2) == 1

; ores / common / rare / overflow
function @sx_orecat($c : number) : number
	return @bit($c, 8) or @bit($c, 16) or @bit($c, 32)

function @sx_cat_name($b : number) : text
	if $b == 1
		return "DEVICES"
	if $b == 2
		return "BUILDING MATERIALS"
	if $b == 4
		return "HAND TOOLS"
	if $b == 8
		return "ORES (ALL)"
	if $b == 16
		return "COMMON ORES"
	if $b == 32
		return "RARE ORES"
	if $b == 64
		return "OVERFLOW"
	if $b == 256
		return "SUB-COMPONENTS (CRAFTING PARTS)"
	return "INPUT (EMPTY INTO THE OTHERS)"

; ---------- items ----------
function @sx_nm($k : text) : text
	var $p = find($k, ".")
	if $p >= 0
		return substring($k, $p + 1, size($k))
	return $k

function @sx_in($list : text, $nm : text) : number
	return find($list, "|" & $nm & "|") >= 0

var $sx_common = "|Silicon|Iron|Copper|Aluminium|Carbon|WaterIce|Rock|OilShale|"
var $sx_rarel = "|Gold|Silver|Uranium|Tungsten|Titanium|Chrome|Nickel|Fluorite|Tin|Lead|"
var $sx_nuc = "|FluoritePowder|PlutoniumDioxide|UraniumDioxide|UraniumPowder|UraniumTetrafluoride|UranylFluoride|YellowCake|"
var $sx_spool = "|DataCable|FluidPipe|HighVoltageCable|ItemConduit|LowVoltageCable|"
var $sx_s64 = "|PilotSeat|HighVoltageBattery|DockingPort|Hitch|GeothermalExchanger|EnrichmentCentrifuge|SabatierReactor|Gyroscope|SmallGyroscope|ActiveRadiator|Crafter|ItemConveyor|PassiveRadiator|SmallSteamTurbine|Propeller|Container|SmallContainer|FluidTank|BigTurboPump|Wheel|"
var $sx_s8 = "|DockableDoor|MiningDrill|ChemicalFurnace|Electrolyser|DieselGenerator|Turbojet|Crusher|SteamTurbine|FissionReactor|BigFluidTank|BigThruster|BigWheel|"
var $sx_p256 = "|Casing|Disk|Magnet|Motor|Panel|HDD|"

; 16 common ore, 32 rare ore, 1 device, 2 building material, 4 hand tool,
; 256 sub-component (parts only used in crafting: screws, wire, casings...)
function @sx_class($k : text) : number
	var $n = @sx_nm($k)
	if find($k, "ARCHEAN_celestial.") == 0
		if @sx_in($sx_common, $n)
			return 16
		if @sx_in($sx_rarel, $n)
			return 32
	if (find($k, "ARCHEAN_nuclear.") == 0) and @sx_in($sx_nuc, $n)
		return 32
	var $z = size($n)
	if (($z > 4) and (substring($n, $z - 4, 4) == "Tool")) or ($n == "Canister")
		return 4
	if (($z > 5) and (substring($n, $z - 5, 5) == "Block")) or ($n == "SteelBeam") or ($n == "SteelRod")
		return 2
	if (find($k, "ARCHEAN_parts.") == 0) or ($n == "HDD")
		return 256
	if @sx_in($sx_spool, $n)
		return 2
	return 1

function @sx_is_ore($k : text) : number
	var $c = @sx_class($k)
	return ($c == 16) or ($c == 32)

; One stack (ores in grams: 10 t).
function @sx_stack($k : text) : number
	var $n = @sx_nm($k)
	var $c = @sx_class($k)
	if $n == "Rock"
		return 10000
	if ($c == 16) or ($c == 32) or @sx_in($sx_spool, $n)
		return 10000000
	if $c == 4
		if $n == "Canister"
			return 256
		return 1
	if ($c == 2) or ($c == 256)
		if $n == "LeadBlock"
			return 256
		if find($k, "ARCHEAN_parts.") == 0
			if @sx_in($sx_p256, $n)
				return 256
			return 1024
		if $n == "HDD"
			return 256
		return 10000
	if @sx_in($sx_s64, $n)
		return 64
	if @sx_in($sx_s8, $n)
		return 8
	if ($n == "UraniumRod") or ($n == "PlutoniumPellet")
		return 1
	return 256

; ---------- containers ----------
function @sx_find($a : text) : number
	var $n = $sx_box.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $sx_box.$i == $a
			return $i
	return -1

function @sx_slot($a : text) : number
	var $i = @sx_find($a)
	if $i < 0
		$sx_box.append($a)
		$sx_it.append("")
		$sx_cat.append(0)
		$i = $sx_box.size - 1
	return $i

function @sx_cats_of($a : text) : number
	var $i = @sx_find($a)
	if $i < 0
		return 0
	return $sx_cat.$i

function @sx_cap($a : text) : number
	var $j = @db_idx_alias($a)
	if $j >= 0
		if $db_type.$j == "SmallContainer"
			return 25
	return 50

; Slots in use / slots (0..1).
function @sx_fill_inv($inv : text, $a : text) : number
	var $used = 0
	foreach $inv ($k, $v)
		var $q = $v:number
		if $q > 0
			$used += ceil($q / @sx_stack($k) - 0.000001)
	return $used / @sx_cap($a)

function @sx_fill($a : text) : number
	var $i = @cb_find($a)
	if $i < 0
		return 0
	return @sx_fill_inv($cb_inv.$i, $a)

function @sx_used() : number
	var $n = $sx_box.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if ($sx_cat.$i != 0) or ($sx_it.$i != "")
			return 1
	return 0

; How well category set $c fits item $k (0 not at all).
function @sx_score($c : number, $k : text) : number
	var $cl = @sx_class($k)
	if ($cl == 16) or ($cl == 32)
		if @bit($c, $cl)
			return 3
		if @bit($c, 8)
			return 2
	elseif @bit($c, $cl)
		return 3
	if @bit($c, 64)
		return 1
	return 0

; CRAFT's own containers: the sorter never fills them (or empties the
; crafting buffer / fulfillment). The completion buffer it does empty.
function @sx_reserved($a : text) : number
	return ($a != "") and (($a == $cr_buf) or ($a == $cr_ful) or ($a == $cr_done))

; Where item $k sitting in container $from belongs. "" = leave it there.
function @sx_dest($k : text, $from : text) : text
	var $n = $sx_box.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if @set_has($sx_it.$i, $k)
			if ($sx_box.$i == $from) or (@cb_find($sx_box.$i) < 0) or @sx_reserved($sx_box.$i)
				return ""
			return $sx_box.$i
	var $fi = @sx_find($from)
	var $sf = 0
	if $fi >= 0
		$sf = @sx_score($sx_cat.$fi, $k)
	var $best = ""
	var $bs = 0
	var $bf = 2
	repeat $n ($j)
		var $a = $sx_box.$j
		if ($a != $from) and !@sx_reserved($a) and (@cb_find($a) >= 0)
			var $s = @sx_score($sx_cat.$j, $k)
			if $s > 0
				var $f = @sx_fill($a)
				var $lim = 0.98
				; out of overflow only into an ore container with plenty of room
				if ($fi >= 0) and @sx_is_ore($k)
					if @bit($sx_cat.$fi, 64)
						$lim = 0.45
				if $f < $lim
					if ($s > $bs) or (($s == $bs) and ($f < $bf))
						$best = $a
						$bs = $s
						$bf = $f
	if ($sf > 0) and ($sf >= $bs)
		return ""
	return $best

; ---------- trash ----------
; Trash cans sit on the conveyor network only - ChipOS can't see them. The
; user confirms (or picks) the conveyor that feeds one: $sx_tcv.
function @sx_tcv_set() : number
	return ($sx_tcv != "") and ($sx_tcv != "-")

function @sx_is_trash_cv($c : number) : number
	var $a = $cv_a.$c
	if @sx_tcv_set() and ($a == $sx_tcv)
		return 1
	return find(lower($a), "trash") >= 0

; A conveyor with TRASH in its alias (a guess to confirm).
function @sx_trash_guess() : text
	var $n = $cv_a.size
	repeat $n ($c)
		if @cr_live($cv_a.$c) and (find(lower($cv_a.$c), "trash") >= 0)
			return $cv_a.$c
	return ""

; The trash conveyor, if it takes from container $a (-1 none).
function @sx_trash_cv($a : text) : number
	if !@sx_tcv_set()
		return -1
	var $u = @cv_find($sx_tcv)
	if $u >= 0
		if @cr_live($sx_tcv) and (($cv_src.$u == "") or @set_has($cv_src.$u, $a))
			return $u
	return -1

function @sx_trash_name() : text
	if @sx_tcv_set()
		return $sx_tcv
	return ""

; ---------- moving ----------
function @sx_tried($c : number, $k : text) : number
	return find($mv_tried, "|" & text("{}", $c) & ":" & $k & "|") >= 0

; Move $amt of $k from container index $si one hop toward container $to.
; 1 started, -1 no way known.
function @sx_hop($k : text, $si : number, $to : text, $amt : number) : number
	var $ti = @cb_find($to)
	if $ti < 0
		return -1
	if time > $mv_tried_t
		$mv_tried = ""
		$mv_tried_t = time + 60
	@bx_route($ti)
	var $ds = $bx_dist.$si
	var $ne = $ed_c.size
	if $ds < 9999
		repeat $ne ($e)
			var $dd = $ed_d.$e
			if ($ed_s.$e == $si) and ($bx_dist.$dd == $ds - 1)
				var $c = $ed_c.$e
				if @cv_carries($c, $k) and !@sx_tried($c, $k) and !@sx_is_trash_cv($c)
					if @cr_is_ore($k)
						$mv_dur = clamp($amt / 1000000, 0.5, 5)
					@mv_start($c, $k, $amt, $to)
					return 1
	; explore: a conveyor that takes from here, or fills $to (it may take
	; from here too), or one not known yet - a small amount while learning
	var $a = $cb_a.$si
	var $nc = $cv_a.size
	var $ex = 1
	if @cr_is_ore($k)
		$ex = 1000
	$amt = min($amt, $ex)
	repeat 3 ($pass)
		repeat $nc ($c2)
			if @cr_live($cv_a.$c2) and !@sx_tried($c2, $k) and !@sx_is_trash_cv($c2)
				var $ok = 1
				if @cv_is_flt($cv_a.$c2) and ($c2 < $cv_fk.size)
					if ($cv_fk.$c2 != "") and !@set_has($cv_fk.$c2, $k)
						$ok = 0
				if ($cv_pr.$c2 == 1) and ($cv_src.$c2 != "") and ($cv_dst.$c2 == "")
					$ok = 0
				if $ok
					var $fit = 0
					if $pass == 0
						$fit = @set_has($cv_src.$c2, $a) and (@set_has($cv_dst.$c2, $to) or ($cv_dst.$c2 == ""))
					elseif $pass == 1
						$fit = @set_has($cv_dst.$c2, $to)
					else
						$fit = ($cv_src.$c2 == "") and ($cv_pr.$c2 != 1)
					if $fit
						@mv_start($c2, $k, $amt, $to)
						return 2
	return -1

function @sx_failed($a : text, $k : text) : number
	return find($sx_fail, "|" & $a & ">" & $k & "|") >= 0

; Ores in the order they are thrown out.
function @sx_order() : text
	var $o = "Silicon,Iron,Copper,Aluminium,Carbon,Rock,WaterIce"
	if $sx_rare
		$o = $o & ",Nickel,Tin,Lead,Chrome,Fluorite,Titanium,Tungsten,Silver,Gold,Uranium"
	return $o

; Keep an ore container from filling up. 1 = something started.
function @sx_trim($i : number, $a : text) : number
	var $f = @sx_fill_inv($cb_inv.$i, $a)
	if ($f <= 0.5) or ($sx_ovm == 0) or ($sx_ovm == 3)
		return 0
	var $keep = $sx_stk
	if $keep < 1
		$keep = 2
	if $f > 0.85
		$keep = 1
	var $inv = $cb_inv.$i
	var $ord = @sx_order()
	var $no = @split_count($ord, ",")
	repeat $no ($q)
		var $k = "ARCHEAN_celestial." & @split_part($ord, ",", $q)
		var $have = $inv.$k:number
		var $st = @sx_stack($k)
		if ($have > $keep * $st + 1) and (@sx_dest($k, $a) == "") and !@sx_failed($a, $k)
			var $x = $have - $keep * $st
			if $sx_ovm == 1
				var $tc = @sx_trash_cv($a)
				if $tc < 0
					$sx_note = upper($a) & text(" {0}% FULL - THE TRASH CONVEYOR DOES NOT TAKE FROM IT (SEE OVERFLOW)", $f * 100)
					return 0
				$mv_dur = clamp($x / 1000000, 0.5, 6)
				@mv_start($tc, $k, $x, "")
				$sx_note = "TRASHING EXTRA " & upper(@bx_name($k)) & " FROM " & upper($a) & " (" & @cr_amt($k, $x) & " OVER)"
				return 1
			; overflow container
			var $ov = ""
			var $nb = $sx_box.size
			repeat $nb ($j)
				if ($ov == "") and @bit($sx_cat.$j, 64) and ($sx_box.$j != $a) and (@cb_find($sx_box.$j) >= 0)
					if @sx_fill($sx_box.$j) < 0.98
						$ov = $sx_box.$j
			if $ov == ""
				$sx_note = upper($a) & text(" {0}% FULL - NO OVERFLOW CONTAINER WITH ROOM", $f * 100)
				return 0
			if @sx_hop($k, $i, $ov, $x) > 0
				$sx_note = "MOVING " & @cr_amt($k, $x) & " " & upper(@bx_name($k)) & " TO OVERFLOW " & upper($ov)
				return 1
			$sx_fail = $sx_fail & "|" & $a & ">" & $k & "|"
	return 0

; Every 2 s: one move at a time, and never while CRAFT is feeding a crafter.
function @sx_tick()
	while $sx_it.size < $sx_box.size
		$sx_it.append("")
	while $sx_cat.size < $sx_box.size
		$sx_cat.append(0)
	$sx_present = ($cr_boxes >= 2) and ($cv_a.size >= 1)
	$sx_active = $sx_present and !$sx_off and @sx_used()
	if (!$sx_active) or (time < $sx_next)
		return
	$sx_next = time + 2
	if $mv_on or $pr_on
		$sx_next = time + 0.5
		return
	var $nl = $ln_st.size
	repeat $nl ($l)
		if $ln_st.$l == 1
			$sx_note = "WAITING - CRAFT IS MOVING THINGS"
			return
	if time > $sx_fail_t
		$sx_fail = ""
		$sx_fail_t = time + 60
