	; new conveyors: learn them first (small test moves), then sort
	var $ncv = $cv_a.size
	repeat $ncv ($c)
		if ($cv_pr.$c == 0) and @cr_live($cv_a.$c)
			@pr_begin()
			$sx_note = "LEARNING THE CONVEYORS FIRST"
			return
	@cb_read_all()
	if $sx_ck_a != ""
		if @cb_have_a($sx_ck_a, $sx_ck_k) >= $sx_ck_q - 0.0001
			$sx_fail = $sx_fail & "|" & $sx_ck_a & ">" & $sx_ck_k & "|"
		$sx_ck_a = ""
	var $n = $sx_box.size
	if $n == 0
		return
	; the completion buffer is emptied into the sorted containers (left
	; alone while an order is being crafted, unless it is filling up)
	var $di = @cb_find($cr_done)
	if $di >= 0
		if ($co_key.size == 0) or (@sx_fill_inv($cb_inv.$di, $cr_done) > 0.8)
			var $dinv = $cb_inv.$di
			foreach $dinv ($dk, $dv)
				var $dq = $dv:number
				if ($dq > 0) and !@sx_failed($cr_done, $dk)
					var $dd = @sx_dest($dk, $cr_done)
					if $dd != ""
						var $dr = @sx_hop($dk, $di, $dd, $dq)
						if $dr == 2
							$sx_ck_a = $cr_done
							$sx_ck_k = $dk
							$sx_ck_q = $dq
						if $dr > 0
							$sx_note = "MOVING " & upper(@bx_name($dk)) & " FROM COMPLETION BUFFER TO " & upper($dd)
							$ui_dirty = 1
							return
						$sx_fail = $sx_fail & "|" & $cr_done & ">" & $dk & "|"
	repeat $n ($q)
		var $b = @posmod($sx_rr + $q, $n)
		var $a = $sx_box.$b
		var $i = @cb_find($a)
		if ($i >= 0) and !@sx_reserved($a) and (($sx_cat.$b != 0) or ($sx_it.$b != ""))
			var $inv = $cb_inv.$i
			foreach $inv ($k, $v)
				var $qty = $v:number
				if ($qty > 0) and !@sx_failed($a, $k)
					var $d = @sx_dest($k, $a)
					if $d != ""
						var $r = @sx_hop($k, $i, $d, $qty)
						if $r == 2
							$sx_ck_a = $a
							$sx_ck_k = $k
							$sx_ck_q = $qty
						if $r > 0
							$sx_note = "MOVING " & upper(@bx_name($k)) & " FROM " & upper($a) & " TO " & upper($d)
							$sx_rr = $b + 1
							$ui_dirty = 1
							return
						$sx_fail = $sx_fail & "|" & $a & ">" & $k & "|"
			if @sx_orecat($sx_cat.$b)
				if @sx_trim($i, $a)
					$sx_rr = $b + 1
					$ui_dirty = 1
					return
	$sx_rr = @posmod($sx_rr + 1, $n)
	if find($sx_note, "FULL") < 0
		if $sx_fail != ""
			$sx_note = "SORTED - SOME ITEMS HAVE NO KNOWN CONVEYOR ROUTE (RUN LEARN)"
		else
			$sx_note = "ALL SORTED"

; Ask how to handle extra ore once ore / overflow categories are in use.
function @sx_need_ask() : number
	if !$sx_present
		return 0
	if ($sx_ovm != 0) and (($sx_ovm != 1) or @sx_tcv_set())
		return 0
	var $n = $sx_box.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if @sx_orecat($sx_cat.$i)
			return 1
	return 0

; CRAFT fulfillment: move the first order's finished items into the
; fulfillment container (from the completion buffer, or where crafters put
; them). The order is done once they are there.
var $cf_next = 0
function @cr_ful_tick()
	if ($co_key.size == 0) or (time < $cf_next)
		return
	$cf_next = time + 1
	var $fi = @cb_find($cr_ful)
	if ($fi < 0) or $mv_on or $pr_on
		return
	var $nl = $ln_st.size
	repeat $nl ($l)
		if $ln_st.$l == 1
			return
	var $k = $co_key.0
	var $need = $co_qty.0 - @cr_delivered(0)
	if $need <= 0
		return
	var $src = ""
	if @cb_have_a($cr_done, $k) > 0
		$src = $cr_done
	else
		var $nf = $cf_out.size
		repeat $nf ($f)
			var $o = $cf_out.$f
			if ($src == "") and ($o != "") and ($o != $cr_ful) and (@cb_have_a($o, $k) > 0)
				$src = $o
	if $src == ""
		return
	var $si = @cb_find($src)
	var $amt = min($need, @cb_have($si, $k))
	if @sx_hop($k, $si, $cr_ful, $amt) > 0
		$cr_note = "MOVING " & upper(@rc_name($k)) & " TO " & upper($cr_ful)
	else
		$cr_note = "NO CONVEYOR KNOWN FROM " & upper($src) & " TO " & upper($cr_ful) & " - RUN TEST"
	$ui_dirty = 1

; ChipOS - COMMS app pages.
var $bfn_cur = -1                       ; broadcast field being edited
var $cm_dev = ""                        ; device chosen for a field

function @page_comms()
	var $y = @set_header("COMMS")
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	if $cm_bcn_n == 0
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_warn, "No beacon found. Add a Beacon with an alias to broadcast and to listen.", $tw)
		return
	var $st = "BROADCAST: " & @cm_mode_name($cm_mode)
	if ($cm_mode > 0) and ($cm_freq != "")
		$st = $st & "  ON " & $cm_freq
	if ($cm_mode > 0) and ($cm_freq == "")
		$st = $st & "  (NO FREQUENCY)"
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, $st, $tw)
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, @sun_line(), $tw)
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, @wx_line(), $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.5
	var $nm = $cm_name
	if $nm == ""
		$nm = "(NOT SET)"
	$y = @set_row($y, "BROADCAST", $nm & "  -  " & @cm_mode_name($cm_mode), "go:cm_tx", $th_accent)
	var $fn = 0
	var $bn = $bf_on.size
	repeat $bn ($i)
		if $bf_on.$i
			$fn += 1
	$y = @set_row($y, "WHAT IS BROADCAST", text("{} chosen values + built-in fields", $fn), "go:cm_fields", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "CONTACTS", text("{} frequencies", $cd_freq.size), "go:cm_dir", $th_accent)
	var $sst = "STOPPED"
	if $sc_on == 1
		$sst = "SCANNING " & @sc_fmt($sc_f)
	elseif $sc_on == 2
		$sst = "PAUSED AT " & @sc_fmt($sc_f)
	$y = @set_row($y, "SCANNER", $sst & text("   {} found", $sh_freq.size), "go:cm_scan", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "SOLAR CYCLE / TIME SERVER & WEATHER", "time server, solar cycle and weather settings", "go:cm_srv", $th_accent)

function @page_cm_tx()
	var $y = @set_header("COMMS / BROADCAST")
	var $nm = $cm_name
	if $nm == ""
		$nm = "(NOT SET)"
	$y = @set_row($y, "NETWORK NAME", $nm & "  (tap to change)", "cm_kb_name", $th_accent)
	var $fq = $cm_freq
	if $fq == ""
		$fq = "(NOT SET)"
	$y = @set_row($y, "FREQUENCY", $fq & "  (tap to change)", "cm_kb_freq", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "SEND", @cm_mode_name($cm_mode) & "  (tap to change)", "cm_mode", $th_accent)
	var $bl = $cm_bcn
	if $cm_tx == ""
		$bl = $bl & " (AUTO)"
	$y = @set_row($y, "SENDING BEACON", $bl & "  (tap to change)", "cm_bcn", $th_accent)
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "NAME ONLY sends just the name. STRUCTURED DATA sends chipos.node fields - choose them in WHAT IS BROADCAST.", $tw)

; Built-in fields + the user's values, tap to switch on/off.
function @cm_field_rows()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $lb = "TYPE OF BUILD"
	repeat 4 ($q)
		var $bit = 1
		if $q == 1
			$bit = 2
			$lb = "POSITION (lat, lon, alt from the Nav)"
		elseif $q == 2
			$bit = 4
			$lb = "SUNRISE / SUNSET"
		elseif $q == 3
			$bit = 8
			$lb = "WEATHER (relayed from the station)"
		var $mk = "[  ]  "
		if @cm_flag($bit)
			$mk = "[X]  "
		$sl_txt.append($mk & $lb)
		$sl_spec.append(text("b{}", $bit))
	var $n = min($bf_key.size, $bf_src.size)
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $mk2 = "[  ]  "
		if ($i < $bf_on.size) and $bf_on.$i
			$mk2 = "[X]  "
		$sl_txt.append($mk2 & $bf_key.$i & " = " & @cm_src_text($bf_src.$i))
		$sl_spec.append(text("f{}", $i))
	$sl_txt.append("+ ADD A VALUE")
	$sl_spec.append("add")

function @page_cm_fields()
	@cm_field_rows()
	@pick_list("WHAT IS BROADCAST", "Name, frequency and time are always sent. Tap a line to switch it; tap a value's name to edit it.", "cm_field")

function @page_cm_fedit()
	if ($bfn_cur < 0) or ($bfn_cur >= $bf_key.size)
		@go("cm_fields")
		return
	var $y = @set_header("VALUE: " & $bf_key.$bfn_cur)
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "SOURCE: " & $bf_src.$bfn_cur & "   NOW: " & @cm_src_text($bf_src.$bfn_cur), $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.4
	var $ol = "SENDING: OFF"
	var $os = 0
	if $bf_on.$bfn_cur
		$ol = "SENDING: ON"
		$os = 3
	$y = @set_button($y, $ol, "cm_fon", $os)
	$y = @set_button($y, "RENAME", "cm_kb_key", 0)
	$y = @set_button($y, "REMOVE", "cm_fdel", 2)

function @page_cm_src()
	$cwn_type = 3
	@cw_sources()
	@pick_list("ADD A VALUE - SOURCE", "Pick what to broadcast.", "cm_src")

function @page_cm_chan()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	repeat 8 ($c)
		var $tv = @in_t($cm_dev, $c)
		var $lv = text("{0.00}", @in_n($cm_dev, $c))
		if $tv != ""
			$lv = @ui_fit($tv, 24)
		$sl_txt.append(text("CHANNEL {}   (now ", $c) & $lv & ")")
		$sl_spec.append(text("{}", $c))
	@pick_list($cm_dev & " - CHANNEL", "Which channel? Live values are shown.", "cm_chan")

function @page_cm_dir()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	@cd_pad()
	var $n = $cd_freq.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $nm = $cd_name.$i
		if $nm == ""
			$nm = "?"
		var $ln = $nm & "  (" & $cd_freq.$i & ")  " & @cm_dist($cd_dist.$i) & "  " & @cm_age($cd_t.$i)
		if $i == $cd_focus
			$ln = "> " & $ln & "  FOLLOWING"
		$sl_txt.append($ln)
		$sl_spec.append(text("{}", $i))
	$sl_txt.append("+ ADD A FREQUENCY")
	$sl_spec.append("add")
	var $sst = "SCANNER: FIND BEACONS"
	if $sc_on == 1
		$sst = "SCANNER: SCANNING " & @sc_fmt($sc_f) & text(" ({} FOUND)", $sh_freq.size)
	elseif $sh_freq.size > 0
		$sst = text("SCANNER: {} FOUND", $sh_freq.size)
	$sl_txt.append($sst)
	$sl_spec.append("scan")
	var $hint = "Frequencies are listened to in turn (about 1.3 s each)."
	if $cm_rx == $cm_bcn
		$hint = $hint & " A second beacon lets ChipOS listen without retuning the sender's receiver."
	@pick_list("CONTACTS", $hint, "cm_dir")

; One directory entry: everything it sends.
function @page_cm_dent()
	@cd_pad()
	if ($cm_cur < 0) or ($cm_cur >= $cd_freq.size)
		@go("cm_dir")
		return
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $d = $cd_data.$cm_cur
	var $any = 0
	foreach $d ($k, $v)
		$any = 1
		$sl_txt.append($k & ":  " & $v)
		$sl_spec.append("")
	if (!$any) and ($d != "")
		$sl_txt.append($d)
		$sl_spec.append("")
	if $d == ""
		$sl_txt.append("NOTHING HEARD YET")
		$sl_spec.append("")
	var $bw = $cw * 10
	@ui_btn($content_x + $content_w - $bw, $content_y - $chh * 0.3, $bw, $chh * 2, "REMOVE", "cm_ddel", 2)
	var $fl = "FOLLOW: AUTO"
	var $fs = 0
	if $cd_follow.$cm_cur == 1
		$fl = "FOLLOW: ON"
		$fs = 3
	elseif $cd_focus == $cm_cur
		$fl = "AUTO: FOLLOWING"
		$fs = 1
	var $fw = $cw * 17
	@ui_btn($content_x + $content_w - $bw - $fw - $cw, $content_y - $chh * 0.3, $fw, $chh * 2, $fl, "cm_dfollow", $fs)
	var $t = $cd_name.$cm_cur
	if $t == ""
		$t = $cd_freq.$cm_cur
	@pick_list($t, $cd_freq.$cm_cur & "   " & @cm_dist($cd_dist.$cm_cur) & "   heard " & @cm_age($cd_t.$cm_cur), "cm_nop")

; Scanner: start / pause / stop, speed, and what it found.
function @page_cm_scan()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $n = $sh_freq.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $k = $n - 1 - $i
		var $d = $sh_data.$k
		var $nm = $d.name
		if $nm == ""
			$nm = substring($d, 0, 28)
		if $nm == ""
			$nm = "(carrier, no data)"
		var $inc = ""
		var $cn = $cd_freq.size
		repeat $cn ($ci)
			if $cd_freq.$ci == $sh_freq.$k
				$inc = "  - IN CONTACTS"
		$sl_txt.append($sh_freq.$k & "  " & $nm & "  " & @cm_dist($sh_dist.$k) & $inc)
		$sl_spec.append(text("{}", $k))
	if $n == 0
		$sl_txt.append("NOTHING FOUND YET")
		$sl_spec.append("")
	$sl_txt.append(text("OPEN CONTACTS ({})", $cd_freq.size))
	$sl_spec.append("contacts")
	var $bh = $chh * 2.2
	var $gap = $cw * 0.5
	var $bw = (min($content_w, $cw * 70) - $gap * 3) / 4
	var $y0 = $content_y
	var $gl = "START"
	var $gs = 3
	if $sc_on == 1
		$gl = "PAUSE"
		$gs = 1
	elseif $sc_on == 2
		$gl = "RESUME"
	@ui_btn($content_x, $y0, $bw, $bh, $gl, "cm_scgo", $gs)
	@ui_btn($content_x + ($bw + $gap), $y0, $bw, $bh, "STOP", "cm_scstop", 0)
	@ui_btn($content_x + ($bw + $gap) * 2, $y0, $bw, $bh, text("{0.0}s EACH", $sc_dwell), "cm_scspd", 0)
	@ui_btn($content_x + ($bw + $gap) * 3, $y0, $bw, $bh, "FROM 0000", "cm_screset", 0)
	var $st = "STOPPED AT " & @sc_fmt($sc_f)
	if $sc_on == 1
		$st = "SCANNING " & @sc_fmt($sc_f)
	elseif $sc_on == 2
		$st = "PAUSED AT " & @sc_fmt($sc_f)
	if $sc_on != 0
		var $todo = @posmod($sc_from - $sc_f - 1, 10000) + 1
		var $left = $todo * (max($sc_dwell, 0.15) + 0.05)
		$st = $st & text("  (~{0} min left)", $left / 60)
	else
		$st = $st & text("  (full sweep ~{0} min)", 10000 * (max($sc_dwell, 0.15) + 0.05) / 60)
	var $sv_y = $content_y
	var $sv_h = $content_h
	$content_y = $y0 + $bh + $chh * 0.5
	$content_h = $sv_y + $sv_h - $content_y
	@pick_list("SCANNER - FOUND", $st & ". Tap one to add it to CONTACTS. Contacts, time and weather pause while scanning.", "cm_schit")
	$content_y = $sv_y
	$content_h = $sv_h

function @page_cm_srv()
	var $y = @set_header("COMMS / TIME SERVER & WEATHER")
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	var $tl = "OFF"
	if $ts_on
		$tl = "ON"
	; v0.29: ChipOS as the time server
	var $vl = "OFF  (tap to turn on)"
	if $tsv_on != 2
		$vl = "ON - NAV " & $tsv_nav & "  (tap to turn off)"
	$y = @set_row($y, "CHIPOS IS THE TIME SERVER", $vl, "cm_tsv", $th_accent)
	if $tsv_on != 2
		var $bl = "IN THIS BASE'S BROADCAST ON " & $cm_freq & " (time, sunrise / sunset, Solar4488V2)"
		if ($cm_mode != 2) or ($cm_freq == "")
			$bl = "TURN ON THE STRUCTURED BROADCAST (with a frequency) - the time server rides in it"
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, $bl, $tw)
		var $nl = $tsv_nav
		if $nl == ""
			$nl = "NONE FREE"
		$y = @set_row($y, "TIME SERVER NAV: " & $nl, "a free, fixed nav - tap to pick", "go:cm_tsvnav", $th_accent)
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, @tsv_line(), $tw)
		$y += $chh * 0.4
	$y = @set_row($y, "LISTEN TO A TIME SERVER", $tl & "  (tap to change)", "cm_tson", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "SOLAR MODEL FREQUENCY", $ts_freq & "  (Solar4488V2)", "cm_kb_ts", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "FALLBACK FREQUENCY", $ts_fb & "  (SUN SET / SUN RISE text)", "cm_kb_tsfb", $th_accent)
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, @sun_line(), $tw)
	@att_find_nav()
	if $att_nav == ""
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_warn, "Local times need a Nav Instrument (with an alias).", $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.4
	var $wf = $cm_wx
	if $wf == ""
		$wf = "(NONE)"
	$y = @set_row($y, "WEATHER STATION FREQUENCY", $wf & "  (tap to change)", "cm_kb_wx", $th_accent)
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, @wx_line(), $tw)

; Setup step (only when a beacon is present).
function @wiz_net()
	@wiz_frame("NETWORK NAME", "STEP 5")
	var $tw = min($desk_w * 0.9, $cw * 50)
	var $x = $desk_w / 2 - $tw / 2
	var $y = $chh * 7
	$y = @ui_para_c($desk_w / 2, $y, $th_dim, "A beacon was found. Give this build a name to broadcast (you can change it later in COMMS).", $tw)
	$y += $chh * 0.5
	var $bh = $chh * 2.6
	var $nm = $cm_name
	if $nm == ""
		$nm = "TAP TO SET NAME"
	@ui_btn($x, $y, $tw, $bh, $nm, "cm_kb_name", 1)
	$y += $bh + $chh * 0.5
	@ui_btn($x, $y, $tw, $bh, "SEND: " & @cm_mode_name($cm_mode), "cm_mode", 0)
	$y += $bh + $chh * 0.5
	var $hb = ($tw - $cw) / 2
	$y = @bz_fit($y, $bh)
	@ui_btn($x, $y, $hb, $bh, "< BACK", "wz:net_back", 0)
	@ui_btn($x + $hb + $cw, $y, $hb, $bh, "NEXT", "wz:net_next", 3)

; Keyboard results.
; Pick the time server's nav: only free ones are listed.
function @page_cm_tsvnav()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$sl_txt.append("AUTOMATIC")
	$sl_spec.append("")
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if @tsv_is_nav($j) and @tsv_free_ok($db_alias.$j)
			var $t = $db_alias.$j
			if $t == $tsv_nav
				$t = "[ON] " & $t
			$sl_txt.append($t & "   (" & $db_type.$j & ")")
			$sl_spec.append($db_alias.$j)
	@pick_list("TIME SERVER NAV", "Only free navs are listed: not the one ChipOS reads position and the current target from, not the solar array's, not a vane's. It must not move.", "cm_tsvnavset")

function @cm_kb_done($id : text, $ok : number, $t0 : text)
	if !$ok
		return
	var $t = @bk_clean($t0)
	if $id == "cm_name"
		; the frequency follows the name unless a different one was typed
		if ($t != "") and (($cm_freq == "") or ($cm_freq == @cm_freq_of($cm_name)))
			$cm_freq = @cm_freq_of($t)
		$cm_name = $t
		if ($cm_mode == 0) and ($t != "")
			$cm_mode = 1
	elseif $id == "cm_freq"
		$cm_freq = substring($t, 0, 32)
	elseif $id == "cm_ts"
		$ts_freq = substring($t, 0, 32)
	elseif ($id == "cm_tvt") and ($t != "")
		$tsv_ft = substring($t, 0, 32)
	elseif ($id == "cm_tvs") and ($t != "")
		$tsv_fs = substring($t, 0, 32)
	elseif ($id == "cm_tve") and ($t != "")
		$tsv_fe = substring($t, 0, 32)
		$ts_next = 0
	elseif $id == "cm_tsfb"
		$ts_fb = substring($t, 0, 32)
		$ts_next = 0
	elseif $id == "cm_wx"
		$cm_wx = substring($t, 0, 32)
		$wx_next = 0
	elseif $id == "cm_add"
		var $f = substring($t, 0, 32)
		if $f != ""
			@cd_pad()
			$cd_freq.append($f)
			@cd_pad()
	elseif $id == "cm_key"
		var $k = @cm_freq_of($t)
		if $k != ""
			if ($bfn_cur >= 0) and ($bfn_cur < $bf_key.size)
				$bf_key.$bfn_cur = $k
			else
				$bf_key.append($k)
				$bf_src.append($bfn_src)
				$bf_on.append(1)
			@go("cm_fields")
	$ui_dirty = 1

function @cm_action($act : text, $val : number)
	if $act == "cm_kb_name"
		@kb_open(-2, "cm_name", "NETWORK NAME", $cm_name)
	elseif $act == "cm_kb_freq"
		@kb_open(-2, "cm_freq", "BROADCAST FREQUENCY", $cm_freq)
	elseif $act == "cm_kb_ts"
		@kb_open(-2, "cm_ts", "TIME SERVER FREQUENCY", $ts_freq)
	elseif $act == "cm_tsv"
		if $tsv_on != 2
			$tsv_on = 2
		else
			$tsv_on = 1
	elseif $act == "cm_tsvnavset"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			$tsv_navsel = $sl_spec.$val
			$tsv_booted = 0
			$tsv_pick_t = 0
			@go("cm_srv")
	elseif $act == "cm_kb_tvt"
		@kb_open(-2, "cm_tvt", "TIME FREQUENCY", $tsv_ft)
	elseif $act == "cm_kb_tvs"
		@kb_open(-2, "cm_tvs", "SUNRISE / SUNSET FREQUENCY", $tsv_fs)
	elseif $act == "cm_kb_tve"
		@kb_open(-2, "cm_tve", "SOLAR DATA (Solar4488V2) FREQUENCY", $tsv_fe)
	elseif $act == "cm_kb_tsfb"
		@kb_open(-2, "cm_tsfb", "FALLBACK FREQUENCY", $ts_fb)
	elseif $act == "cm_kb_wx"
		@kb_open(-2, "cm_wx", "WEATHER STATION FREQUENCY", $cm_wx)
	elseif $act == "cm_kb_key"
		if ($bfn_cur >= 0) and ($bfn_cur < $bf_key.size)
			@kb_open(-2, "cm_key", "FIELD NAME", $bf_key.$bfn_cur)
	elseif $act == "cm_mode"
		$cm_mode = @posmod($cm_mode + 1, 3)
	elseif $act == "cm_bcn"
		; next beacon (or back to automatic)
		var $n = $db_id.size
		var $pick = ""
		var $take = $cm_tx == ""
		repeat $n ($j)
			if contains($db_type.$j, "Beacon") and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
				if $take and ($pick == "")
					$pick = $db_alias.$j
				if $db_alias.$j == $cm_tx
					$take = 1
		$cm_tx = $pick
		$cm_scan_next = 0
		$cm_sent_f = "-"
	elseif $act == "cm_tson"
		$ts_on = !$ts_on
		$ts_next = 0
	elseif $act == "cm_field"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			var $sp = $sl_spec.$val
			if $sp == "add"
				$bfn_cur = -1
				@go("cm_src")
			elseif find($sp, "b") == 0
				var $bit = 0
				$bit = substring($sp, 1, 3)
				if @cm_flag($bit)
					$cm_relay -= $bit
				else
					$cm_relay += $bit
			elseif find($sp, "f") == 0
				var $fi = 0
				$fi = substring($sp, 1, 3)
				$bfn_cur = $fi
				@go("cm_fedit")
	elseif $act == "cm_fon"
		if ($bfn_cur >= 0) and ($bfn_cur < $bf_on.size)
			$bf_on.$bfn_cur = !$bf_on.$bfn_cur
	elseif $act == "cm_fdel"
		if ($bfn_cur >= 0) and ($bfn_cur < $bf_key.size)
			$bf_key.erase($bfn_cur)
			$bf_src.erase($bfn_cur)
			$bf_on.erase($bfn_cur)
		@go("cm_fields")
	elseif $act == "cm_src"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			var $sp2 = $sl_spec.$val
			var $k2 = @spec_part($sp2, 0)
			if ($k2 == "dev") or ($k2 == "out")
				$cm_dev = @spec_part($sp2, 1)
				@go("cm_chan")
			else
				$bfn_src = $sp2
				$bfn_cur = -1
				var $def = $sl_txt.$val
				var $c = find($def, ": ")
				if $c >= 0
					$def = substring($def, $c + 2, size($def))
				@kb_open(-2, "cm_key", "FIELD NAME", @cm_freq_of($def))
	elseif $act == "cm_chan"
		$bfn_src = "dev:" & $cm_dev & text(":{}", $val)
		$bfn_cur = -1
		@kb_open(-2, "cm_key", "FIELD NAME", @cm_freq_of($cm_dev) & text("-ch{}", $val))
	elseif $act == "cm_dir"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			if $sl_spec.$val == "add"
				@kb_open(-2, "cm_add", "FREQUENCY TO LISTEN TO", "")
			elseif $sl_spec.$val == "scan"
				@go("cm_scan")
			else
				var $di = 0
				$di = $sl_spec.$val
				$cm_cur = $di
				@go("cm_dent")
	elseif $act == "cm_scgo"
		if $sc_on == 1
			$sc_on = 2
		else
			if $sc_on == 0
				$sc_from = $sc_f
			$sc_on = 1
			$sc_k = 0
	elseif $act == "cm_scstop"
		$sc_on = 0
		$sc_k = 0
		; let the contacts / time server listening carry on
		$cm_job = -9
		$cm_job_t = time
	elseif $act == "cm_scspd"
		if $sc_dwell < 0.25
			$sc_dwell = 0.3
		elseif $sc_dwell < 0.45
			$sc_dwell = 0.5
		elseif $sc_dwell < 0.9
			$sc_dwell = 1
		else
			$sc_dwell = 0.2
	elseif $act == "cm_screset"
		$sc_f = 0
		$sc_k = 0
	elseif ($act == "cm_schit") and ($val < $sl_spec.size) and ($sl_spec.$val == "contacts")
		@go("cm_dir")
	elseif $act == "cm_schit"
		if ($val < $sl_spec.size) and ($sl_spec.$val != "")
			var $hi = 0
			$hi = $sl_spec.$val
			if $hi < $sh_freq.size
				var $have = 0
				var $cn = $cd_freq.size
				repeat $cn ($ci)
					if $cd_freq.$ci == $sh_freq.$hi
						$have = 1
				if $have
					@ui_toast("ALREADY IN CONTACTS")
				else
					@cd_pad()
					$cd_freq.append($sh_freq.$hi)
					@cd_pad()
					var $last = $cd_freq.size - 1
					$cd_data.$last = $sh_data.$hi
					$cd_t.$last = $sh_t.$hi
					$cd_dist.$last = $sh_dist.$hi
					var $hn = $sh_data.$hi
					$cd_name.$last = $hn.name
					@ui_toast("ADDED TO CONTACTS")
	elseif $act == "cm_dfollow"
		if ($cm_cur >= 0) and ($cm_cur < $cd_freq.size)
			@cd_pad()
			$cd_follow.$cm_cur = !$cd_follow.$cm_cur
			$cd_next.$cm_cur = 0
			if $cd_follow.$cm_cur
				@ui_toast("FOLLOWING: CHECKED EVERY SECOND")
			else
				@ui_toast("AUTO: FOLLOWED WHEN CLOSE")
	elseif $act == "cm_ddel"
		if ($cm_cur >= 0) and ($cm_cur < $cd_freq.size)
			@cd_remove($cm_cur)
		@go("cm_dir")
	$ui_dirty = 1

xc_files.name: fluids_ui.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - FLUIDS and REFINERY pages.

function @fl_tank_line($i : number) : text
	var $c = @ft_contents($i)
	var $m = @ft_main($c)
	if $m == ""
		$m = "EMPTY"
	var $t = @ft_temp($i)
	var $tsx = ""
	if $t > 0
		$tsx = "  " & @ws_temp_s($t)
	return $ft_a.$i & text("  {0}%  ", @ft_level($i) * 100) & upper($m) & $tsx

function @fm_line($a : text) : text
	var $n = $fm_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $fm_a.$i == $a
			var $o = replace(substring($fm_out.$i, 1, max(0, size($fm_out.$i) - 2)), "|", ", ")
			var $in = replace(substring($fm_in.$i, 1, max(0, size($fm_in.$i) - 2)), "|", ", ")
			if $o == ""
				return $a & ": NOTHING SEEN - POWER? (OR NOT CONNECTED)"
			var $l = $a & ":" & $fm_what.$i & " > " & $o
			if $in != ""
				$l = $l & "  FROM " & $in
			return $l
	return $a & ": NOT LEARNED YET"

function @page_fluids()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 64)
	var $y = $content_y
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, text("{} TANKS  {} ELECTROLYSERS  {} SABATIER", $ft_a.size, $fe_a.size, $fs_a.size), $tw)
	if $fl_note != ""
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, $fl_note, $tw)
	var $bh = $chh * 2.2
	var $gap = $cw * 0.5
	var $bw = ($tw - $gap * 2) / 3
	var $al = "AUTO: OFF"
	var $as = 0
	if $fe_auto
		$al = "AUTO: ON"
		$as = 3
	if ($fe_a.size + $fs_a.size) > 0
		@ui_btn($content_x, $y, $bw, $bh, "LEARN", "fl_learn", 1)
		@ui_btn($content_x + $bw + $gap, $y, $bw, $bh, $al, "fl_auto", $as)
		@ui_btn($content_x + ($bw + $gap) * 2, $y, $bw, $bh, "RULES", "go:fl_rules", 0)
		$y += $bh + $chh * 0.4
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $nt = $ft_a.size
	repeat $nt ($i)
		$sl_txt.append(@fl_tank_line($i))
		$sl_spec.append("")
	var $ne = $fe_a.size
	repeat $ne ($e)
		var $st = "  (OFF)"
		if $e < $fe_run.size
			if $fe_run.$e
				$st = text("  (ON {0.000} kg/s H2)", @in_n($fe_a.$e, 2))
		$sl_txt.append(@fm_line($fe_a.$e) & $st)
		$sl_spec.append("")
	var $ns = $fs_a.size
	repeat $ns ($s)
		$sl_txt.append(@fm_line($fs_a.$s))
		$sl_spec.append("")
	var $sv_y = $content_y
	var $sv_h = $content_h
	$content_y = $y
	$content_h = $sv_y + $sv_h - $y
	@pick_list("TANKS & MACHINES", "LEARN switches each machine on alone for 20 s to see which tanks it uses.", "fl_none")
	$content_y = $sv_y
	$content_h = $sv_h

function @page_fl_rules()
	var $y = @set_header("FLUIDS / RULES")
	$y = @set_stepper($y, "START WHEN AN OUTPUT TANK IS UNDER", text("{0}%", $fe_lo), "fl_lo-", "fl_lo+")
	$y = @set_stepper($y, "STOP WHEN AN OUTPUT TANK REACHES", text("{0}%", $fe_hi), "fl_hi-", "fl_hi+")
	$y = @set_stepper($y, "BATTERY: TURN OFF AT", text("{0}%", $fp_off), "fp_off-", "fp_off+")
	$y = @set_stepper($y, "BATTERY: BACK ON AT", text("{0}%", $fp_on), "fp_on-", "fp_on+")
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 60)
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "The battery rule is shared by the electrolysers, sabatier reactors and the refinery.", $tw)
	var $er = $fe_relay
	if $er == ""
		$er = "NONE - tap to pick"
	else
		$er = $er & "  (on while one runs - AUTO only)"
	$y = @set_row($y, "ELECTROLYSER / SABATIER POWER RELAY", $er, "fl_rp_fe", $th_accent)

; Pick the relay that powers the furnaces ($fl_rp_for "rf") or the
; electrolysers / sabatier reactors ("fe").
function @page_fl_rpick()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	$sl_txt.append("NONE   (ChipOS leaves the power alone)")
	$sl_spec.append("-")
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if ($db_cat.$j == 2) and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			$sl_txt.append($db_alias.$j & "   (" & $db_type.$j & ")")
			$sl_spec.append($db_alias.$j)
	var $t = "WHICH RELAY POWERS THE FURNACES?"
	var $h = "ChipOS turns it on while the refinery runs and off when it stops (or the battery rule holds it)."
	if $fl_rp_for == "fe"
		$t = "WHICH RELAY POWERS THE ELECTROLYSERS?"
		$h = "With AUTO on, ChipOS turns it on while any electrolyser or sabatier reactor runs (and while learning), off when none do."
	@pick_list($t, $h, "fl_rpick")

; Pick what cools the furnaces: each device, or a junction / relay that
; feeds several. All on while refining, off when it stops.
function @page_rf_cool()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		var $a = $db_alias.$j
		var $t = $db_type.$j
		if ($a != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			if contains($t, "Radiator") or ($t == "DataJunction") or ($t == "DataBridge") or contains($t, "Pump") or ($db_cat.$j == 2)
				var $mk = "[  ] "
				if find($rf_cool, "|" & $a & "|") >= 0
					$mk = "[X] "
				$sl_txt.append($mk & $a & "   (" & $t & ")")
				$sl_spec.append($a)
	$sl_txt.append("DONE")
	$sl_spec.append("")
	@pick_list("REFINERY COOLING", "Tick what cools the furnaces: radiators or pumps one by one, or the data junction / relay that runs them all. They are on while the refinery runs and off when it stops.", "rf_coolset")

function @rf_type_name() : text
	if $rf_type == 2
		return "ENRICHMENT"
	return "OIL REFINERY"

function @page_refinery()
	var $tw = min($content_w, $cw * 64)
	var $y = @set_header("REFINERY - " & @rf_type_name())
	if !$rf_present
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "No chemical furnace found.", $tw)
		return
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_accent, $rf_note, $tw)
	if $rf_alert != ""
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_warn, $rf_alert, $tw)
	var $ol = "OFF - TAP TO START"
	if $rf_on
		$ol = "ON - TAP TO STOP"
	$y = @set_row($y, "REFINERY", $ol, "rf_on", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "FURNACE TEMPERATURE", text("{0} K  (tap to change)", $rf_target), "rf_kb_temp", $th_accent)
	var $nf = $ff_a.size
	var $ft = ""
	repeat $nf ($i)
		if $i < 6
			$ft = $ft & text("{0} ", @in_n($ff_a.$i, 0))
	$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, text("{} FURNACES NOW (K): ", $nf) & $ft, $tw)
	if $rf_type == 1
		var $fd = $rf_feed
		if $fd == ""
			$fd = "(PICK ONE)"
		$y = @set_row($y, "FEED CONVEYOR", $fd & text("   {0.0} kg/s", $rf_rate), "go:rf_pick", $th_accent)
		var $sh = "NO SHALE CONTAINER"
		if $rf_buf != ""
			$sh = $rf_buf & "  " & @cr_amt("ARCHEAN_celestial.OilShale", $rf_shale)
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, "OIL SHALE: " & $sh, $tw)
	else
		$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_dim, text("{} CENTRIFUGES. ChipOS can't know the game's exact stage count; it runs a test and measures what reaches the product tank.", $fc_a.size), $tw)
		var $tl = "TEST RUN (5 MIN)"
		if $rf_test == 1
			$tl = "TEST RUNNING..."
		$y = @set_row($y, $tl, "checks what reaches the product tank", "rf_test", $th_accent)
		if $rf_test_res != ""
			$y = @ui_para_l($content_x, $y, $th_text, $rf_test_res, $tw)
	var $tk = $rf_tank
	if $tk == ""
		$tk = "(FOUND WHEN IT FILLS)"
	var $tlv = ""
	if $rf_tlev >= 0
		$tlv = text("  {0}%", $rf_tlev * 100)
	$y = @set_row($y, "PRODUCT TANK", $tk & $tlv & "  (tap to pick)", "go:rf_tpick", $th_accent)
	var $rr = $rf_relay
	if $rr == ""
		$rr = "NONE - tap to pick the relay that powers the furnaces"
	else
		$rr = $rr & "  (on only while refining)"
	$y = @set_row($y, "FURNACE POWER RELAY", $rr, "fl_rp_rf", $th_accent)
	var $cl = "NONE PICKED - tap to pick radiators, pumps, a relay or a data junction"
	if $rf_cool != ""
		$cl = replace(substring($rf_cool, 1, max(0, size($rf_cool) - 2)), "|", ", ") & "  (on only while refining)"
	elseif ($rf_rad == 1) and ($fr_a.size > 0)
		$cl = text("{} active radiators found - on while refining (tap to pick)", $fr_a.size)
	$y = @set_row($y, "COOLING", $cl, "go:rf_cool", $th_accent)
	if ($fr_a.size > 0) and ($rf_cool == "")
		var $rd = text("{} found - ChipOS leaves them alone (tap to change)", $fr_a.size)
		if $rf_rad == 1
			$rd = text("{} found - on while refining (tap to change)", $fr_a.size)
		$y = @set_row($y, "ACTIVE RADIATORS", $rd, "rf_rad", $th_accent)
	$y = @set_row($y, "BATTERY RULE", text("off at {0}%, back on at {0}%", $fp_off, $fp_on), "go:fl_rules", $th_accent)

function @page_rf_pick()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if ($db_type.$j == "ItemConveyor") and ($db_alias.$j != "") and ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1)
			$sl_txt.append($db_alias.$j)
			$sl_spec.append($db_alias.$j)
	if $sl_txt.size == 0
		$sl_txt.append("NO ITEM CONVEYORS WITH AN ALIAS")
		$sl_spec.append("")
	@pick_list("WHICH CONVEYOR FEEDS THE FURNACES?", "It moves oil shale into the furnaces.", "rf_pickc")

function @page_rf_tpick()
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	var $n = $ft_a.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		$sl_txt.append(@fl_tank_line($i))
		$sl_spec.append($ft_a.$i)
	$sl_txt.append("FIND IT AUTOMATICALLY")
	$sl_spec.append("")
	@pick_list("PRODUCT TANK", "", "rf_pickt")

function @fl_kb_done($id : text, $ok : number, $t0 : text)
	if !$ok
		return
	if ($id == "rf_temp") and isnumeric($t0)
		var $k = 0
		$k = $t0
		$rf_target = clamp($k, 300, 1500)

function @fl_action($act : text, $val : number)
	if $act == "fl_learn"
		@fl_learn_start()
	elseif $act == "fl_auto"
		$fe_auto = !$fe_auto
		if !$fe_auto
			@fl_all_off()
	elseif $act == "fl_lo-"
		$fe_lo = max(5, $fe_lo - 5)
	elseif $act == "fl_lo+"
		$fe_lo = min($fe_hi - 5, $fe_lo + 5)
	elseif $act == "fl_hi-"
		$fe_hi = max($fe_lo + 5, $fe_hi - 1)
	elseif $act == "fl_hi+"
		$fe_hi = min(100, $fe_hi + 1)
	elseif $act == "fp_off-"
		$fp_off = max(0, $fp_off - 5)
	elseif $act == "fp_off+"
		$fp_off = min($fp_on - 5, $fp_off + 5)
	elseif $act == "fp_on-"
		$fp_on = max($fp_off + 5, $fp_on - 5)
	elseif $act == "fp_on+"
		$fp_on = min(100, $fp_on + 5)
	elseif $act == "rf_on"
		$rf_on = !$rf_on
	elseif $act == "rf_kb_temp"
		@kb_open(-2, "rf_temp", "FURNACE TARGET (K)", text("{0}", $rf_target))
	elseif $act == "rf_pickc"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			if $sl_spec.$val != ""
				$rf_feed = $sl_spec.$val
				@go("refinery")
	elseif $act == "rf_pickt"
		if $val < $sl_spec.size
			$rf_tank = $sl_spec.$val
			@go("refinery")
	elseif $act == "rf_test"
		@rf_test_start()
	elseif $act == "rf_coolset"
		if ($val < $sl_spec.size)
			var $ca = $sl_spec.$val
			if $ca == ""
				@go("refinery")
			elseif find($rf_cool, "|" & $ca & "|") >= 0
				$rf_cool = replace($rf_cool, "|" & $ca & "|", "|")
				if $rf_cool == "|"
					$rf_cool = ""
				@rf_cool_out($ca, 0)
			else
				if $rf_cool == ""
					$rf_cool = "|"
				$rf_cool = $rf_cool & $ca & "|"
			$rf_rad_w = -1
	elseif $act == "rf_rad"
		if $rf_rad == 1
			$rf_rad = 2
		else
			$rf_rad = 1
		$rf_rad_n = $fr_a.size
		$rf_rad_w = -1
	elseif ($act == "fl_rp_rf") or ($act == "fl_rp_fe")
		$fl_rp_for = substring($act, 6, 2)
		@go("fl_rpick")
	elseif ($act == "fl_rpick") and ($val >= 0) and ($val < $sl_spec.size)
		var $ra = $sl_spec.$val
		if $ra == "-"
			$ra = ""
		if $fl_rp_for == "fe"
			$fe_relay = $ra
			$fe_relay_w = -1
			@go("fl_rules")
		else
			$rf_relay = $ra
			$rf_relay_w = -1
			@go("refinery")
	$ui_dirty = 1

xc_files.name: contacts.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - CONTACTS: saved beacon frequencies and what was last heard on
; them (kept here, ahead of the custom widgets, so gauges and graphs can
; read a contact's structured data).
storage array $cd_freq : text           ; directory
storage array $cd_name : text
storage array $cd_data : text           ; last data heard
storage array $cd_t : number            ; when (unix, 0 = never)
storage array $cd_dist : number
storage array $cd_follow : number       ; 1 = always follow (poll every second)
; polling (not kept over a restart: everything is polled soon after boot)
array $cd_next : number                 ; next poll due (unix)
array $cd_dx : number                   ; direction to it when last heard
array $cd_dy : number
array $cd_dz : number
array $cd_prev : number                 ; distance the poll before
var $cd_focus = -1                      ; the contact being followed (-1 none)

function @cd_pad()
	if ($cd_follow.size >= $cd_freq.size) and ($cd_next.size >= $cd_freq.size) and ($cd_name.size >= $cd_freq.size) and ($cd_data.size >= $cd_freq.size) and ($cd_t.size >= $cd_freq.size) and ($cd_dist.size >= $cd_freq.size)
		return
	repeat 64 ($q)
		if $cd_follow.size < $cd_freq.size
			$cd_follow.append(0)
		if $cd_next.size < $cd_freq.size
			$cd_next.append(0)
			$cd_dx.append(0)
			$cd_dy.append(0)
			$cd_dz.append(0)
			$cd_prev.append(0)
		if $cd_name.size < $cd_freq.size
			$cd_name.append("")
		if $cd_data.size < $cd_freq.size
			$cd_data.append("")
		if $cd_t.size < $cd_freq.size
			$cd_t.append(0)
		if $cd_dist.size < $cd_freq.size
			$cd_dist.append(0)

function @cd_remove($i : number)
	@cd_pad()
	$cd_freq.erase($i)
	$cd_name.erase($i)
	$cd_data.erase($i)
	$cd_t.erase($i)
	$cd_dist.erase($i)
	$cd_follow.erase($i)
	$cd_next.erase($i)
	$cd_dx.erase($i)
	$cd_dy.erase($i)
	$cd_dz.erase($i)
	$cd_prev.erase($i)
	$cd_focus = -1

; Pick the next listening job. Time server and weather come first when due.

; Contact index for a frequency (-1 = not a contact).
function @cd_find($f : text) : number
	var $n = $cd_freq.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $cd_freq.$i == $f
			return $i
	return -1

; A number from a contact's last data. "_dist" = distance in metres.
; Sets $cd_fok = 1 when the value was found.
var $cd_fok = 0
function @cd_field($f : text, $key : text) : number
	$cd_fok = 0
	var $i = @cd_find($f)
	if $i < 0
		return 0
	@cd_pad()
	if $key == "_dist"
		$cd_fok = $cd_t.$i > 0
		return $cd_dist.$i
	var $d = $cd_data.$i
	var $out = 0
	foreach $d ($k, $v)
		if ($k == $key) and isnumeric($v)
			$out = $v
			$cd_fok = 1
	return $out

; Distance for a gauge or list: metres up close, then km / mi.
function @cm_dist_n($m : number) : text
	if $cfg_units
		if $m < 1609.34
			return text("{0} ft", $m * 3.28084)
		return text("{0.0} mi", $m / 1609.34)
	if $m < 1000
		return text("{0} m", $m)
	return text("{0.0} km", $m / 1000)

; Does a contact send structured data (numbers by name)?
function @cd_structured($i : number) : number
	@cd_pad()
	var $d = $cd_data.$i
	var $n = 0
	foreach $d ($k, $v)
		if isnumeric($v) and ($k != "version")
			$n += 1
	return $n > 0

; Which contact to follow: one marked FOLLOW, else the nearest one that is
; close (under 2 km) and heard lately, else one we are closing in on fast.
function @cd_pick_focus()
	@cd_pad()
	var $n = $cd_freq.size
	var $best = -1
	var $bd = 0
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $cd_follow.$i == 1
			if $best < 0
				$best = $i
	if $best < 0
		repeat $n ($j)
			var $fresh = ($cd_t.$j > 0) and (time - $cd_t.$j < 120)
			var $d = $cd_dist.$j
			var $closing = ($cd_prev.$j > 0) and ($d > 0) and ($cd_prev.$j - $d > 150)
			if $fresh and ($d > 0) and (($d < 2000) or $closing)
				if ($best < 0) or ($d < $bd)
					$best = $j
					$bd = $d
	if $best != $cd_focus
		$cd_focus = $best
		if $best >= 0
			$cd_next.$best = 0
		$ui_dirty = 1

; Seconds between polls of contact $i.
function @cd_interval($i : number) : number
	if $i == $cd_focus
		return 1
	var $d = $cd_dist.$i
	if ($d > 0) and ($d < 5000)
		return 60
	if ($cd_prev.$i > 0) and (abs($cd_prev.$i - $d) > 100)
		return 120
	if ($cd_focus >= 0) and ($cd_freq.size > 4)
		return 1800
	return 1200

; Direction angle (degrees, 0 = ahead) to a contact, -1 if unknown.
function @cd_bearing($i : number) : number
	@cd_pad()
	var $x = $cd_dx.$i
	var $z = $cd_dz.$i
	if (abs($x) + abs($z)) < 0.0001
		return -1
	var $a = atan($x, $z) * 180 / pi
	return @posmod($a, 360)

function @cd_label($i : number) : text
	@cd_pad()
	if $cd_name.$i != ""
		return $cd_name.$i
	return "BEACON " & $cd_freq.$i

function @cm_age_s($t : number) : text
	var $a = time - $t
	if $a < 60
		return text("{0}s AGO", $a)
	if $a < 3600
		return text("{0}m AGO", $a / 60)
	return text("{0}h AGO", $a / 3600)

xc_files.name: windgen.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - WIND GENERATORS: propellers on a Small Pivot, spun by the wind.
; ChipOS finds which spare pivots turn a propeller (it turns each one to
; three angles and watches every propeller's speed), sweeps each turbine
; round once to find the wind, then keeps nudging it toward the angle that
; spins its propeller fastest. No nav needed. Never on a flying build.
; Pivot input: -1..1 = -360..360 degrees (servo).
; (wt_state, wt_pv, wt_pr, wt_mode and @wt_uses live in solar.xc.)
array $wt_props : text                  ; every propeller now
array $wt_cand : text                   ; spare pivots not tried yet
array $wt_tried : text                  ; pivots tried since boot
array $wt_fprops : text                 ; propellers frozen for one test
array $wt_psum : number
array $wt_lo : number
array $wt_hi : number
array $wt_pc : number                   ; command per turbine (RAM)
array $wt_dir : number
array $wt_off : number                  ; pivot angle minus wind-from when facing it
array $wt_offok : number
array $wt_wl : number                   ; wind-from the turbine was last aimed at
array $wt_sgn : number                  ; v0.26.3: +1 / -1 - the spin direction that means "facing the wind"
var $wt_bn = 0                          ; sweep: most negative spin and where
var $wt_bnp = 0
var $wt_avail = 0
var $wt_scan_t = 0
var $wt_note = ""
var $wt_t = 0
var $wt_i = 0                           ; turbine / candidate index
var $wt_k = 0                           ; step
var $wt_cur = ""                        ; pivot under test
var $wt_one = ""                        ; propeller being averaged alone
var $wt_sum = 0
var $wt_cnt = 0
var $wt_avg_on = 0
var $wt_avg_end = 0
var $wt_ref = 0
var $wt_best = 0
var $wt_bp = 0
var $wt_rps = 0                         ; last average (display)
var $wt_sw_from = 0                     ; first turbine the sweep covers
var $wt_all_c = 0                       ; v0.27.1: the one command every turbine gets
var $wt_adir = 1
storage var $wt_refnav : text           ; nav facing the way the turbines face at pivot 0 ("" ask, "-" none)
storage var $wt_rsg : number            ; which way + turns the pivots (0 not known yet)
storage var $wt_flip : number           ; 1: turbines face away at that angle - turn them round

function @wt_is_turb($a : text) : number
	var $n = $wt_pv.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $wt_pv.$i == $a
			return 1
	return 0

function @wt_was_tried($a : text) : number
	var $n = $wt_tried.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if $wt_tried.$i == $a
			return 1
	return 0

function @wt_on() : number
	return $wt_avail and ($wt_state == 1)

function @wt_cmd($pv : text, $p : number) : number
	var $q = $p - floor(($p + 1) / 2) * 2
	@out_n($pv, 0, $q)
	return $q

function @wt_scan()
	if time < $wt_scan_t
		return
	$wt_scan_t = time + 5
	$wt_props.clear()
	$wt_cand.clear()
	var $npiv = 0
	var $n = $db_id.size
	repeat $n ($j)
		if ($db_seen.$j >= $scan_gen - 1) and ($db_alias.$j != "")
			var $t = $db_type.$j
			var $a = $db_alias.$j
			if $t == "Propeller"
				$wt_props.append($a)
			elseif $t == "SmallPivot"
				if @wt_is_turb($a)
					$npiv += 1
				elseif !(@sol_uses($a) or ($a == $ws_vane) or (@cs_find($a) >= 0))
					$npiv += 1
					if !@wt_was_tried($a)
						$wt_cand.append($a)
	; only on a BASE: on anything that moves, propellers are engines
	$wt_avail = ($wt_props.size > 0) and ($npiv > 0) and ($cfg_arch == 0)

; Average propeller speed for $d seconds: one propeller ($wt_one) or all.
function @wt_avg_start($d : number)
	$wt_avg_on = 1
	$wt_avg_end = time + $d
	$wt_sum = 0
	$wt_cnt = 0
	$wt_psum.clear()
	if $wt_one == ""
		var $n = $wt_fprops.size
		repeat $n ($i)
			$wt_psum.append(0)

function @wt_avg_tick()
	if $wt_one != ""
		$wt_sum += @in_n($wt_one, 0)
	else
		var $n = $wt_fprops.size
		repeat $n ($i)
			$wt_psum.$i += abs(@in_n($wt_fprops.$i, 0))
	$wt_cnt += 1
	if time >= $wt_avg_end
		$wt_avg_on = 0
		if $wt_cnt > 0
			$wt_sum /= $wt_cnt
			var $m = $wt_psum.size
			repeat $m ($i2)
				$wt_psum.$i2 /= $wt_cnt

; ---- finding: 0, 60 and 120 degrees; the propeller whose speed changes ----
function @wt_find()
	if $wt_k == 0
		if $wt_cand.size == 0
			$wt_mode = 2
			$wt_i = $wt_sw_from
			$wt_k = 0
			if $wt_pv.size == 0
				$wt_mode = 4
				$wt_t = time + 60
				$wt_note = "NO PIVOT TURNS A PROPELLER"
			return
		$wt_cur = $wt_cand.0
		$wt_tried.append($wt_cur)
		$wt_fprops.clear()
		$wt_lo.clear()
		$wt_hi.clear()
		var $n = $wt_props.size
		repeat $n ($i)
			$wt_fprops.append($wt_props.$i)
			$wt_lo.append(1000000)
			$wt_hi.append(-1)
		$wt_one = ""
		$wt_bp = @wt_cmd($wt_cur, 0)
		$wt_note = "FINDING WHICH PIVOT TURNS A TURBINE: " & $wt_cur
		$ui_dirty = 1
		$wt_t = time + 8
		$wt_k = 1
		return
	if ($wt_k == 1) or ($wt_k == 3) or ($wt_k == 5)
		@wt_avg_start(5)
		$wt_k += 1
		return
	; an average just finished (k 2, 4, 6)
	var $best_p = 0
	var $m = $wt_psum.size
	repeat $m ($i2)
		var $v = $wt_psum.$i2
		if $v < $wt_lo.$i2
			$wt_lo.$i2 = $v
		if $v > $wt_hi.$i2
			$wt_hi.$i2 = $v
	if $wt_k < 6
		@wt_cmd($wt_cur, ($wt_k / 2) / 6)
		$wt_t = time + 8
		$wt_k += 1
		return
	; which propeller changed the most?
	var $bi = -1
	var $bs = 0
	repeat $m ($i3)
		var $sp = $wt_hi.$i3 - $wt_lo.$i3
		if ($sp > max(0.5, 0.3 * $wt_hi.$i3)) and ($sp > $bs)
			$bs = $sp
			$bi = $i3
	if $bi >= 0
		$wt_pv.append($wt_cur)
		$wt_pr.append($wt_fprops.$bi)
		@ui_toast("WIND TURBINE FOUND: " & $wt_cur)
	elseif $wt_hi.size > 0
		; no wind at all: try this pivot again later
		var $calm = 1
		repeat $m ($i4)
			if $wt_hi.$i4 >= 0.2
				$calm = 0
		if $calm
			$wt_tried.erase($wt_tried.size - 1)
			$wt_mode = 4
			$wt_note = "NO WIND - TRYING AGAIN IN 5 MINUTES"
			$wt_t = time + 300
	@wt_cmd($wt_cur, 0)
	$wt_k = 0
	if $wt_mode == 1
		$wt_t = time + 2

; Weather station wind (where it comes FROM), fresh and strong enough to use.
function @wt_wind_ok() : number
	return @ws_on() and $wn_ok and ($wn_spd > 0.5) and ((time - $wn_t) < 300)

; v0.27.1: ALL turbines always get the SAME pivot command, so they always
; face the same way. With the weather station's wind and the nav the user
; picked (it faces the way the turbines face at pivot 0), the command is
; worked out directly: face = where the wind comes from.
function @wt_padd()
	while $wt_pc.size < $wt_pv.size
		$wt_pc.append(0)
		$wt_dir.append(1)
		$wt_off.append(0)
		$wt_offok.append(0)
		$wt_wl.append(-1)
		$wt_sgn.append(1)

function @wt_all($p : number)
	@wt_padd()
	var $q = $p - floor(($p + 1) / 2) * 2
	$wt_all_c = $q
	var $n = $wt_pv.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		if @db_has_alias($wt_pv.$i)
			$wt_pc.$i = @wt_cmd($wt_pv.$i, $q)

; The reference nav (picked by the user) is usable.
function @wt_ref_ok() : number
	return ($wt_refnav != "") and ($wt_refnav != "-") and @db_has_alias($wt_refnav)

; Pivot command that points the turbines at the wind (turn sign $sg).
function @wt_aim($sg : number) : number
	var $face = $wn_from
	if $wt_flip
		$face += 180
	var $d = @posmod($face - @in_n($wt_refnav, 6) + 180, 360) - 180
	return $sg * $d / 360

; Average spin of every turbine together (abs), over $wt_fprops.
function @wt_avg_all($d : number)
	$wt_fprops.clear()
	var $n = $wt_pr.size
	repeat $n ($i)
		$wt_fprops.append($wt_pr.$i)
	$wt_one = ""
	@wt_avg_start($d)

function @wt_total() : number
	var $t = 0
	var $m = $wt_psum.size
	repeat $m ($i)
		$t += $wt_psum.$i
	return $t

; ---- no weather wind: sweep all turbines together over 12 headings ----
function @wt_sweep()
	@wt_padd()
	if @wt_ref_ok() and @wt_wind_ok()
		$wt_mode = 3
		$wt_k = 0
		return
	if $wt_k == 0
		$wt_best = -1
		$wt_bp = 0
	if $wt_k > 0
		var $tot = @wt_total()
		if $tot > $wt_best
			$wt_best = $tot
			$wt_bp = ($wt_k - 1) / 12
	if $wt_k < 12
		@wt_all($wt_k / 12)
		$wt_note = text("FINDING THE WIND - ALL TURBINES TOGETHER ({}/12)", $wt_k + 1)
		$ui_dirty = 1
		$wt_k += 1
		$wt_t = time + 6
		$wt_avg_end = -1
		return
	@wt_all($wt_bp)
	$wt_rps = $wt_best
	$wt_mode = 3
	$wt_k = 0
	$wt_t = time + 4

; ---- keep them into the wind ----
function @wt_track()
	@wt_padd()
	if $wt_pv.size == 0
		$wt_mode = 0
		return
	if @wt_ref_ok() and @wt_wind_ok()
		; which way does + turn the pivot? Tried once, both ways, all
		; turbines together; the way that spins them faster is kept.
		if $wt_rsg == 0
			; Probe +45 and -45 deg (pivot frame), all turbines together. The
			; one closer to the wind spins faster, which tells which way +
			; turns. Only possible when the wind is not square to the
			; pivot-0 direction (|sin 2x| > 0.5); until then aim with +.
			var $x = ($wt_flip * 180 + @in_n($wt_refnav, 6) - $wn_from) * pi / 180
			var $wq2 = sin(2 * $x)
			if (abs($wq2) < 0.5) and ($wt_k == 0)
				@wt_all(@wt_aim(1))
				$wt_note = "FACING THE WIND: FROM " & @ws_compass($wn_from) & " (TURN DIRECTION CHECKED WHEN THE WIND ALLOWS)"
				$wt_t = time + 5
				return
			if $wt_k == 0
				@wt_all(45 / 360)
				$wt_note = "CHECKING WHICH WAY THE PIVOTS TURN (1/2)"
				$ui_dirty = 1
				$wt_k = 1
				$wt_t = time + 8
				$wt_avg_end = -1
				return
			if $wt_k == 1
				$wt_ref = @wt_total()
				@wt_all(-45 / 360)
				$wt_note = "CHECKING WHICH WAY THE PIVOTS TURN (2/2)"
				$ui_dirty = 1
				$wt_k = 2
				$wt_t = time + 8
				$wt_avg_end = -1
				return
			var $m2 = @wt_total()
			$wt_k = 0
			if abs($wt_ref - $m2) > 0.1 * max($wt_ref, $m2)
				if ($wt_ref - $m2) * (-$wq2) > 0
					$wt_rsg = 1
				else
					$wt_rsg = -1
		var $usg = $wt_rsg
		if $usg == 0
			$usg = 1
		var $want = @wt_aim($usg)
		if abs(@posmod(($wt_all_c - $want) * 360 + 180, 360) - 180) > 3
			@wt_all($want)
		else
			@wt_all($wt_all_c)
		$wt_note = "FACING THE WIND: FROM " & @ws_compass($wn_from) & text(" ({0} deg, WEATHER STATION)", $wn_from)
		$ui_dirty = 1
		$wt_t = time + 5
		return
	; no weather wind: nudge all of them together toward more spin
	var $st = 0.02
	if $wt_k == 0
		@wt_avg_all(5)
		$wt_k = 1
		return
	if $wt_k == 1
		$wt_ref = @wt_total()
		$wt_rps = $wt_ref
		if $wt_ref < 0.2
			$wt_note = "NO WIND"
			$wt_k = 0
			$wt_t = time + 10
			return
		$wt_note = "KEEPING THE TURBINES INTO THE WIND (ALL TOGETHER, BY SPIN)"
		@wt_all($wt_all_c + $st * $wt_adir)
		$wt_t = time + 5
		$wt_k = 2
		return
	if $wt_k == 2
		@wt_avg_all(5)
		$wt_k = 3
		return
	$wt_rps = @wt_total()
	if @wt_total() < $wt_ref
		@wt_all($wt_all_c - $st * $wt_adir)
		$wt_adir = -$wt_adir
	$wt_k = 0
	$wt_t = time + 3

function @wt_tick()
	@wt_scan()
	if !@wt_on()
		if $wt_mode != 0
			$wt_mode = 0
		return
	if $wt_avg_on
		@wt_avg_tick()
		return
	; the coarse sweep averages after each settle
	if (($wt_mode == 2) or ($wt_mode == 3)) and ($wt_avg_end == -1) and (time >= $wt_t)
		$wt_avg_end = 0
		@wt_avg_all(4)
		return
	if time < $wt_t
		return
	; wait while the solar tracker is still finding its own joints
	if ($so_state == 1) and ($so_piv == "") and $so_avail
		$wt_note = "WAITING FOR SOLAR TRACKING TO FIND ITS PIVOT"
		$wt_t = time + 5
		return
	if ($wt_mode == 0) or ($wt_mode == 4)
		$wt_mode = 1
		$wt_k = 0
		$wt_i = 0
		$wt_sw_from = 0
	; new spare pivots: test them first, then sweep only the new turbines
	if ($wt_mode == 3) and ($wt_k == 0) and ($wt_cand.size > 0)
		$wt_mode = 1
		$wt_sw_from = $wt_pv.size
	if $wt_mode == 1
		@wt_find()
		return
	if $wt_mode == 2
		@wt_sweep()
		return
	if $wt_mode == 3
		@wt_track()

xc_files.name: home.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
; ChipOS - home screens (widgets + app shortcuts), app drawer.
storage var $hm_ver : number
storage var $hm_pages : number
storage array $hm_pg : number
storage array $hm_kind : number         ; 1 app shortcut, 2 widget, 3 custom widget, 4 app widget (ref = app*10 + n)
storage array $hm_ref : number          ; app id / widget id
storage array $hm_c : number
storage array $hm_r : number
storage array $hm_sc : number          ; old size multiplier (v0.6.3)
storage array $hm_w : number           ; size in cells (0 = default)
storage array $hm_h : number
var $hm_szmode = 0                     ; edit mode: 0 move, 1 size
var $hm_cur = 0
var $hm_edit = 0
var $ov_menu = 0
var $hm_tc = 0                          ; target cell for the next add
var $hm_tr = 0
; grid geometry (desktop px)
var $g_ox = 0
var $g_oy = 0
var $g_cw = 100
var $g_ch = 100
var $g_cols = 1
var $g_rows = 1
var $g_kx = 0                           ; cells per screen (spanned) - items never cross an edge
var $g_ky = 0
var $g_r0 = 0
const $widget_count = 15                 ; 1 CLOCK 2x1, 2 BATTERY 2x1, 3 SOLAR 1x1, 4 ALERTS 2x1, 5 RELAYS 2x2, 6 ATTITUDE 2x2, 7 COMPASS 2x2, 8 SPEEDOMETER 2x2, 9 DRIVE 2x2, 10 CALCULATOR 2x2, 11 STICKY NOTE 2x2, 12 NOTE LIST 2x2, 13 STOPWATCH 2x1

; Older layouts have no size multiplier yet: treat them as x1.
function @hm_sc_pad()
	if $hm_sc.size > $hm_pg.size
		$hm_sc.clear()
	if $hm_w.size > $hm_pg.size
		$hm_w.clear()
		$hm_h.clear()
	repeat 200 ($q)
		if $hm_sc.size < $hm_pg.size
			$hm_sc.append(1)
		if $hm_w.size < $hm_pg.size
			$hm_w.append(0)
		if $hm_h.size < $hm_pg.size
			$hm_h.append(0)

function @hm_load()
	if $hm_ver != 1
		$hm_pages = 1
		$hm_pg.clear()
		$hm_kind.clear()
		$hm_ref.clear()
		$hm_c.clear()
		$hm_r.clear()
		$hm_sc.clear()
		$hm_w.clear()
		$hm_h.clear()
		$hm_ver = 1
	@hm_sc_pad()

function @wg_name($w : number) : text
	if $w == 1
		return "CLOCK"
	if $w == 2
		return "BATTERY"
	if $w == 3
		return "SOLAR"
	if $w == 4
		return "ALERTS"
	if $w == 6
		return "ATTITUDE"
	if $w == 7
		return "COMPASS"
	if $w == 8
		return "SPEEDOMETER"
	if $w == 9
		return "DRIVE"
	if $w == 10
		return "CALCULATOR"
	if $w == 11
		return "STICKY NOTE"
	if $w == 12
		return "NOTE LIST"
	if $w == 13
		return "STOPWATCH"
	if $w == 14
		return "WEATHER"
	if $w == 15
		return "ENGINES"
	if $w == 16
		return "MAP"
	return "RELAYS"

function @wg_w($w : number) : number
	if $w == 3
		return 1
	return 2

function @wg_h($w : number) : number
	if ($w == 13) or ($w == 14)
		return 1
	if $w >= 5
		return 2
	return 1

; Items of an app that is not running are hidden (and come back with it).
function @item_app($i : number) : number
	if ($hm_kind.$i == 1) and ($hm_ref.$i >= 100)
		return $hm_ref.$i - 100
	if $hm_kind.$i == 4
		return floor($hm_ref.$i / 10)
	return -1

function @item_hidden($i : number) : number
	var $ap = @item_app($i)
	if $ap < 0
		return 0
	return !@xa_is_online($ap)

function @item_bw($i : number) : number
	if $hm_kind.$i == 2
		return @wg_w($hm_ref.$i)
	if $hm_kind.$i == 3
		return $cw_w.($hm_ref.$i)
	return 1

function @item_bh($i : number) : number
	if $hm_kind.$i == 2
		return @wg_h($hm_ref.$i)
	if $hm_kind.$i == 3
		return $cw_h.($hm_ref.$i)
	return 1

function @item_sc($i : number) : number
	if $i < $hm_sc.size
		return clamp($hm_sc.$i, 1, 3)
	return 1

function @item_w($i : number) : number
	if $i < $hm_w.size
		if $hm_w.$i > 0
			return $hm_w.$i
	return @item_bw($i) * @item_sc($i)

function @item_h($i : number) : number
	if $i < $hm_h.size
		if $hm_h.$i > 0
			return $hm_h.$i
	return @item_bh($i) * @item_sc($i)

; Grid: on a spanned wall every screen is split 2x2 (cells never cross an
; edge); on one screen the cells fill the area between the bars.
function @hm_grid()
	var $top = $sb_h + $chh * 0.6
	var $bot = $desk_h - $nb_h - $chh * 2.2
	if ($disp_mode == 1) and ($grp_w > 0)
		var $kx = max(1, round($grp_w / ($cw * 9)))
		var $ky = max(1, round($grp_h / ($chh * 6)))
		$g_cw = $grp_w / $kx
		$g_ch = $grp_h / $ky
		$g_kx = $kx
		$g_ky = $ky
		$g_ox = 0
		var $r0 = ceil($top / $g_ch)
		var $r1 = floor($bot / $g_ch)
		$g_oy = $r0 * $g_ch
		$g_r0 = $r0
		$g_cols = max(1, floor($desk_w / $g_cw))
		$g_rows = max(1, $r1 - $r0)
	else
		var $aw = $desk_w - $cw * 2
		var $ah = $bot - $top
		$g_cols = max(2, floor($aw / ($cw * 13)))
		$g_rows = max(2, floor($ah / ($chh * 5.5)))
		$g_cw = $aw / $g_cols
		$g_ch = $ah / $g_rows
		$g_ox = $cw
		$g_oy = $top
		$g_kx = 0
		$g_ky = 0
		$g_r0 = 0

; Is the w x h block at (c, r) on page p free (ignoring item skip)?
function @hm_free($p : number, $c : number, $r : number, $w : number, $h : number, $skip : number) : number
	if ($c < 0) or ($r < 0) or ($c + $w > $g_cols) or ($r + $h > $g_rows)
		return 0
	if $g_kx > 0
		if (floor($c / $g_kx) != floor(($c + $w - 1) / $g_kx)) and ($w <= $g_kx)
			return 0
		if (floor(($r + $g_r0) / $g_ky) != floor(($r + $g_r0 + $h - 1) / $g_ky)) and ($h <= $g_ky)
			return 0
	var $fn = $hm_pg.size
	repeat $fn ($fi)
		if ($fi != $skip) and ($hm_pg.$fi == $p)
			var $ic = $hm_c.$fi
			var $ir = $hm_r.$fi
			var $iw = @item_w($fi)
			var $ih = @item_h($fi)
			if ($c < $ic + $iw) and ($ic < $c + $w) and ($r < $ir + $ih) and ($ir < $r + $h)
				return 0
	return 1

; Place a new item (kind, ref, size w x h) on the current page: the held
; cell if it fits, else the nearest allowed spot.
function @hm_add_ref($kind : number, $ref : number, $w : number, $h : number) : number
	var $pc = -1
	var $pr = -1
	if @hm_free($hm_cur, $hm_tc, $hm_tr, $w, $h, -1)
		$pc = $hm_tc
		$pr = $hm_tr
	else
		var $best_d = 1000000
		var $tot = $g_cols * $g_rows
		repeat $tot ($ai)
			var $ac = mod($ai, $g_cols)
			var $ar = floor($ai / $g_cols)
			if @hm_free($hm_cur, $ac, $ar, $w, $h, -1)
				var $ad = abs($ac - $hm_tc) + abs($ar - $hm_tr)
				if $ad < $best_d
					$best_d = $ad
					$pc = $ac
					$pr = $ar
	if $pc < 0
		return 0
	$hm_pg.append($hm_cur)
	$hm_kind.append($kind)
	$hm_ref.append($ref)
	$hm_c.append($pc)
	$hm_r.append($pr)
	@hm_sc_pad()
	return 1

function @hm_add($kind : number, $ref : number) : number
	var $w = 1
	var $h = 1
	if $kind == 2
		$w = @wg_w($ref)
		$h = @wg_h($ref)
	return @hm_add_ref($kind, $ref, $w, $h)

; Create the widget and put it on the current home page.
function @cw_create($size : number) : number
	var $w = 1
	var $h = 1
	if $size >= 1
		$w = 2
	if $size == 2
		$h = 2
	$cw_type.append($cwn_type)
	$cw_src.append($cwn_src)
	$cw_name.append($cwn_label)
	$cw_w.append($w)
	$cw_h.append($h)
	$cw_st.append(0)
	@cw_pad()
	$cw_unit.($cw_type.size - 1) = $cwn_unit
	$cwn_unit = 0
	var $ok = @hm_add_ref(3, $cw_type.size - 1, $w, $h)
	return $ok

function @hm_remove($i : number)
	$hm_pg.erase($i)
	$hm_kind.erase($i)
	$hm_ref.erase($i)
	$hm_c.erase($i)
	$hm_r.erase($i)
	if $i < $hm_sc.size
		$hm_sc.erase($i)
	if $i < $hm_w.size
		$hm_w.erase($i)
	if $i < $hm_h.size
		$hm_h.erase($i)

; Move one step in a direction; if that spot is not allowed (taken, or it
; would cross a screen edge on a spanned wall), keep going to the next one
; that is.
; Resize one edge: $side 0 left, 1 right, 2 top, 3 bottom; $d +1 grow, -1 shrink.
function @hm_edge($i : number, $side : number, $d : number) : number
	@hm_sc_pad()
	var $nc = $hm_c.$i
	var $nr = $hm_r.$i
	var $nw = @item_w($i)
	var $nh = @item_h($i)
	if $side == 0
		$nc -= $d
		$nw += $d
	elseif $side == 1
		$nw += $d
	elseif $side == 2
		$nr -= $d
		$nh += $d
	else
		$nh += $d
	if ($nw < 1) or ($nh < 1)
		return 0
	if !@hm_free($hm_pg.$i, $nc, $nr, $nw, $nh, $i)
		return 0
	$hm_c.$i = $nc
	$hm_r.$i = $nr
	$hm_w.$i = $nw
	$hm_h.$i = $nh
	return 1

function @hm_move($i : number, $dc : number, $dr : number)
	var $nc = $hm_c.$i
	var $nr = $hm_r.$i
	var $moved = 0
	repeat 40 ($st)
		if !$moved
			$nc += $dc
			$nr += $dr
			if ($nc < 0) or ($nr < 0) or ($nc >= $g_cols) or ($nr >= $g_rows)
				$moved = -1
			elseif @hm_free($hm_pg.$i, $nc, $nr, @item_w($i), @item_h($i), $i)
				$hm_c.$i = $nc
				$hm_r.$i = $nr
				$moved = 1

function @hm_page_count_items($p : number) : number
	var $pc_n = 0
	var $pn = $hm_pg.size
	repeat $pn ($pi3)
		if $hm_pg.$pi3 == $p
			$pc_n += 1
	return $pc_n

; Delete page p (its items too) and shift later pages down.
function @hm_page_remove($p : number)
	var $k = $hm_pg.size - 1
	var $kn = $hm_pg.size
	repeat $kn ($q)
		var $ix = $k - $q
		if $hm_pg.$ix == $p
			@hm_remove($ix)
	var $n2 = $hm_pg.size
	repeat $n2 ($q2)
		if $hm_pg.$q2 > $p
			$hm_pg.$q2 = $hm_pg.$q2 - 1
	$hm_pages = max($hm_pages - 1, 1)
	$hm_cur = min($hm_cur, $hm_pages - 1)

; ---------------- widgets ----------------
function @wg_draw($w : number, $x : number, $y : number, $ww : number, $hh : number, $i : number)
	if $w == 14
		@wx_widget($x, $y, $ww, $hh)
		return
	if $w == 15
		@eng_widget($x, $y, $ww, $hh)
		return
	if $w == 16
		; the built-in map moved to the EarthNAV app
		return
	if $w >= 10
		; built-in app widgets
		var $ba = 6
		var $bwn = 0
		if $w == 11
			$ba = 7
		elseif $w == 12
			$ba = 7
			$bwn = 1
		elseif $w == 13
			$ba = 8
		@ui_box($x, $y, $ww, $hh, $th_panel, $th_line)
		@ba_draw($ba, $bwn, $x + $cw * 0.4, $y + $chh * 0.4, $ww - $cw * 0.8, $hh - $chh * 0.8)
		return
	if ($w >= 6) and ($w <= 9)
		if $w == 9
			@dv_panel($x, $y, $ww, $hh)
			$ui_hv = 0
			@ui_hit($x, $y, $x + $ww, $y + $hh, "go:drive")
		elseif $w == 6
			@att_draw($x, $y, $ww, $hh)
		elseif $w == 7
			@compass_draw($x, $y, $ww, $hh)
		else
			@speedo_draw($x, $y, $ww, $hh)
		if $hit_on and ($hit_sl_cur < 0)
			$att_rx1.append($x)
			$att_ry1.append($y)
			$att_rx2.append($x + $ww)
			$att_ry2.append($y + $hh)
		return
	@ui_box($x, $y, $ww, $hh, $th_panel, $th_line)
	var $tx = $x + $cw * 0.8
	if $w == 1
		@clock_widget($x, $y, $ww, $hh, 3, -1, 0, -1)
	elseif $w == 2
		@pw_status_lines()
		var $bp = "--"
		if $pw_pct >= 0
			$bp = text("{0}%", $pw_pct)
		var $g_col = $th_ok
		if $pw_pct < $pw_restore
			$g_col = $th_warn
		if $pw_pct < $pw_low
			$g_col = $th_bad
		@ui_text($tx, $y + $chh * 0.5, $th_dim, "BATTERY")
		@ui_text_r($x + $ww - $cw * 0.8, $y + $chh * 0.5, $g_col, $bp)
		var $gb_y = $y + $chh * 2.2
		var $gb_h = max($hh - $chh * 4.6, $chh * 0.8)
		@ui_box($tx, $gb_y, $ww - $cw * 1.6, $gb_h, $th_bg, $th_line)
		if $pw_pct > 0
			@ui_box($tx, $gb_y, ($ww - $cw * 1.6) * $pw_pct / 100, $gb_h, $g_col, $g_col)
		var $la = @ui_fit($pw_line_a, floor(($ww - $cw * 1.6) / $cw))
		@ui_text($tx, $gb_y + $gb_h + $chh * 0.6, $th_dim, $la)
		@ui_hit($x, $y, $x + $ww, $y + $hh, "go:power")
	elseif $w == 3
		@ui_text($tx, $y + $chh * 0.6, $th_dim, "SOLAR")
		var $sv = @fmt_power($pw_solar)
		@ui_text_c($x + $ww / 2, $y + $hh * 0.36, $th_warn, $sv)
		; bar: full width = the panels' potential, filled = what they make now
		var $sbw = $ww - $cw * 1.6
		var $sby = $y + $hh * 0.36 + $chh * 1.4
		var $sbh = max(min($chh * 1.0, $y + $hh - $sby - $chh * 1.6), 3)
		@ui_box($tx, $sby, $sbw, $sbh, $th_bg, $th_line)
		if ($pw_spot > 0) and ($pw_solar > 0)
			@ui_box($tx, $sby, max($sbw * min($pw_solar / $pw_spot, 1), 2), $sbh, $th_warn, $th_warn)
		var $spt = "OF " & @fmt_power($pw_spot)
		if $pw_spot <= 0
			$spt = "NO PANELS"
		@text_fit_c($x + $ww / 2, $sby + $sbh + $chh * 0.3, $th_dim, $spt, $sbw)
		@ui_hit($x, $y, $x + $ww, $y + $hh, "go:power")
	elseif $w == 4
		@ui_text($tx, $y + $chh * 0.6, $th_dim, "ALERTS")
		var $ac = @alert_count()
		var $al_col = $th_ok
		var $al_t = "ALL GOOD"
		if $ac > 0
			$al_col = $th_warn
			$al_t = text("{} NAME   {} MISSING", $db_unnamed, $db_missing)
		var $al_f = @ui_fit($al_t, floor(($ww - $cw * 1.6) / $cw))
		@ui_text_c($x + $ww / 2, $y + $hh * 0.5, $al_col, $al_f)
		@ui_hit($x, $y, $x + $ww, $y + $hh, "go:devices")
	else
		@ui_text($tx, $y + $chh * 0.6, $th_dim, "RELAYS")
		var $rr_y = $y + $chh * 2
		var $rr_h = ($hh - $chh * 2.6) / 4
		var $shown = 0
		var $rn = $db_id.size
		repeat $rn ($rj)
			if ($shown < 4) and ($db_cat.$rj == 2) and ($db_alias.$rj != "") and ($db_seen.$rj >= $scan_gen - 1)
				var $ron = $db_on.$rj == 1
				var $rst = 0
				if $ron
					$rst = 3
				var $rlab = @ui_fit($db_alias.$rj, floor(($ww - $cw * 3) / $cw))
				$ui_hv = $rj
				@ui_btn($tx, $rr_y + $shown * $rr_h, $ww - $cw * 1.6, $rr_h - 2, $rlab, "wg_relay", $rst)
				$shown += 1
		if $shown == 0
			@ui_text_c($x + $ww / 2, $y + $hh / 2, $th_dim, "NO NAMED RELAYS")

; ---------------- home page ----------------
function @home_draw()
	@hm_grid()
	var $hn = $hm_pg.size
	var $on_page = 0
	repeat $hn ($hi)
		if $hm_pg.$hi == $hm_cur
			$on_page += 1
			var $ix = $g_ox + $hm_c.$hi * $g_cw
			var $iy = $g_oy + $hm_r.$hi * $g_ch
			var $iw = @item_w($hi) * $g_cw
			var $ih = @item_h($hi) * $g_ch
			var $pad = min($g_cw, $g_ch) * 0.06
			var $hid = @item_hidden($hi)
			if $hid
				if $hm_edit
					@ui_box($ix + $pad, $iy + $pad, $iw - $pad * 2, $ih - $pad * 2, $th_bg, $th_line)
					var $oa = @item_app($hi)
					var $ol = "OFFLINE"
					if $oa < $xa_name.size
						$ol = $xa_name.$oa & " - OFFLINE"
					@text_fit_c($ix + $iw / 2, $iy + $ih / 2 - $chh / 2, $th_dim, $ol, $iw - $cw * 2)
			elseif $hm_kind.$hi == 4
				var $wa = floor($hm_ref.$hi / 10)
				var $wi = $hm_ref.$hi - $wa * 10
				@ui_box($ix + $pad, $iy + $pad, $iw - $pad * 2, $ih - $pad * 2, $th_panel, $th_line)
				var $wf = @in_t($xa_alias.$wa, 4 + $wi)
				if $wf == ""
					var $wl = $xa_name.$wa & "..."
					@text_fit_c($ix + $iw / 2, $iy + $ih / 2 - $chh / 2, $th_dim, $wl, $iw - $cw * 2)
				elseif !$hm_edit
					@xf_render($wf, $ix + $pad, $iy + $pad, $iw - $pad * 2, $ih - $pad * 2, $wa)
				else
					var $hs = $hit_on
					$hit_on = 0
					@xf_render($wf, $ix + $pad, $iy + $pad, $iw - $pad * 2, $ih - $pad * 2, $wa)
					$hit_on = $hs
			elseif $hm_kind.$hi == 1
				var $ap = $hm_ref.$hi
				var $is = min($iw * 0.5, $ih - $chh * 2.4)
				var $icy = $iy + $pad + $is / 2 + $chh * 0.4
				@icon_draw($ap, $ix + $iw / 2, $icy, $is)
				var $an = @app_name($ap)
				var $lh = @icon_label($ix + $iw / 2, $icy + $is / 2 + $chh * 0.4, $an, $iw - $cw)
				if !$hm_edit
					$ui_hv = $ap
					@ui_hit($ix, $iy, $ix + $iw, $iy + $ih, "app")
			elseif $hm_kind.$hi == 3
				@cw_draw($hm_ref.$hi, $ix + $pad, $iy + $pad, $iw - $pad * 2, $ih - $pad * 2)
			else
				@wg_draw($hm_ref.$hi, $ix + $pad, $iy + $pad, $iw - $pad * 2, $ih - $pad * 2, $hi)
			if $hm_edit
				; Edit overlay: remove + move arrows.
				var $eb = max($chh * 1.8, min($g_cw, $g_ch) * 0.22)
				@d_line($ix + 1, $iy + 1, $ix + $iw - 1, $iy + 1, $th_accent)
				@d_line($ix + 1, $iy + $ih - 1, $ix + $iw - 1, $iy + $ih - 1, $th_accent)
				@d_line($ix + 1, $iy + 1, $ix + 1, $iy + $ih - 1, $th_accent)
				@d_line($ix + $iw - 1, $iy + 1, $ix + $iw - 1, $iy + $ih - 1, $th_accent)
				var $mx = $ix + $iw / 2
				var $my = $iy + $ih / 2
				if !$hm_szmode
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($ix + $iw - $eb, $iy, $eb, $eb, "X", "ed_x", 2)
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($ix, $my - $eb / 2, $eb, $eb, "<", "ed_l", 0)
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($ix + $iw - $eb, $my - $eb / 2, $eb, $eb, ">", "ed_r", 0)
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($mx - $eb / 2, $iy, $eb, $eb, "^", "ed_u", 0)
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($mx - $eb / 2, $iy + $ih - $eb, $eb, $eb, "v", "ed_d", 0)
				else
					; each edge: green arrow pushes it out, plain arrow pulls it in
					var $sb = max(min($eb, $iw / 5, $ih / 2.2), $cw * 2.2)
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($ix, $my - $sb - 1, $sb, $sb, "<", "sz_lg", 3)
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($ix, $my + 1, $sb, $sb, ">", "sz_ls", 0)
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($ix + $iw - $sb, $my - $sb - 1, $sb, $sb, ">", "sz_rg", 3)
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($ix + $iw - $sb, $my + 1, $sb, $sb, "<", "sz_rs", 0)
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($mx - $sb - 1, $iy, $sb, $sb, "^", "sz_tg", 3)
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($mx + 1, $iy, $sb, $sb, "v", "sz_ts", 0)
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($mx - $sb - 1, $iy + $ih - $sb, $sb, $sb, "v", "sz_bg", 3)
					$ui_hv = $hi
					@ui_btn($mx + 1, $iy + $ih - $sb, $sb, $sb, "^", "sz_bs", 0)
	if ($on_page == 0) and (!$hm_edit)
		var $cy = $sb_h + ($desk_h - $sb_h - $nb_h) / 2 - $chh
		var $hint_y = @ui_para_c($desk_w / 2, $cy, $th_dim, "PRESS AND HOLD TO ADD WIDGET OR APP SHORTCUT", $desk_w * 0.8)
	; Page dots + arrows
	var $dy = $desk_h - $nb_h - $chh * 1.6
	var $dn = $hm_pages
	var $dsp = $chh * 1.6
	var $dx0 = $desk_w / 2 - ($dn - 1) * $dsp / 2
	repeat $dn ($di)
		var $dcol = $th_dim
		var $dfill = $th_bg
		if $di == $hm_cur
			$dcol = $th_accent
			$dfill = $th_accent
		@d_circle($dx0 + $di * $dsp, $dy, $chh * 0.35, $dcol, $dfill)
		$ui_hv = $di
		@ui_hit($dx0 + $di * $dsp - $dsp / 2, $dy - $dsp / 2, $dx0 + $di * $dsp + $dsp / 2, $dy + $dsp / 2, "hm_page")
	if $hm_pages > 1
		var $ab = $chh * 2
		@ui_btn($cw, $dy - $ab / 2, $ab * 1.4, $ab, "<", "hm_prev", 0)
		@ui_btn($desk_w - $cw - $ab * 1.4, $dy - $ab / 2, $ab * 1.4, $ab, ">", "hm_next", 0)
	if $hm_edit
		var $db_w = $cw * 12
		var $mdl = "MODE: MOVE"
		var $mds = 0
		if $hm_szmode
			$mdl = "MODE: SIZE"
			$mds = 1
		var $md_w = $cw * 14
		var $bar_x = $desk_w / 2 - ($db_w + $md_w + $cw) / 2
		@ui_btn($bar_x, $sb_h + $chh * 0.4, $md_w, $chh * 2.2, $mdl, "ed_mode", $mds)
		@ui_btn($bar_x + $md_w + $cw, $sb_h + $chh * 0.4, $db_w, $chh * 2.2, "DONE", "ed_done", 3)

; Long-press menu (sheet).
function @home_menu_draw()
	@ui_hit(0, 0, $desk_w, $desk_h, "menu_close")
	var $mw = min($desk_w * 0.9, $cw * 34)

	@ui_text_c($desk_w / 2, $my + $chh * 0.7, $th_text, "HOME SCREEN")
	var $y = $my + $chh * 2.4

	@ui_btn($mx + $cw, $y, $mw - $cw * 2, $bh, "ADD APP SHORTCUT", "mn_app", 0)
	$y += $bh + $chh * 0.5

array $pk_widx : number
; Picker: widgets (kind 2) or apps (kind 1) - a scrolling list.
function @picker_draw($kind : number)
	$sl_txt.clear()
	$sl_spec.clear()
	if $kind == 2
		repeat $widget_count ($k)
			var $id = $k + 1
			var $wn = @wg_name($id)
			var $wsw = @wg_w($id)
			var $wsh = @wg_h($id)
			var $ws = text("{} x {}", $wsw, $wsh)
			if $id == 1
				$ws = "choose style"
			$sl_txt.append($wn & "   (" & $ws & ")")
		repeat 5 ($ct0)
			var $ct = $ct0 + 1
			var $ctn = @cw_type_name($ct)
			var $ctl = "CUSTOM " & $ctn & "   (pick a source)"
			if @cw_is_control($ct)
				$ctl = "CUSTOM " & $ctn & "   (pick a target)"
			$sl_txt.append($ctl)
		$sl_txt.append("CUSTOM GRAPH   (pick a source)")
		$sl_txt.append("CONTACT   (pick a saved contact)")
		$sl_txt.append("CONTAINER CONTENTS   (scrolling list)")
		$pk_wapp.clear()
		$pk_widx.clear()
		var $xan = $xa_alias.size
		repeat $xan ($xk)
			if @xa_is_online($xk) and ($xk < $xa_wdef.size)
				var $wd = $xa_wdef.$xk
				var $wn2 = min(@split_count($wd, "|"), 4)
				repeat $wn2 ($wq)
					var $we = @split_part($wd, "|", $wq)
					var $wnm = @split_part($we, "~", 0)
					var $wwt = @split_part($we, "~", 1)
					var $wht = @split_part($we, "~", 2)
					$sl_txt.append($xa_name.$xk & ": " & upper($wnm) & "   (" & $wwt & " x " & $wht & ")")
					$pk_wapp.append($xk)
					$pk_widx.append($wq)
		@pick_list("ADD WIDGET", "", "pick")
	else
		var $na = @app_total()
		repeat $na ($k)
			$sl_txt.append(@app_name(@app_id($k)))
		@pick_list("ADD APP SHORTCUT", "", "pick")

; App drawer.
function @drawer_draw()
	@hm_grid()
	var $dn_apps = @app_total()
	repeat $dn_apps ($k)
		var $ap = @app_id($k)
		var $c = mod($k, $g_cols)
		var $r = floor($k / $g_cols)
		var $ix = $g_ox + $c * $g_cw
		var $iy = $g_oy + $r * $g_ch
		var $is = min($g_cw * 0.5, $g_ch - $chh * 2.4)
		var $icy = $iy + $is / 2 + $chh * 0.4
		@icon_draw($ap, $ix + $g_cw / 2, $icy, $is)
		var $an = @app_name($ap)
		var $lh = @icon_label($ix + $g_cw / 2, $icy + $is / 2 + $chh * 0.4, $an, $g_cw - $cw)
		$ui_hv = $ap
		@ui_hit($ix, $iy, $ix + $g_cw, $iy + $g_ch, "app")
	if $xa_alias_warn
		; banner just above the nav bar
		var $wy = $desk_h - $nb_h - $chh * 1.9
		@ui_box($cw, $wy - $chh * 0.3, $desk_w - $cw * 2, $chh * 1.6, $th_panel2, $th_warn)
		@text_fit_c($desk_w / 2, $wy, $th_warn, "ADD-ON APPS: ALIAS THIS COMPUTER chipos", $desk_w - $cw * 3)

; ChipOS - shell: status bar, navigation bar, notifications, app registry,
; icons, clock, units, theme.
storage var $cfg_shell_ver : number
storage var $cfg_accent : number        ; 0 cyan 1 green 2 orange 3 purple 4 red 5 yellow
storage var $cfg_units : number         ; 0 metric, 1 imperial
storage var $cfg_tz : number            ; hours added to the clock shown
storage var $clk_minutes : number       ; minutes since day 1 00:00 (saved)
storage var $cfg_volume : number        ; buzzer volume %

var $sb_h = 20
var $nb_h = 24
array $nt_text : text
array $nt_time : number
var $nt_unread = 0
var $ov_shade = 0
; Long-press tracking
var $hold_k = -1
var $hold_start = 0
var $hold_last = -10
var $hold_fired = 0

const $app_count = 4
; Sound (buzzers: ch0 volume 0-1, ch1 frequency Hz)
var $ov_vol = 0
var $snd_until = 0
var $snd_freq = 880
var $snd_last = -1
var $snd_premute = 50
var $snd_scan_next = 0
var $bz_present = 0
array $bz_alias : text
var $vol_tx = 0
var $vol_tw = 1                    ; 1 POWER, 2 DEVICES, 3 SETTINGS

storage var $cfg_bgmode : number         ; 0 standard, 1 tinted, 2 deep tint

function @theme_apply()
	var $ta = $cfg_accent
	var $r = 0
	var $g = 196
	var $b = 228
	if $ta == 1
		$r = 46
		$g = 210
		$b = 110
	elseif $ta == 2
		$r = 250
		$g = 150
		$b = 40
	elseif $ta == 3
		$r = 170
		$g = 120
		$b = 250
	elseif $ta == 4
		$r = 240
		$g = 80
		$b = 80
	elseif $ta == 5
		$r = 240
		$g = 210
		$b = 60
	$th_accent = color($r, $g, $b)
	$th_accent_dk = color($r * 0.36, $g * 0.36, $b * 0.4)
	if $cfg_bgmode == 1
		$th_bg = color($r * 0.03 + 4, $g * 0.03 + 4, $b * 0.03 + 4)
		$th_panel = color($r * 0.065 + 7, $g * 0.065 + 7, $b * 0.065 + 7)
		$th_panel2 = color($r * 0.1 + 10, $g * 0.1 + 10, $b * 0.1 + 10)
		$th_line = color($r * 0.22 + 16, $g * 0.22 + 16, $b * 0.22 + 16)
	elseif $cfg_bgmode == 2
		$th_bg = color($r * 0.06 + 3, $g * 0.06 + 3, $b * 0.06 + 3)
		$th_panel = color($r * 0.11 + 5, $g * 0.11 + 5, $b * 0.11 + 5)
		$th_panel2 = color($r * 0.17 + 7, $g * 0.17 + 7, $b * 0.17 + 7)
		$th_line = color($r * 0.35 + 12, $g * 0.35 + 12, $b * 0.35 + 12)
	else
		$th_bg = color(6, 10, 16)
		$th_panel = color(13, 21, 31)
		$th_panel2 = color(20, 33, 47)
		$th_line = color(38, 62, 84)

function @shell_load()
	if $cfg_shell_ver != 1
		$cfg_accent = 0
		$cfg_tscale = 100
		$cfg_units = 0
		$cfg_24h = 1
		$cfg_tz = 0
		$cfg_volume = 50
		$cfg_shell_ver = 1
	@theme_apply()

function @accent_swatch($i : number) : number
	if $i == 1
		return color(46, 210, 110)
	if $i == 2
		return color(250, 150, 40)
	if $i == 3
		return color(170, 120, 250)
	if $i == 4
		return color(240, 80, 80)
	if $i == 5
		return color(240, 210, 60)
	return color(0, 196, 228)

; ---- units ----
function @fmt_temp($c : number) : text
	if $cfg_units
		return text("{0.0} F", $c * 9 / 5 + 32)
	return text("{0.0} C", $c)

function @fmt_len($m : number) : text
	if $cfg_units
		return text("{0.0} ft", $m * 3.28084)
	return text("{0.0} m", $m)

function @fmt_mass($kg : number) : text
	if $cfg_units
		return text("{0.0} lb", $kg * 2.20462)
	return text("{0.0} kg", $kg)

; ---- sound ----
function @snd_beep($f : number, $d : number)
	$snd_freq = $f
	$snd_until = time + $d

function @snd_tick()
	if time >= $snd_scan_next
		$snd_scan_next = time + 3
		$bz_alias.clear()
		$bz_present = 0
		var $sn = $db_id.size
		repeat $sn ($sj)
			if contains($db_type.$sj, "Buzzer") and ($db_seen.$sj >= $scan_gen - 1)
				$bz_present = 1
				if $db_alias.$sj != ""
					$bz_alias.append($db_alias.$sj)
		$snd_last = -1
	var $sv = 0
	if time < $snd_until
		$sv = $cfg_volume / 100
	var $skey = $sv * 100000 + $snd_freq
	if $skey == $snd_last
		return
	$snd_last = $skey
	foreach $bz_alias ($bi, $ba)
		@out_n($ba, 1, $snd_freq)
		@out_n($ba, 0, $sv)

function @vol_draw()
	@ui_hit(0, $sb_h, $desk_w, $desk_h, "vol_close")
	var $vw = min($desk_w * 0.9, $cw * 34)
	var $vh = $chh * 8
	var $vx = $desk_w - $vw - $cw
	var $vy = $sb_h + $chh * 0.3
	@ui_box($vx, $vy, $vw, $vh, $th_panel2, $th_accent)
	@ui_hit($vx, $vy, $vx + $vw, $vy + $vh, "")
	var $vt = text("VOLUME {}%", $cfg_volume)
	if $cfg_volume == 0
		$vt = "MUTED"
	@ui_text($vx + $cw, $vy + $chh * 0.7, $th_text, $vt)
	var $mb = $cw * 10
	var $mlab = "MUTE"
	if $cfg_volume == 0
		$mlab = "UNMUTE"
	@ui_btn($vx + $vw - $mb - $cw, $vy + $chh * 0.3, $mb, $chh * 1.8, $mlab, "vol_mute", 0)
	var $bb = $chh * 2.2
	var $ty = $vy + $chh * 3.4
	@ui_btn($vx + $cw, $ty, $bb, $bb, "-", "vol-", 0)
	@ui_btn($vx + $vw - $cw - $bb, $ty, $bb, $bb, "+", "vol+", 0)
	$vol_tx = $vx + $cw * 2 + $bb
	$vol_tw = $vw - $cw * 4 - $bb * 2
	var $tr_y = $ty + $bb / 2 - $chh * 0.3
	@ui_box($vol_tx, $tr_y, $vol_tw, $chh * 0.6, $th_bg, $th_line)
	@ui_box($vol_tx, $tr_y, $vol_tw * $cfg_volume / 100, $chh * 0.6, $th_accent, $th_accent)
	@d_circle($vol_tx + $vol_tw * $cfg_volume / 100, $tr_y + $chh * 0.3, $chh * 0.7, $th_text, $th_text)
	@ui_hit($vol_tx, $ty, $vol_tx + $vol_tw, $ty + $bb, "vol_track")

		@ui_text($vx + $cw, $vy + $vh - $chh * 1.6, $th_warn, "NAME A BUZZER TO HEAR SOUND")

function @notify($t : text)
	@os_log($t)

		$nt_text.erase(0)
		$nt_time.erase(0)

	@snd_beep(988, 0.12)

var $sx_app = 0                         ; containers + conveyors: sorter
; Built-in apps in the drawer: POWER DEVICES SETTINGS CLOCK [DRIVE] CALC NOTEPAD STOPWATCH TIMER COUNTDOWN
function @app_builtin_n() : number
	return $app_count + 6 + $dv_present + $cm_present * 3 + $cr_present + $ws_present + $so_present + $fl_app + $rf_app + $lt_app + $fy_app + $bt_app + $mn_app + $sx_app

function @app_total() : number
	var $n = @app_builtin_n()
	var $xn = $xa_alias.size
	repeat $xn ($xi)
		if @xa_is_online($xi)
			$n += 1
	return $n

function @app_id($k : number) : number
	var $bn = @app_builtin_n()
	if $k < $app_count
		return $k + 1
	if $k < $bn
		var $kk = $k - $app_count
		if $dv_present
			if $kk == 0
				return 5
			$kk -= 1
		if $cm_present
			if $kk == 0
				return 11
			if $kk == 1
				return 13
			if $kk == 2
				return 14
			$kk -= 3
		if $cr_present
			if $kk == 0
				return 12
			$kk -= 1
		if $ws_present
			if $kk == 0
				return 15
			$kk -= 1
		if $so_present
			if $kk == 0
				return 16
			$kk -= 1
		if $fl_app
			if $kk == 0
				return 17
			$kk -= 1
		if $rf_app
			if $kk == 0
				return 18
			$kk -= 1
		if $lt_app
			if $kk == 0
				return 19
			$kk -= 1
		if $fy_app
			if $kk == 0
				return 20
			$kk -= 1
		if $bt_app
			if $kk == 0
				return 21
			$kk -= 1
		if $mn_app
			if $kk == 0
				return 22
			$kk -= 1
		if $sx_app
			if $kk == 0
				return 24
			$kk -= 1
		; AUTOMATE is always there
		if $kk == 0
			return 23
		$kk -= 1
		return 6 + $kk
	var $want = $k - $bn
	var $xn = $xa_alias.size
	repeat $xn ($xi)
		if @xa_is_online($xi)
			if $want == 0
				return 100 + $xi
			$want -= 1
	return 1
