		$b = 60
	elseif $a == 3
		$r = 110
		$g = 120
		$b = 135
	else
		return 0
	$ic_r = $r
	$ic_g = $g
	$ic_b = $b
	return 1

function @ic_px($u : number) : number
	return $ic_x + $u * $ic_k

function @ic_py($u : number) : number
	return $ic_y + $u * $ic_k

; line drawn with a plus-shaped brush n px each way (no gaps on diagonals)
function @ic_brush($ax : number, $ay : number, $bx : number, $by : number, $n : number, $c : number)
	var $cnt = $n * 2 + 1
	repeat $cnt ($k)
		var $o = $k - $n
		@d_line($ax + $o, $ay, $bx + $o, $by, $c)
		@d_line($ax, $ay + $o, $bx, $by + $o, $c)

; thick line (unit coords) with soft edges
function @ic_line($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number)
	var $ax = @ic_px($x1)
	var $ay = @ic_py($y1)
	var $bx = @ic_px($x2)
	var $by = @ic_py($y2)
	@ic_brush($ax, $ay, $bx, $by, $ic_n + 1, $ic_e)
	@ic_brush($ax, $ay, $bx, $by, $ic_n, $ic_w)
	@d_circle($ax, $ay, $ic_n, $ic_w, $ic_w)
	@d_circle($bx, $by, $ic_n, $ic_w, $ic_w)

; filled box (unit coords)
function @ic_fill($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number)
	var $ax = @ic_px($x1)
	var $ay = @ic_py($y1)
	var $bx = @ic_px($x2)
	var $by = @ic_py($y2)
	@d_rect($ax - 1, $ay - 1, $bx + 1, $by + 1, $ic_e, $ic_e)
	@d_rect($ax, $ay, $bx, $by, $ic_w, $ic_w)

; box outline (unit coords), stroke 2n+1 px
function @ic_box($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number)
	var $ax = @ic_px($x1)
	var $ay = @ic_py($y1)
	var $bx = @ic_px($x2)
	var $by = @ic_py($y2)
	var $n = $ic_n
	@d_rect($ax - $n - 1, $ay - $n - 1, $bx + $n + 1, $by + $n + 1, $ic_e, $ic_e)
	@d_rect($ax - $n, $ay - $n, $bx + $n, $by + $n, $ic_w, $ic_w)
	@d_rect($ax + $n + 1, $ay + $n + 1, $bx - $n - 1, $by - $n - 1, $ic_e, $ic_e)
	@d_rect($ax + $n + 2, $ay + $n + 2, $bx - $n - 2, $by - $n - 2, $ic_f, $ic_f)

; ring / disc / hole (unit coords)
function @ic_ring($x : number, $y : number, $r : number)
	var $px = @ic_px($x)
	var $py = @ic_py($y)
	var $rr = $r * $ic_k
	var $n = $ic_n
	@d_circle($px, $py, $rr + $n + 1, $ic_e, $ic_e)
	@d_circle($px, $py, $rr + $n, $ic_w, $ic_w)
	@d_circle($px, $py, max($rr - $n - 1, 0), $ic_e, $ic_e)
	@d_circle($px, $py, max($rr - $n - 2, 0), $ic_f, $ic_f)

function @ic_disc($x : number, $y : number, $r : number)
	var $px = @ic_px($x)
	var $py = @ic_py($y)
	var $rr = $r * $ic_k
	@d_circle($px, $py, $rr + 1, $ic_e, $ic_e)
	@d_circle($px, $py, $rr, $ic_w, $ic_w)

function @ic_hole($x : number, $y : number, $r : number)
	var $px = @ic_px($x)
	var $py = @ic_py($y)
	var $rr = $r * $ic_k
	@d_circle($px, $py, $rr + 1, $ic_e, $ic_e)
	@d_circle($px, $py, $rr, $ic_f, $ic_f)

; "#rrggbb" -> $hx_r / $hx_g / $hx_b (returns 0 if it isn't one).
var $hx_r = 0
var $hx_g = 0
var $hx_b = 0
function @hex_rgb($h : text) : number
	var $hx = lower($h)
	if (size($hx) != 7) or (substring($hx, 0, 1) != "#")
		return 0
	var $digs = "0123456789abcdef"
	$hx_r = max(0, find($digs, substring($hx, 1, 1)) * 16 + find($digs, substring($hx, 2, 1)))
	$hx_g = max(0, find($digs, substring($hx, 3, 1)) * 16 + find($digs, substring($hx, 4, 1)))
	$hx_b = max(0, find($digs, substring($hx, 5, 1)) * 16 + find($digs, substring($hx, 6, 1)))
	return 1

; An outline ring (add-on icons): only the band, so shapes under it stay.
function @ic_oring($x : number, $y : number, $r : number)
	repeat 24 ($q)
		var $a1 = $q * pi / 12
		var $a2 = ($q + 1) * pi / 12
		var $ax = @ic_px($x + sin($a1) * $r)
		var $ay = @ic_py($y - cos($a1) * $r)
		var $bx = @ic_px($x + sin($a2) * $r)
		var $by = @ic_py($y - cos($a2) * $r)
		@ic_brush($ax, $ay, $bx, $by, $ic_n, $ic_w)

; A filled triangle (add-on icons).
function @ic_tri($x1 : number, $y1 : number, $x2 : number, $y2 : number, $x3 : number, $y3 : number)
	$rt.draw_triangle(@ic_px($x1) - $ox, @ic_py($y1) - $oy, @ic_px($x2) - $ox, @ic_py($y2) - $oy, @ic_px($x3) - $ox, @ic_py($y3) - $oy, $ic_w, $ic_w)

; An add-on's own icon: shapes "R,x1,y1,x2,y2,#c;C,x,y,r,#c;..." on the tile.
function @ic_custom($spec : text, $tile : text)
	var $tr = 120
	var $tg = 120
	var $tb = 130
	if @hex_rgb($tile)
		$tr = $hx_r
		$tg = $hx_g
		$tb = $hx_b
	var $sw = $ic_w
	var $se = $ic_e
	var $n = min(@split_count($spec, ";"), 24)
	repeat $n ($i)
		var $sh = @split_part($spec, ";", $i)
		var $op = upper(@split_part($sh, ",", 0))
		var $a1 = 0
		var $a2 = 0
		var $a3 = 0
		var $a4 = 0
		var $p1 = @split_part($sh, ",", 1)
		var $p2 = @split_part($sh, ",", 2)
		var $p3 = @split_part($sh, ",", 3)
		var $p4 = @split_part($sh, ",", 4)
		if isnumeric($p1)
			$a1 = $p1
		if isnumeric($p2)
			$a2 = $p2
		if isnumeric($p3)
			$a3 = $p3
		if isnumeric($p4)
			$a4 = $p4
		var $ci = 5
		if ($op == "C") or ($op == "O")
			$ci = 4
		elseif $op == "T"
			$ci = 7
		var $cr = 250
		var $cg = 250
		var $cb = 250
		if @hex_rgb(@split_part($sh, ",", $ci))
			$cr = $hx_r
			$cg = $hx_g
			$cb = $hx_b
		$ic_w = color($cr, $cg, $cb)
		$ic_e = color(($cr + $tr) / 2, ($cg + $tg) / 2, ($cb + $tb) / 2)
		if $op == "R"
			@ic_fill($a1, $a2, $a3, $a4)
		elseif $op == "B"
			@ic_box($a1, $a2, $a3, $a4)
		elseif $op == "L"
			@ic_line($a1, $a2, $a3, $a4)
		elseif $op == "C"
			@ic_disc($a1, $a2, $a3)
		elseif $op == "O"
			@ic_oring($a1, $a2, $a3)
		elseif $op == "T"
			var $a5 = 0
			var $a6 = 0
			var $p5 = @split_part($sh, ",", 5)
			var $p6 = @split_part($sh, ",", 6)
			if isnumeric($p5)
				$a5 = $p5
			if isnumeric($p6)
				$a6 = $p6
			@ic_tri($a1, $a2, $a3, $a4, $a5, $a6)
	$ic_w = $sw
	$ic_e = $se

; App icon: rounded tile + symbol, centred at (cx, cy), size s.
function @icon_draw($a : number, $cx : number, $cy : number, $s : number)
	; skip icons outside the screen being drawn (spanned walls draw per screen)
	if ($cx + $s < $ox) or ($cx - $s > $ox + $cur_w) or ($cy + $s < $oy) or ($cy - $s > $oy + $cur_h)
		return
	var $col = @app_color($a)
	var $known = @ic_rgb($a)
	var $w = color(250, 250, 250)
	var $e = $col
	var $soft = $col
	if $known
		$col = color($ic_r, $ic_g, $ic_b)
		$e = color(($ic_r + 250) / 2, ($ic_g + 250) / 2, ($ic_b + 250) / 2)
		$soft = color($ic_r * 0.45 + 5, $ic_g * 0.45 + 6, $ic_b * 0.45 + 8)
	$ic_k = $s / 100
	$ic_x = $cx
	$ic_y = $cy
	$ic_w = $w
	$ic_e = $e
	$ic_f = $col
	$ic_n = max(0, floor($s / 40))
	; rounded tile with a soft rim
	var $h = $s / 2
	var $rad = $s * 0.22
	@d_rect($cx - $h + $rad, $cy - $h - 1, $cx + $h - $rad, $cy + $h + 1, $soft, $soft)
	@d_rect($cx - $h - 1, $cy - $h + $rad, $cx + $h + 1, $cy + $h - $rad, $soft, $soft)
	@d_circle($cx - $h + $rad, $cy - $h + $rad, $rad + 1, $soft, $soft)
	@d_circle($cx + $h - $rad, $cy - $h + $rad, $rad + 1, $soft, $soft)
	@d_circle($cx - $h + $rad, $cy + $h - $rad, $rad + 1, $soft, $soft)
	@d_circle($cx + $h - $rad, $cy + $h - $rad, $rad + 1, $soft, $soft)
	@d_rect($cx - $h + $rad, $cy - $h, $cx + $h - $rad, $cy + $h, $col, $col)
	@d_rect($cx - $h, $cy - $h + $rad, $cx + $h, $cy + $h - $rad, $col, $col)
	@d_circle($cx - $h + $rad, $cy - $h + $rad, $rad, $col, $col)
	@d_circle($cx + $h - $rad, $cy - $h + $rad, $rad, $col, $col)
	@d_circle($cx - $h + $rad, $cy + $h - $rad, $rad, $col, $col)
	@d_circle($cx + $h - $rad, $cy + $h - $rad, $rad, $col, $col)
	if $a >= 100
		var $xi = $a - 100
		var $spec = ""
		if $xi < $xa_icon.size
			$spec = $xa_icon.$xi
		if $spec != ""
			@ic_custom($spec, $xa_hex.$xi)
		else
			var $gl = $xa_glyph.$xi
			var $gmul = max(1, $s / ($chh * 1.6))
			@ui_text_big($cx, $cy - $chh * @tsz($ts * $gmul) / $ts / 2, $w, $gl, $gmul)
		if !$xa_online.($a - 100)
			@d_line($cx - $h, $cy + $h, $cx + $h, $cy - $h, $th_bad)
	elseif $a == 1
		; battery with a bolt
		@ic_box(-17, -24, 17, 32)
		@ic_fill(-8, -34, 8, -26)
		@ic_line(5, -14, -7, 6)
		@ic_line(-7, 6, 7, 6)
		@ic_line(7, 6, -5, 24)
	elseif $a == 2
		; chip with pins
		@ic_box(-19, -19, 19, 19)
		@ic_fill(-7, -7, 7, 7)
		repeat 3 ($p)
			var $po = ($p - 1) * 12
			@ic_line($po, -22, $po, -33)
			@ic_line($po, 22, $po, 33)
			@ic_line(-22, $po, -33, $po)
			@ic_line(22, $po, 33, $po)
	elseif $a == 3
		; gear
		repeat 8 ($g)
			var $ga = $g * pi / 4
			@ic_line(cos($ga) * 20, sin($ga) * 20, cos($ga) * 31, sin($ga) * 31)
		@ic_disc(0, 0, 23)
		@ic_hole(0, 0, 9)
	elseif $a == 4
		; clock
		@ic_ring(0, 0, 30)
		@ic_line(0, 0, 0, -19)
		@ic_line(0, 0, 13, 7)
		@ic_disc(0, 0, 4)
	elseif $a == 5
		; steering wheel
		@ic_ring(0, 0, 30)
		@ic_line(-28, 2, 28, 2)
		@ic_line(0, 2, 0, 28)
		@ic_disc(0, 2, 8)
	elseif $a == 6
		; calculator
		@ic_box(-22, -32, 22, 32)
		@ic_fill(-14, -24, 14, -11)
		repeat 9 ($q)
			var $kx = (mod($q, 3) - 1) * 11
			var $ky = floor($q / 3) * 11 + 1
			@ic_fill($kx - 4, $ky - 3, $kx + 4, $ky + 4)
	elseif $a == 7
		; note page with lines
		@ic_box(-21, -29, 21, 29)
		@ic_line(-11, -15, 11, -15)
		@ic_line(-11, -3, 11, -3)
		@ic_line(-11, 9, 11, 9)
		@ic_line(-11, 20, 2, 20)
	elseif $a == 8
		; stopwatch
		@ic_fill(-6, -36, 6, -29)
		@ic_line(20, -20, 26, -26)
		@ic_ring(0, 5, 26)
		@ic_line(0, 5, 10, -9)
		@ic_disc(0, 5, 4)
	elseif $a == 9
		; hourglass
		@ic_fill(-21, -33, 21, -26)
		@ic_fill(-21, 26, 21, 33)
		@ic_line(-15, -26, 0, 0)
		@ic_line(0, 0, -15, 26)
		@ic_line(15, -26, 0, 0)
		@ic_line(0, 0, 15, 26)
		@ic_fill(-7, 18, 7, 24)
		@ic_fill(-3, 13, 3, 18)
	elseif $a == 11
		; antenna mast with radio waves
		@ic_line(0, -6, 0, 30)
		@ic_line(-13, 30, 13, 30)
		@ic_line(0, 8, -9, 30)
		@ic_line(0, 8, 9, 30)
		@ic_disc(0, -11, 5)
		repeat 2 ($wv)
			var $wr = 15 + $wv * 11
			repeat 4 ($ws)
				var $a1 = (-45 + $ws * 22.5) * pi / 180
				var $a2 = (-45 + ($ws + 1) * 22.5) * pi / 180
				@ic_line(cos($a1) * $wr, -11 + sin($a1) * $wr, cos($a2) * $wr, -11 + sin($a2) * $wr)
				@ic_line(-cos($a1) * $wr, -11 + sin($a1) * $wr, -cos($a2) * $wr, -11 + sin($a2) * $wr)
	elseif $a == 12
		; gear
		@ic_ring(0, 0, 20)
		repeat 8 ($gt)
			var $ga = $gt * pi / 4
			@ic_line(cos($ga) * 22, sin($ga) * 22, cos($ga) * 31, sin($ga) * 31)
		@ic_disc(0, 0, 7)
	elseif $a == 13
		; person card
		@ic_box(-30, -24, 30, 26)
		@ic_disc(-10, -4, 8)
		@ic_line(-22, 16, -10, 8)
		@ic_line(-10, 8, 2, 16)
		@ic_line(10, -8, 22, -8)
		@ic_line(10, 4, 22, 4)
	elseif $a == 15
		; sun behind a cloud
		@ic_ring(-8, -8, 12)
		repeat 6 ($sr)
			var $sa = pi + $sr * pi / 5
			@ic_line(-8 + cos($sa) * 17, -8 + sin($sa) * 17, -8 + cos($sa) * 24, -8 + sin($sa) * 24)
		@ic_disc(-6, 14, 11)
		@ic_disc(10, 6, 14)
		@ic_disc(24, 16, 9)
		@ic_fill(-6, 14, 24, 25)
	elseif $a == 17
		; tank with a drop
		@ic_box(-22, -16, 22, 28)
		@ic_fill(-22, 8, 22, 28)
		@ic_line(0, -32, -8, -20)
		@ic_line(0, -32, 8, -20)
		@ic_disc(0, -17, 8)
	elseif $a == 20
		; plane (top view)
		@ic_line(0, -32, 0, 28)
		@ic_line(-30, 2, 30, 2)
		@ic_line(-12, 24, 12, 24)
		@ic_fill(-4, -30, 4, 26)
	elseif $a == 23
		; IF -> THEN: a diamond, an arrow, a box
		@ic_line(-28, -6, -16, -18)
		@ic_line(-16, -18, -4, -6)
		@ic_line(-4, -6, -16, 6)
		@ic_line(-16, 6, -28, -6)
		@ic_line(-2, -6, 14, -6)
		@ic_line(8, -12, 14, -6)
		@ic_line(8, 0, 14, -6)
		@ic_fill(16, -16, 30, 4)
		@ic_line(-16, 6, -16, 24)
		@ic_line(-16, 24, 22, 24)

	elseif $a == 24

		@ic_line(0, -30, 0, -4)

	elseif $a == 22
		; drill rig over rock
		@ic_line(-20, -30, 20, -30)

		@ic_fill(-4, -30, 4, 10)

; Label under an app icon: one size smaller than body text on big screens,
; cut to fit its column. Returns the label height.
function @icon_label($cx : number, $y : number, $t : text, $wmax : number) : number
	var $sz = @tsz($ts - 1)
	$rt.text_size($sz)
	var $lcw = $rt.char_w
	var $lch = $rt.char_h
	var $lt = $t
	var $fit = floor($wmax / max($lcw, 1))
	if size($lt) > $fit
		$lt = substring($lt, 0, max($fit - 1, 1)) & "."
	@d_write($cx - size($lt) * $lcw / 2, $y, $th_text, $lt)
	$rt.text_size(@tsz($ts))
	return $lch

; ---- bars ----
function @shell_metrics()
	$sb_h = $chh * 2.2
	$nb_h = $chh * 2.8
	$content_x = $cw
	$content_y = $sb_h + $chh * 0.8
	$content_w = $desk_w - $cw * 2
	$content_h = $desk_h - $nb_h - $content_y - $chh * 0.6

function @alert_count() : number
	var $ac = $db_unnamed + $db_missing
	if $pw_shed
		$ac += 1
	return $ac

function @shell_status()
	@ui_box(0, 0, $desk_w, $sb_h, $th_panel, $th_panel)
	@d_line(0, $sb_h, $desk_w, $sb_h, $th_line)
	@ui_hit(0, 0, $desk_w, $sb_h, "shade")
	var $ty = ($sb_h - $chh) / 2
	var $ck = @clk_text()
	var $dy = @fmt_date($cfg_datefmt)
	var $left = $ck & "   " & $dy
	@ui_text($cw, $ty, $th_text, $left)
	var $rx = $desk_w - $cw
	; Battery (Android style): main battery if there is one, else the total.
	var $bp = $pw_main_pct
	if $bp < 0
		$bp = $pw_pct
	if $bp >= 0
		var $bw = $chh * 0.7
		var $bh = $chh * 1.25
		var $by = ($sb_h - $bh) / 2 + $chh * 0.1
		var $b_col = $th_text
		if $bp < $pw_low
			$b_col = $th_bad
		elseif $pw_flow > 50
			$b_col = $th_ok
		@d_rect($rx - $bw, $by, $rx, $by + $bh, $b_col, $th_panel)
		@d_rect($rx - $bw * 0.68, $by - $chh * 0.18, $rx - $bw * 0.32, $by, $b_col, $b_col)
		var $fill_h = ($bh - 2) * clamp($bp / 100, 0, 1)
		@d_rect($rx - $bw + 1, $by + $bh - 1 - $fill_h, $rx - 1, $by + $bh - 1, $b_col, $b_col)
		if $pw_flow > 50
			; bolt
			var $bx = $rx - $bw / 2
			@d_line($bx + $bw * 0.15, $by + $bh * 0.15, $bx - $bw * 0.2, $by + $bh * 0.55, $th_panel)
			@d_line($bx - $bw * 0.2, $by + $bh * 0.55, $bx + $bw * 0.2, $by + $bh * 0.45, $th_panel)
			@d_line($bx + $bw * 0.2, $by + $bh * 0.45, $bx - $bw * 0.15, $by + $bh * 0.85, $th_panel)
		var $bt = text("{0}%", $bp)
		@ui_text_r($rx - $bw - $cw * 0.4, $ty, $b_col, $bt)
		$rx -= $bw + $cw * 0.4 + size($bt) * $cw + $cw * 1.2
	; Speaker (when the build has buzzers): tap for volume.
	if $bz_present
		var $sp = $chh * 0.5
		var $scx = $rx - $chh * 0.9
		var $scy = $sb_h / 2
		var $s_col = $th_text
		if $cfg_volume == 0
			$s_col = $th_dim
		@d_rect($scx - $sp * 1.2, $scy - $sp * 0.45, $scx - $sp * 0.5, $scy + $sp * 0.45, $s_col, $s_col)
		@d_line($scx - $sp * 0.5, $scy - $sp * 0.45, $scx + $sp * 0.2, $scy - $sp, $s_col)
		@d_line($scx + $sp * 0.2, $scy - $sp, $scx + $sp * 0.2, $scy + $sp, $s_col)
		@d_line($scx + $sp * 0.2, $scy + $sp, $scx - $sp * 0.5, $scy + $sp * 0.45, $s_col)
		if $cfg_volume == 0
			@d_line($scx + $sp * 0.6, $scy - $sp * 0.5, $scx + $sp * 1.4, $scy + $sp * 0.5, $th_bad)
			@d_line($scx + $sp * 0.6, $scy + $sp * 0.5, $scx + $sp * 1.4, $scy - $sp * 0.5, $th_bad)
		else
			@d_line($scx + $sp * 0.6, $scy - $sp * 0.4, $scx + $sp * 0.6, $scy + $sp * 0.4, $s_col)
			if $cfg_volume > 50
				@d_line($scx + $sp * 1.1, $scy - $sp * 0.8, $scx + $sp * 1.1, $scy + $sp * 0.8, $s_col)
		@ui_hit($scx - $chh * 1.2, 0, $scx + $chh * 1.4, $sb_h, "vol")
		$rx -= $chh * 2.8
	var $ac = @alert_count()
	if ($ac > 0) or ($nt_unread > 0)
		var $al = text("! {}", $ac)
		if $nt_unread > 0
			$al = text("! {}  * {}", $ac, $nt_unread)
		var $a_col = $th_warn
		if $ac == 0
			$a_col = $th_accent
		@ui_text_r($rx, $ty, $a_col, $al)

function @shell_nav()
	var $ny = $desk_h - $nb_h
	@ui_box(0, $ny, $desk_w, $nb_h, $th_panel, $th_panel)
	@d_line(0, $ny, $desk_w, $ny, $th_line)
	var $bw = min($desk_w / 3, $cw * 12)
	var $cx = $desk_w / 2
	var $my = $ny + $nb_h / 2
	var $r = $chh * 0.6
	; BACK (triangle)
	var $bx = $cx - $bw * 1.2
	@d_line($bx + $r, $my - $r, $bx - $r, $my, $th_text)
	@d_line($bx - $r, $my, $bx + $r, $my + $r, $th_text)
	@d_line($bx + $r, $my + $r, $bx + $r, $my - $r, $th_text)
	@ui_hit($bx - $bw / 2, $ny, $bx + $bw / 2, $desk_h, "nav:back")
	; HOME (circle)
	@d_circle($cx, $my, $r, $th_text, $th_panel)
	@ui_hit($cx - $bw / 2, $ny, $cx + $bw / 2, $desk_h, "nav:home")
	; APPS (grid of dots)
	var $ax = $cx + $bw * 1.2
	repeat 3 ($ai)
		repeat 3 ($aj)
			@d_rect($ax - $r + $ai * $r * 0.8, $my - $r + $aj * $r * 0.8, $ax - $r + $ai * $r * 0.8 + $r * 0.4, $my - $r + $aj * $r * 0.8 + $r * 0.4, $th_text, $th_text)
	@ui_hit($ax - $bw / 2, $ny, $ax + $bw / 2, $desk_h, "nav:apps")

; Notification shade (over everything).
function @shade_draw()
	var $sh_h = min($desk_h - $sb_h, $chh * 22)
	@ui_hit(0, 0, $desk_w, $desk_h, "shade")
	var $sw = min($desk_w, $cw * 70)
	var $sx = $desk_w / 2 - $sw / 2
	@ui_box($sx, $sb_h, $sw, $sh_h, $th_panel2, $th_accent)
	var $ck = @clk_text()
	@ui_text_big($sx + $sw / 2, $sb_h + $chh * 0.6, $th_text, $ck, 2)
	var $y = $sb_h + $chh * 3.4
	if $pw_shed
		@ui_text($sx + $cw, $y, $th_bad, "LOW BATTERY - NON-ESSENTIAL RELAYS OFF")
		$y += $chh * 1.4
	if $db_unnamed > 0
		var $shd1 = text("{} DEVICE(S) NEED A NAME", $db_unnamed)
		@ui_text($sx + $cw, $y, $th_warn, $shd1)
		$y += $chh * 1.4
	if $db_missing > 0
		var $shd2 = text("{} DEVICE(S) MISSING", $db_missing)
		@ui_text($sx + $cw, $y, $th_warn, $shd2)
		$y += $chh * 1.4
	@d_line($sx + $cw, $y, $sx + $sw - $cw, $y, $th_line)
	$y += $chh * 0.6
	var $nn = $nt_text.size
	var $maxl = floor(($sb_h + $sh_h - $chh * 3 - $y) / ($chh * 1.3))
	if $nn == 0
		@ui_text($sx + $cw, $y, $th_dim, "NO NOTIFICATIONS")
	var $nshow = min($nn, max($maxl, 0))
	repeat $nshow ($ni)
		var $nk = $nn - 1 - $ni
		var $nm = $nt_time.$nk
		var $nmod = @posmod($nm, 1440)
		var $nh = @pad2(floor($nmod / 60))
		var $nmi = @pad2(floor(mod($nmod, 60)))
		var $nl = text("{}:{}  ", $nh, $nmi) & $nt_text.$nk
		var $nf = @ui_fit($nl, floor(($sw - $cw * 2) / $cw))
		@ui_text($sx + $cw, $y, $th_text, $nf)
		$y += $chh * 1.3
	var $bw = $cw * 14
	@ui_btn($sx + $sw - $bw - $cw, $sb_h + $sh_h - $chh * 2.6, $bw, $chh * 2, "CLEAR ALL", "nt_clear", 0)

; Send an event to app $k.
function @xa_send_to($k : number, $ev : text, $id : text, $clk : text, $day : number, $units : number, $extra : text)
	if ($k < 0) or ($k >= $xa_alias.size)
		return
	$xa_seq += 1
	var $sq_t = text("{}", $xa_seq)
	var $dy_t = text("{}", $day)
	var $un_t = text("{}", $units)
	var $mnow = @clk_now()
	var $mn_t = text("{}", $mnow)
	var $msg = ".mins{" & $mn_t & "}.seq{" & $sq_t & "}.ev{" & $ev & "}.id{" & $id & "}.clock{" & $clk & "}.day{" & $dy_t & "}.units{" & $un_t & "}" & $extra
	@out_t($xa_alias.$k, 0, $msg)

; Send an event to the open app.
function @xa_send($ev : text, $id : text, $clk : text, $day : number, $units : number, $extra : text)
	@xa_send_to($xa_cur, $ev, $id, $clk, $day, $units, $extra)

xc_files.plain_code:
; =====================================================================
; ChipOS App Kit v3  -  include this in an app computer's program.
;  Give THIS computer any alias, and alias the ChipOS computer "chipos"
;  (both on the same router network). ChipOS finds the app by itself.
;
;  In your program:
;    include "chipos-appkit.xc"
;    init:    @kit_app("NAME", "#rrggbb", "G")    ; name, icon colour, glyph
;    update:  @kit_poll()                         ; read events first
;             if $kit_tap == "my-button" ...      ; a button was tapped
;             if @kit_should_draw()               ; only while open & changed
;                 @kit_begin()
;                 @kit_text_c(50, 20, 2, "accent", "HELLO")
;                 @kit_button("my-button", 30, 60, 40, 15, "TAP ME")
;                 @kit_end()
;  Positions and sizes are % of the app area (0-100). Text size multiplies
;  ChipOS's own text size. Colours: text, dim, accent, ok, warn, bad, or
;  #rrggbb. Do not use the characters | and ~ in your text.
;  Values from ChipOS: $kit_open, $kit_clock ("14:05"), $kit_day,
;  $kit_units (0 metric / 1 imperial), $kit_mins (minutes since day 1
;  00:00, received at $kit_mins_t on this computer's clock).
;  Text input:  @kit_input("id", "Prompt", "starting text") pops up ChipOS's
;  keyboard; when the user presses DONE, $kit_input_id / $kit_input_text are
;  set for one tick (CANCEL sets $kit_input_id and $kit_input_cancel = 1).
;  Sound: @kit_beep(880, 0.3) plays on ChipOS's buzzers (frequency Hz, s).
;  Paragraph: @kit_para(x, y, w, size, colour, text) wraps text to width w.
;  Grid: @kit_grid(x, y, w, h, cols, rows, "0012...") draws coloured cells
;  (0 empty, 1 cyan 2 yellow 3 purple 4 green 5 red 6 blue 7 orange 8 grey 9 white).
;  Animations: call @kit_invalidate() to redraw (e.g. a running stopwatch).
;  Home-screen widgets (up to 4): in init, BEFORE @kit_app:
;    @kit_widget("NAME", 2, 1)            ; name, width, height in cells
;  then in update:
;    if @kit_widget_due()                 ; about once a second / after a tap
;        @kit_begin()  ...draw with the same calls...  @kit_wend(0)
;  (@kit_wend(n) for widget n). Widgets are drawn even when the app is
;  closed. A widget button whose id starts with "open:" opens the app and
;  passes the rest of the id as $kit_tap (e.g. "open:note_3").
;  ChipOS shows the app only while this program runs (heartbeat).
;  Clear data: when the user picks CLEAR DATA, $kit_clear is 1 for one tick;
;  reset your storage variables then.
; =====================================================================
const $kit_host = "chipos"
var $kit_name = ""
var $kit_manifest = ""
var $kit_open = 0
var $kit_tap = ""
var $kit_clock = ""
var $kit_day = 0
var $kit_units = 0
var $kit_mins = 0                       ; ChipOS clock, minutes since day 1 00:00
var $kit_mins_t = 0                     ; this computer's time when it arrived
var $kit_seq = -1
var $kit_rx = ""
var $kit_frame = ""
var $kit_sent = ""
var $kit_dirty = 1
var $kit_redraw_next = 0
var $kit_input_id = ""
var $kit_input_text = ""
var $kit_input_cancel = 0
var $kit_clear = 0                      ; 1 for one tick: ChipOS asked to wipe this app's data
var $kit_off = 0                        ; uninstalled: silent until this program restarts
var $kit_rq = 0
var $kit_bq = 0
var $kit_color = ""
var $kit_glyph = ""
var $kit_wdefs = ""
var $kit_hb = 0
var $kit_hb_next = 0
var $kit_wnext = 0
var $kit_wdirty = 1
array $kit_wsent : text

function @kit_mk()
	$kit_manifest = ".kit{3}.name{" & $kit_name & "}.color{" & $kit_color & "}.glyph{" & $kit_glyph & "}.hb{" & text("{}", $kit_hb) & "}"
	if $kit_wdefs != ""
		$kit_manifest = $kit_manifest & ".widgets{" & $kit_wdefs & "}"

; Declare a home-screen widget (call before @kit_app).
function @kit_widget($name : text, $w : number, $h : number)
	if $kit_wdefs != ""
		$kit_wdefs = $kit_wdefs & "|"
	$kit_wdefs = $kit_wdefs & $name & text("~{}~{}", $w, $h)
	$kit_wsent.append("")

function @kit_app($name : text, $color : text, $glyph : text)
	$kit_name = $name
	$kit_color = $color
	$kit_glyph = $glyph
	@kit_mk()
	output_text($kit_host, 0, $kit_manifest)
	output_text($kit_host, 1, "")
	output_text($kit_host, 2, "")
	output_text($kit_host, 3, "")

; Call first thing in update. Sets $kit_tap for one tick when a button is tapped.
function @kit_poll()
	$kit_tap = ""
	$kit_clear = 0
	$kit_input_id = ""
	$kit_input_text = ""
	$kit_input_cancel = 0
	if $kit_off
		return
	; Heartbeat: re-publish the manifest every 2 s, so ChipOS knows we run.
	if time >= $kit_hb_next
		$kit_hb_next = time + 2
		$kit_hb += 1
		@kit_mk()
		output_text($kit_host, 0, $kit_manifest)
	if time >= $kit_redraw_next
		$kit_redraw_next = time + 5
		$kit_dirty = 1
	var $ev = $kit_rx
	if $ev == ""
		return
	var $sq = $ev.seq:number
	if $sq == $kit_seq
		return
	$kit_seq = $sq
	$kit_clock = $ev.clock
	$kit_day = $ev.day:number
	$kit_units = $ev.units:number
	$kit_mins = $ev.mins:number
	$kit_mins_t = time
	var $e = $ev.ev
	if $e == "open"
		$kit_open = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1
		$kit_tap = $ev.id
	elseif $e == "close"
		$kit_open = 0
	elseif $e == "tap"
		$kit_open = 1
		$kit_tap = $ev.id
		$kit_dirty = 1
	elseif $e == "uninstall"
		; unload: blank every output; ChipOS ignores us until we restart
		$kit_off = 1
		$kit_open = 0
		repeat 8 ($oc)
			output_text($kit_host, $oc, "")
	elseif $e == "clear"
		$kit_clear = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1
		$kit_wdirty = 1
	elseif $e == "wtap"
		$kit_tap = $ev.id
		$kit_wdirty = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1
	elseif $e == "tick"
		$kit_open = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1
	elseif $e == "input"
		$kit_input_id = $ev.id
		$kit_input_text = $ev.text
		$kit_dirty = 1
	elseif $e == "input_cancel"
		$kit_input_id = $ev.id
		$kit_input_cancel = 1
		$kit_dirty = 1

function @kit_invalidate()
	$kit_dirty = 1

; Ask ChipOS for text from the keyboard.
function @kit_input($id : text, $prompt : text, $init : text)
	if $kit_off
		return
	$kit_rq += 1
	var $rq_t = text("{}", $kit_rq)
	output_text($kit_host, 2, ".rq{" & $rq_t & "}.id{" & $id & "}.prompt{" & $prompt & "}.init{" & $init & "}")

; Beep on ChipOS's buzzers.
function @kit_beep($f : number, $d : number)
	if $kit_off
		return
	$kit_bq += 1
	var $bq_t = text("{}", $kit_bq)
	var $bf_t = text("{}", $f)
	var $bd_t = text("{}", $d)
	output_text($kit_host, 3, ".rq{" & $bq_t & "}.f{" & $bf_t & "}.d{" & $bd_t & "}")

; Redraw while open, at most once a second unless something happened.
function @kit_should_draw() : number
	return $kit_open and $kit_dirty and (!$kit_off)

function @kit_begin()
	$kit_frame = ""

function @kit_add($el : text)
	if $kit_frame != ""
		$kit_frame = $kit_frame & "|"
	$kit_frame = $kit_frame & $el

function @kit_text($x : number, $y : number, $size : number, $color : text, $t : text)
	@kit_add(text("T~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $size, $color) & $t)

function @kit_text_c($x : number, $y : number, $size : number, $color : text, $t : text)
	@kit_add(text("C~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $size, $color) & $t)

function @kit_button($id : text, $x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $label : text)
	@kit_add(text("B~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $w, $h) & $id & "~" & $label)

function @kit_box($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $color : text)
	@kit_add(text("R~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $w, $h) & $color)

function @kit_bar($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $pct : number, $color : text)
	@kit_add(text("G~{}~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $w, $h, $pct) & $color)

function @kit_para($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $size : number, $color : text, $t : text)
	@kit_add(text("P~{}~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $w, $size, $color) & $t)

function @kit_grid($x : number, $y : number, $w : number, $h : number, $cols : number, $rows : number, $cells : text)
	@kit_add(text("M~{}~{}~{}~{}~{}~{}~", $x, $y, $w, $h, $cols, $rows) & $cells)

function @kit_end()
	$kit_dirty = 0
	if $kit_off
		return
	if $kit_frame != $kit_sent
		$kit_sent = $kit_frame
		output_text($kit_host, 1, $kit_frame)

; Widgets: time to redraw? (about once a second, or right after a tap)
function @kit_widget_due() : number
	if $kit_off
		return 0
	if $kit_wdirty or (time >= $kit_wnext)
		$kit_wdirty = 0
		$kit_wnext = time + 1
		return 1
	return 0

function @kit_wend($n : number)
	if $kit_off
		return
	if ($n >= 0) and ($n < $kit_wsent.size)
		if $kit_frame != $kit_wsent.$n
			$kit_wsent.$n = $kit_frame
			output_text($kit_host, 4 + $n, $kit_frame)

; Events from ChipOS arrive on whatever port the router is on.
input.0 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
	$kit_rx = $c0

input.15 ($c0 : text, $c1 : text, $c2 : text, $c3 : text)
